jobs.title: Specialist Performance | BHP Chile
jobs.description:
Sobre BHP

En BHP Chile, nuestra oficina corporativa en Santiago es el corazón estratégico de nuestras operaciones en el país. Desde aquí lideramos proyectos que impulsan la minería responsable y la innovación, conectando el impacto local con la visión global de BHP. Somos parte de una compañía dedicada a los recursos naturales presente en más de 90 ubicaciones en el mundo, dedicada a crear un futuro más sostenible.

¿Por qué BHP Chile?

Porque aquí tendrás la oportunidad de crecer en una organización que valora la diversidad, fomenta el desarrollo profesional y apuesta por tecnologías que transforman la industria minera. En BHP Chile podrás generar impacto real en la comunidad y el medioambiente, mientras construyes tu carrera en una empresa reconocida por su cultura inclusiva y su compromiso con el futuro. 

El desafío que te espera

BHP se encuentra en búsqueda de Specialist Performance, quién estará encargado de crear informes y análisis de mantenimiento precisos, oportunos y relevantes que describen el desempeño del mantenimiento en todas las métricas de resultado y proceso, anticipando y mitigando el riesgo.

Principales funciones

Analiza y modela los datos para extraer ideas y soluciones que aborden las hipótesis y los desafíos empresariales.

Impulsa la mejora del negocio a través de la medición del rendimiento de BHP.

Diseña e implementa prácticas de gestión o aseguramiento y procedimientos de gestión de cambios para controlar los resultados de valor en todo BHP.

Busca información, planifica y realiza análisis para respaldar la toma de decisiones basadas en pruebas.

Identifica, involucra y gestiona una amplia gama de grupos de interés internas y externas.

Toma decisiones estratégicas y basadas en pruebas en conformidad con los objetivos comerciales de largo plazo.

Traduce los objetivos corporativos en planes de acción comunicando, gestionando y analizando la aplicación de dichos planes, e informando sobre su progreso para facilitar la ejecución de nuestra estrategia.

Determina la causa subyacente de los problemas y evalúa diferentes soluciones para garantizar un enfoque planificado y estructurado a fin de resolver problemas complejos.

Conoce a nuestro cliente y se apasiona por satisfacer sus necesidades.

Se esfuerza por conseguir el 100% en términos de seguridad y valor para el cliente, y el 0 % en términos de desperdicios.

Aprovecha las capacidades de los miembros de toda la organización.

Lo que esperamos de ti

Título profesional de Ingeniería Mecánica, Eléctrica, Industrial, Minería o Electromecánica.  

Contar con mínimo 5 años de experiencia comprobable en mantenimiento de equipos mineros.

Conocimiento en mejoramiento continuo.

Conocimiento avanzado y experiencia de las diversas plataformas de datos, herramientas y uso de tecnología para análisis y visualización.

Experiencia en exposición a datos y resolución de problemas con experiencia significativa en impulsar proyectos de mejora.

Experiencia en Gestión de Activos.

Experiencia Gestión de Proyectos.

Sistemas y Herramientas ERP. 

Manejo Microsoft Office nivel avanzado.

Disponibilidad para trabajar en Santiago, bajo la modalidad de turno 5x2 con viajes esporádicos a faena.

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí

BHP Chile entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.  

- Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.  

- Remuneración: justa y competitiva que refleje tu rol, habilidades y logros. 

- Cultura inclusiva: Promovemos un entorno laboral donde cada persona se siente valorada, respetada y libre de expresar su identidad auténtica. 

- Reconocimiento: Te recompensamos por tus pequeños y grandes logros a través de nuestro programa global de reconocimiento Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias. 

¡Y mucho más! 

Sobre nuestro proceso

En BHP contratamos personas que se alinean con nuestros valores y cumplen con los requisitos del rol. Para esto, y como parte del proceso, podríamos revisar el cumplimiento de requisitos mínimos, 

Si ya trabajas en BHP, postula a través del portal interno con tu correo corporativo.  

¿Y por qué no tú?

Nuestra compañía te ofrece oportunidades sin límites. Desde beneficios competitivos hasta la posibilidad de trabajar en distintos países, aquí puedes diseñar tu carrera a tu manera. Si estás buscando un lugar donde tu trabajo tenga propósito y tu crecimiento sea parte del camino, este puede ser tu próximo paso.  

¡Postula hoy y sé parte de la transformación de la minería! 

Apoyamos una fuerza laboral diversa 

En BHP nos adherimos a la Ley de Inclusión 21.015.  

Sabemos que la diversidad nos fortalece. Es por eso por lo que estamos enfocados en crear una fuerza laboral más diversa que represente las comunidades en las que operamos y vivimos, asegurando un ambiente laboral donde cada persona sea incluida y tratada con respeto.  

En ese sentido, estamos comprometidos a realizar un proceso de selección justo, equitativo y accesible para todos. Si tienes algún tipo de discapacidad, por favor escríbenos a inclusion@bhp.com para poder ajustar nuestro proceso de selección y brindarte el apoyo necesario.

Freeport-McMoRan es una empresa minera internacional líder con sede central en Phoenix, Arizona. La compañía tiene una cartera dinámica de proyectos de operación, expansión y crecimiento en la industria del cobre. Freeport-McMoRan es uno de los mayores productores mundiales de cobre que cotiza en bolsa, el mayor productor mundial de molibdeno y un importante productor de oro.

Lo alentamos a que se tome el tiempo para explorar la oportunidad de tener una carrera en Freeport-McMoRan.

Description

The Project Engineer – Pipelines will support the planning, coordination, and execution of pipeline engineering activities across the project lifecycle, contributing to the safe, efficient, and timely delivery of pipeline infrastructure. Coordinate pipeline engineering and project execution activities, including technical reviews, progress tracking, documentation, and risk identification.

Support schedules, milestones, budgets, cost estimates, forecasts, resource planning, and project deliverables.

Promote compliance with safety, environmental, quality, and risk management requirements.

Engineering degree or global equivalent. 

Minimum five years of related work experience.

Experience in mining fluid transportation systems such as water, concentrate, tailings, slurry, or reclaimed water pipelines.

Strong technical knowledge, communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively under schedule requirements.

Technical English, with ability to interact with Spanish-speaking and English-speaking stakeholders.

Professional certification or registration, if required by local regulations

Experience in large-scale mining projects involving long-distance pipelines, pumping systems, hydraulic design, and multidisciplinary execution.

Strategic thinking, accountability, adaptability, analytical problem-solving, proactive reporting, and technical writing skills.

Basic proficiency in office, spreadsheet, presentation, email, and project management tools.

Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their career. 
Apply Today!   

Where You Will Work  

Our rod and refining plant in El Paso, Texas, is a key contributor to our ranking as one of the world’s largest manufacturers of continuous cast copper rod – a main material used in the manufacturing of wire and cable products. The refinery has the potential to operate at an annual production capacity of about 900 million pounds of copper cathode, which is sufficient to refine all the copper anode we produce at our Miami operations in Arizona. The refinery also produces nickel carbonate, copper telluride and autoclaved slimes material containing gold, silver, platinum and palladium.  

The beautiful city of El Paso features three universities, many community colleges and numerous schools. Some popular attractions include the International Museum of Art, National Border Patrol Museum and Franklin Mountain State Park. There are many shopping centers, parks, hiking trails and numerous restaurants for our employees and their families to enjoy.   

What You Will Do

Under general supervision, provide expertise and leadership in scheduling and prioritizing contracting activities at assigned site. Oversee safety, quality, and performance of outside service contractors. Serve as site expert and Company representative, interfacing with contractors and multiple disciplines within the company on contracting activities.

Perform contracting activities through the administration of contract requests, participating in sourcing activities and award recommendations, onboarding and offboarding of contractors, and issuing routine correspondence

Ensure contracts assigned are maintained and updated and that the payment methods are in place to ensure prompt payment to contractors

Review and approve invoices for correctness and accuracy of contractor work

Lead and drive collaborative sourcing efforts with stakeholders in outsourcing activities to include, but not limited to, insourcing/outsourcing decisions, development of scopes of work, and contractor performance activities

Establish and monitor planned contractor schedules for plant/equipment within assigned area; review and assist in prioritizing work schedules; review and report on contracting budgets and run rates mitigating any potential risks

Monitor and report safety, health, and environmental requirements; ensure manpower and work force skills are adequate and quality standards are met

Utilize tools and resources in communicating contractor requirements and follow up on contractor work quality and completion

Master a working knowledge of Company’s contracting standards, programs, and goals

Perform other duties as required

What You Bring To Freeport

High School diploma or GED
and
four (4) years of specific experience in maintenance, supply chain, or operations within a mining/manufacturing environment,
OR

High School diploma or GED
and
four (4) years related experience in maintenance, supply chain, or operations within a mining/manufacturing environment including specific Planning experience,
OR

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Accounting, Engineering or related field, with no experience required

Working knowledge of contracting activities

What We Offer You

$65,000-$90,000

Chino is an open-pit copper mining complex located 15 miles from the historic mining community of Silver City in southwestern New Mexico. The historic Chino mine was among the world's first low-grade, open-pit copper mines. Today, the operation consists of a 36,000-metric-ton-per-day concentrator that produces copper and a 150-million-pound-per-year solvent extraction/electrowinning plant that produces copper cathode from solution generated by run-of-mine leaching.

Silver City

to learn more.

Apply and improve tailings, crushed leach, and water management systems and procedures for assigned active and inactive facilities

Apply relevant standards

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related Engineering discipline from an accredited curriculum, with courses in Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering and five (5) years of experience in an applicable field of expertise

Master’s degree in Geotechnical Engineering or related Engineering discipline from an accredited curriculum, with courses in Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering and three (3) years of experience in an applicable field of expertise.

Knowledge of the principles and practices of Civil, Geologic, Geotechnical, or Hydrologic Engineering or a related field of Science or Engineering

jobs.title: Superintendente de Permisos
jobs.description:
Freeport-McMoRan es una empresa minera internacional líder con sede central en Phoenix, Arizona. Operamos grandes activos, de larga vida, geográficamente diversos con importantes reservas probadas y probables de cobre, oro y molibdeno. La compañía tiene una cartera dinámica de proyectos de operación, expansión y crecimiento en la industria del cobre. Freeport-McMoRan es uno de los mayores productores mundiales de cobre que cotiza en bolsa, el mayor productor mundial de molibdeno y un importante productor de oro.

Lo alentamos a que se tome el tiempo para explorar la oportunidad de tener una carrera en Freeport-McMoRan.

Descripción

Superintendente de Permisos

La función principal consiste en liderar y gestionar la estrategia de permisos sectoriales y ambientales para las operaciones y proyectos de la compañía, asegurando el cumplimiento regulatorio y la obtención oportuna de las autorizaciones necesarias para la continuidad y desarrollo del negocio. Asimismo, coordina la interacción con autoridades, organismos fiscalizadores y partes interesadas, administrando recursos y equipos de trabajo bajo criterios de seguridad, sostenibilidad y excelencia operacional. Todo lo anterior realizado en forma eficiente, con seguridad, calidad y enfoque en la producción segura, garantizando así la continuidad operacional del área.

Funciones Esenciales 

Asegurar la correcta elaboración de los permisos sectoriales aplicables en la faena minera, asegurando el cumplimiento del programa y control de costos.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de la legislación ambiental y sectorial para cada uno de los permisos a tramitar.

Identificar riesgos y oportunidades en el proceso de elaboración y tramitación de los permisos.

Administrar las consultoras sectoriales contratadas para la elaboración y tramitación de los permisos.

Coordinar la entrega de información proveniente de áreas operacionales, de proyectos y de ingeniería para garantizar la elaboración y tramitación de los permisos, asegurando que las estrategias definidas contemplen aspectos claves de los proyectos.

Administrar equipos de trabajo y presupuestos asignados a su responsabilidad.

Realizar actividades que promuevan e impacten la seguridad, el medio ambiente, la eficiencia energética, la igualdad de género y la excelencia operacional.

Ejecutar cualquier tarea correspondiente a su área de trabajo que le sea asignada. 

Calificaciones

Requisitos Mínimos

Título profesional en Ingeniería, Ingeniería Ambiental, Biología, Química, Ingeniería Forestal, Ingeniería Agronómica o carrera afín

Experiencia mínima de diez años en la gestión y tramitación de permisos sectoriales y/o en el desarrollo y evaluación de proyectos sometidos al Sistema de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental (SEIA), idealmente en el sector minero

Conocimiento de normativa sectorial y ambiental asociada a grandes proyectos de inversión.

Licencia de conducir Clase B, con al menos dos años de antigüedad.

Manejo de herramientas computacionales (MS Office, MS Project, Google Earth, SIG, entre otras)

Calificaciones Preferentes

Compromiso con la seguridad y salud ocupacional.

Compromiso con la sustentabilidad, el medio ambiente y el uso eficiente de la energía.

Compromiso con la comunidad e igualdad de género y conciliación de la vida laboral, familiar y personal.

Visión de Negocio.

Toma de decisiones

Planificación y organización.

Liderazgo y desarrollo de equipos.

Dominio de inglés intermedio (oral y escrito).

Deseable experiencia en consultoría ambiental o liderando procesos de evaluación ambiental y sectorial de proyectos, ya sea en calidad de titular, consultor(a) o evaluador(a).

jobs.title: Ingeniero o Ingeniera Senior de Permisos
jobs.description:
Freeport-McMoRan es una empresa minera internacional líder con sede central en Phoenix, Arizona. Operamos grandes activos, de larga vida, geográficamente diversos con importantes reservas probadas y probables de cobre, oro y molibdeno. La compañía tiene una cartera dinámica de proyectos de operación, expansión y crecimiento en la industria del cobre. Freeport-McMoRan es uno de los mayores productores mundiales de cobre que cotiza en bolsa, el mayor productor mundial de molibdeno y un importante productor de oro.

Lo alentamos a que se tome el tiempo para explorar la oportunidad de tener una carrera en Freeport-McMoRan.

Descripción

Ingeniero o Ingeniera Senior de Permisos

La función principal consiste en la tramitación de permisos sectoriales y ambientales en el marco del Sistema de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental (SEIA) para proyectos de inversión, el cual será responsable de desarrollar, analizar, coordinar y supervisar la elaboración y obtención de los permisos necesarios para la operación de la faena minera, asegurando además la administración de presupuestos y la participación de las partes interesadas en todo el proceso. Todo lo anterior realizado en forma eficiente, con seguridad, calidad y enfoque en la producción segura, garantizando así la continuidad operacional del área.

Funciones Esenciales 

Asegurar la correcta elaboración de los permisos ambientales y sectoriales asignados a su responsabilidad, asegurando el cumplimiento del programa establecido.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de la legislación ambiental y sectorial para cada uno de los permisos a tramitar.

Identificar riesgos y oportunidades en el proceso de elaboración y tramitación de los permisos.

Administrar las consultoras ambientales y sectoriales contratadas para la elaboración y tramitación de los permisos.

Coordinar las tareas asignadas con áreas operacionales, de proyectos y de ingeniería para garantizar la elaboración y tramitación de los permisos, asegurando que las estrategias definidas contemplen aspectos claves de los proyectos.

Coordinar con la Gerencia de Diálogo Comunitario la participación de comunidades en el proceso de elaboración y tramitación de los permisos cuando corresponda.

Administrar equipos de trabajo y presupuestos asignados a su responsabilidad.

Realizar actividades que promuevan e impacten la seguridad, el medio ambiente, la eficiencia energética, la igualdad de género y la excelencia operacional.

Ejecutar tareas correspondientes a su área de trabajo que le sean asignadas.

Calificaciones

Requisitos Mínimos 

Título profesional en Ingeniería Ambiental, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Forestal, Agronomía, Biología o carrera afín.

Experiencia de al menos ocho años en la gestión y tramitación de proyectos sometidos al Sistema de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental (SEIA), idealmente en el sector minero.

Conocimiento de normativa sectorial y ambiental asociada a proyectos mineros o grandes proyectos de inversión.

Licencia de conducir Clase B, con al menos dos años de antigüedad.

Manejo de herramientas computacionales (MS Office, MS Project, Google Earth, SIG, entre otras).

Calificaciones Preferentes

Compromiso con la seguridad y salud ocupacional.

Compromiso con la sustentabilidad, el medio ambiente y el uso eficiente de la energía.

Compromiso con la comunidad e igualdad de género y conciliación de la vida laboral, familiar y personal.

Visión de negocios

Toma de decisiones

Planificación y organización.

Liderazgo y desarrollo de equipos.

Dominio de inglés básico (oral y escrito).

Deseable experiencia en consultoría ambiental o liderando procesos de evaluación ambiental y sectorial de proyectos, ya sea como titular, consultor(a) o evaluador(a) en el SEIA.

jobs.title: Ingeniero o Ingeniera de Permisos I
jobs.description:
Freeport-McMoRan es una empresa minera internacional líder con sede central en Phoenix, Arizona. Operamos grandes activos, de larga vida, geográficamente diversos con importantes reservas probadas y probables de cobre, oro y molibdeno. La compañía tiene una cartera dinámica de proyectos de operación, expansión y crecimiento en la industria del cobre. Freeport-McMoRan es uno de los mayores productores mundiales de cobre que cotiza en bolsa, el mayor productor mundial de molibdeno y un importante productor de oro.

Lo alentamos a que se tome el tiempo para explorar la oportunidad de tener una carrera en Freeport-McMoRan.

Descripción

Ingeniero o Ingeniera de Permisos I

La función priencipal consiste en la tramitación de los permisos sectoriales necesarios para el desarrollo de nuevos proyectos o modificaciones operacionales. Tendrá la responsabilidad de realizar supervisiones en terreno en caso de ser necesario y gestionar y validar la información técnica elaborada por el área de ingeniería y consultoras externas. En caso de requerirse, deberá participar en reuniones con las autoridades sectoriales, para lo cual deberá ser capaz de elaborar el material técnico de respaldo. Todo lo anterior realizado en forma eficiente, con seguridad, calidad y enfoque en la producción segura, garantizando así la continuidad operacional del área.

Funciones Esenciales

Supervisar la elaboración y tramitación de los permisos sectoriales asignados, asegurando la gestión de costos de cada uno de ellos.

Revisar y validar los reportes técnicos, planos u otro documento necesario para la elaboración los permisos sectoriales.

Asegurar la congruencia entre lo dispuesto en el permiso ambiental y los permisos sectoriales bajo su competencia.

Revisar, validar y asegurar la programación establecida para la elaboración de los permisos sectoriales asignados, tanto del área Ingeniería como de las consultoras externas.

Actualizar la matriz de requerimientos de los permisos asignados.

Elaborar informes de avance semanal de las actividades asignadas.

Llevar la gestión del software para manejo de los permisos de su competencia
.

Realizar actividades que promuevan e impacten la seguridad, el medio ambiente, la eficiencia energética, la igualdad de género y la excelencia operacional.

Ejecutar cualquier tarea correspondiente a su área de trabajo que le sea asignada

Calificaciones

Título en Ingeniería Ambiental, Ingeniería Civil, Biología o carrera afín al ámbito ambiental o a la gestión de permisos sectoriales.

Manejo de herramientas computacionales (MS Office, MS Project, Google Earth, SIG, entre otras).

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Control Diagnostic Electrician
jobs.description:
At Climax Molybdenum, we are committed to providing an employment package that recognizes excellence, encourages safe production and a culture supported by our core values. Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their career.  

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Where You Will Work

Our Henderson mine and mill are an hour drive apart – separated by the Continental Divide and a 15-mile conveyor system (10 miles underground). The Henderson mine is an underground molybdenum mining operation located approximately 42 miles west of Denver and 10 miles west of Empire. It has been in operation since 1976 and today consists of a large block-cave, underground mining complex feeding a concentrator with a current capacity of approximately 32,000 metric tons per day. It can produce approximately 15 million pounds of molybdenum per year. The Henderson mill is located 15 miles west of the mine, between Dillon and Kremmling.  

Both sites are surrounded by 
US Forest Service
 land of the 
Arapaho National Forest
, making it easy for our employees and their families to enjoy year-round hiking, cross-country skiing, and snowshoeing in the area. Explore the opportunity to advance your career at one of our sites – the Henderson mine or mill and live life at the top!   

Employees who are required to work on-site are eligible for a $1,450 monthly housing allowance, provided they meet program guidelines.

What You Will Do

Removal, repair and installation of electrical components, electrical systems, analysis and diagnosis, advanced troubleshooting and systems/process optimization; may mentor or train other electrical workers

Safe completion of routine and non-routine repairs and construction

Perform preventative maintenance including installation, repair and troubleshooting of industrical electrical and/or instrumentation equipment (i.e. substations, power distribution systems, switchgear motors, motor controls, systems and components, process controls, instrumentation and pneumatic equipment)

Must have strong knowledge in the maintenance and troubleshooting of AC/DC drives, PLCs, overhead cranes, management control systems, calibration of field transmitters/transducers and weigh scales, and low and medium voltage equipment

Ability to perform installations and renovations compliant with regulatory agency standards

Follow Standard Operating Procedues (SOP) and work area instructions, participate in safety and environmental activities, and use plant and equipment correctly at all times

Completion of an approved Certified Electronics, Electrical and/or Instrumentation Program, 
OR 

Minimum of four (4) years of experience in Industrial Electrical and/or Instrumentation repair and maintenance, 
OR 

Associate's degree or Trade School Certification in a related field 
and 
two (2) years of experience in Industrial Electrical and/or Instrumentation repair and maintenance 

Experience in troubleshooting, maintenance and repair of electrical circuits and connected equipment; this includes the ability to read, understand and apply information from technical manuals, prints, and schematics for trouble shooting and repair 

Effective written and verbal communication skills to satisfy training, safety, and electronic message transmission policies of the company 

Must have minimum personal tools as described by the department tool list or be able to obtain them within 90 days of hire date 

Must have completed academic and practical competencies required (this includes Line of Progression requirements for internal employees where LOP Exists) and have experience demonstrating the required aptitude. The selected candidate shall demonstrate the ability to apply knowledge and skills while also passing a written assessment where required. This exam is based on skills/abilities and/or academic knowledge; as well as safety. 

Preferred Qualifications

High School diploma or GED 

Experience with VFDs, PLC, HMI, and/or SCADA Control Systems 

Experience working with low and medium voltages 

Experience with AC and/or DC controls 

Experience with instrumentation devices

Experience with HVAC equipment

jobs.title: Quality Lead - China Operations
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Work Location: Shanghai, China 

Roster: Monday to Friday Full Time

The Quality Lead – China Operations is responsible for providing quality leadership, governance and assurance across Fortescue’s China-based supply chain activities, supporting the China Operations team and relevant project and procurement stakeholders.

The role acts as the primary Quality focal point within China, ensuring equipment, materials and supplier services are planned, manufactured, inspected, tested, released and documented in accordance with Fortescue specified requirements, applicable project requirements, contracts, purchase orders, codes and standards.

The position will work closely with China Operations, Project Delivery, Engineering, Procurement, Package Management, suppliers, sub-suppliers and Quality Service Providers to proactively identify and manage quality risks across the supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

•    Lead and champion Fortescue Quality requirements and expectations across China Operations and the associated supply chain.
•    Act as the primary Quality focal point for China-based suppliers, manufacturers and sub-suppliers.
•    Support implementation of the Fortescue Quality Management Framework and applicable Project Quality Management Plans.
•    Plan and conduct supplier/contractor Quality Maturity Assessments, audits and performance reviews. Report and track close out of findings. Monitor supplier/contractor effectiveness of these actions.
•    Provide Quality input into procurement and supplier engagement, including quality requirements within scopes of work, purchase orders, contracts, SDRL/CDRL requirements and supplier deliverables.
•    Facilitate and participate in equipment and services criticality assessments and ensure resulting inspection and intervention requirements are implemented.
•    Review supplier Quality Plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), procedures, inspection records, manufacturing documentation and Manufacturers Data Reports as applicable.
•    Plan, coordinate and oversee supplier surveillance, inspections, Factory Acceptance Tests and other verification activities within China.
•    Coordinate Fortescue personnel and nominated second- and third-party Quality Service Providers undertaking inspection and surveillance activities.
•    Review Notifications of Inspection and determine appropriate Fortescue inspection, witness, surveillance or document-review responses.
•    Monitor supplier manufacturing quality performance and proactively identify emerging risks, trends and areas requiring intervention.
•    Ensure identified non-conformities are appropriately captured, communicated and managed through the Fortescue NCR process and PIMS workflow.
•    Verify quality records, inspection outcomes, NCR status, technical queries, punch-list items, documentation and preservation requirements in support of equipment release.
•    Support completion and authorisation processes associated with Inspection Release Certificates where delegated.
•    Establish effective working relationships between the Quality function, China Operations, project teams, procurement, engineering, logistics and suppliers/contractors.
•    Provide coaching and guidance to China Operations personnel and suppliers on Fortescue Quality requirements, processes and strategies.
•    Provide regular reporting to the Quality Manager and General Manager on Supplier/Contractor performance, inspection activities, key quality risks, NCRs, upcoming interventions and areas requiring management attention.

Qualifications and Experience

•    University degree in Engineering or significant Quality Management experience in major and/or mega projects, or manufacturing;
•    Quality inspection related qualifications Examples: CSWIP, EEHA and:
•    Trade qualification Examples: Electrician, Boiler Maker, Welder, Mechanical Fitter.    
•    Minimum 5 years’ experience in a role of Quality Lead or Snr Quality Advisor Role
•    Experience providing quality execution throughout design, procurement, construction, commissioning and start up. i.e. Owner Operator, EPC, EPCM, EPCI
•    Experience with risk-based Quality assessment. 
•    Experience working with and/or within OEM providers.  
•    High level written skills with excellent attention to detail.  
•    High level of passion for renewable energy.  
•    Proven ability for credible and authentic engagement with strong interpersonal skills.
•    Ability to communicate in English and Chinese

About Us

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Work Location: 
Perth. Fortescue’s Perth office is located on the traditional lands of the Whadjuk Noongar people.

Roster: 
Monday to Friday

The AI Capability Facilitator will build practical AI capability across Fortescue by delivering engaging, hands-on learning experiences for team members with different roles, levels of confidence and AI capability.

The role requires someone who combines strong facilitation and training capability with credible technical knowledge of AI. They need to be able to take something technically complex and make it practical, relevant and usable, whether they are working with someone using AI for the first time or a more advanced user looking to extend how they apply it.

Key Responsibilities

Facilitate practical AI learning for beginner, intermediate and advanced audiences.

Deliver face-to-face workshops, virtual learning sessions, demonstrations, practical labs and other capability-building experiences.

Facilitate sessions for a broad range of audiences, from operational team members through to leaders and specialist functions.

Adapt facilitation style, language and content to different levels of AI knowledge, confidence and technical capability.

Create an environment where team members can experiment with AI, ask questions, test ideas and learn through practice.

Demonstrate AI tools and use cases live and confidently respond to technical and practical questions.

Help team members move beyond understanding AI to applying it effectively in their day-to-day work.

Facilitate conversations that identify opportunities for AI to improve work, solve problems or create value.

Support the development and continuous improvement of workshops, learning materials, exercises and facilitator resources.

Work closely with AI specialists and the AI Learning Designer to ensure learning remains technically accurate, practical and current.

Stay across emerging AI technologies, tools, use cases and ways of working and incorporate relevant developments into learning.

Travel to Fortescue operational sites as required to deliver learning and capability-building activities.

Exceptional facilitation and training capability, including both face-to-face and virtual delivery.

Strong practical knowledge of generative AI and contemporary AI tools.

Ability to explain technical concepts simply without oversimplifying them.

Confidence facilitating groups with significantly different levels of AI capability in the same environment.

Ability to facilitate highly interactive, hands-on learning rather than relying primarily on presentation-based training.

Strong communication, questioning and group engagement skills.

Comfortable demonstrating technology live and troubleshooting in the moment.

Able to build credibility with both technically sophisticated audiences and people who are completely new to AI.

Comfortable working across corporate and operational environments and travelling to Fortescue sites.

Curious, adaptable and motivated to continually learn as AI technology develops.

jobs.title: Industrial Placement (2027-2028) - Control Systems - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (September 2027 - August 2028) student placement programme within our Formula E Control Systems group. This is an exciting opportunity where you will work with highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates who you can learn and develop with - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience.   It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Control Systems group you should be working towards a degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive, Electronics, Mechatronics, Software or Motorsport Engineering.  An understanding of vehicle dynamics would be advantageous.

What you will do

During the placement you will take on responsibilities such as:

Working as an integral part of Car Development Team

Developing control strategies using the MATLAB toolchain for both our on-car and off-car environments, DIL, HIL, to optimise the vehicle control software and realise quantifiable reductions in lap time over a race weekend.

Developing of new methodologies and test procedures to ensure we achieve and maintain a high level of code test coverage within our Vehicle Control Module, Inverter and Motor Control software.

Testing of our hardware and control modules across a variety of test facilities.

Preparation and support of systems on operational vehicles at test and race events

Overall, you will contribute to make our car faster, more reliable and more efficient.

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

• Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

• Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take. 

• Relevant leisure pursuits and activities. 

• Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

Next Steps

Those students that are shortlisted will be invited to attend an assessment.  It is expected that the student takes sole responsibility for making suitable travel and accommodation arrangements.

Our Commitment

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. At Fortescue Zero we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences and skills.  

Fortescue Zero is an equal opportunity employer who values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability, 

We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.

jobs.description:

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Senior Engineer to join the Motorsport & Advanced Engineering department.

About the role

The motorsport and advanced engineering team have project workload that requires an experienced design engineer with a strong skillset of mechanical design, ideally in the context of electrification. The projects are high performance in nature, with a focus on lightweight and powerful systems across motorsport, defence and other applications.

What you will do

As a member of the design and analysis engineering team your duties will include:

Responsible for design across mechanical, electrical and thermal projects

Lead engineering design principles across multiple disciplines

Line management of engineers, with responsibility for output and professional development

Represent Fortescue Zero in front of customers and suppliers

Effective communication with other engineering teams

Continuously improve engineering and business systems and processes

Create Design Verification Plans

Interpret regulations and standards, then develop plans to demonstrate conformity

Project planning of resource and tasks to meet requirements

Problem solving and fault rectification

In addition, your duties may also include:

Conducting design reviews and drawing checking

Design for performance, efficiency and total cost optimisation

Occasional event or test support

Responsibility for the health and safety of those working on a project

Develop supply chain

Must have high quality mechanical design experience (>5 years) in high performance applications such as motorsport, defence, aerospace.

Significant exposure to HV systems, energy storage and low volume applications is highly desirable

Composites and structural design with FEA experience is advantageous.

Must be a proficient CAD (Siemens NX preferred) and PLM (Siemens Teamcenter preferred) user.

Demonstrated leadership potential alongside effective communication skills

jobs.title: Maintenance Superintendent - LALNG
jobs.description:
About Woodside

We know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential and working in a positive work environment. We recognise that enduring, meaningful relationships with communities are fundamental to maintaining our licence to operate.

Technology and innovation are essential to our long-term sustainability. We are growing our carbon and new energy businesses using technology to reduce emissions and the carbon footprint of our products. We are working to improving energy efficiency, offset emissions, reduce emissions intensity and explore options for lower-carbon energy. Woodside led the development of the LNG industry in Australia and is applying this same pioneering spirit to solving future energy challenges globally.

Refer to our corporate website for more information about our different locations and projects: 
https://www.woodside.com/what-we-do

About the Role

This position provides leadership and strategic direction to Maintenance teams for their assigned activities with afocus on HSE, quality, cost management and activity duration.

Duties and Responsibilities

Leading HSE and Sustainability

Safety Leader. Accountable for the safe execution of onsite maintenance work Site through the stewardship of the WMS work management processes. (MoC,ISSoW, OSC, Field Leadership, GSR's, FP6, Risk Management, Critical Control Management, etc.)

Able to qualify for Advanced PSCR role within 12 months

Delivering Business Results

Accountable for ensuring teams assigned activities are delivered safely, efficiently and to a quality standard that ensures high reliability

Accountable for developing and forecasting team's annual budgets

Accountable for delivering sustainable top quartile business outcomes through continuous improvement and quality delivery

Responsible for defining and leading new ways of working that deliver improved performance via maintenance management procedures

Responsible for supporting the maintenance build and the review of EPC and Maintenance contractors’ deliverables

Capability Development 

Responsible for maintenance team build-out, capability assessment and succession planning of team members.

Accountable for ensuring all team members’ development plans arein-place and continuously progressed

Accountable for the management and oversight  of maintenance team Training & Competency requirements

Compass Values

Encourage and support team diversity and inclusivity

Demonstrates our compass values of Respect, Working Together, Discipline, Integrity, Excellence and Working Sustainably

Leadership Effectiveness

Accountable forteam performance by setting clear expectations and managing team accordingly

Accountable for the team culture and the health and wellbeing of all team members.

Demonstrate leadershipin all aspects of role

Internal 

Maintenance Teamsand Managers

Engineering & Project Teams

Operations

P&GC

Contracting and Procurement

Finance

External 

Contract/SME Specialists

Skilled level of competence in maintenance processes

Skilled level of knowledgein budgeting and project management execution forlarge scale Events.

Ability to lead a multi discipline team

Ability to influence and earn credibility across all levels of the organisation

Strong business acumen and agility tomake good business decisionsin a timely manner under trying conditions

Knowledge in LNG operations, process and equipment

10+ years' experience in same or similar role

jobs.title: Mobile Maintenance - Diesel Fitter
jobs.description:
We are MMG and we mine for progress.

At MMG, our vision is to create a leading international mining company for a low carbon future. 

We mine for progress to create wealth for our people, host communities and shareholders with an ambition to grow and diversify our resource, production and value.  

Our aim is to create a workplace that encourages diversity, inclusion and supports our people to grow.  We are guided by our values; think safety first, respect each other, work together, do what we say, and we want to be better.  We recognise the unique value your contribution makes to the progress of our company and the communities in which we operate. 

Dugald River mine is one of the world’s top 10 Zinc mine operations, which has been producing zinc concentrate for customers around the world since 2017. 

The mine is committed to a low-carbon future. In April 2023 the Dugald River Solar Farm began operations, supplying a third of the mine’s power, and reducing emissions by 33% and this is just the start of its renewable energy transition. 

Dugald River employs around 750 employees and contractors on a mix of fly-in, fly-out and local residential basis.

Mobile Maintenance- Diesel Fitter

We currently have a fantastic career opportunity available for an experienced
Diesel Fitter
to join our Mobile Maintenance team at Dugald River Mine. 

Reporting to the Supervisor, you will provide maintenance support to the Dugald River Mine operations. 

This role is based on an 8/7, 7/6 (Days & Nights) roster, bus in bus out from Cloncurry or Mount Isa. FIFO from Townsville or Brisbane may be considered for exceptional candidates.

Qualifications, skills & Experience

Relevant HME Diesel Fitter qualification

Underground mining equipment maintenance experience is essential

A current C Class Licence

It would also be beneficial if you have:

Dogger / Rigger / Forklift / EWP licences

S1, 2, 3 competency

Cert 2 tyre maintenance

 Responsibilities include

To be successful in this role, you will possess a strong work ethic and good safety leadership.

Planned and breakdown maintenance on HME operating in and underground mining environment.

Ability to be flexible within the role and adapt to a changing environment.

Sound knowledge of SAP.

What we offer 

Remuneration for this role includes a competitive salary package, annual bonus and generous local allowances for employees living in the local community of Cloncurry and Mt Isa. 

On-site accommodation at Dugald River is provided in fully air-conditioned en-suite rooms and includes meal service and room cleaning. The village features, communal media facilities including 4G coverage, onsite Medical Centre, sporting facilities, swimming pool and gym facilities. 

MMG also provides the following generous benefits for employees living in the local community of Cloncurry & Mt. Isa 

Gym/PCYC membership 

Access to MMG Charter flights to Brisbane and Townsville for family/leisure purposes 

Financial support for families where children attend boarding school 

Retention payment for long term Cloncurry residents 

MMG is committed to supporting our local communities of Cloncurry Shire and Mount Isa City Council Local Government Areas. MMG encourages local residents to apply for opportunities at Dugald River. We also support successful candidates to relocate to the region and provide a generous relocation package. 

We are We are an equal opportunity employer who values and respects diversity. If you share our values and feel that you could make a meaningful difference in this role, please apply online. To know more about MMG please visit our webpage
https://www.mmg.com/

Dugald River is committed to the safety of our employees and therefore are a clean-shaven site.

jobs.title: Processing Cadet
jobs.description:
MMG Rosebery -

Where Potential Finds Its Future

This isn't just a job, it’s a lifestyle. You're joining a legacy - in one of Australia's most beautiful locations. 

Play a key role in shaping the future of one of Australia's longest-running mines - a place with 90+ years of history, a close-knit community where everyone knows your name, and a natural environment like no other. This is more than a job: it's a chance to build a career somewhere with room to grow; with less routine, more variety and direct exposure to our senior leaders. Be part of a story that's still being written. 

Want to know more about us? Explore our story here: 
Rosebery – MMG

What's in it for you:

Join a culture built on zero harm, and shared values  

A workplace that fosters diversity and inclusiveness, and supports our people with the systems, skills and behaviours required to live our values.

Earning an income while gaining valuable experience

Developing an understanding of the entire processing cycle, from ore treatment through to final product

Family friendly roster 7 days on 7 days off (day and night shift)

Cadet - Processing

If you enjoy being outdoors, learning and utilising your physical fitness, this is a fantastic career opportunity to solidify a career in mining on a
12-month fixed term
contract.

Reporting to the Supervisor - Processing, your responsibilities will include learning how to operate processing plant equipment in a safe, productive, and efficient manner to maximise plant performance without negatively affecting the environment or the health and safety of personnel.

Key Accountabilities:

Support site safety initiatives.

Contribute positively and actively to promote the MMG Roseberry values and behaviours.

Maintain constant surveillance of assigned work stations to ensure effective and efficient operations of the plant in a safe manner.

Complete shift log sheets and record all daily variances.

Complete area inspection and report conditions.

Conduct clean-up duties where required to ensure plant equipment is functioning properly and safely.

Ensure hazards and sources of loss associated with the process are identified, evaluated and controlled and comply with the company and sites safety standards and procedures at all times

Qualifications & Competencies

To be successful, you will have an unwavering commitment to safe work practices, and MUST be able to pass a pre-employment medical and drug & alcohol screen, along with the following:

Living in Tasmania - with a preference in the North West region

Strong communication skills both written and verbal with a keen motivation for learning

Drivers licence.

Excellent problem-solving skills, time management and attention to detail.

Ability to work effectively and cooperate within a team

Basic computer literacy and the use of Microsoft Office Suite

A proven history with safe work practises, with the ability to identify and address unsafe practices.

If you're ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role that empowers you to shape your work environment, we invite you to apply and join us in our pursuit of efficient and sustainable mining operations.

jobs.title: Senior Buyer
jobs.description:
We Pursue a Higher Standard

We are a U.S.-based, well-diversified, growing precious metals producer with seven wholly-owned operations: the New Afton gold-copper mine in British Columbia, Canada, the Rainy River gold-silver mine in Ontario, Canada, the Las Chispas silver-gold mine in Sonora, Mexico, the Palmarejo gold-silver mine in Chihuahua, Mexico, the Rochester silver-gold mine in Nevada, the Kensington gold mine in Alaska and the Wharf gold mine in South Dakota. In addition, the Company wholly-owns the Silvertip polymetallic critical minerals exploration project in British Columbia, Canada.

Coeur Silvertip is one of the highest-grade silver-zinc lead projects in the world. Coeur is focused on targeted exploration of Silvertip’s large, highly prospective land package. Recent drilling results reinforce Silvertip's growing potential as an emerging tier-one asset for the Company.

Coeur Silvertip prioritizes safety, teamwork, career development and growth. If you want to grow your career in a progressive, team-oriented environment, apply today.

About the Job:

Operating in a Northern British Columbia mining environment on a two week in/two week out shift rotation, the Senior Buyer is responsible for the strategic and day-to-day purchasing, contracting, and inventory management requirements of the Silvertip Operation. The role combines high dollar/strategic commodity sourcing and supplier negotiation with the operational purchasing, warehousing, and inventory control functions that keep the site supplied.

Responsibilities:

Maintain regional responsibility for a strategic and/or high-dollar commodity or group of commodities, for price/value determination, product and/or service negotiations, and terms and conditions;

Develop and implement procurement strategies for managed commodities, including competitive positioning, technology direction, supplier analysis, development and selection, and pricing strategy;

Coordinate the purchase of goods and supplies required for the operation, following the purchasing process including purchase orders, product pricing/requests for quotation, and order reconciliation;

Act as the primary interface with suppliers for relationship management, contract negotiation, establishing the business framework for transactions, performance reviews, business development, and supplier awards programs;

Provide contract and negotiation management services with internal and external service providers;

Evaluate and monitor contract performance to determine the need for amendments or extensions, and compliance with contractual obligations; arbitrate claims or complaints arising in the performance of contracts;

Source all products and services, maintaining continuity of supply while delivering the lowest total cost through RFP and contracting solutions;

Lead negotiations for high-impact commodities, providing guidance on negotiation strategy and planning, developing commodity strategy, and delivering consistent communication to suppliers, including senior executives of industry-leading multi-national companies;

Participate in the commodity negotiation process, ensuring accurate forecasting and pricing;

Conduct strategic analysis on pricing, market conditions, suppliers, customers, competitors, contracts, and long-term agreements; manage data flow for market pricing fluctuations and analytical/commodity management tools;

Provide site direction and performance reporting for cost analysis to senior management, ensuring all reporting is accurately completed in a timely manner;

Act as site liaison to manage critical shortages, develop strategies for constrained commodities, and represent the site on related systems changes affecting purchasing responsibilities;

Drive process improvement, working with the team on the development of IT tools, defining business processes, and implementing new tools/processes;

Perform bid activity for sensitive/highly visible complex bids;

Ensure warehousing functions effectively service the operation;

Provide inventory control services and support to Operations, Maintenance, and the Warehouse;

Conduct quarterly review of all items that have not turned in 365 days;

Conduct quarterly review of inventory items valued at $10,000.00 or greater;

Responsible for new Master Inventory additions through the Stock Request Process;

Supervise, direct, coordinate, and coach the activities of employees engaged in warehousing processes;

Ensure employees are trained and experienced for assigned tasks, and perform pre-operational checks, operate equipment, and carry out job functions according to Safe Operating Procedures;

Monitor equipment and processes, and conduct/direct troubleshooting activities when problems arise.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Minimum 8 years experience in a purchasing role, including exposure to strategic/high-dollar commodity sourcing;

Experience in tendering, negotiating, and awarding service contracts;

Strong purchasing negotiation skills;

Prior supervisory or team-lead experience, ideally within a warehouse or inventory environment;

Mining industry experience desired;

Valid driver's license;

Physically fit to perform the duties of the position.

Additional Information:

Willing to work a two-week rotation schedule, with 12-hour shifts per day at a remote camp.

Eligible for Annual Bonus.

Our current designated marshalling locations are Vancouver, Kelowna, Nanaimo, Calgary, Edmonton, Whitehorse, Teslin, and Watson Lake.

No person working at the Company's facilities in the United States and Canada is to be discriminated against in employment because of race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Mine Superintendent
jobs.description: Mine Superintendent Sector: Mining Operations (Underground) A well-established, privately held natural resources producer is seeking a Mine Superintendent to lead all aspects of mining operations at one of its underground sites. This is a senior operational leadership role reporting into site management, with strong exposure to budgeting, EHS strategy, and regulatory compliance. The Role: The successful candidate will take ownership of production efficiency, safety performance, and cost control across the mine, while developing and executing short and mid-range operational plans in collaboration with the broader site leadership team. Key Responsibilities: Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional departments to shape both short and long-term mine planning and operational strategy Lead through front-line supervisors to translate operational targets into daily execution, with regular reporting and performance follow-up Drive workforce planning, performance management, and development initiatives through the front-line leadership team Maintain close daily coordination with the wider site team to proactively manage issues affecting production or downstream processing Own the departmental budgeting cycle end-to-end, including tracking against targets and adjusting plans as conditions change Manage regulatory inspection processes, ensuring documentation, findings, and corrective actions are handled promptly and effectively Build a strong safety culture by setting clear EHS expectations, auditing performance, and driving continuous improvement across health, safety, and environmental practices Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering or a related field preferred 10+ years' experience in mine operations management, including capital project delivery Relevant mine safety certification preferred Strong working knowledge of mine safety regulations and best practice Proficiency across standard office, budgeting, and mine planning software systems Valid driver's license Environment: Underground operation with regular exposure to outdoor and underground working conditions.

jobs.description:
Location
: Las Vegas, NV or Denver, CO

Duration
: 12 weeks

About the Role

The Mining Engineering Intern will partner closely with the Mine Planning and Operations teams to support engineering projects for our Nevada Projects portfolio.

This is a project-based internship. Rather than generalized administrative tasks, you will be assigned a core technical project to own from start to finish. This role offers hands-on experience, culminating in an end-of-program presentation to technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Take ownership of a dedicated 12-week project, managing timelines, and delivering a final technical report and presentation.

Learn to review and develop mine engineering deliverables, including short-range or long-range mine plans, scheduling, and drill & blast designs.

Assist the team in technical trade-off studies, haulage optimizations, or equipment sizing evaluations to support operational efficiency.

Support the design, execution, and data analysis of mine production tracking and continuous improvement programs alongside the engineering team.

Qualifications & Requirements

Currently enrolled as a rising senior in an Undergraduate program or final-year Master's or PhD student pursuing a degree in Mining Engineering or a related discipline.

Foundational understanding of open-pit or underground mining methods, mine planning principles, and earthmoving equipment operations.

Familiarity with or strong interest in mine planning software platforms (e.g., Vulcan, Deswik, Hexagon) is a plus.

Strong technical writing, reporting, and presentation skills.

Ability to analyze datasets, draw logical conclusions, and present findings clearly.

A collaborative mindset with an eagerness to learn and proactively ask questions.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Valid driver's license required; willingness to travel to project sites if necessary.

Fall Recruitment Timeline & Hiring Milestones

September 15 - October 30, 2026 (Application Review): Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Early submission is highly encouraged.

Successful applicants will move to a virtual interview with the internship program manager.

October 12 - November 6, 2026 (Final Rounds): Finalists are invited to a virtual hiring manager interview.

November 16 - 20, 2026 (Offers Extended): Final hiring decisions and official offer letters will be extended before the winter university break.

Compensation
:

Las Vegas, Nevada: Market Related

Denver, Colorado: $27/hour for Undergraduate interns; $35/hour for Graduate interns.

Job Summary-

Metals & Mining, Power Generation, Process Manufacturing

We are looking for dynamic professionals with a passion for manufacturing and digital transformation to join our team driving next-generation industrial operations. You will work at the intersection of
operations, analytics, AI/ML, and automation
, helping leading manufacturing clients reimagine efficiency, reliability, and performance.

Responsibilities:

Lead or contribute to digital and analytics engagements across plant operations, supply chain, and asset management.

Identify operational pain points and translate them into analytics-based solutions and AI/ML use cases.

Conduct diagnostics, site studies, and data-driven assessments to uncover improvement opportunities.

Job Description

Job Title Supervisor, Mining
Reporting to Superintendent, Mining
Business Unit / Function GGM
Department Mining Production - GGM
Grade M10

Why This Role Matters
The role is Supervisor Mining is responsible for overseeing and coordinating mining activities at a designated mine site. This role involves managing a team of mining operators, ensuring adherence to safety and environmental regulations, optimizing production efficiency, and coordinating with other departments to achieve production targets. The Supervisor Mining plays a critical role in ensuring the safe and efficient extraction of ore, managing equipment utilization, and implementing best practices to maximize productivity.

What You Will Deliver
Supervise and coordinate mining operations, including drilling, blasting, loading, hauling, and dumping activities, to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and environmental standards in all mining activities, conducting safety inspections, risk assessments, and incident investigations as required.

Provide leadership and direction to mining crews, assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and providing coaching and training to improve skills and efficiency.

Coordinate with mine planning and engineering teams to implement mine plans, optimize pit designs, and sequence mining activities to maximize ore recovery and minimize dilution.

Monitor equipment performance and utilization, coordinating maintenance activities and repairs to minimize downtime and maximize equipment availability.

Conduct regular inspections of mining equipment, infrastructure, and work areas, identifying maintenance requirements, safety hazards, and opportunities for process improvements.

Maintain accurate production records, shift reports, and equipment logs, preparing reports and documentation for management review and regulatory compliance.

Liaise with other departments, such as geology, processing, and maintenance, to coordinate ore delivery, grade control, and equipment scheduling to support overall production objectives.

Monitor and control operating costs, managing consumables, fuel consumption, and labor resources to optimize productivity and minimize operating expenses.

Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement among mining personnel, promoting adherence to company policies, values, and performance standards.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in mining engineering, geology, or related field; additional certifications in mine supervision or leadership are advantageous.

Experience
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in open-pit or underground mining operations, with at least 2-3 years in a supervisory or leadership role.

Skills That Matter
Strong understanding of mine planning principles, ore reserve estimation, and grade control practices to optimize production and minimize ore loss and dilution.

Proficiency in mine safety regulations, risk management practices, and environmental compliance requirements applicable to mining operations.

Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire teams, resolve conflicts, and foster a positive work culture.

Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify operational inefficiencies, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Company Description

Valterra Platinum, formerly Anglo American Platinum, is a leading primary producer of platinum group metals (PGMs), with integrated mining, smelting, and refining operations in South Africa and Zimbabwe, marketing the metal we produce globally. Following our demerger from Anglo American plc, Valterra Platinum is now an independent, publicly listed company with a primary and secondary listing on the Johannesburg and London stock exchanges respectively.

As we embark on this exciting new chapter, Valterra Platinum is positioned to define and pursue its own strategy, anchored in operational excellence, sustainability, and value creation for the long-term. With full accountability for our performance and growth, we are focused on strengthening our capabilities across the entire PGM value chain, from mine to market.

Our independence empowers us to deepen our commitment to stakeholders and lead with purpose - to Unearth Value to Better Our World. We remain steadfast in our ambition to be the world's foremost producer of platinum group metals, while embedding safety and sustainability in everything we do.

If you're driven by purpose and the opportunity to make a lasting impact, we invite you to join us. Apply today and be part of something bigger.

This role is based in Thabazimbi, South Africa

Job Description

Come and join this dedicated team as our Shift Supervisor Mining. The Shift Supervisor Mining will be responsible for planning, coordinating, leading and controlling resources within the specific mining section to ensure safe and optimum production of the specific section within the shaft.

Daily adherence to the completion of the site-specific Shift Supervisor's logbook appointed for the area of responsibility (Legal Document).

Comply with organisational and legislation safety requirements by maintaining appropriate practices, standards and procedures.

Conducting accident and incident investigations and implement the necessary precautions to avoid re-occurrence.

Ensure that the Miner/s he is responsible for complies with mine design and practices according to the mining cycle.

Order materials, equipments and ensure that there is no wastage of material.

Monitor and ensure Time and Attendance and relevant payroll matters are handled.

Ensure effective discipline and compliance with the Company disciplinary code.

Adhered to daily, weekly and monthly plan.

Qualifications

Grade 12

Blasting Certificate

Shift Supervisor Certificate

Certified Competent A & B

Experience

At least 5 years Shift Supervisor experience in the Conventional underground mine.

Knowledge and Skills

Computer Literacy

Additional Information

Who We Are

We are a Southern African PGM producer, marketing metals globally, with a presence across 8 regions and 17 sites. Our operations include 4 operating mines, 3 smelters, and 2 refineries, giving us full control across the Platinum Group Metals (PGM) value chain-from resource to market.

We explore, we mine, we concentrate, we smelt, we refine and we market. As a result, we have an in-depth knowledge of PGM production and markets. Using this knowledge, we invest in developing sustainable markets for PGMs, partnering directly with research institutions as well as customers in the industrial, jewellery and investment sectors.

With 3 global marketing hubs and a team of over 29,000 employees, we serve a diverse international customer base while remaining deeply rooted in Southern Africa.

What We Offer

At Valterra Platinum, you will join a team committed to excellence and impact.

We offer:

Meaningful work in a high-performance, values-led environment.

Market-aligned reward and recognition.

Opportunities for learning, development and progression.

A culture that respects diversity and encourages innovation.

A clear commitment to safe Operations.

Inclusion and Diversity

Valterra Platinum is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfill their potential.
Valterra Platinum has a zero tolerance to dignity harms, these include all acts of gender based violence, bullying, harassment and victimisation. Ensuring the safety of our employees extends beyond physical safety and includes the eradication of harmful behaviours from our workplace. This responsibility extends to everyone at Valterra Platinum both during work hours and outside of work. We are unconditional in creating a respectful, inclusive, and safe working environment to ensure that no colleague will be violated or harassed under our watch.

How to Apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form via this job advert.

Underground mining has occurred since late 2020 to establish multiple mining fronts that de-risks production with exploration in progress to expand the current high-grade resource.

The Bellevue Gold Mine is located approximately 30km north of Leinster township and sits in a major gold, lithium and nickel producing district. The Company has a highly skilled management team with a track record of exploration success and operating major gold mines.

Bellevue Gold has achieved its ambitious goal of net zero greenhouse gas emissions for the Bellevue Gold Project. This milestone has been underpinned by a sector-leading renewable energy power station, designed to deliver approximately 80-90% renewable energy penetration and support Bellevue's position as a low-carbon gold producer.

Bellevue Gold's vision is to be a sustainable gold mining company that delivers value for shareholders, benefits local communities, and fosters a thriving workplace. jobs.title: Gerente Estudios Estrategicos, MDO
jobs.description:
La oficina de Kinross Copiapo brinda apoyo a mas de 900 empleados chilenos para el proyecto de desarrollo de la mina La Coipa y Lobo-Marte. Kinross Chile ha construido relaciones solidas con sus comunidades anfitrionas basadas en la confianza y el respeto a traves del compromiso y la consulta.

Descripcion del puesto

Liderar la planificacion, coordinacion y ejecucion de estudios de proyectos de crecimiento en las etapas de alcance, prefactibilidad y factibilidad liderando equipos multidisciplinarios con enfasis en la excelencia tecnica, la rentabilidad y la alineacion con las prioridades estrategicas de Kinross.

Responsabilidades del puesto

Definir y gestionar los alcances de los estudios en coordinacion con departamentos tecnicos y consultores externos.

Supervisar el desarrollo de estudios e integrar aportes operacionales de disciplinas como mineria, geologia, metalurgia, medio ambiente y permisos.

Monitorear el progreso respecto a los objetivos de alcance, costo y cronograma, y apoyar los informes a la alta direccion.

Coordinar recursos internos y externos para asegurar una ejecucion eficiente del estudio.

Contribuir al desarrollo de presupuestos anuales de estudios y apoyar la alineacion con la planificacion de capital y procesos de gobernanza de Kinross.

Apoyar la interaccion con los equipos de permisos y relaciones comunitarias para integrar sostenibilidad, relaciones comunitarias y requisitos regulatorios en los entregables del estudio

Promover la cultura de salud, seguridad y medio ambiente (HSE) de Kinross y asegurar la alineacion con todas las expectativas HSE durante el ciclo de vida del estudio.

Fomentar el pensamiento innovador y oportunidades de optimizacion de valor en las evaluaciones de estudios.

Aplicar mejores practicas en planificacion a largo plazo, evaluacion de capital e ingenieria minera para respaldar resultados solidos.

Apoyar la evaluacion de componentes de sostenibilidad y elementos de diseno de mina relacionados con botaderos, pilas de lixiviacion, balance hidrico y cierre.

Revisar y validar insumos tecnicos para asegurar la consistencia con estandares internos y marcos regulatorios externos (por ejemplo, Codigo Chileno de Reporte de Resultados de Exploracion, Recursos y Reservas Minerales, u otro equivalente).

Establecer procedimientos de comunicacion entre el personal de implementacion del proyecto y la alta direccion para asegurar que el progreso, cronograma y estado de costos del proyecto se comuniquen de manera oportuna, coherente y precisa.

Experiencia liderando o apoyando estudios a nivel conceptual, de alcance, prefactibilidad o factibilidad para proyectos de mineria a cielo abierto y/o subterranea.

Solida experiencia en planificacion a largo plazo, evaluacion de proyectos de capital y cumplimiento normativo (por ejemplo, permisos, medio ambiente o reporte de reservas).

Capacidad demostrada para coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios e interactuar con funciones operacionales, sociales y ambientales.

Familiaridad con estandares internacionales de reporte (incluido el Codigo Chileno de Reporte de Resultados de Exploracion, Recursos y Reservas Minerales).

Experiencia en gestion de presupuestos de estudios, cronogramas y consultores.

Conocimiento y experiencia en modelizacion financiera. Capacidad demostrada para dirigir evaluaciones economicas

Preferido: dominio de software de planificacion minera e ingenieria (por ejemplo, MineSight, AutoCAD, MS Project).

Kinross es una empresa minera de oro senior global con sede en Canada con operaciones y proyectos en los Estados Unidos, Brasil, Mauritania, Chile y Canada. jobs.description:
About Central Nevada Gold

Central Nevada Gold Corp. is the 100% owner of the Mule Canyon Gold Mine located ten kilometers southeast of Battle Mountain and five kilometers south of the i80 interstate highway. Our mission is to build a profitable multi-asset precious metals business. Success in the mining industry is built on a foundation of technical rigor, a commitment to safe and responsible operation, and the stewardship of investor capital.

Position Overview

The Controller is responsible for leading the Company's accounting and financial reporting functions for the Mule Canyon mine site and corporate office. This position oversees day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting, cash management, internal controls, payroll oversight, and regulatory compliance while providing accurate and timely financial information to support executive decision-making.

The successful candidate will establish scalable financial processes and controls that support the Company's continued growth while ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP, corporate policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. This role serves as a key business partner to operational leadership and works closely with external auditors, tax advisors, financial institutions, and corporate stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Lead all accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll oversight, fixed assets, and cash management.

Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, management reports, and supporting analyses.

Develop and maintain budgets, forecasts, cash flow projections, and financial models to support operational planning.

Establish and maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and financial procedures that support governance and regulatory compliance.

Coordinate annual audits, tax filings, and relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.

Monitor capital expenditures, project accounting, procurement controls, and asset capitalization.

Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, corporate policies, tax regulations, and other applicable financial reporting requirements.

Partner with operations, engineering, geology, human resources, and executive leadership to provide financial guidance and business analysis.

Develop financial reporting dashboards, key performance indicators, and management metrics.

Support financing activities, Board reporting, due diligence efforts, and other strategic corporate initiatives.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

CPA designation is preferred.

7+ years of progressively responsible accounting or finance experience, including leadership responsibilities.

Experience in mining, construction, manufacturing, natural resources, or other capital-intensive industries is preferred.

Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, budgeting, internal controls, payroll, and cash management.

Experience with ERP/accounting systems and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.

Strong analytical, organizational, leadership, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to communicate financial information effectively while building strong cross-functional relationships.

Reporting Structure

This position reports to the CFO and works cross-functionally with geology, engineering, operations, and corporate teams.

Project Human Resources Superintendent

Position Description

Kibali Gold Mine is seeking to recruit a suitably qualified and experienced Project Human Resources Superintendent to support the ARK Project mine expansion feasibility study.

The Project Human Resources Superintendent will lead and coordinate project-specific HR operations, workforce planning, mobilisation and demobilisation, recruitment, training coordination, employee relations, payroll-input control, statutory compliance, contractor workforce governance and HR reporting for the expansion project team. The role will work closely with Project leadership, Site HR, Finance, Payroll, HSE, Administration, Community Relations, contractors and external stakeholders to ensure effective HR delivery aligned with Kibali Gold Mine standards, Barrick's DNA and applicable DRC requirements.

Position Details

Location
Kibali Gold Mine Site / ARK Project
Contract Type
Project-based contract / Fixed-term / CDI - to be confirmed
Reporting Line
Project Manager and/or Human Resources Manager
Roster
Site roster - to be confirmed
Professional Category / Grade
Superintendent level - to be aligned with Kibali internal grading structure

Develop and implement project-specific HR strategies, policies, procedures, controls and operating rhythms aligned with business objectives, project milestones and applicable regulations.
