•
Compensation and Benefits:
Support and implement compensation and benefits arrangements tailored to the project, ensuring internal equity, market competitiveness, compliance with local labour laws and alignment with Kibali policies.

•
Payroll Input Control:
Validate and control project payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, allowances, bonuses, mobilisation/demobilisation impacts, salary changes, statutory deductions and project-specific benefits, in coordination with Payroll and Finance.

•
Statutory and Project Compliance:
Ensure compliance with the DRC Labour Code, ONEM requirements, CNSS, INPP, payroll tax obligations, labour inspection requirements, employment contract administration, personnel file compliance, project workforce documentation and internal HR policies. Maintain audit-ready records for employees, project staff and contractor workforce.

•
Employee Relations and Industrial Relations:
Serve as a key HR contact for employee concerns, grievances, disciplinary matters and labour-relations issues under the project. Support social dialogue, conflict prevention and positive employee engagement.

Contractor and Subcontractor Workforce Compliance:

•
Change Management:
Support organizational change initiatives related to project implementation, ensuring timely communication, stakeholder alignment and employee engagement throughout the project lifecycle.

•
Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to optimise project HR procedures, contractor HR controls, data quality, reporting, documentation, service delivery and compliance processes.

Qualification Requirements

• Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Labour Law, Project Management or Business Administration will be an added advantage.

• HR professional certification or membership such as SHRM, CIPD, ONPGRH-DRC or equivalent will be an added advantage.

jobs.description:
Finance Superintendent - ARK Expansion Project

Position Description

Kibali Gold Mine
seeks to recruit a
Finance Superintendent
for the ARK Expansion Project (Feasibility Study).

The Finance Superintendent will lead the financial management, capital cost control, forecasting and reporting of the ARK Project during the feasibility study phase. The role is responsible for ensuring robust governance over capital expenditure, providing accurate financial insight to support project decisions, and ensuring alignment between the feasibility study budget, project schedule, procurement plans, cash flow forecasts and life-of-mine/business planning assumptions.

You will be expected to align to the Barrick DNA and to operate within our mining assets with our best people teams. You will contribute in a safe and cost-effective manner to achieve targets in accordance with Mine Safety Standards, Policies and Procedures and ensure daily targets are met.

Duties & Responsibilities

Manage the capital finance, budgeting, cost control and reporting processes for the ARK Project Feasibility Study.

Establish, maintain and continuously improve the feasibility study cost control framework, including cost coding, commitments, accruals, forecasting, variance analysis and reporting requirements.

Support the development, validation and governance of capital cost estimates, ensuring that financial assumptions are accurate, complete and aligned to project scope, schedule and procurement strategy.

Monitor actual and forecast capital expenditure against approved budgets, commitments and contingency, and provide early visibility of cost risks, trends and opportunities.

Prepare monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc capital cost, cash flow, forecast-at-completion and management reports for the feasibility study project.

Review reporting deliverables for accuracy, completeness and consistency prior to final sign-off by project and finance leadership.

Provide financial input into stage-gate submissions, investment approval documentation, AME reporting packs, project steering committee materials and other governance deliverables.

jobs.description:
Nussir søker erfaren regnskapsfører

Ønsker du å bidra til verdiskapning og bolyst i Finnmark? Ønsker du å være med fra starten i et betydelig og svært spennende selskap med internasjonal hverdag? Ønsker du å bo i nord og gi andre muligheten til det samme?

Gruveprosjektet Nussir har stor fremdrift og søker en erfaren autorisert regnskapsfører.

Nussir er en del av det børsnoterte konsernet Blue Moon Metals Inc. som er listet på TSX og NASDAQ. Den norske delen av konsernet har i dag seksti ansatte og forventer sterk vekst frem til stabil produksjon i 2028.

Stillingen har følgende ansvarsområder:

Lede den regnskapsmessige overgangen fra konstruksjonsfasen til produksjon

Ansvar for selskapets regnskapsføring og regnskapsprosesser

Utarbeidelse av måneds-, kvartals- og årsregnskap

Sikre etterlevelse av gjeldende lover, regler og regnskapsstandarder

Ansvar for skatte- og avgiftsrapportering

Koordinering og oppfølging av revisjon

Videreutvikling av interne rutiner, prosesser og kontroller via SAP

Bidra til budsjett-, prognose- og rapporteringsprosesser

Delta i finansielle analyser og beslutningsunderlag for ledelsen

Samarbeid med eksterne rådgivere, myndigheter og øvrige forretningsområder

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

Autorisert regnskapsfører

Høyere økonomisk utdannelse innen regnskap, revisjon eller økonomi

Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring innen regnskap, revisjon eller økonomistyring

Solid kompetanse innen norsk regnskapsregelverk

Internasjonal og IFRS erfaring er en fordel

Erfaring med årsoppgjør, skatt og avgift

God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP-systemer, erfaring med SAP er en fordel

Meget gode ferdigheter i Excel

God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Stillingen byr på betydelige muligheter for læring og vekst, og en del av et konsern i sterk vekst. Stillingen vil ha påvirkningsmulighet i forhold etableringen av et gruveprosjekt i Kvalsund og målsetning om å benytte tid i gruven og prosessanlegget. Det forventes kandidater benytter minst fem arbeidsdager i måneden i Repparfjord. Kontorsted: Hammefest eller Alta.

Stillingen har innebærer personalansvar. Det benyttes for tiden regnskapstjenester fra Admento på regnskap, lønn og IFRS.

Stillingen rapporterer til Head of Finance Norway. For mer informasjon om stillingen, kontakt Alexander Krogh på mobil 416 48 650.

Søknadsfrist: kandidater vurderes løpende

Nussir seeks an experienced Chief Accountant

Would you like to contribute to value creation and help strengthen local communities in Finnmark? Would you like to join a significant and highly exciting company from the ground up, operating in an international environment? Do you want to live in Northern Norway and help create opportunities for others to do the same?
The Nussir mining project is making strong progress and is seeking an experienced Certified Accountant to join our team.

Nussir is part of the publicly listed Blue Moon Metals Inc. group, which is listed on both the TSX and NASDAQ stock exchanges. The Norwegian operations currently employ approximately sixty people and are expected to experience significant growth leading up to stable production in 2028.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage the accounting transition from construction to production

Responsibility for the company's accounting operations and financial processes

Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and accounting standards

Responsibility for tax and VAT reporting

Coordinate and manage external audits

Further develop internal routines, processes, and controls

Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes

Participate in financial analysis and the preparation of decision support for management

Collaborate with external advisors, authorities, and other business functions

Desired Qualifications:

Certified Accountant (Authorized Accountant)

Higher education in Accounting, Auditing, Finance, or Economics

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounting, auditing, or financial management

Strong knowledge of Norwegian accounting regulations; experience with IFRS is an advantage

Experience with year-end closing, taxation, and VAT reporting

Strong systems understanding and experience with ERP systems

International and SAP experience is an advantage

Advanced Excel skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English

The position offers significant opportunities for learning and professional growth as part of a rapidly expanding group. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence the development of the mining project in Kvalsund and will be expected to spend time both at the mine site and at the processing plant. Candidates are expected to spend a minimum of five working days per month in Repparfjord. The office location is either Hammerfest or Alta.

The position includes personnel management responsibilities. Accounting, payroll, and IFRS services are currently provided by Admento.
The position reports to the Head of Finance Norway. For further information regarding the position, please contact Alexander Krogh at +47 416 48 650.

Application Deadline:
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Acerca de nuestra
oficina de

Santiago

La oficina corporativa de Teck en Santiago es el centro administrativo de nuestras operaciones mineras en Chile, brindando apoyo a Quebrada Blanca (QB) en la Región de Tarapacá y a Carmen de Andacollo en Coquimbo.

Ubicada en el corazón de Santiago, nuestra oficina conecta la experiencia global con proyectos mineros de clase mundial.

Descripción del cargo

En Teck, nuestro propósito es proporcionar recursos esenciales con los que el mundo cuenta para mejorar la vida, mientras que cuidamos de las personas, comunidades y la tierra que amamos.

Reportando al Jefe de Gestión Operacional, el/la
Ingeniero/a Gestión Operacional
, será responsable de impulsar la excelencia operacional del negocio mediante la generación de información confiable para la toma de decisiones y la creación de valor sostenible, entregando insights que impulsen la gestión del desempeño productivo y la documentación de resultados para niveles operativos y tácticos/estratégicos.

El cargo se desempeñará en el Centro de Operaciones Integradas de Quebrada Blanca, ubicado en Santiago en turno 5x2.

Responsabilidades principales

Actuar como un/a líder visible en seguridad, promoviendo activamente la cultura preventiva y garantizando el cumplimiento de normas de seguridad y medioambiente.

Generar información confiable para la toma de decisiones y la creación de valor sostenible

Entregar insights y recomendaciones que impulsen la gestión del desempeño productivo de la operación

Hacer seguimiento a la eficiencia y sustentabilidad de los sistemas y activos de Mina, Planta Concentradora, TMF, Puerto y Desaladora, alineados con los objetivos de producción y mantenimiento.

Desarrollar y presentar reportes operacionales, dashboards y análisis que permitan visibilizar el desempeño y facilitar la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.

Identificar riesgos asociados a las operaciones y proponer acciones correctivas para minimizar el impacto en la producción y asegurar la continuidad operacional.

Proponer y ejecutar herramientas digitales para mejorar continuamente la forma de automatizar y eficientar los procesos de generación de información y reportabilidad.

Monitorear, analizar y reportar indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) para asegurar el cumplimiento de los planes operativos, identificando oportunidades de mejora continua a lo largo de la cadena de valor.

Colaborar estrechamente con áreas de Operaciones, Mantenimiento, Confiabilidad y Planificación, asegurando la alineación de los procesos y metas operacionales.

Asegurar que todas las operaciones cumplan con los estándares de salud, seguridad, medioambiente y comunidad (HSEC), impulsando una cultura de trabajo seguro y sostenible.

Participar en iniciativas de optimización y automatización de procesos operacionales.

Requisitos

Título de Ingeniería Civil Industrial o carrera afín.

Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en cargos similares de gestión operacional.

Deseable experiencia de trabajo en centro integrados de operaciones.

Conocimientos en Análisis de Datos y Reportabilidad, manejo de herramientas de análisis, integración y visualización de datos como Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, SQL y Microsoft Office avanzado.

Deseable nivel de inglés intermedio.

Acerca de Teck

En Teck, valoramos la diversidad. Nuestros equipos trabajan de manera colaborativa y respetan la perspectiva y contribución únicas de cada persona. *Esta oferta se enmarca en la ley 21.015, que incentiva la inclusión de personas con discapacidad al mundo laboral.

En caso de que requieras de algún ajuste razonable en el proceso de selección, cuéntanos para apoyarte en tu participación en igualdad de condiciones (ley 20.422).

En Teck actuamos conforme a nuestro principio de Hacer lo Correcto, y en cumplimiento de las leyes aplicables en nuestros países de operación para prevenir la Responsabilidad Penal de las Personas Jurídicas. Por esta razón, incorporamos en nuestros procesos de selección preguntas destinadas a prevenir riesgos asociados a la Ley N°20.393.

Su postulación a esta publicación se considera como su consentimiento para la recopilación, uso y divulgación necesaria de información personal para los propósitos de reclutamiento. Teck respeta la privacidad de todos los candidatos y la confidencialidad de la información personal.

Caylloma, Arequipa, Perú

Tipo de empleo:
Tiempo completo regular

Lugar de trabajo:
On-site

Acerca de
Zafranal

Zafranal es un proyecto de cobre y oro, el cual proyecta una producción de alrededor de 126.000 toneladas anuales de cobre durante sus primeros 5 años de operación. Está ubicado en el departamento de Arequipa, en el distrito de Majes, a una distancia de aproximadamente 4 horas por vía terrestre desde la ciudad de Arequipa, Perú.

Plazo de postulación: 15 de septiembre 2026

Reportando al Jefe/a de Protección Industrial, el/la
Supervisor/a de Protección Industrial y Centro de Control
será responsable de supervisar la ejecución operativa de la protección industrial en Site y la operación del Centro de Control, asegurando el cumplimiento de procedimientos, estándares de seguridad, monitoreo, reportabilidad, escalamiento de incidentes y continuidad operacional. Asimismo, brindará soporte operativo en la coordinación y supervisión del servicio contratista de Respuesta a Emergencias, verificando cobertura, disponibilidad de recursos, tiempos de respuesta y cumplimiento contractual.

El cargo tiene base en Pedregal, jornada 8x6, con visitas frecuentes y programados a otros sectores de relevancia.

Responsabilidades Principales:

Ser un/una líder valiente de seguridad, cumplir y patrocinar las reglas, reglamentos, controles críticos y procedimientos de seguridad y medio ambiente.

Brindar soporte operativo al Jefe/a de Protección Industrial en la implementación, ejecución y seguimiento de estrategias, procedimientos y medidas de protección industrial dentro del Site.

Supervisar las operaciones del Centro de Control, asegurando el monitoreo permanente, la correcta gestión de comunicaciones, SVV/CCTV, Drones, alarmas, registros, reportes, sistemas tecnológicos y escalamiento de eventos.

Realizar rondas de supervisión programadas y aleatorias dentro del Site para identificar vulnerabilidades, condiciones inseguras, incumplimientos procedimentales, brechas de control y oportunidades de mejora.

Coordinar y supervisar los procedimientos de control operativo vinculados al ingreso, salida, movimiento interno de personas, materiales, equipos y vehículos dentro del ámbito de Protección Industrial.

Monitorear y dirigir las actividades del personal de vigilancia, operadores del Centro de Control y servicios operativos asignados, asegurando la protección de zonas críticas, instalaciones, activos y personal.

Reportar, atender y hacer seguimiento a incidentes de seguridad, emergencias, intrusiones, robos, sabotajes, condiciones anómalas o eventos que puedan afectar la continuidad operacional.

Activar protocolos de respuesta ante emergencias, incidentes de seguridad, intrusiones, robos, sabotajes u otros eventos críticos, en coordinación con el Jefe/a de Protección Industrial, Centro de Control, SSO, Operaciones y la empresa contratista de Respuesta a Emergencias.

Apoyar en la elaboración de análisis de riesgos, mapas de calor, matrices de vulnerabilidad, reportes operativos, indicadores, dashboards y acciones correctivas aplicables al Site y al Centro de Control.

Mantener comunicación constante con líderes de otras áreas del proyecto para asegurar el cumplimiento de las medidas de protección industrial.

Brindar inducciones, charlas de sensibilización y reforzamientos operativos sobre prácticas seguras, disciplina operacional, reporte de incidentes, ética y cultura de seguridad patrimonial.

Participar en auditorías internas y externas relacionadas con seguridad patrimonial, protección industrial, Centro de Control, respuesta a emergencias y cumplimiento de procedimientos.

Requisitos:

Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Seguridad, Gestión de Riesgos, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Electrónica, Informática, Prevención de Riesgos o carreras afines.

Egresado de Escuela de Oficiales y oficiales en retiro de las Fuerzas Armadas o Policía Nacional, con experiencia aplicable a seguridad patrimonial, protección industrial, operaciones o respuesta a emergencias.

Especialización deseable en Seguridad Patrimonial, Protección Industrial, Seguridad Industrial, Gestión de Riesgos, Centro de Control, SVV/CCTV, Respuesta a Emergencias o Continuidad Operacional.

Mínimo 5 años de experiencia laboral en empresas de rubros extractivos, minería, petróleo, gas, energía, industria pesada, infraestructura crítica o entornos industriales.

Experiencia previa en operaciones con altos estándares de seguridad patrimonial, protección industrial, control operativo o respuesta a emergencias.

Experiencia en supervisión de personal operativo, operadores de Centro de Control, vigilancia, monitoreo o contratistas.

Experiencia en gestión de sistemas de SVV/CCTV, videovigilancia, alarmas, comunicaciones, control de acceso o plataformas de monitoreo.

Experiencia en elaboración de reportes operativos, dashboards, indicadores, matrices de riesgo, análisis de incidentes y seguimiento de acciones correctivas.

Experiencia en coordinación operativa ante incidentes, emergencias, simulacros, intrusiones, robos, sabotajes, condiciones inseguras o eventos críticos.

Conocimiento en análisis de riesgos, inspecciones, mapas de calor, matrices de vulnerabilidad y detección de condiciones inseguras.

Por qué Teck

En Teck, tu trabajo importa: para el mundo, para nuestras comunidades y para tu futuro.

Como una de las principales empresas de recursos de Canadá, nos enfocamos en proveer de manera responsable los metales esenciales para el desarrollo global y la transición energética, mientras cuidamos a las personas, las comunidades y el entorno que amamos. Lo hacemos guiándonos por nuestros valores, que en conjunto forman The Teck Way .

En Teck, encontrarás un trabajo con propósito, una cultura de respeto e inclusión y la oportunidad de desarrollar tu carrera mientras contribuyes a construir un mundo mejor.

jobs.title: Ingeniero/a Senior Depósito de Relaves
jobs.description:
Ubicación:
Andacollo, Coquimbo, Chile

Tipo de empleo:
Tiempo completo regular

Lugar de trabajo:
On-site

Acerca de
Carmen de Andacollo

Carmen de Andacollo es una mina a cielo abierto que produce concentrado de cobre a partir de la porción hipógena del yacimiento.

Poseemos un 90% de participación en la mina. La Empresa Nacional de Minería (ENAMI) posee el 10% restante. La mayoría del personal de la mina vive en el pueblo de Andacollo, justo al lado de la mina, o en las ciudades cercanas de Coquimbo y La Serena.

Descripción del cargo

Fecha de cierre:
22 Septiembre 2026

Reportando al Superintendente de Recursos Hídricos y Relaves, el o la
Ingeniero/a Senior Depósito de Relaves
será responsable de velar por la construcción, vigilancia y seguridad del Depósito de Relaves de Carmen de Andacollo de acuerdo con lo establecido en los criterios de diseño y filosofía de operación de la instalación, actuando como contraparte técnica del Ingeniero de Registro (EoR) y apoyando al Superintendente en el ejercicio de la autoridad técnica sobre la instalación. Actúa como referente técnico interno para la gestión del Depósito.

El lugar de trabajo es en nuestra faena Carmen de Andacollo, ubicada en la Región de Coquimbo, en sistema de turnos 4x3. Nuestra faena no cuenta con campamento, pero existen buses de traslado desde Coquimbo y La Serena.

Responsabilidades principales

• Ser un/a líder valiente de seguridad, cumplir y patrocinar las reglas y procedimientos de seguridad y medio ambiente.
• Liderar y supervisar técnicamente las diferentes etapas de construcción del Depósito de Relaves, asegurando consistencia entre el diseño aprobado, la ejecución en terreno y la vigilancia geotécnica. Todo siempre en coordinación con el Ingeniero de Registro (EoR) de la instalación.
• Liderar la planificación anual del crecimiento de la instalación de relaves en conjunto con el equipo de Planificación Minera.
• Responsable de la vigilancia geotécnica de la instalación de relaves: análisis de la información entregada por la instrumentación geotécnica disponible, asegurar la disponibilidad de la instrumentación geotécnica, seguimiento de indicadores de desempeño clave y levantar posibles amenazas.
• Actuar como contraparte técnica formal del EoR, evaluando, validando y desafiando sus recomendaciones desde una perspectiva independiente que proteja los intereses técnicos y legales de Teck.
• Identificar, evaluar, cuantificar y comunicar los riesgos geotécnicos del Depósito, definiendo y monitoreando las medidas necesarias para minimizar y mitigar riesgos y mantener una instalación segura.
• Participar y apoyar técnicamente a la Superintendencia en instancias regulatorias y auditorías externas del Depósito
• Apoyar la implementación y mantención del GISTM en CDA, y asegurar el cumplimiento de la Gobernanza de Relaves de Teck (políticas, procedimientos y estándares).
• Gestionar y supervisar los servicios de consultores técnicos asociados al Depósito, asegurando calidad técnica y alineamiento con la Gobernanza de Relaves de Teck.
• Conocer y aplicar la norma ISO 50.001 en su área y la Política de Energía y Cambio Climático y contribuir al cumplimiento de sus objetivos y metas
• asociada a sus funciones.
• Contribuir a la ejecución de los planes de acción establecidos en el Sistema de gestión de Energía, para el cumplimiento de objetivos y metas.
• Definir y comunicar especificaciones para asegurarse del óptimo desempeño energético de los equipos y servicios adquiridos.

Requisitos

• Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil, Geotécnica, Geológica, de Minas, o afín.
• Deseable posgrado o especialización en Ingeniería Geotécnica, Mecánica de Suelos o Gestión de Relaves.
• Mínimo 8 años de experiencia comprobada en depósitos de relaves, incluyendo diseño, construcción y operación de la instalación.
• Experiencia en revisión de Ingeniería y seguimiento del diseño durante la construcción y operación de la instalación de relaves.
• Experiencia demostrable en gestión de instalaciones de relaves a lo largo del ciclo de vida (construcción, operación, vigilancia geotécnica y cierre).
• Experiencia en al menos un tipo de instalación de relaves (cicloneados, roca estéril, estructuras de tierra, etc.). con capacidad de adaptación a otras configuraciones.
• Manejo de control de calidad de obras de tierra (compactación, granulometría, densidades) e interpretación de instrumentación geotécnica (piezómetros, inclinómetros, monitoreo satelital)
• Contar con experiencia como contraparte técnica del Ingeniero de Registro (EoR), con capacidad demostrada para evaluar sus recomendaciones.
• Manejo sólido de la Gobernanza de Relaves (políticas, procedimientos, estándares, etc.) y participación en diferentes tipos de auditorías/revisiones externas (Copper Mark, TSM, ITRB, etc.).
• Deseable experiencia en implementación del GISTM y en interacciones con autoridades regulatorias.
• Deseable dominio de software de análisis de estabilidad y deformación de taludes (GeoStudio, Plaxis, Slide3 o equivalentes).
• Inglés intermedio: para lectura técnica y participación en reuniones con Equipos Corporativos de habla inglesa.

Acerca de Teck

En Teck, valoramos la diversidad. Nuestros equipos trabajan de manera colaborativa y respetan la perspectiva y contribución únicas de cada persona. *Esta oferta se enmarca en la ley 21.015, que incentiva la inclusión de personas con discapacidad al mundo laboral.

En caso de que requieras de algún ajuste razonable en el proceso de selección, cuéntanos para apoyarte en tu participación en igualdad de condiciones (ley 20.422).

En Teck actuamos conforme a nuestro principio de Hacer lo Correcto, y en cumplimiento de las leyes aplicables en nuestros países de operación para prevenir la Responsabilidad Penal de las Personas Jurídicas. Por esta razón, incorporamos en nuestros procesos de selección preguntas destinadas a prevenir riesgos asociados a la Ley N°20.393.

Queremos agradecer a todos(as) los(las) postulan

jobs.title: Compliance Officer (Mining Operations)
jobs.description:
Introduction

The Compliance Officer ensures mining operations meet all legal, regulatory, and licensing requirements. Acting as custodian of the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR) and related statutory documentation, the role involves conducting internal audits, overseeing document control systems, and monitoring mining sites for compliance. The Compliance Officer will be responsible for controlling external audits with the DMPR and other regulatory bodies. While environmental expertise is supported by external consultants, the Compliance Officer plays a key role in safeguarding operational integrity, regulatory adherence, and community development commitments (through the Social and Labour Plan implementation).

Duties & Responsibilities

Regulatory & Licensing Oversight

Maintain and safeguard DMPR Approved Mining documentation.

Verify compliance with Mineral Rights / Permits.

Compile and submit statutory returns and regulatory reports.

Track license conditions, renewal dates, and maintain compliance registers.

Monitor implementation of new requirements on the current mining sites

Monitor and implement Social and Labour Plans at the various mining sites

and communities (site visits required)

﻿Auditing & Inspection

Conduct proactive onsite audits of mining practices, equipment use, and

documentation.

Monitor contractor compliance with safety and permitting requirements.

Review internal controls on the mining sites (sites visits required).

Assess financial provision guarantees to ensure adequate mine rehabilitation

funding.

Attend and represent the company at external audits with DMPR and other

government departments

﻿Document Control & Compliance Monitoring

Implement and manage document control systems to ensure version integrity

and accessibility.

Maintain accurate compliance records and audit trails.

Monitor mining sites for adherence to operational and regulatory standards.

Prepare compliance reports and present findings to management and

regulators.

Environmental & Safety Governance (with consultant support)

Liaise with environmental consultants on EMPR updates and audits.

Participate in incident investigations involving environmental or safety

breaches.

Ensure consultant outputs align with legislative requirements and company

standards.

Desired Experience & Qualification

A Bachelor's degree in Law, or Bachelor of Commerce with accounting.

3 to 5 years of legal, compliance, or hands-on operational experience within mining, OR completed articles with 3 to 5 year experience in accounting firm.

jobs.title: UG Gas Drainage Coordinator
jobs.description:
Anglo American Australia
In Australia, we operate five steelmaking coal mines in Queensland’s Bowen Basin, and have additional joint venture interests in manganese, as well as copper exploration projects under way in North West Queensland. Steelmaking coal is an essential ingredient in blast-furnace steel manufacture, producing steel used for critical building and infrastructure around the world.

We are seeking an experienced Underground Gas Drainage Coordinator to join our Technical Services team at Grosvenor Mine in Moranbah.

This is a critical technical role responsible for the planning, design, coordination and monitoring of underground in-seam gas drainage activities. You will work closely with Ventilation and Gas, Mine Planning, Geology, Operations and specialist drilling contractors to ensure gas drainage programs are safely delivered ahead of development and longwall mining.

The role will suit someone with strong underground coal experience who understands gas drainage design, drilling operations and the importance of accurate planning, monitoring and compliance.

Reporting to the Technical Services Superintendent, you will take ownership of underground gas drainage programs from initial design through to drilling, monitoring and operational handover.

Gas drainage at Grosvenor Mine includes underground in seam and surface to in-seam strategies, with drainage programs designed to reduce gas content and support safe development and longwall operations.

What you will be doing

Your responsibilities will include:

Coordinate the safe planning and delivery of underground gas drainage activities.

Design underground in-seam drilling patterns aligned with the mine plan, geological information, gas reservoir conditions and operational requirements.

Develop individual borehole designs and maintain accurate proposed and as drilled flight plans.

Review gas content, permeability, geological structures, seam conditions and available drainage lead times when developing drilling programs.

Coordinate drilling schedules to ensure gas drainage work is completed ahead of development and longwall mining.

Review drilling logs, flight plans and borehole performance information to confirm drilling requirements have been achieved.

Monitor gas flow, pressure, composition and borehole performance to assess drainage effectiveness.

Identify underperforming boreholes, restrictions, water accumulation or other issues that may affect drainage performance.

Support gas compliance drilling, coring and Permit to Mine requirements.

Manage drilling contractors and monitor safety, quality, schedule and performance outcomes.

Conduct underground inspections and audits of drilling sites, gas drainage stubs and associated infrastructure.

Ensure drilling and gas drainage activities comply with site standards, permits, procedures, risk controls and the Safety and Health Management System.

Provide clear technical advice and regular updates to Ventilation and Gas, Operations, Mine Planning, Geology and site leadership.

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

Demonstrated experience in underground coal mining and underground gas drainage.

Experience coordinating underground in-seam drilling or gas drainage programs.

Strong understanding of coal seam gas behaviour, borehole design, gas drainage infrastructure and drilling operations.

Experience interpreting mine plans, geological information, drilling data and gas monitoring results.

Knowledge of underground gas drainage risk controls, operational permits and compliance requirements.

The ability to assess gas drainage performance and recommend practical corrective actions.

Strong planning, organisation and contractor management skills.

Sound analytical and problem-solving capability.

Confidence working with operational, technical and contractor teams.

Strong written communication, reporting and record management skills.

A practical and safety focused approach to underground work.

Current Australian driver’s licence.

The following will be highly regarded:

Tertiary qualifications in Mining Engineering, Geology, Ventilation, Drilling or a related technical discipline.

Underground coal supervisory qualifications or relevant site recognised competencies.

Experience with AutoCAD or similar mine design software.

Experience with gas reservoir modelling, gas flow monitoring and technical data analysis.

Knowledge of Queensland underground coal mining legislation.

Experience working across development and longwall operations.

A permanent opportunity within an experienced underground Technical Services team.

Monday – Friday roster, FIFO and DIDO available

Competitive salary, superannuation and annual incentive arrangements.

Subsidised accommodation and camp options, subject to role eligibility.

Relocation assistance for the right candidate.

Access to technical training, professional development and career opportunities.

The opportunity to influence gas drainage strategies supporting future mine development and longwall production.

A role with direct impact on underground safety, compliance and operational readiness.

Who we are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. Anglo American is a leading global mining company focused on the responsible production of copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients – future-enabling products that are essential for decarbonising the global economy, improving living standards, and food security. jobs.title: Analista de TI Infraestrutura SR. - VMware - Exclusiva para Mulheres
jobs.description:
A Anglo American é uma empresa global de mineração com sede em Londres, presente em diversos países e com uma história de mais de 100 anos, com o propósito de reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Na América Latina, nossas operações desempenham um papel estratégico no fornecimento responsável de recursos essenciais para o desenvolvimento do mundo – com atuação no Brasil, Chile e Peru, sempre pautadas por inovação, segurança, sustentabilidade e alto desempenho.

No Brasil, operamos o sistema Minas-Rio, que integra mina, usina, mineroduto e porto. As operações do Peru e do Chile se concentram na produção de cobre em larga escala, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma transição energética sustentável.

Acreditamos que nossas pessoas são o maior diferencial competitivo. Investimos no desenvolvimento de talentos, promovendo ambientes inclusivos e colaborativos, onde diferentes perspectivas constroem soluções melhores para os desafios do presente e do futuro.

Na Anglo American, valorizamos quem deseja crescer com propósito e gerar impacto real.

Como
Analista TI Infraestrutura Sênior
você será responsável pelo gerenciamento e controle da área de tecnologia da informação, voltado para áreas de redes, servidores, sustentabilidade do ambiente e segurança da informação, visando garantir a disponibilidade de toda a infraestrutura de telecomunicações e ambiente virtualizado (comunicação de voz e dados), para as respectivas unidades em que atua, apoiando as áreas produtivas e de suporte.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Definir e instalar equipamentos de rede local (LAN) e de longa distância (WAN) incluindo switches, conectores de fibra ótica, roteadores entre outros.

Definir e instalar equipamentos de segurança de rede, tais como firewalls, equipamentos de detecção e prevenção de intrusos (IDS / IPS).

Manter as configurações dos equipamentos de rede, conforme procedimentos internos, a fim de garantir o correto e seguro funcionamento da rede de computadores e seus aplicativos.

Analisar o consumo de banda e utilização da rede e seus equipamentos, descobrindo e resolvendo gargalos de performação ou falha nos equipamentos.

Realizar a Instalação e manutenção de sistemas operacionais Windows servers 2016 ou superior.

Realizar a Instalação, configuração e suporte básico de sistemas de antivírus, Backup e virtualização.

Conhecimento de ITIL, Governança, Arquitetura de Soluções e Segurança da Informação.

Realizar a configuração de firewalls Cisco.

Gerenciar o ITSM utilizado por IM.

Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação ou afins.

Desejável Pós-graduação em áreas afins.

Configuração e gerenciamento de ambiente virtualizado Vmware

Configuração e gerenciamento de servidores Windows.

Desejável conhecimento em gerenciamento de Vulnerabilidades.

Inglês avançado

Disponibilidade para residir em Conceição do Mato Dentro/MG.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

·
Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental:

Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional

·
Especial para você e sua família:

Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!

· Espaço para ser você mesmo:

Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade!

· Para seu futuro:

Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado

· E ainda:

Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança?

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Conduct the required safety interventions before undertaking any tasks.

Ensure a clear working area and the legibility and visibility of safety signs; attend to spillage material to prevent contamination and pollution; and keep a record of actions taken.

Active participation in VF’s, Risk Assessments, and closed-out of Safety Actions.

Safely operate and control equipment/vehicles/equipment, components or materials as instructed.

Ensure that communication is clear, whether verbal or written.

Quality Control:

Validate equipment by performing quality checks at required intervals and record results for necessary rectification.

Submit quality control samples at designated intervals and document data to meet Laboratory Quality System requirements.

Record non-conformances to the Laboratory Quality System to track cases and initiate appropriate corrective actions.

Equipment Validation and Maintenance:

Validate and conduct first-line maintenance on equipment according to SOPs, WIs, and quality system standards for optimal performance.

Report maintenance needs to your supervisor for timely remedial actions to ensure optimal equipment performance and availability.

Ensure the operating environment and conditions conform to supplier specifications and quality system requirements to limit deviations and prevent potential equipment damage. Report any deviations to your supervisor for remedial action.

Prepare equipment for maintenance promptly during breakdowns or shutdowns to minimise production impact.

Compliance:

Adhere to Anglo American compliance requirements and ensure compliance with the team.

Conduct site inspections to identify and escalate non-compliance.

Implement required actions.

Assistance:

Assist the supervisor and co-workers.

Assist in the absence of the responsible person.

Assist within your level and area of competence.

Assist in alignment with KIO policies, procedures, and guidelines.

Operate support equipment within the processing environment (when applicable).

This role is in Processing (PRO) department on a band P5 (B-Upper) level reporting to the Supervisor LAB.

Grade 12 Certificate / N3

SA Drivers Licence

Technical Knowledge

Knowledge of manual and automated laboratory operations acquired through 2 years of experience.

Understand laboratory-specific equipment and processes, including both manual and automated tools.

Familiarity with handling chemical substances safely.

Awareness of shift inspection procedures and their importance.

Comprehension of lock-out procedures to ensure safety.

Insight into safety standards applicable in laboratory settings.

Understand company policies and procedures that govern laboratory practices.

Proficiency in computer systems, including MS Office, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), and automated laboratory control systems.

Knowledge of safety, health, and environmental regulations and legislative, statutory, and regulatory requirements.

We work together with our key partners and stakeholders to unlock the sustainable value that those resources represent for our shareholders, the communities and countries in which we operate and for society at large. A

jobs.title: Operadora / Operador Máquinas B (Transporte Auxiliar)
jobs.description:
Mais do que uma responsabilidade, Segurança é nosso valor. Junte-se a nós nesse compromisso!

Segura. Inteligente. Sustentável. Provavelmente, estas não são as primeiras palavras que você normalmente associa à mineração. Mas a Anglo American não é uma empresa de mineração comum.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos.

Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito.

Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Você como Operadora / Operador de Máquinas B, será responsável por operar máquinas pesadas acionando comandos mecânicos, hidráulicos e eletrônicos, mediante manual de procedimento operacional e conhecimento prático.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Realizar carregamento de minério e transportar , escória, carvão, ferroníquel e materiais diversos, operando carregadeira de pneus, escavadeira hidráulica, motoniveladora, trator de esteira e caminhão basculante.

Realizar manutenção e melhoria em vias de acesso, operando motoniveladora. Contrapilhar minério, escória e carvão.

Retirar caçambas com a utilização de caminhão brook.

Umectar vias com a utilização de caminhão pipa.

Transportar insumos e outros materiais para as diversas áreas da planta industrial “carga seca".

Efetuar controle diário das horas/máquina trabalhadas, fazendo anotações em planilhas.

Efetuar inspeções e limpeza nas máquinas, no início e término da jornada, checando as variáveis de funcionamento e retirando a sujeita.

Auxiliar o mecânico de máquinas e o lubrificador na identificação e diagnóstico de falhas dos equipamentos.

Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Médio Completo;

Curso Técnico em Mineração ou Metalurgia será um diferencial;

Experiência em operação de máquinas pesadas (motoniveladora, trator de esteira, pá carregadeira, escavadeira hidráulica, caminhão pipa e caminhão caçamba e brook);

Carteira de Habilitação "D";

Disponibilidade para atuar em turno e no administrativo.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

·
Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental:

Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional

·
Especial para você e sua família:

Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!

· Espaço para ser você mesmo:

Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade!

· Para seu futuro:

Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado

· E ainda:

Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança?

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho.

You’re talented and adaptable. That’s why you’ll fit in.

We’re re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives. That includes the lives of everyone who works for Anglo American. We strive to be a great company where employees are happy and inspired to do their best work. A place where every colleague can grow, develop and realise their potential. To live up to our Always with Purpose employee value proposition, we’re putting the development and growth of colleagues first by ensuring everyone at Anglo American has the career experience they deserve.

The purpose of the Marketing Business is to sustainably maximise cash flows from the marketing of Anglo American products and services. In support of this, we have set ourselves a target to deliver a considerable uplift in value.

As a result of the changing environment in commodity markets, Anglo American has centralised its marketing & sales activities in one Marketing Business in order to enhance commercial capabilities and extract full value of the commercial value chain. With the centralisation new ways of working, efficient processes and procedures, standardised IM systems as well as a new organisational model are being implemented to create a world class centralised, super-efficient, twin centred marketing function that can anticipate market developments and proactively plan sales and marketing activities with full information, visibility, and a fast, efficient decision-making process.

Our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively, with the utmost consideration for local communities, our customers and the world at large.

What We Offer

When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too. We’re a large, successful multinational company – and we’re still growing all the time.

How We Are Committed To Your Safety

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies that are helping to make mining safer.

You’ll make us better.

Kumba Iron Ore

We produce high-grade iron ore, the key component in steel widely used in construction and manufacturing across the world. Our activities include all aspects – exploration; mining; processing and blending; shipping; marketing and selling. In South Africa, we have mining operations in the Northern Cape province, as well as a head office in Rosebank, Gauteng, and a port operation in Saldanha Bay, Western Cape.

As

your responsibilities will include but not limited to:

Safety, Health, and Environment:

Consistently apply Safety and Health principles in all learner interactions and take personal responsibility for the safety of self and learners to ensure zero harm and elimination of fatalities.

Collect and summarise the specific risks within the working area and implement plans/systems to avoid these risks.

Provide and continuously maintain a GAP analysis of training requirements in the area of responsibility

Design, develop, and maintain training matrixes, materials, programs, and assessments to deliver practical training.

Conduct practical and theoretical training sessions to equip learners with the necessary skills and knowledge.

Assess learners against Legal Authorisation standards and processes to evaluate competency levels.

Monitor and evaluate learners' progress according to NQF standards and draft progress reports to track their development where applicable

Prepare learners for assessments, ensuring they meet the required unit standard/s or learning outcome/s.

Maintain learners' portfolios as the MQA requires Kumba to accurately record their training progress and achievements.

Control and maintain the administration of training documents to ensure that all records are up-to-date and easily accessible.

Conduct need/skills assessments to determine learners' training needs and address gaps in their knowledge or skills.

Monitor learners' performance and application of procedures to ensure they adhere to safety rules and apply the correct procedures.

Assist in ensuring compliance with the company's SHE objectives by requiring learners to adhere to and apply safety rules while completing their training.

Stay updated with the latest developments in your expertise and maintain close contact with the mine's relevant discipline managers/supervisors.

Continuously engage with Plant leaders, understanding and responding to needs at departmental and individual levels.

This role is in People & Organisation (P&O) NC department on a Band 7 (C-Upper) level reporting to the Learning Delivery (LD) Supervisor Processing & SHE.

Grade 12

Relevant ETDP Qualification/Certificate on NQF5

Higher Certificate in OD ETDP Level 05 is preferred

Relevant Level -2 Mineral Processing Certificate is required (Level 3 advantageous)

A2 Safety Training & Legal Liability

Assessor & Moderator Certificate

SA Drivers Licence: Code B

Technical Knowledge

3-5 years of relevant experience with mineral processing learnerships and experience in TMM Licensing in a plant/processing environment.

Understand adult learning principles and methodologies.

Knowledge of training needs analysis, curriculum development, and instructional design.

Demonstrates knowledge in identifying hazards associated with Plant maintenance operations and applying effective risk mitigation strategies.

Knowledge of emergency response procedures and incident investigation techniques.

Familiarity with project and resource management tools and techniques.

Familiarity with South African mining laws, including the Mine Health and Safety Act (MHSA), relevant regulations, safety standards and best practices in the mining industry.

Familiarity with dealing with and coordinating training provider activities to ensure the continuous development of own and contractor employees.

Anglo American is a global diversified mining business. Our portfolio of world-class mining operations provides the metals and minerals that make modern life possible. We use innovative practices and the latest technologies to discover new resources and mine.

We work together with our key partners and stakeholders to unlock the sustainable value that those resources represent for our shareholders, the communities and countries in which we operate and for society at large. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives.

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

Inclusion and Diversity

Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

The role ensures the business meets its regulatory and legislative requirements regarding the identification and verification of the identity of counterparties. We believe that a sustainable business is purposeful, competitive, resilient and agile – it’s a business that thrives through both economic and social cycles. By understanding the context and listening to stakeholders we stay ahead of evolving trends and provide the solutions to societal expectations. By solving the physical challenges of mining through relentless innovation, and constantly searching for more responsible ways to do business, we are changing the way our employees and stakeholders experience our business – creating enduring value for all stakeholders. Sustainability is at the heart of our decision-making – it is how we do business.

The Mining team's role within Technical & Sustainability at De Beers Group is to ensure that mines are designed, developed, and operated to deliver maximum value and allow De Beers Group to meet its strategic, operational and compliance requirements.

In collaboration with Processing and Engineering & Maintenance disciplines, Mining enables tangible value delivery across the business by improving stability, reducing variation, and removing constraints across operations.

This role reflects the consolidation of three previous Principal Mining Engineer roles into one, requiring agile, adaptable, and resilient leadership to contribute to the development and execution of De Beers Group's strategy.

Provide expert technical support to Managed Operations and Non-Managed Joint Venture Operations across mining, planning, productivity, operational performance, and value optimisation.

Support development and optimisation of mine designs, mining methods, production strategies, and operating practices to maximise asset value delivery.

Identify key technical issues, risks and opportunities for business risk mitigation and value add within core mining systems as a process expert.

Drive optimisation of mining systems, equipment utilisation, operational performance, and technical standards across the consolidated portfolio.

Drive people development within the mining discipline across Managed and Non-Managed Joint Ventures, including identifying knowledge gaps, coaching, identifying potential employees, and planning succession for critical roles

Governance, Assurance & Risk Management

Conduct technical 2nd line assurance activities and support governance processes for managed entities.

Review and challenge mine plans, production strategies, capital projects, operating costs, and technical assumptions.

Identify and manage key technical, operational, and strategic risks, constraints, opportunities and improvement initiatives impacting asset performance and long-term value creation.

Ensure compliance with applicable mining, safety, environmental, rehabilitation, and closure requirements.

Studies, Projects and Reporting

Maintain the De Beers Supply Strategy, running scenarios and updating it with changes to the business.

Lead study implementation for managed operations, including tactical transition plans.

Support Resource and Reserve reporting; review production processes and conduct iterative optimisation of the LoM forecast to maximise the reserve-to-resource ratio and achieve optimum NPV+.

Qualifications and Experience

Degree in Mining Engineering or equivalent.

Preferred certification: Professional registration with SAIMM, ECSA (Pr Eng), or equivalent recognised professional body.

Minimum 12-15 years' mining industry experience, including at least 5 years at Mining Manager or Technical Services Manager level (or equivalent), leading massive mining production environments (Hard Rock, UG and Open Pit) and managing contractor-driven mining operations (drilling, blasting, load & haul).

Demonstrated experience integrating mine planning with operational execution, and driving safety, production and cost performance at scale across a consolidated, multi-site portfolio (reflecting the combination of three previous Principal Mining Engineer roles).

Strong commercial understanding of mining operations and demonstrated leadership of multidisciplinary operational teams and contractor partners in complex mining environments.

Strong safety leadership and risk management capability, ensuring safe, compliant, and sustainable mining operations.

Deep mining operational expertise across planning, open pit, and underground mining to deliver production targets and mine plan adherence.

Drives productivity, fleet performance, and operational efficiency through data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Production Supervisor
jobs.description:
Dawson Mine

Steelmaking Coal is an essential ingredient in blast-furnace steel manufacture, producing steel used for critical building and infrastructure around the world.

Dawson Mine, located near Moura, is only a 2-hour drive from Rockhampton & Gladstone. It is a large and dynamic open cut steelmaking coal mine operation made up of two operating pits - Central and South. It commenced operations in 1961 and is one of the oldest coal mining operations in Central Queensland with no signs of slowing down. Dawson Mine is rich in history, it was the first mine in Australia to export coal to Japan in 1961 and was the first mine to introduce draglines into its operation in 1963 – join the legacy today!

We are currently seeking an experienced Production Supervisor with a passion for Truck and Shovel Operations whilst maintaining safe production at Dawson Mine.

Reporting through to the Mining Superintendent, you will demonstrate a drive for safety as well as strong interpersonal and leadership skills. As an experienced supervisor, you will be responsible for managing and leading a large team of operators to ensure operational production standards are met.

You will effectively plan, monitor and coordinate personnel, equipment and resources to achieve Dawson’s set targets and schedules. This role will be of interest to those who enjoy coaching and mentoring an established crew, interesting investigative challenges and effectively working with other departments on site whilst maintaining strong relationships.

Relevant skills, knowledge and experience required for this role include:

To be successful in the role, you will have supervisor experience running a large team within an open cut mining operation.

Demonstrated experience with Truck and Shovel operations and a working knowledge of relevant legislation.

Hold the Supervisor & Risk Facilitator competencies (S1, 2, 3 & G2).

OCE ticket is desirable but not mandatory.

Trainer & Assessor certification is desirable.

Full-time permanent position based at Dawson Mine, Moura QLD

Attractive 7 on, 7 off day/night roster

Competitive Salary Packaging + 12% Superannuation

Annual bonus incentive program

Residential, FIFO (company funded) & DIDO options

Subsidised accommodation and company funded camp options provided

Relocation Assistance available

Gym/Health incentives, On-site Physio, On-site EAP

Anglo American company benefits

What we Offer

When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too. We’re a large, successful multinational company – and we’re still growing all the time.

Who we are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. As the custodians of coal and other precious natural resources – diamonds (through De Beers), copper, platinum and other precious metals, iron ore and nickel – our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively, with the utmost consideration for local communities, our customers and the world at large.

Background checks

Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening which may include a criminal check and validation of qualifications.

Inclusion and Diversity

At Anglo American, we embrace change and promote an inclusive and diverse environment where you can bring your whole self to work, every day. We are adopting new approaches to recruitment, talent development, mentoring, parental leave, and flexible working to further support diversity across our business.

How we are committed to your safety

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

How to apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

REF81194Q

CLOSING DATE

29 October 2026

Please note, screening and interviews may take place prior to closing date – applications may also close before this date.

Recruitment Agencies

Anglo American Steelmaking Coal does not accept unsolicited applications from Recruitment Agencies.

jobs.locationRaw: Reporting to Corporate Headquarters in Toronto, Ontario, Canada
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Analyst (CPA) – Mining

Department:
Finance

Reports To:
Director of Finance

Location:
Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Blue Moon Metals is seeking a
Senior Financial Analyst
to join our growing Finance team. This role will play a key part in supporting financial reporting, IFRS compliance, operational analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate is a recently qualified CPA with experience in the mining sector, strong technical accounting expertise, and a collaborative approach to partnering across corporate and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities

Support the preparation, consolidation, and analysis of monthly management reporting packages, quarterly financial statements, and annual financial reporting in accordance with IFRS

Assist in preparing Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) disclosures, technical accounting assessments, audit working papers, and IFRS accounting analyses

Partner closely with Corporate Accounting and site finance teams to improve the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of financial information and reporting processes

Serve as an internal IFRS technical resource and provide accounting guidance to operational finance teams

Support external reporting requirements, including filings for TSX Venture Exchange, Nasdaq, and other regulatory reporting obligations

Prepare supporting schedules, variance analysis, and reporting documentation for internal and external stakeholders

Collaborate with operational and project teams to analyze mine development, construction, and exploration expenditures

Support ERP and financial systems initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA implementation activities, financial reporting enhancements, and internal control improvements

Participate in ad hoc financial analysis, process optimization initiatives, and strategic projects

Contribute to continuous improvement efforts within the financial reporting function to support a growing mining organization

Qualifications & Experience

Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline

CPA designation required

3–6 years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience

Previous experience within the mining industry strongly preferred

Strong understanding of IFRS accounting standards; exposure to US GAAP considered an asset

Public accounting experience, particularly within a Big 4 mining practice, is considered a strong asset

Experience supporting publicly traded company reporting requirements considered an asset

Proficiency with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills

Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively across technical and operational teams

Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Development opportunities via department rotation

Pay Range And Compensation Package

Compensation and benefits details will be discussed during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Convocatoria Programa Prácticas y Memorias Verano 2027
jobs.description:
En mi Codelco era

Nuestra misión es maximizar el valor económico, ambiental y social de Codelco y su contribución al Estado de manera sostenible, a través de operaciones propias y asociaciones en minería de cobre, litio y sus subproductos. Para ello, necesitamos talentos que contribuyan a asegurar el aporte económico y social a Chile con los más altos estándares de seguridad, las mejores prácticas, y el cuidado del medioambiente y de nuestro entorno.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a estudiantes de Educación Superior, Técnico Profesional o Enseñanza Media Técnico Profesional de diversas áreas y especialidades relacionadas o que pudieran vincularse con la minería.

Nos interesan las personas orientadas hacia la excelencia, que estén dispuestas a desafiarse a sí mismas y a los demás, que trabajen colaborativamente y que busquen un crecimiento integral.

Si eres una persona con determinación, pasión y vocación, y quieres aportar con tu talento a la minería que hace crecer a Chile, Co
delco es el lugar para trazar tu futuro.

Te invitamos a formar parte de una experiencia de aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional en la empresa preferida por profesionales para trabajar (N°1 en Merco Talento 2026).

¿Te unes?

Requisitos de Postulación:

Ser alumno/a regular de la carrera por la que postulas a la práctica y/o memoria.

Contar con cobertura del Seguro Escolar (Ley 16.744) avalado por la casa de estudios durante el período de la práctica y/o memoria.

Poseer salud compatible con el trabajo en faena.

Aspectos Deseables:

Rendimiento académico con nota igual o superior a 5.0 o su equivalente.

Participación en, al menos, 1 actividad extracurricular y/o académica durante tu formación.

Contar con disponibilidad para ser asignado/a a cualquiera de nuestros centros de trabajo.

Condiciones Ofrecidas:

Convenio de Práctica Profesional o Memoria.

Asignación económica mensual acorde a mercado.

Alimentación durante la Práctica o Memoria.

Traslado desde la ciudad base del centro de trabajo hacia los recintos industriales (Ida y vuelta). (Si resides en una ciudad distinta al centro de trabajo asignado; no incluye traslado hacia y desde ese punto, ni alojamiento o campamento)

Para el trabajo en faena: Equipos de protección personal según normativa vigente.

El lugar de trabajo será en oficinas centrales o en los recintos industriales de los distintos centros, según sea asignado/a.

Jornada laboral de lunes a viernes o de lunes a jueves, dependiendo del centro de trabajo al que seas asignado/a.

Según centro de trabajo se evaluará la opción de modalidad de teletrabajo, de acuerdo a la naturaleza de las funciones.

¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte de una experiencia única en el mundo de la minería con Codelco!

jobs.title: Principal Projects Commercia | BHP Chile
jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP, we bring people and resources together to build a better world. We foster an inclusive, diverse, and high‑performing culture where everyone feels safe, respected, and empowered to thrive. With a global portfolio and a strong commitment to sustainability, we offer our teams opportunities to grow, lead meaningful transformations, and make a lasting impact.

We are united by our values, our dedication to safety, and our belief that great people drive great outcomes.

Why not you? Why not BHP?

The challenge Ahead

The role will provide leadership in the development and implementation of contracting strategies, standards, processes, systems and plans for a complex capital mega project that will ensure the safe delivery of value maximizing investments. It will manage the key internal and external project interfaces, assess and manage the risk and build close relationship with our main colaborators, BHP commitment to inclusion & diversity and whilst HSE remains a priority will recognize the importance of people’s wellbeing.

Core Activities

• Ensures conformance with the BHP Charter, the BHP Group Level Documents, Code of Conduct and relevant statutory obligations;

• Provides an overriding commitment to health (including mental health), safety, environment responsibility and sustainable development with relentless focus on lowering risk exposure

•  Provides leadership for the development of the contracting and procurement strategies in an EPCM and EPC models, identifying the interfaces and risks considering the multi-billion dollar project scope; successfully maintains the interface with Supply and Purchasing sub-functions in establishing and executing Project Commercial strategies.

• Project key focal point for Contracts, Procurement and Supply.

Applies an understanding of end-to-end Supply Chain to enhance efficiency, drive optimisation, and maximise value.  

• Evaluates risk profiles, project drivers, and contracting options to inform the development of contracting strategies, and contracts in alignment with project execution strategies.  

• Manages contract execution and analysis to maximise operational and financial performance and mitigate exposure and risk.  

• Develops safe project delivery and contractor performance strategies to maximise portfolio value and enhance improvement and innovation.  

• Gains support for and negotiates outcomes that achieve mutually beneficial goals.  

• Identifies and assesses risks, makes risk informed decisions, uses BHP's risk management framework and builds a risk aware culture to support safe and productive performance outcomes.  

• Identifies, engages and manages a range of diverse internal and external stakeholders.  

• Determines the underlying cause of problems and evaluates multiple solutions to ensure a planned and structured approach to solving complex problems.  

• Mitigates people, environmental and community risks across the value chain, in alignment with sustainability and public policy.  

• Strives to achieve 100% safety, 100% customer value and 0% waste.  

What We Expect From You

Required:

•Degree tertiary qualifications, preferably in an Engineering discipline (s), Construction Management, Economics, Legal or related discipline

•Extensive contract management experience; EPCM and EPC contract management experience.

•10 years of experience in projects; a high degree of business acumen with deep understanding of mega projects execution, risks and strategies. 

•All complex mega capital project phases in the field of Contracting & Procurement.

•Managing a mega project portfolio of spend and interfaces.

•Hands on EPCM and EPC development, contract formation and management experience;

•EPCM and EPC Contract terms and conditions negotiation experience;

•Claims prevention and management;

•Offshore experience is a plus;

•Managing/supervising a team of Contracts & Procurement professionals on a mega project;

•Relating well with people with an engaging style, which quickly enables building of trust and strong relationships with stakeholders;

•Ability to interface in a global setting and to drive excellence across the Commercial Project team. 

•Outstanding leadership capability (Engage, Develop, Problem Solve, Learn and Adapt, Lead Change and Manage Risk);

•Strong and varied project execution experience on complex mega capital projects.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At BHP Chile, we understand that to give your best, you need to feel your best. That’s why our benefits are designed to support you at every stage, caring for your health, driving your development, and promoting a real balance between your personal and professional life.

Professional Development: Continuous learning and real growth opportunities.

Compensation: Fair and competitive, reflecting your role, skills, and achievements.

Inclusive Culture: We promote a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and free to express their authentic identity.

Recognition: We reward your achievements through our global recognition program Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias.

And much more!

We Support a Diverse Workforce

At BHP, we adhere to Inclusion Law 21.015.

We know diversity makes us stronger. That’s why we focus on creating a more diverse workforce that represents the communities where we operate and live, ensuring a workplace where everyone is included and treated with respect.

We are committed to a fair, equitable, and accessible selection process for all. If you have any type of disability, please write to inclusion@bhp.com so we can adjust our selection process and provide the necessary support.
