jobs.title: Especialista Senior Geólogo(a) Geotécnico(a) | Escondida
jobs.description:
Sobre Escondida | BHP 

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global. 

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Somos operados por una compañía global líder en recursos naturales, con operaciones en más de 90 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo. 

Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar. Aquí, tu voz cuenta. Tu crecimiento importa. Y tu trabajo contribuye directamente a transformar el mundo. 

El desafío que te espera

Reportando al SI de Geotecnia Largo Plazo, el/la Especialista Senior Geólogo(a) Geotécnico será responsable de desarrollar los modelos geotécnicos y estructurales utilizados como inputs de los análisis de estabilidad para los planes mineros de corto, mediano y largo plazo. Colaborar en el desarrollo y explotación de la mina a través del mapeo y modelamiento geotécnico/estructural del rajo, validando el proceso de la toma de los datos geomecánicos.

Principales responsabilidades

Realizar mapeo y modelamiento estructural y geotécnico del rajo.

Definir y controlar campaña de sondajes geotécnicos.

Asegurar la calidad del mapeo geotécnico y estructural.

Supervisar proyectos geológicos/geotécnicos, apoyar con análisis de información geotécnica.

Interpretar y analizar información de mapeo estructural (reflex, Televiewer, etc.).

Controlar parámetros geotécnicos, identificar inestabilidades y emitir recomendaciones.

Validar modelos geológicos y geotécnicos.

Analizar e interpretar ensayos de laboratorio.

Analizar inestabilidades de taludes.

Lo que esperamos de ti

Título profesional de Geología con especialización en geotecnia. Deseable especialización en geología estructural.

Deseable poseer postgrado relacionado a geotecnia y geología estructural (Magíster o Doctorado).

Experiencia mínima de 7 años en áreas de geotecnia en la industria minera. 

Conocimiento en modelos geológicos de yacimientos mineros y en especial del tipo pórfido cuprífero. 

Experiencia en control y análisis de parámetros geotécnicos, análisis y clasificación de macizos rocosos y geología estructural. 

Experiencia en definición y control de campañas de sondajes geotécnicos. 

Experiencia en administración de contratos relacionados a trabajos geotécnicos y geológicos.

Deseable experiencia en geotecnia para obras civiles.

Dominio de Vulcan y Leapfrog nivel avanzado. 

Dominio de suite Rocscience. 

Dominio nivel avanzado en Dips. 

Deseable inglés nivel intermedio.

Disponibilidad para trabajar en faena, bajo la modalidad de turno 4x3.

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí

En Escondida | BHP entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.  

- Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.  

- Remuneración: justa y competitiva que refleje tu rol, habilidades y logros. 

- Cultura inclusiva: Promovemos un entorno laboral donde cada persona se siente valorada, respetada y libre de expresar su identidad auténtica. 

- Reconocimiento: Te recompensamos por tus pequeños y grandes logros a través de nuestro programa global de reconocimiento Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias. 

¡Y mucho más!  

Sobre nuestro proceso

En Escondida | BHP contratamos personas que se alinean con nuestros valores y cumplen con los requisitos del rol. Como parte del proceso, podríamos analizar el cumplimiento de los requisitos para determinar la idoneidad y capacidad personal para ejecutar el trabajo.  

Si ya trabajas en BHP, postula a través del portal interno con tu correo corporativo.   

¿Y por qué no tú?

Nuestra compañía te ofrece oportunidades sin límites. Desde beneficios competitivos hasta la posibilidad de trabajar en distintos países, aquí puedes diseñar tu carrera a tu manera. Si estás buscando un lugar donde tu trabajo tenga propósito y tu crecimiento sea parte del camino, este puede ser tu próximo paso.  

¡Postula hoy y sé parte de la transformación de la minería! 

Apoyamos una fuerza laboral diversa

En Escondida | BHP nos adherimos a la Ley de Inclusión 21.015.  

Sabemos que la diversidad nos fortalece. Es por eso por lo que estamos enfocados en crear una fuerza laboral más diversa que represente las comunidades en las que operamos y vivimos, asegurando un ambiente laboral donde cada persona sea incluida y tratada con respeto.  

En ese sentido, estamos comprometidos a realizar un proceso de selección justo, equitativo y accesible para todos. Si tienes algún tipo de discapacidad, por favor escríbenos a inclusion@bhp.com para poder ajustar nuestro proceso de selección y brindarte el apoyo necesario.

jobs.title: Principal Delivery | BHP Chile
jobs.description:
Sobre BHP Chile

En BHP Chile, nuestra oficina corporativa en Santiago es el corazón estratégico de nuestras operaciones en el país. Desde aquí lideramos proyectos que impulsan la minería responsable y la innovación, conectando el impacto local con la visión global de BHP. Somos parte de una compañía dedicada a los recursos naturales presente en más de 90 ubicaciones en el mundo, dedicada a crear un futuro más sostenible.

¿Por qué BHP Chile?

Porque aquí tendrás la oportunidad de crecer en una organización que valora la diversidad, fomenta el desarrollo profesional y apuesta por tecnologías que transforman la industria minera. En BHP Chile podrás generar impacto real en la comunidad y el medioambiente, mientras construyes tu carrera en una empresa reconocida por su cultura inclusiva y su compromiso con el futuro.

El desafío que te espera

Gestionarás un área de alcance asociada a grandes proyectos de capital o proyectos relevantes de activos, proporcionando conocimientos técnicos especializados en la planificación y ejecución de estrategias de construcción. Tu rol será clave en la aplicación de normas y marcos de trabajo, la integración y la gestión de interfaces a lo largo del ciclo de vida de los proyectos, asegurando que la entrega se realice en línea con la declaración de requisitos aprobada.

Principales responsabilidades

Planificar (en SPS/DPS/EXE), apoyar y gestionar la activación y operación de los servicios de faena para construcción de distintos proyectos dentro del programa EGP, asegurando la seguridad, el cumplimiento de los procesos de gobernanza internos y externos, y los estándares de desempeño del Global Standard.

Supervisar, dentro del área de alcance definida, el costo, el programa y los riesgos de los paquetes de trabajo asociados a la entrega de servicios de faena para la correcta ejecución de los proyectos EGP.

Realizar previsiones mensuales de los paquetes de trabajo y aportar información de entrega entre los distintos proyectos EGP, coordinando con empresas EPCM, activos y equipos de proyectos de VP Growth.

Gestionar y mantener herramientas digitales para reportes a la gerencia, tales como cronogramas de trabajo, planillas de planificación, sistemas documentales como Aconex, entre otros.

Asegurar el cumplimiento oportuno de compromisos e hitos de los servicios de faena dentro de tu área de influencia, de acuerdo con los distintos cronogramas de proyecto, evitando impactos en su ejecución.

Aportar conocimientos técnicos para la aplicación de estrategias de entrega, metodologías, sistemas y planes de ejecución que minimicen el despilfarro y preserven el valor, asumiendo la responsabilidad de las decisiones y gestionando su impacto.

Identificar, evaluar y gestionar riesgos dentro del área de alcance definida, comunicándolos oportunamente a las partes interesadas y utilizando el marco de gestión de riesgos de BHP para asegurar resultados seguros y productivos.

Ejecutar planes de gestión de calidad y revisar actividades de control de calidad en terreno, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de calidad definidos.

Impulsar decisiones de valor óptimo que aseguren el avance del área de alcance, gestionando y mitigando desviaciones respecto del plan de ejecución.

Gestionar la ejecución de servicios prestados por terceros, participando en procesos de licitación, evaluación, adjudicación y administración de contratos.

Asegurar que los proyectos se ejecuten de acuerdo con las prácticas BOS y cuestionar el OWO desde etapas tempranas para optimizar el valor y reducir el Capex.

Lo que esperamos de tí

Título universitario (de preferencia ingeniería o construcción.

Experiencia demostrable de al menos 5 años en gestión de proyectos mayores, idealmente en fase de ejecución.

Experiencia comprobable en construcción.

Experiencia en planificación, coordinación y entrega de servicios de faena necesarios para la movilización e inicio de ejecución de proyectos EGP.

Deseable certificación en Gestión de Proyectos, equivalente a PMP o CPPP.

Alta competencia técnica en tu especialidad.

Capacidad analítica avanzada para elaborar informes y presentaciones claras y concisas.

Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita en español e inglés.

Adaptabilidad, flexibilidad y capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas simultáneamente.

Enfoque colaborativo, orientación a soluciones y habilidad para influir en partes interesadas internas y externas, consultores y contratistas

Control Systems Engineer

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí

En BHP Chile entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.

Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.

Remuneración: Justa y competitiva, alineada con tu rol, habilidades y logros.

Cultura inclusiva: Un entorno donde cada persona es valorada y respetada.

Reconocimiento: Programa global Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias para celebrar tus logros.

¡Y mucho más!

Apoyamos una fuerza laboral diversa

En BHP nos adherimos a la Ley de Inclusión 21.015.

Sabemos que la diversidad nos fortalece y estamos comprometidos con un proceso de selección justo, equitativo y accesible.

Si tienes algún tipo de discapacidad, escríbenos a inclusion@bhp.com para brindarte el apoyo necesario durante el proceso.

jobs.title: Specialist Analysis & Improvement - Plazo Fijo (6 meses) | Escondida
jobs.description:
Sobre Escondida | BHP 

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global.

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Somos operados por una compañía global líder en recursos naturales, con operaciones en más de 90 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo. 

Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar. Aquí, tu voz cuenta. Tu crecimiento importa. Y tu trabajo contribuye directamente a transformar el mundo. 

El desafio que te espera

En Escondida | BHP será responsable de identificar oportunidades y brechas operacionales que cambian, habilitan y generan valor en el desempeño de Escondida en lo que respecta al desempeño del asset. Será fundamental para el desarrollo y la implementación exitosa de soluciones de sistemas y procesos con desviaciones, mediante diversidad de soluciones basados en el análisis de datos, así como también con el propio modelamiento de información para entender el comportamiento y proyección futura.

La responsabilidad principal para el especialista es aplicar una sólida experiencia el diagnostico de causas raíz mediante la interpretación de los datos identificando correctamente las principales acciones que se deben realizar para generar un cambio sostenible del procesos o sistema analizado principalmente en área de Operaciones Mina. Deberá realizar el monitoreo y control de las iniciativas asegurando el valor capturado.

Principales Responsabilidades

Como Specialist Analysis & Improvement, serás responsable de:

Presentar ideas, resultados y recomendaciones a una variedad de clientes de forma efectiva a nivel de gerentes

Participa de la sustentabilidad del sistema operativo BHP (BOS) al brindar diagnóstico de OEE y configurar las aspiraciones de indicadores claves del negocio.

Es pilar fundamental en la resolución de problemas: asegura que se definan adecuadamente los principales problemas en la cadena de valor, incluido el contexto del problema, los stakeholders, las medidas de éxito (KPIs) y los desafíos potenciales.

Realiza la identificación de oportunidades, diagnósticos certeros y análisis de brechas con el fin de identificar las principales oportunidades de valor.

Evalúa la eficacia del sistema y del proceso end-to-end.

Participa de forma colaborativa de la generación de iniciativas para cerrar las brechas del negocio detectadas, así como el monitoreo y control de la ejecución de estas.

Crear asociaciones y mantiene sólidas relaciones de trabajo con los stakeholders, tiene una mirada centrada en la voz del cliente.
Comprender los problemas operacionales y diseña e implementa soluciones mediante técnicas de consultoría y resolución de problemas.
Gestiona la cartera de iniciativas de mejora de la cadena de valor, centrándose en la limitaciones e interfaces generales, así como los KVDs de transferencia.

Evalúa el comportamiento de métricas del negocio y proporciona retroalimentación a los equipos de planificación, para detectar amenazas, oportunidades y ejecución del corto y largo plazo.

Automatiza reportes, análisis y rutinas que tengan uso de data como fuente y generen valor a la organización

Realización de análisis estadísticos avanzados para proporcionar información procesable, identificar tendencias y medir el desempeño. Así como el desarrollo de modelos de optimización mediante herramientas de análisis descriptivo estándar, determinístico, de simulación e idealmente maneja y aplica conceptos de advanced analytics, machine learning, deep learning y los algoritmos relacionados

Colabora con los equipos de desarrollo software de productos para asegurar la funcionalidad del modelo, utilizando soluciones en la nube y monitoreando la calidad y efectividad de los modelos en las operaciones.

Proporcionar liderazgo intelectual mediante la investigación de las mejores prácticas, la realización de experimentos y la colaboración con los líderes de la industria.

Da asesoría sobre procesos oportunidades de procesos metalúrgicos en Plantas de Hidrometalurgia y/o Plantas concentradoras o en alguna etapa de la cadena de valor de cobre.

Lo que esperamos de ti

Buscamos personas que cuenten con:

Titulo profesional de Ingeniería de Minas, Mecánica, Eléctrica, Industrial u Especialidades a fin (Electrónica, Metalurgia, etc.). También se consideran carreras asociadas al análisis de datos como Matemáticas, Informática u otros.

Disponibilidad para trabajar bajo modalidad de contrato a plazo fijo (6 meses) por reemplazo pre y post natal.

Al menos 3 años en roles de producción y/u otras área mina.

Experiencia laboral en consultoría, excelencia operacional o control de procesos minero.

Experiencia laboral en procesos de planificación, perforación y tronadura, carguío y transporte, despacho y/o mantenimiento mina en ejecución, planificación o confiabilidad, en minería de cobre.

Excelentes habilidades de análisis, resolución de problemas y pensamiento crítico (certificado Six-sigma green belt).

Experiencia trabajando con grandes conjuntos de datos, simulación / optimización y herramientas informáticas distribuidas.

Experiencia en la gestión y manejo de carteras de iniciativa de mejora o proyectos.

Experiencia o interés en trabajar en un entorno de equipo, con capacidad para gestionar plazos competitivos.

Experiencia liderando o participando de forma activa en el desarrollo e implementación de proyectos de mejor

jobs.title: Lead Asset Training - Plazo Fijo (6 meses) | Escondida
jobs.description:
Sobre Escondida | BHP 

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global.

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Somos operados por una compañía global líder en recursos naturales, con operaciones en más de 90 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo. 

Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar. Aquí, tu voz cuenta. Tu crecimiento importa. Y tu trabajo contribuye directamente a transformar el mundo. 

El desafio que te espera

En Escondida | BHP serás responsable de identificar, definir, planificar, diseñar, desarrollar, ejecutar, reportar y gobernar los entrenamientos del sitio, en línea con el Framework global de Learning. Tu propósito será asegurar la correcta ejecución del proceso de formación en todo el Asset, habilitando el rol de cada persona que se integra a Escondida | BHP, mediante un liderazgo sólido y transversal.

Liderarás equipos y proyectos asociados a Asset Training, siendo responsable de la identificación de necesidades, la planificación de recursos y costos, el diseño de soluciones de aprendizaje y la gobernabilidad de los procesos. Todo esto con una mirada de corto y largo plazo, alineada a la sostenibilidad de los procesos y al desarrollo continuo de capacidades.

Este rol requiere una alta capacidad de articulación con stakeholders, integración con equipos de proyectos y relacionamiento con áreas como HR y RRLL, gestionando personas, procesos y riesgos. El principal desafío será liderar con foco en el futuro, asegurando la habilitación de los roles en la operación, promoviendo el upskilling y reskilling organizacional, y contribuyendo a la seguridad y continuidad del proceso productivo.

Además, se espera que actúes como referente experto en gestión de capacitación, personas y riesgos asociados al aprendizaje, con capacidad de análisis y toma de decisiones en estos ámbitos.

Principales Responsabilidades

Como Lead Asset Training, serás responsable de:

Diseñar soluciones de aprendizaje efectivas y sostenibles que respalden los objetivos de rendimiento empresarial y una cultura de aprendizaje continuo.

Utilizar metodologías y herramientas de diseño instruccional para evaluar necesidades de aprendizaje y crear experiencias que faciliten la adquisición de conocimientos.

Tomar decisiones estratégicas basadas en evidencia, alineadas con los objetivos de largo plazo del negocio.

Identificar, involucrar y gestionar una amplia gama de grupos de interés internos y externos.

Planificar, ejecutar y realizar seguimiento de proyectos para generar valor y asegurar el logro de resultados.

Realizar presentaciones y facilitar talleres utilizando storytelling para influir, conectar y comprometer a la audiencia.

Implementar y evaluar herramientas, métodos, datos y enfoques de gestión del cambio.

Aplicar el entendimiento del contexto del negocio, el modelo operativo y las formas de trabajo para mejorar la toma de decisiones, la productividad y el desempeño.

Aprovechar las capacidades de personas en toda la organización para maximizar resultados.

Promover la excelencia operacional, asegurando estándares de seguridad, foco en el cliente y eficiencia (minimización de desperdicios).

Lo que esperamos de ti

Buscamos personas que cuenten con:

Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Civil en Minas o Metalurgia.

Disponibilidad para trabajar bajo modalidad de contrato a plazo fijo (6 meses) por reemplazo pre y post natal.

Experiencia laboral de al menos 5 años en roles similares.

Experiencia en gestión de proyectos (PMO) y liderazgo de equipos.

Experiencia en capacitación, desarrollo organizacional y plataformas LMS (deseable).

Manejo de herramientas analíticas como Power BI u otros softwares de gestión de datos.

Conocimientos en diseño instruccional (deseable).

Ubicación: Faena Escondida.

Jornada: Turno 4x3.

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí

En Escondida | BHP entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.  

- Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.  

- Remuneración: justa y competitiva que refleje tu rol, habilidades y logros. 

- Cultura inclusiva: Promovemos un entorno laboral donde cada persona se siente valorada, respetada y libre de expresar su identidad auténtica. 

- Reconocimiento: Te recompensamos por tus pequeños y grandes logros a través de nuestro programa global de reconocimiento Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias. 

¡Y mucho más!  

Sobre nuestro proceso

En Escondida | BHP contratamos personas que se alinean con nuestros valores y cumplen con los requisitos del rol. Como parte del proceso, podríamos analizar el cumplimiento de los requisitos para determinar la idoneidad y capacidad personal para ejecutar el trabajo.  

Si ya trabajas en BHP, postula a través del portal interno con tu correo corporativo.   

¿Y por qué no tú?

Nuestra compañía te ofrece oportunidades sin límites. Desde beneficios competitivos hasta la posibilidad de trabajar en distintos países, aquí puedes diseñar tu carrera a tu manera. Si estás buscando un lugar donde tu trabajo tenga propósito y tu crecimiento sea parte del camino, este puede ser tu pró

BHP’s copper province in South Australia (Copper SA) comprises the Olympic Dam, Prominent Hill and Carrapateena underground mines, with smelter and refinery complex at Olympic Dam. The company is also progressing the Oak Dam exploration prospect.

For you, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and help shape the future of one of Australia's leading copper businesses.

Reporting to the Superintendent Strategic Mine Planning, you will be part of a team supporting growth studies, Life of Asset planning and Ore Reserve reporting for the Copper SA assets.

Through insight and innovation, you will play a critical role in long-term strategic mine planning to support and align with business priorities. 

This unique role can influence and inform strategic mine planning outcomes across multiple sites using various underground mining methods while interfacing with project teams to deliver value.

Your extensive industry experience will enable you to develop and maintain effective working relationships with a wide stakeholder group with the ability to communicate at all levels of the organisation.

This role is based in Adelaide with occasional site travel required.

In this role you will:

Develop mine planning strategies to support growth opportunities within the Copper SA province.

Produce underground mine designs and schedules across multiple mining methods to optimise long-term value

Support the integration and optimisation of Copper SA.

Utilise industry experience to develop continuous improvement initiatives

Leverage your expertise and industry connections to bring new technologies and ways of working to the business to improve safety and productivity.

Promote mine planning as the vehicle that supports, collates, and drives forward all technical disciplines and asset optionality.

Support the annual Ore Reserve estimation and declaration.

Provide technical support for significant mine planning projects, studies, and reviews.

Apply divergent thought to value optimisation for the operations.

Communicate and collaborate with other Planning and Execution teams.

Develop scopes of work to engage additional external stakeholders as required to support business needs.

Project management of packages of work as required to support studies.

Monitor and maintain progress for all design work, using the relevant team tools.

About You

Degree qualified in Mining Engineering (or equivalent), with a strategic mindset.

Extensive experience in underground mine planning and operations across various operations/projects.

Expertise in underground hard rock mining methods including block caving.

Demonstrated successful communication of complex issues and influencing positive change.

Adept at leading and influencing diverse groups in a large organisation.

Deep technical knowledge of mine planning as an integrated activity with all other technical disciplines.

Sound written and verbal communication skills.

Experience in delivering studies through to operations readiness and execution

Previous experience as a Competent Person for Ore Reserves Reporting is advantageous.

Proficiency in Deswik and/or Cave mining method production scheduling software.

A major shaft project is supporting underground expansion and extending mine life to at least 2040, creating long-term opportunities across the operation.

Degree in Geotechnical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mining Engineering or a related discipline

Experience in underground mining geotechnical roles.

Proven ability to manage small to medium geotechnical projects in a mining or construction setting

Familiarity with mining, geotechnical design and monitoring software (e.g. Deswik, Rocscience suite, rockfall 3D, slide)

Strong communication, stakeholder engagement and reporting skills

A proactive, safety-first mindset and ability to work independently and as part of a team

Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills

jobs.description:
At Freeport-McMoRan, we are committed to providing an employment package that recognizes excellence, encourages safe production and a culture supported by our core values. Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their career.
Apply Today!

Where You Will Work

Our Miami smelter and rod plant is nestled just 90 miles east of Phoenix. The smelter processes copper concentrate primarily from our company’s Arizona copper mines and is the most significant source of sulfuric acid for our North American leaching operations.
 
Arizona

’

s Globe-Miami
 
historic mining district offers natural beauty and a rich mining heritage. The Tri-Town of Globe, Claypool and Miami offers convenient shopping locales, including Walmart, Safeway, Fry

’

s and other local stores. Here, our employees and their families can connect with the outdoors and enjoy the family-friendly atmosphere.
  
Visit

Globe-Miami.com

to learn more.

Description

The goal of the Reliability Centered Maintenance Group is to achieve higher equipment availability and lower maintenance costs through predictive maintenance technologies.  This goal is realized by regularly scheduled monitoring of equipment with predictive technologies and coordinating the necessary maintenance through teamwork with other maintenance and operations personnel, including but not limited to supervision, planning, engineering, and field personnel.

This position requires travel to other facilities and interaction with vendors, contractors and company personnel; any and all business must be conducted in a professional manner as a representative of Freeport-McMoRan.  This position requires a responsible, self-motivated person who is able to work efficiently with minimal supervision. This position requires working in confined spaces and tight corridors, as well as, working closely around moving, rotating, electrically energized, and elevated equipment in a safe and efficient manner.  

The RCM Technicians monitor equipment ranging from the SX/EW, Powerhouse, the Water System, IPCC, Mine (Shovels, Drills, Haulage) to outlying areas

Perform vibration data collection utilizing current technology (CSI)

Utilization of the current software to load, dump, and analyze vibration route data, as well as, build and update the associated databases (AP sets, alarm sets, etc.)

Report building/giving presentations utilizing various software programs, daily planning, including but not limited to MSTs and work orders utilizing the current CMMS

Data collection, analysis and reporting utilizing

Learn various RCM/PdM technologies, primarily ultrasonic analysis and the associated software with future development into additional technologies

Support the RCM Program and its continual development; educate other personnel in any area of the RCM Program

Communicate effectively to provide, receive, and implement constructive feedback to support the mentoring program

Actively participate with Maintenance and Planning groups

Perform additional duties as required

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of seven (7) years of hands-on mechanical maintenance repair/rebuild experience with industrial equipment (pumps, motors, gearboxes, pulleys, etc.) that includes:

Working knowledge and understanding of moving and rotating equipment such as pumps, motors, gearboxes and conveyors, from an operations and maintenance perspective, mechanically and electrically

A working knowledge and understanding of basic prints and ability to read them

Journeyman level ability to read, understand and apply information from technical manuals and other reference materials

Must have completed academic and practical competencies required (this includes Line of Progression requirements for internal employees where LOP Exists) and have experience demonstrating the required aptitude. The selected candidate shall demonstrate the ability to apply knowledge and skills while also passing a written assessment where required. This exam is based on skills/abilities and/or academic knowledge; as well as safety.

Ability to work in a team with a high regard for safety and environmental concerns and with a strong commitment to policies

Effective written, verbal, and communication skills to satisfy training, safety, and electronic message transmission policies of the company

Demonstrated computer skills in Windows environment with experience in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

Possess Level I certification or obtain within one (1) year of hire date

Valid state driver's license

Satisfactory performance record (internal applicant)

Preferred

High School diploma or GED

Minimum of ten (10) years of hands-on mechanical maintenance repair/rebuild experience with industrial equipment (pumps, motors, gearboxes, pulleys, etc.) that includes:

A working knowledge and understanding of moving and rotating equipment such as pumps, motors, gearboxes and conveyors, from an operations and maintenance perspective, electrically and mechanically

A working knowledge and understanding of basic prints and ability to read them

Journeyman level ability to read, understand and apply information from technical manuals and other referenced materials

Vibration experience or Certification

Familiar with RBMWare (AMS-CSI) Software

Experience in utilizing and maintaining Emerson/CSI online vibration monitoring system

Experience with RCFA

What We Offer You 

The estimated pay range for this role is currently 
$36.00 - $48.50/hour.
This range reflects base salary only and does not include bonus payments, benefits or retirement contributions. Actual base pay is determined by experience, qualifications, skills and other job-related factors. jobs.description:
About Us

Fortescue is both a proud West Australian company and a global green solutions business. We are recognised for our culture, innovation and industry-leading development of infrastructure, mining assets and green energy initiatives.

Our Opportunity

Work Location:

Perth Office – Fortescue’s Perth office is located on the traditional lands of the Whadjuk Noongar people

Roster:

 Monday to Friday

Join Fortescue at an exciting point in our journey as we transform mining through technology, autonomy and decarbonisation. 

As Product Owner – HaulX, you’ll help build technology integral to the safe, efficient and reliable operation of our autonomous mining fleet, and our transition towards battery electric fleets. 

Working with operators, customers, engineers and product teams, you’ll turn real operational challenges into clear product priorities and practical solutions. Whether your experience comes from product, mining operations, engineering, technology or business analysis, if you bring strong operational insight, curiosity and an ability to connect people and ideas, we encourage you to apply. 

Key Responsibilities

Engage with operators, customers and stakeholders to truly understand your customer and your customers problems, opportunities and the experience of people using HaulX

Make informed prioritisation and trade-off decisions, clearly communicating the
what
and
why
behind product priorities, ensuring the customer is centered in every decision

Continuously shape and prioritise the HaulX product backlog, balancing customer needs, operational priorities, safety and business value

Translate operational problems and business needs into clear themes, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for development teams

Partner with engineering, product, operations, verification and other specialists throughout the product lifecycle

Support the safe and successful introduction of new capabilities through release communication, documentation, training and operational readiness

Gather feedback and product performance insights to continuously improve usability, productivity and operational outcomes. 

Qualifications and Experience

Experience in product ownership, mining operations, fleet management, autonomous haulage, mining, 
business
analysis, engineering or a related field

An understanding of mining operations and/or complex operational technology environments; experience with fleet management or autonomous systems will be highly regarded

Collaborate at every step, leverage your strong communication and relationship-building skills across operational, technical and leadership teams

Ability to understand customer problems and translate business or operational needs into clear, measurable, actionable priorities

Sound judgement and problem-solving skills, with an ability to balance competing needs and make evidence-based decisions

Product Owner or product lifecycle experience is valued but not essential where you can demonstrate relevant transferable capability

Familiarity with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira or Confluence is advantageous. 

Our Commitment

Fortescue is deeply committed to providing a safe culture that builds respect, fosters inclusiveness, and values diversity. We celebrate individual strengths and team members from all backgrounds are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with across the world. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with differing abilities, LGBTIQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics.
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Work Location:
Chichester Operations – Cloudbreak. Fortescue’s Cloudbreak Operations are located on the traditional lands of the Palyku and Nyiyaparli peoples.

Roster:
8D6X FIFO Perth

The Lead Project Execution reports to the Superintendent Maintenance Projects and is responsible for leading and mentoring a team of Project Area Leads during the execution phase of sustaining capital projects.

The role will provide leadership across project execution, commissioning, asset handover and operational readiness, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time and in line with the Fortescue project framework.

The sustaining capital portfolio includes critical asset replacements, asset modifications and upgrades, obsolete equipment replacement, structural remediation and electrical equipment upgrades.

Lead, mentor and develop a team of experienced Project Area Leads.

Coordinate resources in line with upcoming project execution requirements.

Provide focused leadership on risk management and promote a positive safety culture.

Engage with maintenance, operations, engineering, shutdown and planning teams.

Review and lead project methodology, schedule and readiness discussions.

Coordinate communication and interfaces across departments.

Provide direction to cross-functional teams to overcome obstacles and maintain project progress.

Manage projects through execution, commissioning, handover and operational readiness.

Maintain project risk and issues registers and escalate schedule or performance risks.

Ensure multilevel walkdowns are completed for critical path projects.

Lead vendor feedback and lessons-learned activities.

Support succession planning, capability development and workforce planning.

Minimum of 3 years’ supervisory experience in a brownfields environment.

Experience managing contractors in the mining or heavy industry sectors.

Experience across campaign maintenance, shutdowns and small capital projects.

Strong understanding of contractor management, safety, quality and risk controls.

Knowledge of Western Australian mine safety legislation and relevant Australian Standards.

Ability to interpret and challenge project methodologies, schedules and engineering designs.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID:
182228

Job Level:
Internship

Home District/Group:
Kiewit Mining District

Department:
Field Operations

Market:
Mining

Employment Type:
Full Time Temporary

Position Overview

Are you interested in a hands-on real-world learning experience directly related to the skills needed in a full-time construction career? In this internship, you will have the opportunity to develop, participate and learn key roles and functions within construction management.

Our mission is to make a difference and we offer opportunities for you to make one too through our construction operations. Whether we're boring tunnels through mountains, turning rivers into energy or building bridges that connect communities, we depend on our passionate, skilled, and safety-obsessed construction professionals to get it done right. You bring your big ideas, commitment to top quality, and an unwavering work ethic. In return, we offer huge career and travel opportunities and the satisfaction of building the next big thing from the ground up. There's a reason Kiewit attracts the best: we offer fast-paced excitement and fulfillment you won't find anywhere else.

District Overview

Kiewit Mining Group has grown steadily to become one of North America's leading producers of high-quality, high-energy coal and is ranked as one of the top 10 coal producers in the nation. We are built on a solid foundation of safety, quality, production and integrity.

Location

One of the many things that makes Kiewit's culture unique is that we go where the work is, which exposes your career to abundant opportunities. We relocate our teams based on the work that is available, combined with the development plans, skill sets and career goals of each team member. This means your Kiewit adventure is custom-designed to meet our shared needs.

Responsibilities

Field engineering, operation planning, cost control, project scheduling, quantity tracking, material procurement, contract administration, estimating & supervision of field activities

Performing engineering tasks requiring standard techniques and handling minor problems of a technical nature arising during construction

Maintaining records as required regarding job progress, costs, material usage, etc.

Planning and scheduling of job and/or job segments

Investigating problems and/or reported incidents; identifying and recommending solutions/alternatives as appropriate

Reviewing plans and specifications to determine material requirements (quantities and qualities), pricing of materials, etc.

Working with suppliers as required facilitating the handling and expediting delivery of materials

Qualifications

Ability to travel or relocate as needed

Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Civil, Mining, Geomatics, Geology, Mechanical Engineering or related field

Ability to freely access all points of a construction site in a wide-ranging climates and environments

Highly motivated, with a demonstrated passion for excellence and taking initiative

Strong work ethic, willing to do what it takes to get the job done right the first time

Demonstrated commitment to ethics and integrity

Passion for safety, with the ability to help us ensure that nobody gets hurt

Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills

Team player with the ability to work independently to meet deadlines, goals and objectives

Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail

Other common names for this role: Office Engineer Intern, Office Intern, Field Intern #LI-KS1

Other Requirements:
• Regular, reliable attendance
• Work productively and meet deadlines timely
• Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment
• Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.
• Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.
• May work at various different locations and conditions may vary.

Base Compensation: $21.00/hr - $25.00/hr
(Actual compensation is subject to variation due to such factors as education, experience, skillset, and/or location)

This posting will be active from: 09/04/2026 - 12/19/2026

We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that's among the best in our industry, including top-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

There's no limit to what you'll do at Kiewit.
Whether you're building or supporting projects that provide communities with dependable energy, safe transportation, clean water, or access to health care, the work you do will
positively impact people's lives for generations to come.

Here you'll have endless opportunities to
expand your expertise
through on-the-job experience and internal and external training and development opportunities.

We offer our full-time staff employees a
comprehensive benefits package that's among the best in our industry.
From top-tier health care programs to employee assistance programs and retirement planning, we aim to provide you with the tools you need to be successful in the areas of life that matter most to you.

Kiewit is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe a diverse workforce is vital to the success of our business.
We continue our efforts to attract, develop and retain employees from all backgrounds who are passionate about our industry.

We are committed to veteran and military hiring and will consider relevant military experience as equivalent to qualification requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Mining Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are SGS - the world's leading testing, inspection, and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer, and more interconnected world.

Job Description

The Senior Mining Engineer will Lead mine planning, design, and optimization activities for mining projects from concept through production. Manage technical studies (PEA, PFS, FS), production schedules, ventilation, and operational improvements. Provide mentorship, oversee contractors, ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards, and support resource-to-reserve conversion, project economics, and stakeholder engagement

Develop and evaluate open-pit mine plans and underground mine designs as a consulting mining engineer.

Apply innovative methodologies to conceptual, pre-feasibility, feasibility, and operating mine projects.

Prepare and author technical reports, including acting as a Qualified Person (QP) where applicable.

Establish, maintain, and strengthen client relationships.

Conduct technical and economic evaluations of underground and open-pit mining projects.

Participate in project budgeting, including feasibility studies, cash flow analyses, Net Present Value (NPV), and Internal Rate of Return (IRR) assessments.

Design and optimize short-term and long-term open-pit mining plans.

Prepare clear, concise, and technically sound reports and presentations.

Travel to client sites within Canada and internationally for short-term assignments as required.

Demonstrate expert knowledge of the mining and minerals industry; experience in rock mechanics is considered a strong asset.

Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including geologists, metallurgists, geotechnical engineers, and environmental specialists.

Support business development activities, proposals, and client engagement initiatives.

Knowledgeable in Mine Planning Training, Mine Evaluation, Mine Reclamation Planning, Mine Operation Management, Mine Environment Management and Equipment selection

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering or a related engineering discipline (e.g., Civil, Mechanical, Process, or equivalent).

Experience

Minimum of 15 years of technical experience within the mining industry.

More than 10 years of experience in project evaluation, budgeting, and cost estimation from project initiation through completion.

Demonstrated leadership and management experience, with a proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary teams.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining a high standard of quality and accountability.

Strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.

Additional language proficiency (e.g., French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic) may be required depending on the role and project location.

Technical Skills

Strong understanding of mining operations, mine planning, project development, and economic evaluation.

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Working knowledge of AutoCAD.

Experience with Microsoft Project and Oracle applications is considered an asset.

Proficiency in one or more mining software packages such as:

GEOVIA GEMS

Whittle

Vulcan

Datamine

Surpac

Micromine

Other industry-standard mine planning and resource modeling software

Professional Competencies

Proven ability to manage and coordinate multiple projects in a fast-paced, professional consulting environment.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including technical writing and report preparation.

Strong attention to detail and effective time management skills.

Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team while also performing effectively independently.

Ability to perform under pressure and meet demanding project schedules.

Additional Requirements

Ability to read, understand, and follow work instructions safely, accurately, and efficiently.

Willingness to work extended hours when required to meet project deadlines.

Availability to travel periodically to SGS offices, client sites, and project locations within Canada and internationally.

Commitment to full compliance with SGS Health & Safety policies, the Code of Integrity, and Professional Conduct standards.

May be assigned responsibility for special projects, strategic initiatives, or other ad hoc assignments as required.

Additional Information

Salary:
$61.55 to $71.80 hourly

Some benefit highlights:

80% coverage Health, Dental and Vision

Paid time off

RRSP Program Eligibility

SGS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression and Indigenous status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodations. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.

This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements, but a general description of the job. Nothing contained herein restricts the company's rights to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Accommodations are available on request for qualified candidates during each stage of the recruitment process.

Please note that candidates applying for Canadian job openings should be authorized to work in Canada.

Location: Silver Bay, MN

Cleveland-Cliffs has an immediate opening for a Structural Engineer at our Northshore Mining Company facility. This position will be located between the Minnesota Mine Sites. The primary responsibility of this position will be to develop and implement site wide structural steel management plans to include assessments, prioritization, and management plans.

Manage structural engineering projects from concept, design, calculations, material specifications, drawings, cost estimates, contractor management, to installation

Ensure contract work is documented properly with specifications and work scopes, coordinate within operational needs and completed safely

Direct and coordinate work performed by engineering consultants and contractors

Direct and coordinate work performed by operating employees as required for new equipment installation or testing to ensure conformity to engineering design and specifications

Provide structural assessments to management, engineers, and mechanical crafts people on as needed basis

Conduct studies and prepare reports on project cost projections and potential cost-saving projects

Evaluate structures and provide recommendations regarding condition and risk mitigation

Develop and maintain a rolling five-year capital and maintenance plan for the facility

Promote and support a strong safety culture while ensuring all engineering activities comply with applicable safety standards and regulations

Produce design and fabrication drawings using AutoCAD or Solidworks

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering; Structural Engineering emphasis preferred. Mechanical Engineering degree considered with demonstrated experience.

Ability to obtain a Professional Engineering (PE) license in Minnesota.

Previous knowledge of project management and creation of work scopes

Previous project engineering experience.

Experience with cost analysis and budgeting.

Ability to plan and coordinate multiple work tasks with a variety of employees, departments and outside contractors .

Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces including civil, structural, electrical, process, and geotechnical requirements to deliver integrated engineering outcomes;

Strong first-principles engineering capability across materials handling, bulk-solids flow, rotating equipment, fluid systems and fixed plant.

Practical understanding of underground hard-rock operations and the constraints of confined, remote and high-risk environments.

Able to identify technical risk, challenge assumptions constructively and develop fit-for-purpose solutions.

Clear communicator with project teams, vendors, site personnel and clients.

Organised and able to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality under programme pressure.

Collaborative, accountable and committed to mentoring and knowledge transfer.

Experience with engineering and modelling software including AutoCAD, Navisworks, Plant 3D, Revit, or equivalent platforms;

Sound working knowledge of relevant Australian Standards and mining legislation, including AS 4024, AS 1418, AS 4041, AS 4100, and WHS requirements. Equivalent international standards experience with demonstrated adaptability will also be considered.

Experience working within multidisciplinary EPCM or consulting project environments;

Proficiency across Microsoft Office Suite and engineering document management systems.

A bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognised institution.

At least 9 years' mechanical engineering experience, including significant exposure to mining, bulk materials handling or heavy industry.

Experience producing coordinated deliverables across concept, pre-feasibility, feasibility, detailed design and construction support.

Build standardized, auditable models that link technical drivers to financial outcomes.

Apply risk analysis (e.g., probabilistic ranges, Monte Carlo) and, where appropriate, real-options logic.

Develop capital allocation frameworks, investment criteria, and stage-gate governance.

Lead portfolio reviews across greenfield, brownfield, sustaining capital, and closure liabilities.

Own commodity market research for strategy and individual projects.

Benchmark peers and competitors; analyze margins, capital intensity, and productivity.

Support/lead due diligence for investments, JVs, and M&A from a finance/market perspective.

Translate technical QRA/estimating outputs into valuation impacts and executive-ready recommendations.

BA/BS + 8 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

Demonstrated leadership of complex financial analysis projects and capital allocation processes.

Advanced Excel-based modelling; expert scenario/sensitivity design; robust model architecture and auditability.

Proficiency translating mine plans, costs, and schedules into cash flows and valuation metrics.

Deep understanding of mineral markets.

Hands-on design and operation of capital governance (stage-gate), portfolio optimization, and investment criteria (hurdle rates, risk-adjusted returns).

jobs.title: Senior Mine Geologist
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Mine Geologist is responsible for the development, maintenance, and reconciliation of geological resource models supporting the Montana Resources operation. The position is also responsible for in-pit and near-pit development drilling and interpretation of results. This position provides technical leadership in resource estimation, orebody interpretation, grade control integration, resource classification, and reserve conversion activities. The Geologist collaborates with mine engineering, metallurgy, and operations teams to ensure accurate resource reporting and optimal mine planning along with mine development.

Responsibilities

Resource Modeling & Estimation

Develop, update, and validate 3D geological and resource models.

Interpret lithological, structural, alteration, and mineralization data from drilling programs.

Conduct resource estimation and classification using geostatistical techniques and industry best practices.

Prepare mineral resource updates and support reserve conversion activities.

Maintain geological databases and ensure data quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC).

Support annual and life-of-mine resource reporting.

Resource Reconciliation

Perform reconciliation between resource models, grade control models, and production results.

Identify and evaluate variances affecting mine and mill performance.

Recommend improvements to estimation methodologies and geological interpretations.

Monitor model performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

Technical Support

Provide geological input to mine planning and scheduling processes.

Collaborate with mine engineers to optimize pit designs and extraction strategies.

Support drilling programs through targeting, logging standards, and geological interpretation.

Provide geological interpretation of paragenesis, mineralization, alteration, zoning and structural controls of porphyry copper deposits.

Assist with economic evaluations and technical studies.

Participate in feasibility, optimization, and expansion projects.

Reporting and Compliance

Prepare technical reports, resource statements, maps, and presentations.

Ensure compliance with company resource reporting standards

Maintain documentation supporting resource estimates and technical assumptions.

Qualifications

Required Education

Bachelor's Degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Earth Sciences, or related discipline.

Master's Degree in Geology or Geostatistics preferred.

Required Experience

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in mining geology, with significant experience in open pit copper operations.

Demonstrated experience in mineral resource estimation and geological modeling.

Experience with drilling methods and QA/QC of exploration data.

Experience with resource reconciliation and mine planning integration.

Proficiency in Leapfrog Geo and MineSight,

Strong knowledge of geostatistics, block modeling, variography, and resource classification.

Advanced Microsoft Office and technical reporting skills.

Strong understanding of geological modeling and resource estimation methodologies.

jobs.title: Mine Maintenance Superintendent
jobs.description:
Mine Maintenance Superintendent

Position Specifications

Position: 
Mine Maintenance Superintendent

Location:
 Oko West Project, Guyana
 
The Mine Maintenance Superintendent will lead all maintenance activities for the mining fleet at the Oko West Project in Guyana, ensuring safe execution while maximising equipment availability, reliability and cost effectiveness in support of production targets.
Reporting to the Mine Manager, the role leads the maintenance team — general foremen, engineers, supervisors, planners and technicians — and coordinates closely with Mine Operations, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Engineering, OEMs and contractors to ensure effective maintenance planning, execution, parts availability and continuous improvement. This is a rotation-based role in a remote mining environment, requiring strong field presence and effective coordination of maintenance activities across operating shifts.

The Company

In 2020, G Mining Ventures (GMIN) was created to acquire direct ownership of projects and capitalise on the value uplift that successful mine development offers. In July 2024, GMIN acquired the Oko West Project, a new gold discovery in northwest Guyana located approximately 95 km west of Georgetown, which the Company is now developing into an operating mine. Our client has selected Globe 24-7 Inc. as its strategic recruitment partner to successfully fill the above-mentioned position and to add value to the hiring strategy with market knowledge, trends and a proven track record in conducting similar searches.

Main Responsibilities

Lead all planned, preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance activities for the mining fleet, including shovels, excavators, haul trucks, drills, dozers, graders, loaders and support equipment.

Maximise fleet availability and reliability by monitoring equipment condition, breakdowns, recurring failures, maintenance backlog, component life and maintenance KPIs, implementing timely corrective actions.

Ensure effective maintenance planning and scheduling, covering preventive maintenance, major repairs, component replacements, shutdowns, work orders, manpower, tooling and resources.

Lead maintenance general foremen, supervisors, planners, technicians and contractors, ensuring adequate staffing, competency development, performance management, accountability and effective shift handovers.

Ensure effective use of the Maintenance Management System, maintaining accurate equipment history, work orders, maintenance costs, parts consumption and performance data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

Coordinate with Supply Chain, Warehouse, OEMs and suppliers to ensure availability of critical spare parts, consumables, major components, technical support and warranty follow-up.

Develop and control maintenance budgets, forecasts and costs, identifying opportunities to improve equipment lifecycle performance and reduce downtime and maintenance costs.

Provide visible safety leadership and ensure all maintenance activities comply with Company HSE standards, including isolation, lockout, lifting, stored energy, pressure systems and other maintenance-related critical risks.

Position Requirements

As the successful candidate, it is essential that you possess the following skills, experience and competencies:

Bachelor s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance or a related technical field preferred; equivalent technical qualifications combined with significant relevant experience may be considered.

Minimum 10 to 15 years of progressive heavy equipment maintenance experience, including at least five years in a senior supervisory or superintendent role.

Strong experience managing and maintaining large mining fleets and leading multidisciplinary maintenance teams.

Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, major component management and maintenance planning.

Strong understanding of maintenance KPIs, including equipment availability, MTBF, MTTR, schedule compliance, backlog and maintenance costs.

Proven experience with a Maintenance Management System and maintenance data management; SAP PM or a similar system is an asset.

Strong knowledge of maintenance budgeting, cost control, spare parts management and coordination with OEMs and suppliers.

Strong leadership, communication, organisational, analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a remote and demanding mining environment. 

In addition, the following behavioural competencies are essential to succeed in the role:

Strong safety leadership and field presence.

High level of accountability, ownership and operational discipline.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

Effective team leadership, coaching and development.

Strong collaboration with Operations and support departments.

Continuous improvement and equipment reliability mindset.

Compensation

Our client will provide a market-related remuneration package, including an annual performance bonus and participation in the Company s group medical and life insurance plan for the employee and dependents.
The position is residential at site on a rotational roster of 23 days on and 19 days off. For international candidates, the Company provides international and in-country travel, accommodation and meals while in Guyana, together with support throughout the required immigration process.

Contact Us 

To apply for this position, please send a copy of your resume in Word format.

jobs.title: Senior Mining Surveyor
jobs.description:
Reference: JHB000300-zm-1

The Senior Mining Surveyor is responsible for managing and executing all mine surveying functions to support safe and efficient mining operations. This includes GPS-based field surveys, Drone based field surveys, volumetric stockpile reporting, reconciliations, photogrammetry, mine planning support, civil construction surveys, and rehabilitation planning. The role ensures accurate spatial data, compliance with legal survey requirements, and timely delivery of high-quality survey
outputs to operational and management teams.

Duties & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

1. Surveying & Data Acquisition

Conduct high-precision GPS, Drone and total station surveys for mining, engineering, and surface infrastructure.

Perform daily, weekly, and monthly production surveys to support mining operations.

Maintain and update mine survey control networks and benchmark systems.

2. Stockpile Surveys, Volumes & Reconciliation

Perform stockpile surveys using GPS, drone photogrammetry, and total station.

Generate volumetric calculations and produce accurate daily, weekly and monthly mining and stock reports.

Conduct inventory reconciliations between survey volumes, plant figures, and dispatch data.

Ensure compliance with audit requirements for stock reporting.

3. Photogrammetry & Remote Sensing

Plan and execute drone flights for photogrammetry and mapping.

Process imagery into orthomosaics, DTM/DSM, and point clouds.

Integrate drone data into mine planning and geotechnical analysis.

Ensure drone operations comply with regulatory procedures (CAA/SACAA, etc.).

4. Mine Planning & Design Support

Provide survey inputs for short-, medium-, and long-term mine planning.

Assist planning engineers with pit designs, dump designs, haul roads, and excavation limits.

Set out and verify blast patterns, ore boundaries, cut lines, and excavation limits.

Monitor pit walls, slopes, and stability using survey data.

5. Civil Engineering Survey Work

Conduct surveys for civil construction, such as haul roads, stormwater structures, foundations, platforms, pipelines, and plant expansions.

Provide setting-out for contractors and verify as-built data.

Maintain accurate as-built documentation for project completion.

6. Environmental & Rehabilitation Planning

Produce rehabilitation survey plans and track progress of rehab areas.

Support environmental compliance by providing accurate survey data for land disturbance, topsoil management, and closure planning.

Monitor and report on rehabilitated landform stability and drainage compliance.

7. Reporting & Compliance

Prepare survey reports, maps, plans, section drawings, and 3D models.

Ensure compliance with mine standards, legal survey specifications, and health & safety rules.

Maintain digital and hard-copy survey records in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Supervise and mentor junior surveyors and survey assistants.

Minimum Requirements:

National Diploma or Degree in Mine Surveying, Geomatics, or related field.

Government Mine Surveyor Certificate (advantage or required, depending on operation).

Minimum 5–8 years’ mining surveying experience, ideally in open pit or underground mines.

Experience with drones/UAVs for mining applications.

Valid SACNASP, IMSSA, or PLATO registration (advantage).

Valid driver’s licence.

Skills and Competencies:

Advanced GPS, GNSS, and total station proficiency.

Strong knowledge of photogrammetry and drone survey processing (Pix4D, Agisoft, etc.).

Proficient in mining software: Surpac, Vulcan, MinePlan, Datamine, or similar.

High competence in AutoCAD/Civil 3D or equivalent.

Excellent analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and ability to work cross-functionally with mining, geology, engineering, and environmental teams.

Ability to lead and mentor survey teams.

Key Deliverables/ KPIs:

Accurate and timely weekly & monthly survey volumes and stock reports.

Zero survey-related errors affecting production or compliance.

Updated survey control networks and mine plans.

Quality drone maps and photogrammetry outputs delivered on schedule.

Effective support for mine planning and engineering.

Compliance with legal survey requirements and safety standards.

On-time rehabilitation survey updates and environmental reporting.

Alta capacidad de análisis, criterio técnico y orientación al cumplimiento de estándares de calidad y seguridad.

Experiencia en proyectos de infraestructura de gran escala.
Experiencia en inspección técnica, construcción o supervisión de obras.

Experiencia trabajando en equipos de ingeniería, construcción o inspección de proyectos complejos.

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Element Six, part of De Beers Group, is a global leader in the design, development and production of synthetic diamond and tungsten carbide supermaterials.

With research and development facilities and manufacturing sites in the UK, Ireland, Germany, South Africa and the US, we have been pushing the boundaries of synthetic diamond innovation for more than 60 years. We utilise the extreme properties of synthetic diamond to open up new possibilities in exciting areas such as quantum optics, acoustics and thermal conductivity.

Our success comes from building strong, collaborative relationships, both internally in our extraordinary teams, and externally with our customers. We strive to deliver extreme performance and we seek talented, ambitious people who will thrive in an environment that fosters individuality, inclusivity, innovation and creativity.

We offer an exciting and varied career, with opportunities to work in various locations and teams, and across different functions and projects.

If you like the idea of an exciting variety of work in a diverse global team, then we want you to get in touch.

An opportunity to work with a committed team of innovative thinkers, developing new diamond materials by chemical vapour deposition (CVD) to deliver ground-breaking technological solutions. CVD-grown diamond is a truly innovative and exciting material to work with, enabling cutting-edge applications in optics, semiconductors, quantum technology and electrochemistry. Together we will advance the understanding and applications of diamond to develop novel products and processes for commercialisation, in partnership with world-leading manufacturers.

We are looking for someone to join our team, working at our world-class Global Innovation Centre in Harwell, Oxfordshire focusing on CVD diamond materials. This role is ideally suited to a recent graduate/post-graduate looking to acquire new skills and experiences.

You must care about what you do, work well individually and as part of a team, and be creative, motivated, and able to deliver on challenging objectives. You will be welcomed into a project team, given clear responsibilities, trusted to drive progress, and given opportunities for personal growth and career development.

Outline of the role

Utilise state-of-the-art CVD synthesis reactors, analytical equipment and tools to synthesise, characterise and process diamond materials

Develop, understand and utilise techniques to enhance material manufacturing capabilities such as polishing and shaping.

Design and execute work packages and analyse data to inform onward innovation.

Invent and patent new CVD growth and processing methods towards novel diamond products and solutions.

Develop value add processes, such as by treatments, brazing, metallization, ion implantation, and mounting, to tailor diamond components for integration into customers applications.

Collaborate and communicate with internal and external commercial and academic partners on materials and applications development and testing.

Scientist or engineer with an undergraduate degree in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science or a relevant Engineering subject.

An ability to complete practical laboratory work which requires attention to detail, in a safe and systematic way.

A demonstrated willingness and ability to learn quickly and apply new skills and techniques to practically solve novel problems.

Strong analytical skills for data capture and interpretation.

Good interpersonal and presentational skills, and able to work effectively as part of a team.

If this opportunity is something that excites you, we are interested to hear about how you can help us shape the future.

All applicants must be able to provide documentation verifying their eligibility to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not provided for this role.

jobs.title: Geology & Geotechnical Coordinator
jobs.description:
Anglo American Steelmaking Coal

Steelmaking coal is an essential ingredient in blast-furnace steel manufacture, producing steel used for critical building and infrastructure around the world. In Australia, we operate three steelmaking coal mines in Queensland’s Bowen Basin.

We are currently seeking an experienced Geoscience Coordinator to oversee and manage geological and geotechnical activities, ensuring the effective utilisation of geoscience information and the success of our projects. You will play a critical role in coordinating fieldwork, data analysis, and compliance with industry standards and regulations.

You will lead a team of geologists, geotechnical engineers and technicians, managing geoscience fieldwork, data collection, and analysis for various projects. Develop project timelines, budgets, and resource management plans, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives.

This role will involve the analysis of geoscience data, interpretation of findings, and the presentation of comprehensive reports. You will stay abreast of industry trends and technological advancements, ensuring that our geological activities remain at the forefront of the field.

Responsibilities:

Coordinate and oversee geoscience fieldwork, data collection, and analysis.

Develop project timelines, budgets, and resource management plans.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet project objectives.

Analyze geoscience data and produce comprehensive reports.

Interpret geological/geotechnical information to identify potential risks and opportunities.

Stay updated with industry trends and technological advancements.

Assess geological resources and reserves for various purposes.

Contribute to resource estimation and modeling activities.

Ensure compliance with geological/geotechnical regulations and permitting processes.

Lead and mentor a team of geologists, geotechnical engineers and technicians.

Foster a collaborative and innovative work environment.

Communicate geological/geotechnical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree in Geology/Geotechnical Engineering or a related field (Master's degree desirable).

Experience in geological and/or fieldwork, data analysis, and project management.

Strong leadership and team management skills.

Familiarity with geological/geotechnical regulations and compliance.

Flexibility to work in different geological environments.

Any relevant professional registration (Desirable)

Demonstrate and use skills in geological/geophysical/geotechnical interpretation and modelling via the proficient use of MINEX and/or Vulcan or other geology/geotechnical computer software packages.

Demonstrate and use skills in other necessary computer software packages (e.g. Vulcan, Deswik, CAD drafting, word processor, spreadsheet, statistical analysis, file manipulation, data logging).

Full-time, permanent position Monday to Friday

Flexible work options available, including a 9 day fortnight

FIFO, DIDO, Residential options

Relocation Assistance Provided

Middlemount Housing and Assistance (Sal Sac)

Attractive Salary & Annual Bonus + 12% Superannuation

Free access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Discounted gym membership

What we Offer

When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too. We’re a large, successful multinational company – and we’re still growing all the time.

Who we are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. As the custodians of coal and other precious natural resources – diamonds (through De Beers), copper, platinum and other precious metals, iron ore and nickel – our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively, with the utmost consideration for local communities, our customers and the world at large.

Background checks

one of the most significant potash projects in the world; Jansen.

About Potash and the Jansen Project

Imagine being part of something truly world-class, something that’s shaping the future of sustainable agriculture and responsible resource development. That’s what the Jansen Potash Project offers.

Located about 140 kilometers east of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan,
Jansen is set to become one of the largest and most sustainable potash mines on the planet.
With a CAD$21 billion (US15.3 billion) investment, it marks teh biggest private investment in Saskatchewan's history, and a bold step forward for BHP in Canada. 

But Jansen is more than a mine; it's a
long-term opportunity to build something meaningful.

Why BHP?

At BHP, we are transforming the way mining is done. We embrace innovation, sustainability, and inclusion to build a smarter, safer, and more human future.

You will provide technical leadership and assurance across high- and low-voltage systems, ensuring solutions are safe, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with BHP standards and statutory requirements. •    Implement E&I engineering strategies, plans, processes, and systems aligned with BHP requirements.
•    Support prevention through design, strategic procurement, and data-centric design initiatives. 
•    Ensure designs meet project objectives and applicable Canadian and Saskatchewan mining regulations. 
•    Identify and assess risks, make risk informed decisions, use BHP's risk management framework, and build a risk aware culture to support safe and productive performance outcomes. 
•    Participate in formal technical documentation reviews and approvals.
