•    Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. 
•    Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) registration in Canada. 
•    Significant industry experience in mining (surface, shaft, and underground), utilities, or manufacturing environments. 
•    Experience in potash and underground operations is considered an asset. 
•    Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams. 
•    Ability to make sound technical decisions that influence functional strategy. 
•    Familiarity with the SmartPlant design suite is an advantage.

Saskatoon, Saskatchewan,

And so much more!

Reporting to the Manager of Development for GBC and KL Mines - The Development Services Technical Expert role is critical to ensure the efficient, reliable, and forward-planned delivery of underground services required to support ongoing and future mining operations. This position is responsible for planning, designing, and coordinating the provision of key infrastructure including water supply, compressed air, electrical systems, and ventilation networks. This position involves gaining a comprehensive understanding of the Indonesian and Papuan culture, as well as building relationships, solving problems creatively as a team, and effectively communicating in different styles. The Technical Expert must also have a continuous learning mindset, be patient, adaptable, and able to work in an environment where work and personal life mix. Additionally, a strong sense of collaboration, mentoring, coaching, questioning, and influencing skills are essential for success in this role.

1. Directly communicate and implement the company’s safety, health and environmental policies and procedures, including: conducting safety meetings to promote subordinate’s awareness of safety and environmental issues.

2. Work with national staff to help them learn how to coordinate all activities including: service and infrastructure planning, installation of temporary and permanent services, develop “industry best practices’ for service installations throughout the mines.

3. Communicate with national staff to ensure that they are aware of safety, production equipment performance and the affected operational costs.

4. Assist with the implementation and application of advanced technology to improve the operational processes.

5. Ensure that communication and information linking the various projects that constitute the development of a new mine is passed on to all the relevant stakeholders to minimize disruptions that impact on mine schedules.

6. Assist the Mines to establish and maintain relationships with major internal and external departments to keep and ensure a good safety record, achieve development targets, optimize equipment utilization and identify potential for improvement within the organization.

7. Assist to train, mentor, monitor, motivate, and appraise performance and potential capabilities of subordinates to contribute to the development of a professional team.

8. Help develop the local national miners to the level required for them to become competent and confident in their ability to handle their assigned tasks.

Understanding of concepts and workflow of Maintenance Planning/Scheduling 

Understanding of mining and/or processing equipment function 

Demonstrated working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. 

Demonstrated working knowledge of maintenance management systems and associated applications. 

Demonstrated professional/effective written and oral communications skills.

jobs.title: Senior Cost Controller - HaulX
jobs.description:
About Us

Fortescue is both a proud West Australian company and a global green solutions business. We are recognised for our culture, innovation and industry-leading development of infrastructure, mining assets and green energy initiatives.

Our Opportunity

Work Location:

Perth Office – Fortescue’s Perth office is located on the traditional lands of the Whadjuk Noongar people

Roster:

 Monday to Friday

Join Fortescue's HaulX team as a Senior Cost Controller and play a key role in supporting cost control, financial reporting and commercial governance across the program.

You will provide accurate and timely cost information to support informed decision-making, maintain financial discipline and ensure the program remains aligned with approved budgets and governance requirements. Working closely with project managers, finance, procurement, commercial and project controls teams, you will manage forecasts, commitments, actual expenditure and cost risks across the HaulX program.

Key Responsibilities

Support the implementation of cost management systems, processes and procedures covering project cost control, budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow and performance analysis 

Manage project cost and progress reporting to provide accurate and timely information to the project management team and identify actions required to maintain approved baseline targets

Coordinate cost activities within the broader project controls team, ensuring alignment and collaboration with Finance and other supporting functions

Apply the project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) to ensure cost systems, processes and reporting follow a consistent project approach

Support the contracting and procurement teams with project contracts, purchase orders and payment certificate reviews, including setup in PIMS and SAP

Review and verify invoices, establish month-end accruals and allocate expenditure to cost centres and WBS

Prepare cost-to-complete forecasts, identify cost risks and recommend actions to mitigate potential overruns against the approved baseline and budget

Prepare monthly cost reports, variance analysis and clear management commentary, including supporting project change management and quarterly capital planning

Apply earned value management (EVM) tools and techniques, evaluate contractor progress claims and reconcile costs against budgets and contracts

Monitor and audit cost management systems and SAP, escalate significant variances.

Qualifications and Experience

At least six years of project controls experience within a resources environment, preferably across major capital projects 

Prior experience in a similar cost control role within the resources, renewable energy, construction or engineering sectors

Demonstrated experience establishing, managing and reporting cost components for mid to large-scale capital projects

Experience developing and managing project progress reporting methodologies

Strong understanding of project controls principles, processes and techniques

Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with project stakeholders

Experience with PIMS cost systems is desirable

Proficient computer skills, including advanced Microsoft Excel, Word and Microsoft Office

Bachelor's degree in Commerce or Finance

Project management qualification or internationally accredited project controls certification.

Our Opportunity

Are you looking for the next step in your career and want to be a part of something big? 

Established in Western Australia in 2003, Fortescue is a global green technology, energy and metals company, recognised for its culture, innovation and industry leading development of infrastructure, mining assets and green energy initiatives.

As we move towards a more sustainable future and work towards decarbonising our iron ore mining operations, we’re seeking passionate, driven individuals who are eager to contribute to our Real Zero mission and help shape the future.

We are currently seeking expressions of interest from
Mining Operators
with experience working on some or all of the beloq equipment to join our talent community.

D10T/D11T Dozer

854 Wheel Dozer

CAT6060 shovel, CAT 6040, Hitachi 3600, CAT 6030 or Hitachi 2500 Excavator

Work Location:
Opportunities are 
FIFO

from Perth, Busselton, Karratha, Port Hedland, Fitzroy Crossing or Kununurra to our Pilbara WA mine sites.

Rosters available:
Our rosters range from 7D7N14R OR 7D7N7R depending on site and department.

About this Talent Community

Please note that this is a centralised talent community for current and future opportunities across all operational sites.

By submitting your application, you will be added to our Talent Pool and may be notified if your application is forwarded for review against a similar role.

Unless you are actively being considered for a specific position, you may not receive further updates or communication from us. In the meantime, we encourage you to regularly visit our careers website to stay informed about new and upcoming opportunities.

This talent community is for external applicants only. Internal employees and contractors are encouraged to visit our internal careers page to explore current vacancies.

Our Commitment

Fortescue celebrates individual strengths and team members are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics. 
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

https://fortescue.com/careers

Internal Candidates / Current Contractors please apply via Success Factors Careers Portal. For further information on how to apply please visit the Fortescue Hub. 

Fortescue reserves the right to close applications early should a suitable pool of candidates be identified. Fortescue will never contact you to ask for payment of any kind, whether directly or through a third party.

jobs.title: Conveyor Installs Specialist
jobs.description:
Coordinate the conveyor systems with your mechanical proficiency!

Anglo American Australia

Grosvenor Mine – an underground steelmaking coal mine produced its first longwall coal in May 2016 and is located in Moranbah, about 190 km south-west of Mackay.

We are building the team to deliver the next chapter of Grosvenor Mine. With a planned return to longwall production by Q4 2027, this is a unique opportunity to contribute to a major mine restart and help shape the future of underground mining.

Working alongside experienced professionals, you will play a role in implementing leading-edge technology, automation, monitoring systems and operational improvements that will define how the mine operates for years to come.

We are seeking a Conveyor Installs Specialist to join the team at Grosvenor Mine on a full-time, permanent basis with Anglo American. Reporting to the Engineering & Maintenance Manager, the Conveyor Installs Specialist will be responsible for the coordination of the conveyor belt installation and end-to-end project delivery for the underground coal mine.

This role will see you accountable for:

Provide safe, efficient and reliable mechanical engineering services to the Maintenance & Engineering department.

Provide technical support to the Engineering & Maintenance team by coordinating resources, utilising the work order system and organising the supply and availability of equipment.

Manage conveyor install and design to ensure projects are adequately planned by developing technical specifications, procedures, material and services requirements, labour and skill requirements and all other mine compliance obligations.

Assist in achieving agreed maintenance plans and targets for engineering projects, procurement and disposal of equipment.

Coordinate the Conveyor overhaul and installations to meet the mine schedule.

Develop the project schedule for all conveyor installs, and retrieval as well as any overhaul work required.

Provide input to mine planning meetings to ensure plans are developed to mitigate production delays due to conveyor installation and salvage.

Identify root causes of major down time, accidents, non-compliances to schedules, statutory requirements and assists with the implementation of appropriate remedial actions in conjunction with internal and external resources.

Ensure compliance with all people, safety, technical, operating and business systems, behaviours and culture in your area.

Collaborate and build strong relationships across a range of both internal and external stakeholders.

Mechanical Trade qualification essential or higher tertiary education desirable

Previous experience with Conveyor system design.

Previous experience in a mining maintenance role (preferably Coal) or heavy industry

Demonstrated experience leading a team of professionals to deliver against set targets

Experience in driving best practise through your department and into the business. This includes the development and implementation of strategy in line with business goals.

Demonstrated ability to interpret legislation and apply where relevant to ensure compliance

Track record in driving continuous improvement

Computer literacy in CAD manipulation essential

Full-time permanent position based at Grosvenor Mine, Moranbah QLD

Monday to Friday site role with 9-day fortnight available

Competitive salary package and annual incentive programs

Residential, FIFO (company funded) & DIDO options

Subsidised accommodation and company funded camp options provided

Relocation assistance to Moranbah township available

What we Offer

When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package and a range of flexible work arrangements that support the balance of work, family and individual circumstances. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too. We’re a large, successful multinational company – and we’re still growing all the time.

Who we are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. As the custodians of coal and other precious natural resources – diamonds (through De Beers), copper, platinum and other precious metals, iron ore and nickel – our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively, with the utmost consideration for local communities, our customers and the world at large.

Background checks

Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening which may include a criminal check and validation of qualifications.

Inclusion and Diversity

Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

How we are committed to your safety

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

How to apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

REF81140V

CLOSING DATE

30 September 2026

Please note, screening and interviews may take place prior to closing date – applications may also close before this

Diseñar, implementar y optimizar mecanismos de integración entre los sistemas, plataformas y fuentes de información utilizados por el Programa Life Extension 2, mediante la definición de estándares, flujos de datos y soluciones tecnológicas, con el propósito de asegurar la disponibilidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información requerida para la gestión y toma de decisiones del programa, acorde a las políticas de la empresa y de los requerimientos de sus sistemas de gestión.

Responsabilidades y actividades principales

Analizar los requerimientos funcionales y no funcionales de integración del Programa LE2, identificando dependencias, restricciones, riesgos y alternativas de solución, a fin de definir diseños técnicamente viables, escalables y sostenibles.

Diseñar soluciones de integración entre los sistemas y plataformas utilizados por el Programa LE2, con el propósito de facilitar el intercambio oportuno y confiable de información entre las diferentes áreas y procesos.

Implementar mecanismos de interoperabilidad entre aplicaciones, bases de datos y herramientas digitales, a fin de asegurar la disponibilidad y consistencia de la información del programa.

Definir estándares, protocolos y lineamientos de integración de datos, con el propósito de promover la calidad, trazabilidad y gobernanza de la información.              

Administrar los flujos de intercambio de información entre plataformas corporativas y sistemas del programa, a fin de minimizar reprocesos y reducir la duplicidad de datos.

Monitorear el desempeño de las integraciones implementadas, identificando oportunidades de mejora y acciones correctivas que contribuyan a la continuidad operativa de los sistemas.

Participar en la implementación de nuevas plataformas digitales, evaluando requerimientos de integración, compatibilidad y confidencialidad de los datos, con el propósito de asegurar su incorporación eficiente al ecosistema tecnológico del programa.

Desarrollar documentación técnica, diagramas de arquitectura y procedimientos asociados a las integraciones de sistemas, a fin de facilitar su mantenimiento y sostenibilidad.

Analizar incidencias relacionadas con la transferencia e integración de datos, proponiendo soluciones que contribuyan a mantener la confiabilidad de la información.

Cumplir las normas y procedimientos de Seguridad Industrial a fin de proteger la vida y salud de las personas, prevenir accidentes graves y garantizar operaciones seguras y sostenibles.

Cumplir con otras responsabilidades delegadas por su supervisión directa ligadas a su posición que aseguren la sostenibilidad del negocio.

Formación requerida

Bachiller o Titulado en carreras de Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática, Software, Electrónica o carreras afines.

Estudios de post grado

Especialización en integración de sistemas, Arquitectura empresarial o Gestión de Datos.

Experiencia previa

Mínimo 5 años de experiencia desarrollando soluciones de integración de sistemas, aplicaciones o plataformas empresariales.

Experiencia implementando interfaces, APIs, middleware o mecanismos de interoperabilidad entre sistemas.

Experiencia trabajando con plataformas corporativas de gestión de proyectos, ingeniería o gestión documental.

Conocimientos informáticos

MS Office: nivel avanzado.

Diseño de APIs - REST, OData, OpenAPI: nivel avanzado.

SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite: nivel avanzado.

AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch: nivel intermedio.

Amazon Cognito, OAuth 2.0, JWT: nivevl intermedio.

Observabilidad de Integraciones mediante Amazon CloudWatch logs y métricas: nivel intermedio.

NET 10: nivel intermedio.

React 19: nivel intermedio.

SQL Server: nivel intermedio.

Git y AWS CodeCommit: nivel intermedio.

Despliegue continuo y prácticas DevSecOps: nivel intermedio.

Idiomas

Inglés (no requiere certificado): deseable nivel avanzado.

Datos adicionales del puesto

Vicepresidencia de: Administración y Finanzas

Gerencia de: Sistemas, Telecomunicaciones y Control de procesos

Reporta a: Superintendente de Sistemas

Locación: Lima

Vacante: Temporal

BHP is a global resources company operating across more than 90 locations worldwide. Through Copper South Australia (Copper SA), we are building a leading copper portfolio that supports the global energy transition, supplying materials essential for renewable energy, electric vehicles and digital infrastructure.

For you, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and help shape the future of one of Australia's leading copper businesses.

Truck Operator

,

In these roles, you will gain hands-on experience in:

Operating large mining equipment, including Toyota Landcruiser 4wd manual vehicles, trucks, Rock Breakers (Excavator) and integrated tool carriers (ITs)

Installing and maintaining critical infrastructure that supports underground operations

Working alongside drills and other heavy mining equipment

Operating safely in dynamic underground environments, including working at heights

Working a 7/7 lifestyle roster (7 days on, 7 days off, 7 nights on, 7 nights off) consisting of rotating 12-hour shifts based at Olympic Dam.

jobs.title: Specialist GBS Planning and Scheduling | Malaysia or Philippines *
jobs.description:
About BHP 

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

Come and be a part of this success.

About the Role

Provides specialist advice and executes tasks in the development and monitoring of plans and schedules, baselines, activity completion, identification of trends and corrective/preventative actions to influence on-time delivery of the project’s objectives.

Key Accountabilities:

Manage stakeholder expectation through proactive customer engagement and receiving feedback.

Effectively communicates with all stakeholders, including internal and external customers.

Develops summary and detailed schedules for a program or project.

Develops baseline schedule and monitor/analyse current schedule against established baseline.

Develops schedule range model for schedule range/risk analysis and participates in ranging workshops, analysis and preparation of schedule range/risk reports.

Reviews and provides constructive feedback on contractor schedules and reports.

Provides planning and conceptual sequencing expertise for the development of engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and operational readiness activities including assignment of resources.

Identifies activities or sequences of activities that are material and critical to the project and business unit and effectively communicates these to the appropriate members of the project team.

Monitors critical path activities on a regular basis and provides update and analysis including possible mitigation efforts that must be undertaken to minimise impacts.

Develops planned progress curves and analyse monthly progress.

Validates ongoing implementation of functional planning and scheduling strategies to optimise the schedule in response to changing project conditions.

Assists in reporting program level dashboards and reports.

Integrates contractor/other function schedules into an overall program/project schedule and provide monthly updates against the baseline.

About You

Relevant tertiary qualification in a business/trade-related discipline or demonstrated equivalent business experience

Significant years experience in similar role or capacity

Usage of Primavera P6 software [intermediate level]

Advanced Excel Skills

Strong problem-solving skills including organising and analyzing multiple data sources

Strong communication skills (written and verbal), collaboration and interpersonal skills and able to work autonomously

Proficient in Spanish language; preferred but not required

About Our Process 

At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks. 

If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal. 

Supporting a Diverse Workforce 

The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance-based bonuses and a best-in-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms.  

At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity employer that is committed to making BHP a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and be at their best every day. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and recognise that true diversity includes gender, age, race, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, education levels, and many more aspects of your identity.

BHP is committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible for all. If you have a disability, we know that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. If you would like to reach out to someone about your situation and our recruitment process, please email us at 

inclusion@bhp.com

jobs.title: Strategic Partnership Manager - Motorsport & Advanced Engineering
jobs.description:
The Power of Now

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

An opportunity has arisen for a Strategic Partnership Manager to join the Motorsport & Advanced Engineering department.

About the role

This role supports the successful conversion of strategic opportunities into contracted business across the motorsport, advanced engineering, and defence sectors, with a focus on elite performance electrification technology, energy storage systems, and zero-emission power system components.

Working closely with senior commercial leaders who own key customer relationships and opportunity origination, this role is responsible for identifying leads and driving opportunity execution, including bid development, commercial structuring, pricing, internal stakeholder coordination, and contract negotiation. In addition, the role will also be required to own and maintain ongoing customer relationships and generate additional revenue opportunities from existing accounts in addition to new business.

What will you do

Opportunity Execution & Bid Management

Lead the end-to-end development of customer proposals, from initial brief through to submission

Coordinate inputs from engineering, product, finance, legal, and commercial teams

Ensure proposals are technically credible, commercially competitive, and aligned with customer requirements

Manage bid timelines, governance, and internal approval processes

Commercial Structuring & Pricing

Develop pricing models, cost build-ups, and commercial structures in collaboration with finance and technical teams

Support definition of commercial strategies, including risk allocation and contract positioning

Ensure alignment with internal financial targets and risk frameworks

Contract Development & Negotiation

Lead the preparation of commercial terms and contract documentation

Support and participate in contract negotiations with customers

Work closely with legal and commercial ops teams to ensure robust and compliant agreements

Internal Coordination

Act as the central point of coordination across multiple internal stakeholders

Ensure clear communication between opportunity owners (senior leads) and delivery teams

Track and manage actions, dependencies, and risks across opportunities

Customer Engagement 

Support senior commercial leads in customer interactions, particularly during bid and negotiation phases

Pursue new opportunities through active participation in the market (e.g. industry shows, events, outreach)

Contribute to development of customer-specific value propositions and materials

Pipeline & Reporting

Maintain accurate records of opportunity progress, pipeline status, and forecasts within CRM system

Provide structured updates on bid performance, risks, and key milestones

Market & Continuous Improvement

Support market and competitor analysis to strengthen proposal quality

Contribute to improving bid processes, tools, and commercial frameworks

Assist in improving existing standardised templates, pricing models, and collateral

About you

Adequate experience in commercial, bid management, or business development role within tier 1 motorsport, advanced engineering, defence, or high-technology sectors

Demonstrated experience in managing complex bids or opportunity lifecycles

Proven track record of developing commercial proposals and closing contracts

Experience in pricing, cost modelling, or commercial structuring

Experience working in cross-functional technical environments

Exposure to regulated or defence procurement environments (advantageous)

Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce is desirable

Strong commercial and financial acumen

Excellent account management and organisational skills

Ability to coordinate multi-disciplinary teams under tight timelines

Strong written communication skills, particularly in proposal and contract development

High attention to detail with ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities

What is in it for you?

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Aviva Pension

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus
public holidays and the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days per year

Childcare Benefits

Free on-site gym access and discounted national memberships

Fortescue celebrates individual strengths and team members are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

https://fortescue.com/careers 

Internal Candidates / Current Contractors please apply via Success Factors Careers Portal. For further information on how to apply please visit the Fortescue Hub. 

Fortescue reserves the right to close applications early should a suitable pool of candidates be identified. Fortescue will never contact you to ask for payment of any kind, whether directly or through a third party.

jobs.title: Mining Engineer
jobs.description:
NEW GRAD MINING ENGINEER - NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY!

Help Build the Future of American Manufacturing

This is more than a job-it's an opportunity to leave a lasting mark on U.S. infrastructure. Mountain Cement Company, a subsidiary of Eagle Materials, is seeking an experienced
Mining Engineer
to help bring the newest cement plant in the United States to life. You will play a critical role in day to day operations at a state-of-the-art facility, leveraging advanced tools and equipment to drive safety, efficiency and long-term performance.

Eagle Materials is a trusted leader in American manufacturing, supplying essential materials that support homes, businesses, roads, energy projects, and critical infrastructure across the country. Every product we make-cement, wallboard, paperboard, concrete, and aggregates-is
100% manufactured in the United States
, reinforcing our commitment to domestic production and economic growth.

At Eagle Materials, safety and environmental stewardship are not just priorities-they are core values. We invest in our people, our technology, and our facilities, fostering a culture where talented professionals are empowered to innovate, lead, and grow their careers. You'll work alongside passionate, driven teammates who take pride in building something that truly matters.

If you're looking for a career-defining opportunity to be a part of a passionate, hard working team at a next-generation facility and make a meaningful impact, we invite you to join us.
Learn more at

www.eaglematerials.com
.

Overview:
The Mine Coordinator/Engineer will provide daily oversight as necessary and technical support to ensure mine production requirements are met, in the short and long term, efficiently, safely, and within MSHA requirements. They are responsible for supervision, meeting mine production, planning quality, budgetary plans, and safety objectives. Basic qualifications and/or traits that the Mining Engineer must possess include:

Excellent communication skills

The ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

Timely and sound decision-making skills

Strong interpersonal skills

The ability to develop and implement policies and procedures.

Use of Microsoft documents, information, data, presentation software (Excel, PowerPoint and Word)

Responsibilities:
The responsibilities of the Mining Engineer include but are not limited to:

Responsible for effective coordination of daily mining operations to ensure multiple production shifts and maintenance activities are working synergistically towards common mine objectives.

Responsible for short term and long term mine planning and permitting.

Oversee mine survey activities and update mine maps monthly.

Responsible for mine control and monthly AutoCAD mapping.

Responsible for mine drainage planning, measurement, and control.

Responsible for maintaining MSHA required evacuation plans, roadway berming, and maps.

Responsible for quarry highwall monitoring.

Support operations in ground control optimization.

Support operations to optimize mine production and maintenance practices.

Support and/or participate in the mine improvement groups, committees, mine safety program, and the overall company safety strategies, etc.

Coordinate with appropriate parties to plan, develop, and enact the remediation of overburden and other materials previously stored in the mine area.

Responsible for coordinating the environmental requirements as they relate to the mine and to the plant.

Responsible for monthly drone inventory measurements of plant and mine inventories of outside stockpiles.

Responsible for development and management of annual departmental budget, including managing/reducing operational and equipment costs.

Responsible for leading a strong, effective Safety culture within the mine department.

Education & Experience:

Requires a BS in Mining Engineering.
Required

Mining experience, particularly in surface mines, with a history of both engineering and supervisory/management experience.
Preferred

Proficient in the use of AutoCAD, preferably with experience using Arc GIS.
Preferred

Proficient in the use of the Microsoft Office suite of products, Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and MS Project.
Preferred

Strong leadership skills: possess the ability to lead, manage and motivate; have a proven track record for creating employee ownership of safety, production, and quality.
Preferred

Physical Requirements
: The Mining Engineer position is safety sensitive. The physical requirements include, but are not limited to:

Working 8-12 hours shifts.

Working in areas of heat, cold, muddy, icy, or dusty conditions for extended periods of time.

Subject to twisting, bending, stooping, lifting, and climbing.

Lifting 65+ lbs regularly.

Ability to stand for extended periods of time.

jobs.title: Production Excellence Specialist (Engineer)
jobs.description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is transforming the future?

Who We Are

We are Vale Base Metals - a global supplier of the critical minerals transforming the future.

With industry-leading reserves of copper and nickel in Canada, Brazil, and Indonesia, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in the U.K., Canada, and Japan, VBM delivers a secure and responsible supply of high-quality products to customers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Global demand for critical minerals is growing exponentially. From energy to aerospace, batteries to magnets, robotics to artificial intelligence, a secure and responsible supply of critical minerals is fundamental to power modern technologies. And at Vale Base Metals, we are transforming our business to provide a secure and responsible supply of these minerals.

Join our diverse team of 13,000 talented individuals committed to providing mineral security to a world in transition. We invite you to put your skills to work, driving meaningful and enduring change while enjoying a rewarding career.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a
Production Excellence Engineer
to join our
Production Operations
team in Long Harbour.

This is a permanent on-site position
,
working 4 x 10's schedule.

As the Production Excellence Engineer you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth, operational efficiency, safety performance, and cultural transformation. This leader is responsible for developing and embedding best-in-class manufacturing practices, fostering a culture of accountability and collaboration, and implementing innovative strategies to maximize enterprise-wide efficiency and value creation. Your experience and skills will also serve as a functional leadership resource, providing strategic relief coverage for Production Area Managers and Superintendents, reinforcing continuous improvement and operational resilience across all production areas within an Operating Plant.

Additionally, in this position you will:

Develop and implement strategic production initiatives that enhance profitability, efficiency, and long-term business scalability.

Lead the execution of Shingo Model principles by aligning production systems and leadership behaviors with world-class operational excellence standards, embedding a mindset of enterprise-wide transformation and sustainable business performance

Ensure the technical proficiency of operations teams, equipping them with the necessary training and protocols to maintain a safe, efficient, and risk-optimized work environment. Support development of technical qualification routines for Production area including oral boards, Control Room Technician qualification and training)

Support Production Area Manager in development of annual and 5-year budgets, annual and 5-year capital plans, and annual forecasting.

Audit and analyze trends in quality, cost and production performance against the annual production plan. Develop and implement actions to address common cause variances or to take advantage of opportunities as they arise (with a focus on

continuous improvement), while balancing the allocation of resources, meeting quantity and quality output requirements for the internal and/or external "Customers".

Verify compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLA) and required standards.

Support and mentor department leadership and technical support functions to provide consistent quality and compliance to Management of Change processes

Develop the area's annual execution plan and develop area specific goals and objectives to achieve the annual execution plan

Support the development of execution plan strategies and implement operating plans for the area(s) of responsibility, considering, targets and related actions to reduce incident frequency rates, environmental performance, production output, quality, costs and capital expenditures.

Develop weekly and monthly production and/or maintenance plans and update forecasts as required. Escalate when plans and/or forecasts will not be achieved.

Monitor area production and/or maintenance performance, and asset integrity, to confirm that processes are in place to maintain the plant and equipment, sustain/build capability, and to achieve the targets outlined in the Execution plan.

What We Offer You

Competitive compensation including a variable annual incentive plan

Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans and optional insurances)

Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

Employee Family Assistance Program

Virtual Healthcare

Online training and career development opportunities

A Bus Service departing from the St. John's vicinity

About You

Education:

Undergraduate Degree in a related technical field (i.e. process engineering, industrial engineering, chemical engineering);

Professional Engineer Designation (P.Eng) is required.

Experience:

A minimum of 8 years experience in a similar role, preferably in a complex industrial setting.

Skills:

Advanced knowledge and experience in the field of hydrometallurgy (process and unit operations)

Operational experience and knowledge of hydrometallurgical plants and metals refineries.

Previous supervisor experience, preferably in a technical setting.

Ability to lead a group of technical professionals and work collaboratively to support a diverse group of business functions.

Superior organizational, analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a keen attention to detail.

Ability to multitask, change priorities, problem solve and resolve conflict. Able to communicate with, build, and maintain strong positive relationships across multiple departments.

Acerca de nuestra
oficina de

Santiago

La oficina corporativa de Teck en Santiago es el centro administrativo de nuestras operaciones mineras en Chile, brindando apoyo a Quebrada Blanca (QB) en la Región de Tarapacá y a Carmen de Andacollo en Coquimbo.

Ubicada en el corazón de Santiago, nuestra oficina conecta la experiencia global con proyectos mineros de clase mundial.

Descripción del cargo

Plazo de Postulación:
10

de septiembre, 2026.

En Teck, nuestro propósito es proporcionar recursos esenciales con los que el mundo cuenta para mejorar la vida, mientras que cuidamos de las personas, comunidades y la tierra que amamos.

Reportando al Process Lead - Source to Pay , el/la Senior Supply Chain Specialist es responsable de integrar y gestionar los procesos y datos de la cadena de suministro. Este puesto se encarga de la documentación de los procesos y datos, los controles y la alineación con los estándares de la organización y las políticas de gobernanza. El especialista colaborará con los equipos de la cadena de suministro, tanto a nivel central como en la operación, para optimizar el desempeño de los procesos y los datos de la cadena de suministro y respaldar las iniciativas de mejora continua. Este puesto es fundamental para apoyar los objetivos de transformación de Teck, que buscan estandarizar, simplificar y clarificar el personal, los procesos y la tecnología que facilitan e integran la cadena de suministro, la gestión de activos y las finanzas.

Responsabilidades principales

Ser un líder valiente en materia de seguridad, cumplir y promover las normas y procedimientos de seguridad y medio ambiente

Apoyar los requisitos de los procesos de negocio y los datos, así como la colaboración entre múltiples equipos, incluyendo la Oficina de Gestión de la Transformación, la Planificación de Recursos Empresariales (para alinear los puntos de integración), la Gestión de Activos, Finanzas y el Sistema Operativo de Gestión (MOS) de Teck.

Apoyar el desarrollo de procesos y datos de la cadena de suministro global que cumplan con los requisitos operativos clave

Apoyar a los líderes funcionales al proporcionar información sobre las ineficiencias en los procesos y datos de la cadena de suministro, así como sobre las oportunidades de mejora.

Proporcionar información detallada a los líderes de procesos y a los propietarios de procesos globales sobre el estado actual de los procesos de negocio locales, los puntos críticos y las oportunidades de mejora.

Validar los diseños de procesos futuros para garantizar que satisfagan las necesidades operativas locales.

Participar en actividades de recopilación de requisitos, mapeo de procesos y análisis de brechas.

Apoyar los esfuerzos de migración de datos mediante la identificación y validación de fuentes de datos clave.

Requisitos

Profesional universitario en Administración de empresas, Ingeniería o un campo relacionado.

Experiencia mínimo de 10 años de experiencia progresiva en puestos relevantes de la cadena de suministro.

Profundo conocimiento de las dinámicas operativas internas y de la cadena de suministro; capacidad para utilizar la inteligencia corporativa a fin de orientar la dirección de la empresa.

Experiencia y pericia comprobadas con SAP y en la disciplina de procesos de negocio, incluyendo la documentación, el análisis y la optimización de procesos.

Gran capacidad para trabajar más allá de las fronteras funcionales y geográficas, estableciendo relaciones de colaboración para impulsar la integración y la adopción de procesos.

Habilidades claras de comunicación e influencia, incluyendo sólidas habilidades para la resolución de conflictos entre líderes, propietarios de negocios y equipos funcionales.

Capacidad para alinear el diseño de procesos con los objetivos estratégicos, al tiempo que se garantiza la eficiencia operativa a escala global.

Capacidad para evaluar procesos de negocios y datos complejos, identificar ineficiencias y proponer soluciones basadas en datos para la mejora.

Acerca de Teck

En Teck, valoramos la diversidad. Nuestros equipos trabajan de manera colaborativa y respetan la perspectiva y contribución únicas de cada persona. *Esta oferta se enmarca en la ley 21.015, que incentiva la inclusión de personas con discapacidad al mundo laboral.

En caso de que requieras de algún ajuste razonable en el proceso de selección, cuéntanos para apoyarte en tu participación en igualdad de condiciones (ley 20.422).

En Teck actuamos conforme a nuestro principio de Hacer lo Correcto, y en cumplimiento de las leyes aplicables en nuestros países de operación para prevenir la Responsabilidad Penal de las Personas Jurídicas. Por esta razón, incorporamos en nuestros procesos de selección preguntas destinadas a prevenir riesgos asociados a la Ley N°20.393.

Queremos agradecer a todos(as) los(las) postulantes por su interés y esfuerzo en postular a esta posición; Sin embargo, sólo se contactará a los(las) candidatos(as) seleccionados(as) para entrevistas.

Su postulación a esta publicación se considera como su consentimiento para la recopilación, uso y divulgación necesaria de información personal para los propósitos de reclutamiento. Teck respeta la privacidad de todos los candidatos y la confidencialidad de la información personal.

jobs.title: Manager, Early Talent and Talent Attraction
jobs.description:
WHAT DOES AGNICO EAGLE VALUE?

At Agnico Eagle, our values never waver. We believe in trust, respect, equity, family and responsibility. Why? Because they express who we are, and they have helped us succeed in business for over 60 years. We value
you
- your unique set of skills and experience. We value your willingness to build those skills and make a meaningful contribution to our company. And, we value your commitment to treat every person on our team with respect, helping us to operate safely, protect the environment and make a positive contribution to our local communities.

ABOUT OUR OPERATION

Canadian-based and led, Agnico Eagle is Canada's largest mining company and the second largest gold producer in the world. It produces precious metals from operations in Canada, Australia, Finland and Mexico and has a pipeline of high-quality exploration and development projects. Agnico Eagle is a partner of choice within the mining industry, recognized globally for its leading sustainability practices. Agnico Eagle was founded in 1957 and has consistently created value for its shareholders, declaring a cash dividend every year since 1983.

Want to learn more about our operations and projects?
Click here
!

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE:

Reporting to the Director, Talent Acquisition, you will be part of the Human Resources Department. You will lead early talent recruitment and engagement activities across Canada. Working in partnership with Corporate and Regional Communications teams, you will support talent attraction initiatives and help bring employer branding activities to life across recruitment channels and events. You will also be responsible for identifying and managing strategic talent sourcing partnerships, including diversity-focused partnerships, and overseeing talent acquisition tools that support effective and efficient recruitment processes.

You will develop and deliver programs and initiatives that support early talent pipelines and current and future hiring needs across the organization. You may also contribute to talent acquisition policy development, support the implementation of Talent Acquisition tools and process improvements, and work with the Talent Acquisition Leadership Team on initiatives that enhance service delivery and stakeholder experience across Canada

Lead the development and execution of Agnico Eagle's national early talent strategy, ensuring programs support current and future workforce needs across Canada.

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Talent Attraction and Early Talent professionals while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.

Oversee the recruitment and selection of interns, co-op students, summer students, graduates, and early career professionals, while continuously enhancing programs to improve candidate experience and hiring outcomes.

Build and maintain strategic relationships with universities, colleges, student organizations, Indigenous communities, and industry partners to strengthen talent pipelines and expand Agnico Eagle's talent network.

Partner with Corporate and Regional Communications teams to support talent attraction, employer branding, and recruitment marketing initiatives that enhance Agnico Eagle's visibility as an employer of choice.

Identify and manage strategic sourcing partnerships, including diversity-focused organizations, to support hiring objectives and broaden access to qualified talent.

Leverage talent analytics, labour market insights, and recruitment metrics to evaluate program effectiveness, inform strategy, and drive continuous improvement.

Represent Agnico Eagle at recruitment events, career fairs, industry conferences, community forums, and other external engagements, serving as an ambassador for the organization and its employer brand.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Bilingualism in French and English (spoken and written) is mandatory. Candidates must be able to communicate effectively and professionally in both official languages.

Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field.

7 years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition, Early Talent, Talent Attraction, Recruitment Marketing, or a related discipline.

Proven experience leading and developing Talent Acquisition or Recruitment teams within a complex, multi-site, or national organization.

Demonstrated experience designing and managing early talent programs, including campus recruitment, internships, co-op programs, graduate hiring, and workforce pipeline initiatives.

Experience building strategic partnerships with educational institutions, community organizations, industry associations, and diverse talent networks.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across all levels of the organization.

Experience leveraging recruitment technologies, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and talent analytics to support strategic decision-making and improve hiring outcomes.

Strong project management, communication, and leadership skills, with experience managing budgets, vendors, and cross-functional initiatives.

Your Work Schedule:

40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Based at our Corporate Office in Toronto, Ontario.

Travel may be required to support campus recruitment and business needs across Canada.

Compensation Statement

No pay range is disclosed, as compensation is expected to exceed $200,000.

jobs.title: Mining Programme Project Consultant (12 month fixed-term contract)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Our client is a Mining Sector Regulator currently overseeing numerous mining projects nationally and playing an advisory role to occupational health and safety legislation and research outcomes focused on improving and promoting occupational health and safety in South African mines.

The client promotes a culture of health and safety in the mining industry and liaises with the Mining Qualifications Authority and any other statutory bodies about mining health and safety to align all mining legislation in the South African context.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Programme Project Consultant will be operating on Middle Management Level to support projects and ensuring that strategic initiatives are effectively planned, coordinated, monitored, planned, monitored and delivered within agreed timelines with stakeholders. Budgeting, quality standards and governance will be a critical part of the role for the success of the on-going projects.

Roles & Responsibilities

Programme & Project Coordination

Coordinate multiple projects and workstreams across the programme portfolio.

Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones and deliverables.

Track project progress against scope, cost, quality and timelines.

Identify interdependencies, bottlenecks, risks and potential delays.

Coordinate project meetings, workshops and progress reviews.

Ensure actions, decisions and deliverables are documented and followed through.

Support Programme Managers and Project Managers with project implementation and governance.

Stakeholder Management

Establish and maintain effective relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

Coordinate communication between mining operations, technical teams, finance, procurement, HR, contractors and service providers.

Facilitate stakeholder meetings and ensure alignment on programme objectives.

Escalate critical issues and provide appropriate recommendations to management.

Project Monitoring & Reporting.

Develop and maintain programme dashboards and management reports.

Monitor key performance indicators, milestones, expenditure and resource utilisation.

Prepare regular status reports for management and governance structures.

Analyse project information and highlight trends, exceptions and areas requiring intervention.

Ensure accurate and timely reporting of programme performance.

Risk, Compliance & Governance.

Maintain programme risk and issue registers and coordinate mitigation actions.

Ensure projects comply with organisational policies, governance frameworks and relevant mining legislation.

Support project assurance, audits and governance reviews.

Monitor compliance with approved project scope, budgets and change-control processes.

Promote effective project governance and accountability.

Financial & Resource Coordination.

Monitor project budgets, expenditure and financial commitments.

Work with Finance and Procurement to ensure appropriate budgetary and procurement processes are followed.

Support resource planning and allocation across projects.

Identify potential cost overruns and recommend corrective actions.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, systems and reporting.

Facilitate lessons-learned sessions and ensure lessons are incorporated into future projects.

Promote standardisation of project management practices across the programme.

Support change management and organisational readiness

Desired Experience & Qualification

Bachelor of Commerce Honours Degree in (Mining Engineering, Rock Mechanics, Geology, Health & Safety) or related qualification

Recognised Project Management Qualification (advantageous)

5 years minimum experience working in a mine

Demonstrated experience in managing multiple projects

Exposure to mining capital projects, operational improvement initiatives, transformation programmes or infrastructure projects will be advantageous

Experience with project reporting, budgeting, risk management and stakeholder engagement

Package & Remuneration

Negotiable

Interested?

Candidates who meet the minimum experience and application requirements can apply through Pnet.

jobs.title: Specialist Delivery
jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP, we believe our purpose goes beyond mining: we work to improve lives and create a more sustainable future. We are a global resources company with operations in more than 90 locations worldwide.

In Canada, our presence is growing with the development of
one of the most significant potash projects in the world: Jansen.
This project reflects our long-term commitment to sustainability, community engagement, and economic growth.

Come and be part of this success!

About Potash and the Jansen Project

Imagine being part of something truly world-class, something that's shaping the future of sustainable agriculture and responsible resource development. That's what the Jansen Potash Project offers.

Located about 140 kilometers east of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, 
Jansen is set to become one of the largest and most sustainable potash mines in the world.
At approximately US$15.3 billion investment, it marks the biggest private investment in Saskatchewan's history, and a bold step forward for BHP in Canada.

Beyond its scale, Jansen will create lasting value for people and communities. The project is expected to support approximately 5,500 jobs during construction and around 900 permanent roles once production begins.

Whether you're looking to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, or be part of a legacy project, Jansen could be the place where it all begins.

Why BHP?

With operations worldwide, BHP offers limitless opportunities. Whether it's competitive benefits, international career pathways, or the chance to be part of a world-class project like Jansen, at BHP you can shape a career that's truly yours.

We are proud to be recognized as one of 
Canada's Top 100 Employers for 2026,
a testament of our dedication to fostering a positive, diverse and rewarding work environment.

If you're looking for a place where your work has purpose, your growth is supported, and your impact is real, this could be your next step.

The Challenge Ahead

As a
Specialist Delivery
, you will play an important role in supporting the successful execution of Technology project delivery activities across Potash. Working within a multidisciplinary team, you'll provide technical expertise in managing technology projects and/or products throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

As a
Specialist Delivery
, you will:

Support the execution of Technology projects and delivery activities in alignment with approved project objectives, scope, schedule, budget, and performance requirements.

Monitor project performance, identify potential deviations, and contribute to project controls, reporting, and performance improvement initiatives.

Assist with project planning and scheduling activities, ensuring key milestones, dependencies, and critical path activities are effectively managed.

Support contractor and contract management activities, including contract administration, performance monitoring, and issue resolution.

Champion a strong safety culture by promoting compliance with health, safety, environmental, and operational requirements.

Identify, assess, and manage project risks and opportunities while supporting informed decision-making and proactive mitigation strategies.

Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support project delivery and alignment across teams.

Investigate issues, determine root causes, and contribute practical solutions to complex project and construction challenges.

Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, and ways of working that enhance efficiency, safety, and project outcomes.

Deliver high-quality outcomes while maintaining a customer-focused mindset and commitment to operational excellence.

Knows our customer and is obsessed with meeting their needs.

Strives to achieve 100% safety, 100% customer value and 0% waste.

Engages the capabilities of the entire organisation.

What You'll Bring to the Role

You are a collaborative and technically capable project professional with a passion for delivering safe, efficient, and successful project outcomes.

You'll bring:

Ability to motivate and guide teams toward project goals.

Clear communication with stakeholders, clients, and team members.

Ability to quickly address challenges and make informed decisions.

Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Familiarity with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Gantt charts, Kanban boards, and AI-enabled software.

Ability to navigate changing project requirements and maintain team cohesion.

Experience supporting the delivery of Technology projects in the mining, industrial, infrastructure, engineering, or resource sector.

Strong understanding of project delivery principles, execution, contractor management, project controls, scheduling, or contract administration.

The ability to monitor and interpret project performance related to schedule, cost, risk, resources, and delivery objectives.

A demonstrated commitment to health, safety, environment, and sustainable work practices.

Experience working with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and cross-functional project teams.

Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and relationship-building skills.

Proven analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to evaluate issues and identify practical solutions.

A continuous improvement mindset focused on improving performance, simplifying processes, and delivering value.

Sound judgment and the ability to balance risk, opportunity, and business outcomes.

A collaborative, inclusive, and accountable approach aligned with BHP's Charter Values.

Experience in Technology project delivery in large-scale construction, mining, heavy industrial, or major project environments will be highly regarded.

Recommended

Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Inf

jobs.description:
Sobre Escondida | BHP 

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global.

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Somos operados por una compañía global líder en recursos naturales, con operaciones en más de 90 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo. 

Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar. Aquí, tu voz cuenta. Tu crecimiento importa. Y tu trabajo contribuye directamente a transformar el mundo. 

El desafio que te espera

En Escondida | BHP tendrás la oportunidad de garantizar la gestión integral y estratégica de contratos críticos para las operaciones y servicios de MEL/BHP, asegurando el cumplimiento de los más altos estándares de seguridad, productividad, sostenibilidad y generación de valor. Lidera el ciclo completo de los contratos, impulsando la mejora continua, optimización de recursos y procesos, así como iniciativas transformacionales. Actúa como referente técnico y estratégico en la toma de decisiones contractuales, promoviendo relaciones sólidas con los stakeholders y resguardando la seguridad y salud de las personas en cada etapa del ciclo de contratos.

Principales Responsabilidades

Como Engineer Contracts, serás responsable de:

Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares HSE y normativa legal (Ley 20.123, DS 76, DS 132).

Validar inventario de riesgos HSE y ejecución del Plan HSE.

Liderar rutinas críticas (Performance Meetings, Voz del Cliente, Liderazgo en Terreno).

Monitorear y gestionar indicadores de seguridad, salud y medioambiente (cumplimiento de programa de liderazgo en terreno, hazards, Near Miss, FA, MT y LTI) con el monitoreo del cierre con calidad y a tiempo de los planes de acción derivados.

Liderar la gestión de contratos durante todo el ciclo de vida; Estrategia, On-boarding, Ejecución y Off-boarding.

Asegurar cumplimiento de KPI’s, SLA’s y compromisos contractuales con seguimiento sistemático.

Controlar riesgos operacionales, financieros y legales, mediante planes de continuidad de negocio (BCP’s).

Gestionar modificaciones contractuales, claims y gestión de no conformidades.

Participar en la definición del alcance, segmentación operacional y estrategia de abastecimiento.

Contribuir en procesos de budget y forecast, alineando objetivos con la estrategia del negocio.

Implementar iniciativas de mejora continua y transformación (WAVE, Comité de Contratos).

Construir relaciones efectivas con proveedores estratégicos, promoviendo excelencia operacional y alineación con valores BHP.

Coordinar y liderar reuniones de desempeño, reuniones de seguridad y revisiones periódicas con empresas colaboradoras.

Actuar como nexo entre áreas internas (Operaciones, Mantención, Finanzas, Legal, HSE, Supply) y contratistas para asegurar colaboración y cumplimiento.

Facilitar comunicación clara y formal en sistemas corporativos (Libros de Obra Digital) para garantizar trazabilidad y transparencia.

Lo que esperamos de ti

Buscamos personas que cuenten con:

Título universitario en Ingeniería Civil, Industrial, Mecánica, Eléctrica o afín.

Experiencia laboral de al menos 4 años en gestión de contratos críticos en minería.

Deseable Postgrado en Gestión de Contratos, Supply Chain, MBA o certificación PMP

Inglés nivel intermedio.

Conocimientos de sistemas de información transversales (1SAP – Gestión de eventos – Liderazgo en Terreno).

Conocimiento en planificación, control presupuestario y Work Management.

Análisis de datos y reportabilidad (Excel, Power BI).

Conocimiento normativo: Ley 20.123, DS 76, DS 132, DS 594, Ley 16.744.

Gestión de riesgos, plan de ejecución de contrato y gestionar no conformidades.

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí

En Escondida | BHP entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.  

- Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.  

- Remuneración: justa y competitiva que refleje tu rol, habilidades y logros. 

- Cultura inclusiva: Promovemos un entorno laboral donde cada persona se siente valorada, respetada y libre de expresar su identidad auténtica. 

- Reconocimiento: Te recompensamos por tus pequeños y grandes logros a través de nuestro programa global de reconocimiento Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias. 

¡Y mucho más!  

Sobre nuestro proceso

En Escondida | BHP contratamos personas que se alinean con nuestros valores y cumplen con los requisitos del rol. Como parte del proceso, podríamos analizar el cumplimiento de los requisitos para determinar la idoneidad y capacidad personal para ejecutar el trabajo.  

Si ya trabajas en BHP, postula a través del portal interno con tu correo corporativo.   

¿Y por qué no tú?

Nuestra compañía te ofrece oportunidades sin límites. Desde beneficios competitivos hasta la posibilidad de trabajar en distintos países, aquí puedes diseñar tu carrera a tu manera. Si estás buscando un lugar donde tu trabajo tenga propósito y tu crecimiento sea parte del camino, este puede ser tu próximo paso.

jobs.description:
About BHP 

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

Come and be a part of this success.

About the Role

Our Operations - Olympic Dam

One of Australia’s largest mines and a complex minerals processing operation, Olympic Dam, is unique in that we produce Copper, Uranium, Gold and Silver. The local township of Roxby Downs is an active and progressive community offering a variety of modern, well equipped housing, educational, health, sporting, leisure, shopping and cultural facilities.

Please note this position is based at Olympic Dam, operating on a 7/7 day/night roster pattern arrangement with residential, FIFO (from Adelaide) or DIDO options available.

We currently have multiple roles available for a Production Technician to join our Smelting, Casting and Acid Plant / Feed Preparation teams. In this role you will be responsible for safe and efficient operation of Smelter and Acid Plant / Feed Preparation equipment in accordance with operational procedures. This includes working in challenging environments with molten metal and acid operations.

In this role you will:

Execute production tasks in alignment with the production schedule and operational priorities.

Proactively identify, report, and address hazards to maintain a safe working environment

Ensure product quality and compliance with production specifications to meet customer requirements.

Embrace training opportunities across all equipment and plant areas to support operational flexibility.

Participate in field leadership activities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Foster an inclusive and respectful team culture, working effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds.

About You

Experience working in a similar role with exposure to Smelting or Acid Plant/Feed Preparation operations (desirable)

Current South Australian C Class driver’s licence (required)

Forklift licence, CB Bridge & Gantry Crane and DG Dogging licences (desirable)

A strong understanding of workplace safety practices, including hazard identification and risk management

Ability to work autonomously, or as part of a team

A proactive and motivated approach to problem-solving, with a commitment to continuous improvement.

BENEFITS

BHP offers an array of attractive perks to our employees, not limited to annual bonus, shares program, employee recognition program, heavily discounted corporate offers and so much more. To hear more about the benefits we offer our employees, please take a moment to play Why choose BHP for your career? 
Why choose BHP for your career? - YouTube

At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks. 

If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal. 

Supporting a Diverse Workforce 

The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance-based bonuses and a best-in-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms.  

At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity employer that is committed to making BHP a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and be at their best every day. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and recognise that true diversity includes gender, age, race, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, education levels, and many more aspects of your identity.

BHP is committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible for all. If you have a disability, we know that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. If you would like to reach out to someone about your situation and our recruitment process, please email us at 

inclusion@bhp.com

jobs.description:
At Climax Molybdenum, we are committed to providing an employment package that recognizes excellence, encourages safe production and a culture supported by our core values. Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their career.  

We accept applications on an ongoing basis. 

Where You Will Work  

Our Henderson mine and mill are an hour drive apart – separated by the Continental Divide and a 15-mile conveyor system (10 miles underground). The Henderson mine is an underground molybdenum mining operation located approximately 42 miles west of Denver and 10 miles west of Empire. It has been in operation since 1976 and today consists of a large block-cave, underground mining complex feeding a concentrator with a current capacity of approximately 32,000 metric tons per day. It can produce approximately 15 million pounds of molybdenum per year. The Henderson mill is located 15 miles west of the mine, between Dillon and Kremmling.  

Both sites are surrounded by 
US Forest Service
 land of the 
Arapaho National Forest
, making it easy for our employees and their families to enjoy year-round hiking, cross-country skiing, and snowshoeing in the area. Explore the opportunity to advance your career at one of our sites – the Henderson mine or mill and live life at the top!   

Employees who are required to work on-site are eligible for a $1,450 monthly housing allowance, provided they meet program guidelines.

What You Will Do

Under general supervision, oversee underground excavation stability management functions including underground excavation support design and stability monitoring and serve as a resource for Geomechanical information and analysis.

In this role, you perform geotechnical analyses related to underground mining, document and present findings, and stay current with state-of-practice geotechnical engineering.

As the Geomechanical Engineer II U/G, you develop and review ground support designs for underground excavations using empirical, kinematic, and stress-based analysis methods to ensure a safe working environment.

You will manage and review underground excavation stability data collection, analysis, monitoring data processing, and remedial work.

Communicate accurate, timely, and relevant Geomechanical and underground excavation stability information to mine and site personnel through reports and presentations.

Proactively seek improvements to safe mining practices related to monitoring, maintenance, support design, and data acquisition.

Develop, maintain, and implement strategic plans to enhance underground excavation stability programs.

Provide Geomechanical project oversight and review for external consultants.

Utilize appropriate software including MS Office, AutoCAD, Deswik (or equivalent), and RocScience tools such as unWedge, Phase2, RS3, and Dips.

Perform other duties as required.

Bachelor’s degree in an appropriate Engineering discipline and three (3) years of related experience in hard rock mining relating to rock mechanics and underground excavation stability
