jobs.title: Technical Project Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Location:
Kidlington, Oxford, Unit 5 Technology Dr,

Roster:
Monday to Friday 

Duration:
6-months (Maternity Cover, with possibility to extend) 

Overview:

This role sits within the PMO side of Programmes, helping improve Elysia’s delivery excellence, governance, tooling and project visibility, while also providing hands-on delivery support for internal technical projects.

It is ideal for someone with a technical background who enjoys improving how work gets delivered and aspires to grow into a technical Project Manager role.

You will use data, tools and process to help teams move faster, make better decisions and deliver consistently.

Key Responsibilities

You will own the consistent setup, tracking and reporting of technical projects across programmes, ensuring project information is accurate, structured and reliable.

You will work with Project Managers and technical teams to set up JIRA projects, plans, trackers, dashboards and reporting routines across Elysia’s portfolio and projects you own, providing clear visibility of project status, milestones, risks and dependencies.

A key part of the role will be improving the operations behind project delivery, making sure tools, templates and processes are efficient, useful and followed by teams.

You will help identify gaps, inconsistencies and pain points in how projects are planned and tracked, then support improvements to Elysia’s delivery processes, governance and ways of working.

At every step, you will be supported and empowered to make an impact. We are looking for someone excited to work with technical teams and improve how projects are delivered.

What will you do:
•    Support the setup of new projects in a consistent way by creating and maintaining JIRA plans, trackers, dashboards, RAID logs, risk registers and reporting routines. 
•    Own the capture and maintenance of project baselines, so current delivery status can be compared against agreed plans for portfolio reporting and SLT reviews. 
•    Maintain SLT portfolio visibility by ensuring dashboards and reports provide a clear view of project health, milestones, KPIs, budgets, risks, dependencies, resource and decisions required. 
•    Track cross-project dependencies, resource constraints, gaps and risks, escalating conflicts, trade-offs or capacity concerns where support or decisions are required. 
•    Support cross-team planning by helping ensure project plans are well integrated with Programme Managers’ wider plans, baselines and portfolio priorities. 
•    Provide PMO oversight to ensure Project Managers and Programme Managers keep plans, trackers and reports up to date as priorities, estimates, scope or delivery assumptions change.
•    Identify recurring pain points in how projects are planned, tracked and reported, then turn them into practical improvements to Elysia’s delivery processes and tools. 
•    Help ensure teams follow agreed planning, reporting and escalation processes in a way that is useful, lightweight and scalable. 
•    Support projects you own by maintaining plans, driving actions, tracking blockers and helping teams stay focused on agreed delivery outcomes. 
•    Own Jira, Confluence and project administration improvements that make project information easier to manage, report and act on. 
•    Build and sustain positive relationships with Project Managers, Programme Managers, technical teams, Commercial stakeholders and customers where relevant.

Qualifications and Experience

Our team values a growth mindset over an expansive CV. We encourage you to apply if you have some or all the following:
•    Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a STEM field such as Engineering or similar field. 
•    Experience coordinating or planning projects in a fast-paced engineering, software or product environment. 
•    Confident using modern project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence. Experience with Structure.Gantt, Power BI or the ability to code is an advantage. This role requires experience beyond standard Office tools. 
•    Strong interest in PMO, delivery excellence, governance and process improvement. 
•    Comfortable working with project data, including plans, milestones, KPIs, budgets, risks, dependencies, actions and resource information, and able to turn it into clear plans, trackers, dashboards and reports. 
•    Well organised, detail-oriented and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to spot gaps, inconsistencies and risks early. 
•    Able to improve processes and ways of working without making them unnecessarily heavy or bureaucratic. 
•    Comfortable working with technical teams and able to understand enough technical detail to track dependencies, blockers, progress and the impact of changes
•    Strong communication skills, with the confidence to follow up with technical, customer and commercial stakeholders, clarify information, build positive relationships and help keep teams accountable to agreed actions and deadlines. 
•    Awareness of agile, software delivery or automotive standards is preferred.

About Us

At Elysia, we are at the forefront of revolutionizing the life, safety, and performance of battery systems, across markets and industries. 

As a pioneering technology company, we specialize in the development of cutting-edge software solutions that supports, optimises and de-risks the deployment of batteries, from cradle to grave, starting with design and manufacture, through to first-life monitoring and the transition to second-life or recycling.

Our team of brilliant minds and passionate experts are dedicated to pushing the boundaries in software-derived performance, both within embedded BMS and cloud-based domains. We believe in the combination of expertise in electrochemistry, battery systems and data science to build products that empower our customers to unlock the full potential of their battery assets.

jobs.description:
About Woodside

We know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential as well as bring their whole self to work. We also recognise that enduring, meaningful relationships with communities are fundamental to maintaining our licence to operate.

Technology and innovation are essential to our long-term sustainability. We are growing our carbon and new energy businesses using technology to reduce emissions and the carbon footprint of our products. We are working to improving energy efficiency, offset emissions, reduce emissions intensity and explore options for lower-carbon energy. Woodside led the development of the LNG industry in Australia and is applying this same pioneering spirit to solving future energy challenges round the globe.

About the Role

Reporting to the Global Head of Portfolio Marketing and Market Development in London, this role will support the team and oversee all office administration activities in one of the fastest growing offices in the Woodside portfolio. 

Maintain Office Management Systems:

Ensure office security is maintained, and oversee

 office service providers

Arrange entertainment & events, in accordance with Code of Conduct

Ensure documentation is managed and stored in accordance with Woodside guidelines

Facilitate internal/external meetings

Manage the office access control system

Complete the annual country office self-assessment

Office Operations & Facilities Management

Oversee office facilities, ensuring a safe and well-maintained workspace

Manage office supplies, equipment and procurement, supplier contracts, coordinating with vendors for maintenance and services

Serve as the point of contact for building management and external service providers

Manage employee onboarding

Act as the UK Immigration Authorising Officer on behalf of Woodside Energy (UK) Ltd

Support with building lease and related matters

Support with ad hoc IT requests,

IT equipment requests and orders, including the procurement of laptops, monitors etc

Manage the UK mobile phone account

Duties and Responsibilities

Health & Safety

Support delivery of the in-Country Emergency Plan

Ensure the Woodside security system (Everbridge) is regularly updated to maintain an accurate record of all London-based staff

Conduct monthly office health and safety inspections, including annual fire risk assessment

Organise regular first aid and fire safety training courses

Financial Management & Accounting

Facilitate the quarterly VAT return reconciliation process for general office corporate credit card expenditure

Manage the onboarding of new vendors, create PR/P0s and MPRs, and handle SAP approval processes to ensure timely processing of Service Entry Sheets and payments

Facilitate the completion of the annual office general budget forecast

Organise payment of the annual data protection fee for UK entities

Administrative Support

Meet and greet visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming office environment

Provide ad hoc support to senior Woodside executives visiting London

Organise corporate events, team-building activities and employee celebrations

Organise in-house catering and ad hoc external client lunches

Order stationary supplies

Skills and Experience

We are looking for an experienced office manager who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, corporate environment. This role will interact with senior executives both from within Woodisde and external stakeholders. You'll bring a positive and upbeat energy, combined with a high degree of professionalism and discretion.

You will be able to demonstrate previous office management experience, ideally with exposure to a global operating environment.

Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems is required.

You will have strong digital literacy across all MS Office products, and experience in the oil and gas sector will help you succeed in this role.

Recognition and Reward

Commitment to your ongoing development, including on-the-job opportunities, formal programs and coaching

jobs.title: Telecommunications Engineer
jobs.description:
About Woodside

We know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential and working in a positive work environment. We recognise that enduring, meaningful relationships with communities are fundamental to maintaining our licence to operate.
 
Technology and innovation are essential to our long-term sustainability. We are growing our carbon and new energy businesses using technology to reduce emissions and the carbon footprint of our products. We are working to improving energy efficiency, offset emissions, reduce emissions intensity and explore options for lower-carbon energy. Woodside led the development of the LNG industry in Australia and is applying this same pioneering spirit to solving future energy challenges globally.
 
Refer to our corporate website for more information about our different locations and projects:
https://www.woodside.com/what-we-do

About the Role

The focus of the position is to act as a disciplined lead and subject matter expert for telecom systems deployed and operated within International Operations.   The Senior Telecoms Engineer plays a key role within Woodside’s International Digital Field Services Team providing technical advice, guidance and strategic direction of the telecom’s portfolio.   The position plays an important role in the governance of risk and compliance of telecoms systems including assurance activities related to safety critical telecoms hardware

Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Leadership
•    Act as the discipline lead for telecom systems deployed throughout International Operations
•    Champion innovation and continuous improvement of telecom systems
•    Ensure consistent and fit for purpose delivery of telecom solutions in adherence to Woodside Engineering standards and industry best practice
•    Provide subject matter expert advice and guidance to the telecoms team as required
•    Maintain frameworks, standards and strategic roadmap for full lifecycle management of telecom systems including design and maintenance, in coordination with our Australia based telecoms team
•    Deliver telecom project scopes including the development of select engineering deliverables as needed.

HSE, Risk, Compliance 
•    Manage telecom systems risk and compliance in accordance with company framework
•    Pro-active participation in all aspects of health and safety with respect to delivery of telecom services
•    Provide oversight and ensure consistency and robustness in the management of safety critical telecom hardware controls
•    Provide technical support as required and commensurate with risk to telecom safety hardware control owners, including engagement in performance/regulatory standard updates, operational risk management reviews, and maintenance deferral decisions.
•    Participate in second line assurance activities of telecom critical controls.

Capital Projects  
The Telecoms Engineer will support (up to 50% allocation) International Oil & Gas and New Energy green and brownfield capital projects as Telecoms Lead with the following responsibilities:
•    Ensure delivery of telecom systems throughout the project in alignment with Basis of Design (BOD)
•    Act as the client representative for telecommunication systems with each contractor
•    Develop working relationships with project stakeholders, engineers and Digital function. 
•    Provide engineering input on contractor telecoms deliverables throughout the design cycle.
•    Manage telecoms technical interfaces and queries across project boundaries and ensure effective handover to operations.
•    Support procurement, FAT, IFAT, commissioning and handover to operations activities to include international and offshore travel as required.

Technical 
•    Responsible for providing customers with technical consultancy and quality support to manage risks and ensure business impact is considered
•    Responsible for handling, tracking, prioritizing escalations and actively participate in major Digital incident responses, resolving root cause where possible
•    Participating in the planning, management and delivery of IT minor enhancements, projects and technical roadmap activities
HSEQ
•    Responsible for work execution on site to ensure all work is completed to the conditions of the associated risks and work permits

Continuous Improvement & Delivery Excellence
•    Drive improvements in capital digital delivery practices, standards, and integration approaches 
•    Strengthen alignment between service Delivery and broader Digital functions 
•    Improve predictability, efficiency, and quality of Digital outcomes 

Skills and Experience

Within the Job Level band, expectations around skills, experience, capability and competency levels vary.
The Competency Framework should be referred to with regard to the levels of skills and experience required. The base expectations are below;

Qualifications 
•    Bachelor's degree in Telecommunication or Electrical Engineering or a related degree
•    8+ years’ experience in detailed engineering and design of telecom systems
•    Prefer at least 4 years in Oil & Gas industry

Experience 
•    Engineering experience in Oil & Gas operations or project delivery such as EPC environment
•    Demonstrated solid analytical problem-solving techniques
•    Has written technical specifications, reports and other documentation with clear written and oral communication skills.
•    Experience demonstrates self-starter, autonomous work capability while remaining a team player.

Skills & Competencies
•    Expert knowledge across telecom systems including; various analogue and digital radio technologies, satellite, microwave radio, ETV, CCTV, PAGA, LAN, WAN and wireless connectivity, video conferencing, navigation, security
•    Experienced in the installation, commissioning and operation of telecom systems
•    Proven ability to analyze, design, implement and optimize telecom systems

jobs.title: General Supervisor, Metallurgy
jobs.description:
WHAT DOES AGNICO EAGLE VALUE?

At Agnico Eagle, our values never waver. We believe in trust, respect, equity, family and responsibility. Why? Because they express who we are, and they have helped us succeed in business for over 60 years. We value
you
- your unique set of skills and experience. We value your willingness to build those skills and make a meaningful contribution to our company. And, we value your commitment to treat every person on our team with respect, helping us to operate safely, protect the environment and make a positive contribution to our local communities.

ABOUT OUR OPERATION

Canadian-based and led, Agnico Eagle is Canada's largest mining company and the second largest gold producer in the world. It produces precious metals from operations in Canada, Australia, Finland and Mexico and has a pipeline of high-quality exploration and development projects. Agnico Eagle is a partner of choice within the mining industry, recognized globally for its leading sustainability practices. Agnico Eagle was founded in 1957 and has consistently created value for its shareholders, declaring a cash dividend every year since 1983.

Want to learn more about our Hope Bay Project?
Click here
!

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE:

Reporting to the Superintendent, Process Plant, you will be part of the Process Plant Department. You will play a key role in preparing the metallurgy function as the project transitions from construction to commissioning, ramp-up, and full production. You will develop and action the Metallurgy Operational Readiness Plan, build the metallurgy team, and provide technical leadership to ensure the process plant is ready to operate safely, efficiently, and sustainably. You will ensure that the goals and objectives are achieved while promoting and respecting Agnico Eagle’s culture, Health & Safety Code of Conduct, and the environment.

Develop, coordinate, and execute the Metallurgy Operational Readiness Plan in alignment with the overall Process Plant readiness strategy;

Provide metallurgical input to Engineering, Construction, Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Laboratory, and Commissioning teams during design, construction, commissioning, and ramp-up;

Review process design information, metallurgical work, flowsheets, control philosophy, operating parameters, and commissioning plans to identify operational risks and improvement opportunities;

Build the metallurgy team structure and support the recruitment, onboarding, training, and development of metallurgy personnel;

Lead the metallurgy team through operational readiness, commissioning, ramp-up, and transition to steady-state production;

Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical teams in a dynamic operational environment;

Strong knowledge of gold processing circuits, including crushing, grinding, gravity concentration, flotation, leaching, adsorption/recovery, detoxification, tailings, water management, and refinery operations;

Experience developing metallurgical accounting systems, sampling programs, KPI dashboards, operating procedures, and performance reporting tools;

Strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to convert plant data into practical operational recommendations;

Experience with process control, plant automation, and operational improvement initiatives;

Strong planning, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with cross-functional teams;

Cultural awareness and understanding of work in the Canadian Arctic is considered an asset;

Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office software, especially Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Note that the official working language at Hope Bay is English.

Your Work Schedule

During the early project phase, the role may involve Monday-to-Friday remote or office-based work with regular site visits and as the project advances toward commissioning and ramp-up, the role will gradually transition to 21 days on / 21 days off, site-based rotation aligned with operational needs;

jobs.title: Corporate Risk Manager
jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION:
We are seeking a dynamic Corporate Risk Manager to lead and drive project risk management across our portfolio of mining projects and operational sites. This strategic role will embed robust governance frameworks, ensure alignment with corporate objectives, and actively engage with project teams to integrate risk practices that support safe and sustainable performance. They will be expected to spend time embedded within project teams on-site, particularly during the early phases of each project, to establish tailored risk processes, build relationships, and ensure risk practices are integrated as early as possible. The ideal candidate will work closely with project teams, executive leadership, and external stakeholders to embed a proactive risk culture and support strategic decision-making.

This contractor position will be embedded within a corporate organization that oversees large-scale mining capital projects (Billion $+). The position will directly report to the Director of Project Controls, and will directly support the Project Managers, Project Controls Managers, and the Project Risk Managers to drive integrated and proactive risk management on projects. The Corporate Risk Manager will be a key enabler of successful project delivery, ensuring risks are identified early, communicated clearly, and managed effectively across all phases of the project lifecycle-from early planning through to construction and handover.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Ensure that project risks are identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored in alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices
* Responsible for ensuring project specific Risk Management Plan and Register are executed per the Corporate Risk Procedures* Lead risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning for major capital and operational projects.
* Responsible to attend, drive and provide support for all risk events (risk reviews, risk workshops, risk assessments).* Ensure risk events (Risk kick off meetings, Risk Workshops, Risk Reviews) are establish and conducted on a clearly defined timeline.
* Monitor and report on key project risks, trends, and mitigation effectiveness to senior leadership. * Provide support and drive when necessary quantitative and qualitative risk assessments.
* Ensure the engagement of the project team to support a positive risk awareness culture.* Archive project risk registers to support lessons learned.

JOB SCOPE:

* Nature of work: Works on highly complex issues and responsible to implement solutions. Leads and directs the work of others. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. * Level of interaction: Leads the department with interaction with external piers in various departments, responsible for cross coordination between groups.
* Autonomy/decision making: Works under very limited to no supervision and has latitude to set objectives, priorities, and timelines. * Budgetary responsibility: Has no budgetary responsibility.
* Managerial responsibility: no managerial responsibility.

REQUIREMENTS:
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business or related fields and twelve (12) years' experience in Project Management, at least ten (10) years of experience in a leadership role in project controls OR
* High School diploma or GED and fifteen (15) years' experience in engineering, construction, project controls or business-related field with at least ten (10) years of experience in a leadership role in project controls * Highly engaging, confident, and persuasive communicator.
* Analytical and strategic thinker with strong business acumen.* Able to work across organizational boundaries and influence at all levels.
* Action-oriented with a hands-on approach to solving problems.* High integrity, with sound judgment and a strong ethical foundation.
* Leadership ability and strong management skills.* Proven experience implementing Risk management across multiple large-scale capital projects and operational assets.
* Strong knowledge of industrial project lifecycles and associated risks (technical, operational, environmental, geopolitical).* Strong communication skills both verbal and written.
* Strong analytical skills. * Ability to multi-task in a high paced project environment.
* Experience with Enablon software tool.* Experience with cost control including project estimating, forecasting and cost management including reporting.
* Experience with heavy industrial capital projects.* Certification in risk management (e.g., IRM, CRM, PMI-RMP) is advantageous.

jobs.description:
The Company

Our client is a leading company in the mining sector. Globe 24-7 Inc. has been selected as its strategic recruitment and selection partner to lead the search for a
Senior Mine Engineer.

La posición

Our client  mission is to acquire, build, operate and explore for sustainable precious metal mining operations using our proven self-perform approach, while focusing on the health and safety of our employees and host communities.
Job SummaryReporting to the Engineering Superintendent, the Senior Mine Engineer will be responsible for providing technical leadership and hands-on engineering support to both open-pit and underground mining operations. This role plays a critical part in mine planning, design, scheduling, and operational optimization from early start-up through ramp-up and steady-state operations.
The Senior Mine Engineer will act as the cross-shift counterpart to the Engineering Superintendent, ensuring continuity of engineering leadership and decision-making during the Superintendent s absences. This position requires strong technical expertise in both open-pit and underground mining, as well as the ability to operate autonomously on site.

Key Responsibilities

Mine Planning & Engineering

Conduct pit optimization for open-pit operations and stope optimization for underground mining to define economically optimal mining limits.

Estimate mineral resources, determine cut-off grades, and support mineral reserve calculations through technical analysis and economic evaluation.

Prepare detailed mine designs including pit phases, stope layouts, development plans, and production schedules.

Develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-term mine plans aligned with production targets, cost objectives, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.

Contribute to annual mine planning, budgeting, and production forecasting.

Support the design and optimization of underground infrastructure including ramps, ventilation networks, dewatering systems, and material handling systems.

Evaluate and update mining fleet requirements and equipment replacement plans to support operational efficiency.

Operational Support & Optimization

Provide direct engineering support to site operations during commissioning, ramp-up, and steady-state production.

Collaborate with geology, mining operations, and processing teams to optimize mine design and sequencing.

Identify and implement opportunities to improve mine planning practices, sequencing, and operational efficiency.

Support the integration of new technologies, digital tools, and automation solutions within engineering processes.

Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and consultants to ensure quality and timely execution of engineering work.

Leadership & Team Development

Support the Engineering Superintendent in leading the Mine Engineering team and delivering engineering objectives.

Contribute to engineering strategy development and provide technical recommendations to the Mine Manager.

Assist in the recruitment, development, and mentoring of engineering personnel.

Communicate work objectives, priorities, and performance expectations to support production targets.

Participate in performance reviews and provide technical feedback and coaching to engineering staff.

Provide engineering leadership and decision-making support when acting on behalf of the Engineering Superintendent.

Compliance, Safety & Sustainability

Ensure engineering activities comply with company standards, Guyanese regulations, and industry best practices.

Promote and support health, safety, and environmental best practices across all engineering activities.

Identify, report, and address unsafe conditions and behaviors in accordance with company procedures.

Provide visible safety leadership to engineering teams, contractors, and site personnel to support a zero-harm culture.

Support environmental management initiatives and ensure compliance with permitting requirements.

Requirements 
Experience

Experience supporting greenfield mining project development and operational ramp-up is highly desirable.

Strong project coordination and leadership skills within multidisciplinary teams.

Proficiency in mining software such as Deswik, GEOVIA Whittle, Datamine, Hexagon (MinePlan/MineSight), Surpac, or Civil 3D.

Experience with underground mine infrastructure including ventilation, dewatering, and power distribution systems.

Knowledge of applicable mining regulations and operational standards.

Demonstrated ability to work autonomously in a site-based environment while supporting management and operational teams.

Education / Certification / Designation

Bachelor s degree in Mining Engineering (Master s degree considered an asset).

8–12 years of mining operation and engineering experience.

Required Behavioural Skills

Strategic Thinking & Global Focus: Understands long-term objectives and aligns engineering strategies accordingly.

Stakeholder Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external partners.

Personal Leadership & Accountability: Demonstrates integrity, initiative, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Team Development & Culture Building: Invests in team growth through coaching, engagement, and development initiatives.

Operational Excellence: Drives efficiency and innovation through structured execution and accountability.

Working Conditions the Senior Mine Engineer position will be a rotation-based role, offering flexibility in scheduling to accommodate the successful candidate s location and personal preferences.

Compensation

The Company will provide an attractive compensation and benefits package.

Contact Us

Please send your CV, preferably as a Microsoft Word document.

jobs.description:
Mais do que uma responsabilidade, Segurança é nosso valor. Junte-se a nós nesse compromisso!

Segura. Inteligente. Sustentável. Provavelmente, estas não são as primeiras palavras que você normalmente associa à mineração. Mas a Anglo American não é uma empresa de mineração comum.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos.

Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito.

Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Você será responsável por conduzir ações de engajamento, com vizinhos e representantes do poder público municipal (Executivo e Legislativo), ONGs, associações escolas, dentre outros.

jobs.title: Analista Operação Armazém Júnior
jobs.description:
Mais do que uma responsabilidade, Segurança é nosso valor. Junte-se a nós nesse compromisso!

Segura. Inteligente. Sustentável. Provavelmente, estas não são as primeiras palavras que você normalmente associa à mineração. Mas a Anglo American não é uma empresa de mineração comum.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos.

Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito.

Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Você como Analista Operação Armazém Júnior, será responsável por realizar o acompanhamento de estoques, controle de movimentações de materiais, notas fiscais e transportes. Também atuará na análise de indicadores, elaboração de relatórios e suporte aos processos operacionais, garantindo eficiência, conformidade e segurança nas operações.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Realizar o lançamento, conferência e controle de Notas Fiscais de entrada e saída de materiais, garantindo conformidade fiscal e operacional.

Efetuar o cadastro e processamento de Conhecimentos de Transporte (CT-e), assegurando a rastreabilidade das movimentações logísticas.

Administrar e controlar a balança rodoviária de cargas, realizando pesagens de entrada e saída, validação de documentos e emissão de relatórios operacionais.

Monitorar e controlar o fluxo operacional de carvão mineral, acompanhando recebimento, armazenagem, movimentação interna e expedição.

Elaborar, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à operação de armazenagem, estoques, transporte e produtividade.

Realizar registros e movimentações sistêmicas de materiais por meio do SAP, garantindo a integridade das informações.

Apoiar o controle de estoques por meio de inventários rotativos e periódicos, identificando divergências e propondo ações corretivas.

Elaborar relatórios operacionais e gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Acompanhar a programação logística de recebimento e expedição de cargas.

Interagir com transportadoras, fornecedores e áreas internas para assegurar a fluidez dos processos logísticos.

Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos de Segurança, Qualidade e Meio Ambiente.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos de armazenagem e movimentação de materiais.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas

Conhecimento e experiência em SAP

Conhecimento avançado do Pacote Office, com domínio de Excel para elaboração de planilhas, controles operacionais, análise de dados, indicadores, tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos e relatórios gerenciais

Experiência com lançamento de Notas Fiscais e Conhecimentos de Transporte (CT-e)

Experiência em operações de balança rodoviária e controle de movimentação de cargas

Conhecimento em gestão de indicadores operacionais e controle de desempenho logístico

Conhecimento em processos de armazenagem, recebimento, expedição e controle de estoques

Experiências Desejáveis

Vivência em operações de mineração, siderurgia

Experiência com gestão do fluxo de carvão mineral

Experiência na realização de inventários físicos e reconciliação de estoques

Conhecimento em Power BI para acompanhamento e apresentação de indicadores

Familiaridade com ferramentas de melhoria contínua (Lean, Kaizen, 5S e PDCA)

Conhecimento em legislações e documentação aplicáveis ao transporte e movimentação de cargas

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura.

jobs.title: Asesor(a) de Planificación Comercial - Temporal
jobs.description:
Anglo American, en sociedad con la Corporación Mitsubishi, está desarrollando la operación minera Quellaveco, uno de los yacimientos de cobre más grandes del mundo, localizado en la región de Moquegua, al sur del Perú.

Quellaveco tendrá una vida de reservas de 30 años. Utilizará proceso minero de tajo abierto y flotación para producir concentrados de cobre, así como molibdeno y plata como subproductos. Se espera que Quellaveco produzca en promedio 300 mil toneladas de cobre por año en sus primeros 10 años de operación.

En Anglo American nuestra estrategia es asegurar y desarrollar Quellaveco aplicando prácticas y tecnologías innovadoras que confiamos a nuestra gente. Estamos comprometidos a convertirnos en socios para el futuro, operar con seguridad, sustentabilidad y responsabilidad.

En Anglo American nos encontramos en búsqueda de un(a)
Asesor de Planificación Comercial
para nuestro equipo de
Supply Chain.

Tendrá la responsabilidad de Desarrollar y gestionar el proceso de planificación comercial de la cadena de abastecimiento, alineando la demanda operativa, los presupuestos, y las estrategias de contratación y compras, con el fin de apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas con análisis y proyecciones confiables y ser el ancla estratégica entre Supply Chain y el equipo de Finanzas.

Funciones principales

Liderar el proceso de planificación comercial anual y metas de ahorro, coordinando la recopilación, validación y consolidación de requerimientos de bienes, servicios y contratos de todas las áreas usuarias (mina, planta, mantenimiento, etc.).

Integrar la planificación de compras y contratos con el ciclo presupuestal (Opex/Capex).

Facilitar el modelamiento de escenarios de gasto y consumo. Desarrollar modelos de proyección de gasto mensual, trimestral y anual basados en tendencias históricas, contratos vigentes, consumo estimado y planes operativos.

Monitorear el cumplimiento de la planificación frente a la ejecución real (requerimientos vs. compras vs. contratos vs. consumo).

Gestionar el portafolio de requerimientos y su alineación con el presupuesto y las metas de ahorro

Identificar desvíos y proponer acciones correctivas o ajustes contractuales y/o presupuestales.

Consolidar información y reportes ejecutivos. Elaborar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para la gerencia de Supply Chain, Finanzas y otras áreas de dirección.

Asegurar trazabilidad y consistencia de la información comercial del área.

Apoyar procesos de toma de decisiones estratégicas brindando análisis cuantitativo y cualitativo

Participar en la preparación de presentaciones para directorio, auditorías o comités ejecutivos.

Funciones y responsabilidades SHE

Conocer y aplicar los valores, principios y la Política SHE de Anglo American Quellaveco y contribuir a su visión de cero daños

Asegurar que las medidas de control para los peligros y riesgos de SHE, relacionadas con las actividades a desempeñar, se encuentren implementadas en el lugar de trabajo, para el desarrollo de una labor segura.

Cumplir los estándares, procedimientos y reglamentos internos del Sistema de Gestión; así como participar activamente en las reuniones de capacitación, concientización y formación de la cultura de Cero Daños.

Reportar oportunamente los actos y condiciones inseguras; así como los Incidentes.

Formación académica e idioma

Bachiller o titulado(a) en Administración de empresas, Ingenierías, Finanzas, Economía o afines.

Indispensable inglés a nivel intermedio o avanzado (capaz de sostener conversaciones).

Trayectoria laboral

Al menos 5 años de experiencia laboral en gestión y planificación de demanda (cadena de abastecimiento) en sectores retail, banca, consumo masivo, minería, hidrocarburos, energía o afines.

Competencias SHE

Conocimiento y experiencia en la Gestión de la Seguridad, Salud y Medio Ambiente, considerando la normativa legal vigente aplicable al sector minero.

Conocimiento y experiencia en investigación de incidentes.

Conocimiento y experiencia para identificar peligros y riesgos de SHE y proponer controles efectivos

Sobre el rol

Contrato: Temporal por reemplazo de periodo de maternidad (diciembre 2026 a julio 2027)

Reporta a: Gerente de Desempeño de Cadena de Abastecimiento

Sistema: 5x2 híbrido (2 días presencial y 3 remoto)

Ubicación: San Isidro - Lima

Cierre de convocatoria

Domingo 13 de septiembre

Siguientes pasos

De continuar a la siguiente etapa, recibirá un correo por parte de nosotros invitándolo a completar su primera evaluación en nuestra plataforma HireVue y un formulario de datos en Ms Forms. Agradeceremos estar muy atento a su bandeja de entrada o de correo no deseados, a fin de continuar con cada una de las etapas de nuestro proceso dentro de los tiempos establecidos.

¡Contamos contigo para cumplir nuestro propósito: Re-imaginar la minería para mejorar la vida de las personas!

jobs.title: Financial Trader (Shipping)
jobs.description:
Anglo American's Shipping Division is the Group's exclusive 'in-house' ocean freight service provider, offering a comprehensive range of shipping services to our business units around the world. Using global scale and strength, we aim to optimise our marine activities and provide safe, reliable, compliant and competitive freight to our commodity businesses and their customers in today's dynamic marketplace.

The Shipping Financial Trading team plays a crucial role in maximizing the value of the shipping business through optimizing price risk management strategies of our trading and equity sales tonnage, executing trading strategies based on market dynamics and providing advisory to counterparties on price structured solutions.

Purpose

The Shipping Financial Trader is responsible for maximising the value of Anglo American’s Shipping portfolio through disciplined freight risk management, proprietary FFA trading, rigorous market analysis and effective execution of freight derivatives, with a primary focus on supporting the hedging requirements of the physical Shipping business.

Success in the position requires strong commercial judgement, analytical rigour, decisive execution and disciplined risk management. The role will form independent market views, challenge assumptions constructively, identify mispricing across freight routes and the forward curve, and respond confidently as market conditions change. This requires a thorough understanding of the financial characteristics of FFAs, macroeconomic drivers and the underlying physical freight market.

Working closely with the physical Shipping team and other commercial stakeholders, the trader will support the identification and management of freight risk, translate physical exposures into effective hedging strategies, and help enable commercially competitive physical decisions. Within approved mandates, the trader will take ownership of trading decisions, maintain high standards of governance and controls, and communicate market views, risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders. Through close integration with the physical Shipping business, the trader will contribute to stronger risk-adjusted outcomes and sustainable value creation.

Key responsibilities include

Performance & Delivery

Market Analysis and Trading Strategy

Provide thought leadership in freight market developments and trading strategies.

Develop comprehensive and forward-looking view of the dry-bulk freight market by analysing vessel supply, cargo demand, fleet utilisation, congestion, weather, seasonality, commodity flows, physical fixtures, forward curves and broader macroeconomic developments.

Interpret movements across key freight routes, vessel classes and contract periods, distinguishing short-term market noise from sustained changes in freight-market fundamentals.

Analyse the relationship between physical freight markets and FFA pricing, including spot-to-forward dynamics, route spreads, time spreads, basis relationships, liquidity conditions and market positioning.

Translate market analysis into clear, actionable trading and hedging recommendations with defined rationale, timing, risk parameters and expected outcomes.

Identify relative-value and outright opportunities across freight routes, calendar periods and related markets, while assessing liquidity, carry, roll dynamics and basis risk.

Maintain awareness of competitor behaviour, counterparty activity and structural developments in freight and commodity markets to identify emerging risks and opportunities.

Communicate market views and trading recommendations clearly, confidently and concisely to the Financial Trading team, physical Shipping teams and relevant stakeholders.

Price Risk Management

Work closely with physical Shipping team and commercial stakeholders to understand the Shipping portfolio’s current and anticipated freight exposure.

Develop appropriate hedging strategies for physical freight exposures, taking account of route, vessel class, timing, volume, index exposure, liquidity, hedge effectiveness and residual basis risk.

Recommend the appropriate combination of FFA contracts, structures and execution periods to manage freight-price risk efficiently within the approved risk-management framework.

Evaluate the trade-off between risk reduction, hedge cost, liquidity and potential opportunity cost when recommending or executing hedging strategies.

Support the physical Chartering desk in evaluating freight economics and developing innovative, competitive and value-maximising commercial offers.

Trade Execution and Position Management

Execute FFA and other approved freight-related derivative transactions through exchanges, clearing platforms, banks and OTC counterparties in accordance with delegated authorities, approved mandates and company policies.

Demonstrate strong execution judgement by assessing liquidity, market depth, bid-offer dynamics, timing, information leakage, counterparty selection and transaction cost.

Manage orders and positions actively, maintaining awareness of market conditions and adjusting execution strategy to achieve the intended commercial or risk-management outcome.

Monitor outright positions, route spreads, time spreads, option exposures where applicable, hedge ratios and concentration risks against approved limits.

Maintain a clear understanding of the risk and reward of each position, including the underlying market thesis, key sensitivities, downside scenarios and conditions that would invalidate the original view.

Respond decisively to changing market conditions while avoiding reactive or undisciplined trading.

Maintain accurate and timely records of trading rationale, transactions, exposures and relevant approvals.

Build and maintain effective relationships with brokers, banks, clearing members, exchanges and trading counterparties to support reliable market access, strong price discovery and efficient execution.

jobs.description:
The
Processing

Development Programme
in Processing for Kolomela mine is open for applications. Candidates that meet the minimum requirements and are interested in partaking in the programme are encouraged to apply.

Be part of the team.

The team that makes it happen.

Guided by our purpose and our values, we enable both high performance and purposeful action as we aim to “re-imagine mining to improve people’s lives", delivering the metals and minerals that make modern life possible.

Kumba Iron Ore

We produce high-grade iron ore, the key component in steel widely used in construction and manufacturing across the world. Our activities include all aspects – exploration; mining; processing and blending; shipping; marketing and selling. In South Africa, we have mining operations in the Northern Cape province, as well as a head office in Gauteng, and a port operation in Saldanha Bay, Western Cape.

This opportunity will allow you to acquire practical experience in your chosen field of study and maximize your contribution to our business as part of your on-going development. This is a full-time programme and the duration is approximately 3 years. This programme will afford you an opportunity to acquire the necessary skills to drive your career.

Grade 12/N3 or equivalent (with Mathematics / Mathematics Literacy)

Valid South African Driver’s License.

Proof of residential address

Medical and Physical Fitness (RFA)

LPCAT assessment

Applicants to be aged between 18-35 years

Currently unemployed and not studying

Who We Are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity and showing care and respect for people and the planet, that means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies.

What We Offer

When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too. We’re a large, successful multinational company – and we’re still growing all the time.

Inclusion and Diversity

Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

How to apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

jobs.title: Coordenadora Comunidades Tradicionais | Vaga Exclusiva para mulheres
jobs.description:
A Anglo American é uma empresa global de mineração com sede em Londres, presente em diversos países e com uma história de mais de 100 anos, com o propósito de reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Na América Latina, nossas operações desempenham um papel estratégico no fornecimento responsável de recursos essenciais para o desenvolvimento do mundo – com atuação no Brasil, Chile e Peru, sempre pautadas por inovação, segurança, sustentabilidade e alto desempenho.

No Brasil, operamos o sistema Minas-Rio, que integra mina, usina, mineroduto e porto. As operações do Peru e do Chile se concentram na produção de cobre em larga escala, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma transição energética sustentável.

Acreditamos que nossas pessoas são o maior diferencial competitivo. Investimos no desenvolvimento de talentos, promovendo ambientes inclusivos e colaborativos, onde diferentes perspectivas constroem soluções melhores para os desafios do presente e do futuro.

Na Anglo American, valorizamos quem deseja crescer com propósito e gerar impacto real.

Você será responsável por coordenar o relacionamento com as comunidades tradicionais localizadas nas áreas de influência direta do empreendimento e novos projetos, promovendo o diálogo transparente e contínuo, a construção de relações de confiança, a gestão de impactos sociais e o cumprimento de compromissos e condicionantes socioambientais. Atuar de forma estratégica para assegurar o respeito aos direitos, à cultura, aos modos de vida e aos protocolos comunitários, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento sustentável dos territórios e para a manutenção da licença social para operar.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Coordenar o relacionamento institucional com comunidades tradicionais localizadas naáreas de influência direta do empreendimento e novos projetos, assegurando uma atuação pautada pelo respeito, transparência e confiança mútua.

Liderar a implementação de programas, projetos e iniciativas voltados ao fortalecimento das comunidades tradicionais e ao desenvolvimento sustentável dos territórios.

Garantir a conformidade com a legislação aplicável, compromissos socioambientais, condicionantes de licenciamento e padrões corporativos relacionados aos direitos de povos e comunidades tradicionais.

Coordenar contratos inerentes aos processos de consulta, escuta ativa e diálogo comunitário, promovendo a participação efetiva das comunidades nas decisões que possam impactá-las.

Identificar, avaliar e gerenciar riscos sociais associados às operações da empresa, propondo medidas preventivas e mitigadoras.

Atuar na prevenção, mediação e resolução de conflitos entre a empresa e as comunidades, buscando soluções sustentáveis e consensuais.

Gerenciar indicadores, planos de ação e orçamento relacionados às iniciativas de relacionamento comunitário e investimento social.

Estabelecer e fortalecer parcerias com órgãos governamentais, instituições de ensino, organizações da sociedade civil, lideranças comunitárias e demais partes interessadas.

Assegurar a incorporação das melhores práticas nacionais e internacionais relacionadas a direitos humanos, diversidade cultural e desenvolvimento territorial.

Liderar e desenvolver a equipe sob sua responsabilidade, promovendo ambiente colaborativo, inclusivo e orientado a resultados.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Superior em Ciências Sociais, Antropologia, Sociologia, Serviço Social, Ciências Ambientais, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-graduação em Gestão Socioambiental, Sustentabilidade, Direitos Humanos, Desenvolvimento Territorial ou áreas afins.

We are constructing a state-of-the-art underground mine to enable the extraction of Polyhalite – a unique multi-nutrient fertiliser – along with the necessary infrastructure both above and below ground that will be required for transport, processing, and distribution.

POLY4 is our flagship multi-nutrient fertiliser product. Made from Polyhalite, it contains four of the six macro-nutrients that are essential to plant growth. It allows farmers to maximise their crop yield, increase quality and improve soil structure with one simple product.

jobs.title: Longwall Mechanical Production Fitter
jobs.description:
Anglo American Australia
operates five steelmaking coal mines in Queensland’s Bowen Basin, and have additional joint venture interests in manganese, as well as copper exploration projects under way in North West Queensland. Steelmaking coal is an essential ingredient in blast-furnace steel manufacture, producing steel used for critical building and infrastructure around the world.

We are seeking an experienced Longwall Mechanical Production Fitter to join our underground production team at Moranbah North Mine.

This is a hands on role in maintaining and supporting critical longwall equipment to keep the operation running safely, reliably, and efficiently. You will work alongside production, electrical, and maintenance personnel to identify mechanical issues, complete planned maintenance, and respond to equipment breakdowns.

About the role

Reporting to the Longwall Mechanical Supervisor, your responsibilities will include:

Performing planned, preventative and breakdown maintenance on longwall equipment

Inspecting, maintaining and repairing shearers, AFCs, BSLs and powered roof supports

Maintaining and fault-finding hydraulic and mechanical systems

Diagnosing equipment faults and completing practical repairs to minimise production delays

Supporting longwall production and equipment availability

Completing equipment inspections and identifying emerging defects

Assisting with component changeouts, installations and longwall moves when required

Following isolation, stored-energy and underground risk-control requirements

Completing work orders and maintenance records accurately

Working closely with operators, electricians and other trades

Maintaining high standards of housekeeping and equipment care

Contributing to a positive, respectful and safety focused crew

The longwall is the mine’s primary production area, with equipment availability, operating capability and effective management of delays directly affecting coal production

About you

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

Australian recognised Mechanical Trade Qualification

Experience working in an underground coal mine

Previous longwall mechanical maintenance experience

Experience with shearers, AFCs, BSLs, roof supports and hydraulic systems

Strong mechanical fault-finding and troubleshooting skills

Experience completing planned and breakdown maintenance

A sound understanding of isolation and stored-energy controls

Strong safety awareness and hazard-identification skills

The ability to work effectively within a production-focused team

Clear communication and a practical approach to problem-solving

Current underground competencies and qualifications required for the position

A current Australian driver’s licence

Longwall equipment includes the shearer, AFC and powered roof supports, with mechanical work involving commissioning, installation, maintenance and equipment inspections.

If you are an experienced underground Mechanical Fitter who enjoys working on production equipment, solving mechanical problems and being part of a high-performing longwall crew, we would like to hear from you.

What we offer

Permanent employment opportunity

7 on 7 off day night roster

Competitive remuneration and site benefits

Camp accommodation and meals

Ongoing technical training and development

Exposure to specialised underground longwall equipment

A supportive and experienced production team

Career development within underground mining operations

Who we are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. Anglo American is a leading global mining company focused on the responsible production of copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients – future-enabling products that are essential for decarbonising the global economy, improving living standards, and food security. Our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively to unlock enduring value from precious natural resources for our shareholders, for the benefit of the communities and countries in which we operate, and for society as a whole. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives.

Background checks

Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening which may include a criminal check and validation of qualifications.

Inclusion and Diversity

Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

How we are committed to your safety

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

How to apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

13 September 2026

Please note, screening and interviews may take place prior to closing date applications may also close before this date.

jobs.description:
Somos 
Minsur 
tercer productor de estaño a nivel mundial y el mayor proveedor de este mineral en el hemisferio occidental. Trabajamos bajo una visión de clase mundial, siendo referentes a nivel nacional e internacional en la aplicación de los lineamientos más importantes en términos de seguridad, eficiencia operacional, responsabilidad socioambiental y desarrollo de talento. Formamos parte de Breca, uno de los grupos empresariales más sólidos e importantes del Perú y somos la primera empresa minera peruana en ingresar al ICMM (Consejo Internacional de Minería y Metales). Como parte de nuestro plan de crecimiento nos encontramos en búsqueda del mejor talento para ocupar la posición: Practicante de Comunicaciones Externas

II. OBJETIVO DE LA POSICION

Brindar soporte en la ejecución de las actividades del área de Comunicaciones, con especial énfasis en el frente de comunicación social, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de la estrategia de comunicación externa de las unidades operativas y proyectos de exploración.

III. RESPONSABILIDADES Y FUNCIONES

Apoyar en la implementación y seguimiento de los planes de comunicación de las unidades mineras y proyectos de exploración, contribuyendo al desarrollo de acciones dirigidas a sus públicos y grupos de interés.

Elaborar y adaptar mensajes, contenidos y materiales de comunicación, incluyendo notas, presentaciones, piezas gráficas y contenidos para canales digitales, de acuerdo con los objetivos de comunicación, las necesidades de las unidades y los lineamientos corporativos.

Sistematizar y analizar información relacionada con las actividades de comunicación, elaborando y actualizando matrices, bases de información y reportes que faciliten el seguimiento de acciones, hitos, compromisos y resultados.

Apoyar en la preparación y coordinación de actividades de comunicación y relacionamiento con grupos de interés, considerando las características y necesidades de los públicos involucrados.

Brindar soporte operativo y administrativo para la ejecución y seguimiento de las acciones de comunicación, coordinando requerimientos, materiales, proveedores y entregables.

VIII. EXPERIENCIA, EXIGENCIAS Y REQUERIMIENTOS

Deseable experiencia en prácticas, voluntariados, proyectos universitarios o iniciativas vinculadas a comunicación social, comunitaria, institucional o estratégica

FORMACIÓN REQUERIDA

Egresado/a de las carreras de Comunicación, Comunicación Social, Comunicación para el Desarrollo o afines.

CONOCIMIENTOS

Conocimientos básicos de comunicación social y comunicación estratégica.

Buena redacción y capacidad de síntesis.

Manejo de Microsoft Office (Deseable)

Manejo básico de herramientas digitales y canales de comunicación.

Manejo de Illustrator (Deseable)

Conocimientos básicos en la elaboración de presentaciones y materiales de comunicación.

Proactividad e iniciativa.

Organización y capacidad de seguimiento.

Disposición para el trabajo colaborativo.

Capacidad para adaptarse a diferentes contextos y públicos.

jobs.description:
Ingeniero/a Senior de Confiabilidad
 - 
División El Salvador

¿Quieres ser parte del desarrollo sostenible de Chile y el mundo?

¡Únete a la empresa más importante del país y construyamos juntos(as) la minería del futuro!

Nuestra estrategia de negocio es maximizar de forma competitiva y sustentable el valor económico de Codelco y su aporte al Estado de Chile. Si compartes nuestro propósito, te invitamos a participar del concurso

Ingeniero/a Senior de Confiabilidad

 de la Gerencia Mantenimiento Plantas, para impulsar juntos(as) la transformación y sostenibilidad de nuestra Corporación.

Buscamos a personas comprometidas(os) con el progreso del país, líderes que desafíen el status quo, que muestren su mejor versión e impulsen el trabajo colaborativo para enfrentar el futuro de la compañía.

Diversidad e Inclusión

En Codelco estamos llamados a ser líderes en diversidad e inclusión por nuestro rol social y productivo para el país. En términos de equidad de género aspiramos alcanzar 35% de representación femenina al 2027 y generar igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas, porque tenemos convicción en el valor de los equipos diversos (esta oferta se enmarca en la ley 21.015 que incentiva la inclusión de personas con discapacidad). 

¡Te invitamos a ser parte del mejor lugar para desarrollar tus talentos!

Propósito del Cargo:  

Liderar y asegurar el cumplimiento, el proceso de mejora continua de la estrategia de mantenimiento y la confiabilidad de la planta de chancado primario, secundario y terciario, el rol desenvuelve todos los equipos y disciplinas comprendidas en estas plantas, tales como, mecánicas, eléctricas, hidráulica y lubricación, instrumentación. Debe contar con experiencia suficiente para liderar las instancias del ciclo de mantenimiento rol confiabilidad y de la misma forma llevar el control y la mejora de los planes predictivos y preventivos de acuerdo con lo establecido por el SOMA y sus mejores prácticas para asegurar el cumplimiento de metas y objetivos de continuidad operacional establecido, ocupándose de cumplir y hacer cumplir las políticas, normas y procedimientos establecidos en la División y en la Corporación, relacionados con seguridad, salud ocupacional, medio ambiente y diversidad e inclusión.

Funciones Principales:

Generar reportes técnicos y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Proveer información clave para la planificación y gestión de activos.

Coordinar con equipos multidisciplinarios para la ejecución de mejoras y mantenimiento.

Desarrollar y optimizar planes de mantenimiento basados en confiabilidad (RCM, mantenimiento predictivo y preventivo). Asegurando estrategias de mantenimiento efectivas que reduzcan detenciones no programadas y costos de mantenimiento.

Liderar análisis de fallas (RCA, ACR, metodologías de confiabilidad) y determinar causas raíz de fallas recurrentes y establecer planes de acción que eviten su repetición.

Implementar, promover nuevas tecnologías y liderar proyectos de mejora incrementando la detección temprana de fallas para fortalecer el mantenimiento predictivo y optimizar la gestión de activos

Coordinar con operaciones, mantenimiento y contratos externos la implementación de mejoras y estrategias de mantenimiento, asegurando ejecución efectiva de las acciones de confiabilidad en terreno.

¡Porque aquí el despliegue de tus talentos se pondrá al servicio De Chile!

Requisitos de Postulación:

Debe contar con Título Profesional en las carreras de Ingeniería Civil en las especialidades: mecánico, eléctrico, electrónico, industrial o especialidad afín al cargo.

Debe contar con al menos 6 años de experiencia profesional en áreas de mantenimiento, confiabilidad o gestión de activos en la industria minera y/o industrial.

Debe contar con al menos 5 años de experiencia comprobada en equipos del sistema de chancado y manejo de materiales, tales como:  Chancadores (primario, secundario o terciario), Correas transportadoras, Harneros, Alimentadores, Sistemas de lubricación, Poleas, motores y reductores

Debe contar con salud compatible para el cargo. 

Aspectos Deseables:

Contar con Post título Confiabilidad y gestión de activos.

Contar con experiencia en la gestión y administración de contratos.

Contar con Licencia de conducir clase B vigente.

Contar con manejo de SAP PM.

Contar con experiencia en RCM.

Contar con experiencia en Análisis de causa raíz.

jobs.title: Material Handling Systems Belt Runner/Operator (MHS) (Underground) - Carrapateena - FIFO
jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

Come and be a part of this success.

Our Operations - Carrapateena

Located 472 kilometres north-west of Adelaide, South Australia, Carrapateena is part of our Minerals Australia operations, within the Copper South Australia province. The mine is located on the traditional land of the Kokatha people. Carrapateena produces copper concentrate and is one of the largest mining projects in South Australia in the last decade. 

Please note this position is based at Carrapateena, operating on an 8/6, 7/7 day/night roster pattern arrangement with FIFO from Adelaide OR Port Augusta.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the Underground Material Handling System (MHS) Supervisor, the Belt runner/Operator is a key role in ensuring that the operational tasks associated with the MHS system are carried out safely and effectively to support Carrapateena in achieving their production targets.  The MHS system consists of conveyors, transfer chutes and feeders which are located underground and on the surface.  The role also focuses heavily on housekeeping standards in these areas and basic conveyor belt inspections and maintenance

In this role you will:-

Integrate with Maintenance counterparts to ensure effective, pro-actively planned maintenance to minimise unplanned downtime

Ensure daily operational tasks are completed and job history recorded in SAP.

monitor conveyor belt and transfer chutes operations, identifying issues and escalating to maintenance team in timely manner

Maintain high housekeeping standards for all the equipment

Assist where required in the permit to work system, including helping to update and build documents relating to specific tasks.

Provide continual feedback to the Shift Maintenance Supervisors on job progress

Working in dusty, high-temperature, and confined underground environments while strictly adhering to rigorous safety protocols for high-voltage and heavy rotating machinery.

Checking idlers, rollers, and belt structural integrity, as well as coordinating with mechanical fitters or specialized belt splicers when structural failures or belt trips occur. 

ABOUT YOU

Our successful candidate: --

Experience performing routine inspections and maintenance reporting

Exposure to working at heights and confined spaces

Proven experience working around conveyors systems.

Proven commitment to look after your own wellbeing and the confidence to speak up when others put themselves in harm's way

Hold extensive experience driving a manual vehicle.

Self-motivated, driven and focused on achieving high-performance targets whilst always prioritizing safety first

I.T, Bobcat, riggers, dogging, and excavator advantageous, but not essential

Ability to communicate across multiple levels and disciplines

Whilst not essential, experience working with SAP would be of advantage

Diversity & Inclusion

Carrapateena thrives on a diverse workforce, providing an energetic & inclusive team of individuals of varying backgrounds

BENEFITS

BHP offers an array of attractive perks to our employees, not limited to, attractive allowances, annual bonus, shares program, employee recognition program, heavily discounted corporate offers and so much more. To hear more about the benefits we offer our employees, please take a moment to play Why choose BHP for your career? 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W541c1oeLmE

APPLICATIONS CLOSE: Monday 21 September at Midnight SA Time.

About Our Process

At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants’ suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks. 

 If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal. 

Supporting a Diverse Workforce  

The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance-based bonuses and a best-in-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms.  

At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity employer that is committed to making BHP a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and be at their best every day. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and recognise that true diversity includes gender, age, race, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, education levels, and many more aspects of your identity.

BHP is committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible for all. If you have a disability, we know that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. If you would like to reach out to someone about your situation and our recruitment process, please email us at 

inclusion@bh

jobs.title: Rail Grinding Supervisor | WAIO | Port Hedland | FIFO
jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. 

With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities.  Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success. 

Come and be a part of this success.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and safety-focused 
Rail Grinding Supervisor
to join the Rail Network Maintenance team at WAIO. Reporting to the Asset Integrity Superintendent, you will lead the safe and effective execution of rail grinding activities while supporting the reliability and integrity of BHP's rail network.

This leadership role is offered on an 8 days on / 6 days off, 7 nights on / 7 days off roster and will be FIFO from Perth.

As
Rail Grinding Supervisor,
you will provide frontline leadership to operational and contractor teams, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with regulatory and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Demonstrate and promote a strong commitment to health, safety, environment, and operational excellence.

Lead, coach, and develop team members to support their wellbeing, performance, and professional growth.

Foster an inclusive, diverse, and high-performing team culture.

Set a positive leadership example through effective risk management, problem solving, decision making, and delivery of results.

Fulfil the responsibilities of a BHP Responsible Person, ensuring compliance with rail safety legislation, site requirements, and relevant BHP procedures.

Lead and coach teams in the application of BHP Operating System (BOS) principles and practices.

Identify, support, and implement continuous improvement opportunities across maintenance activities.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across operational and maintenance teams.

Execute weekly maintenance plans and drive schedule compliance to achieve daily work execution targets.

Review and optimise weekly work schedules to meet work management standards and operational requirements.

Support the strategic objectives of the Asset Integrity function.

Champion field leadership activities and actively participate in site safety and risk management programs.

About You

You are a proactive leader with a strong commitment to safety, operational excellence, and people development. Your ability to build relationships, manage risk, and lead teams in a dynamic operational environment will enable you to succeed in this role.

You will also bring:

Demonstrated safety leadership and a strong track record of field leadership participation.

Experience supervising contractor or service provider work groups.

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global.

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar.
