Implementar, mantener y optimizar balances metalúrgicos que aseguren la trazabilidad y confiabilidad de la información de producción.

Liderar los procesos de reconciliación metalúrgica mediante el análisis y gestión de desviaciones entre mediciones, muestreos, inventarios y resultados productivos.

Identificar, cuantificar y explicar pérdidas metalúrgicas y variaciones de desempeño, determinando causas raíz y proponiendo acciones correctivas.

Validar la calidad de los datos provenientes de sistemas de medición, laboratorios y reportabilidad operacional.

Coordinar el proceso de cierre de mes metalúrgico, asegurando el cumplimiento de estándares corporativos y requisitos de gobernanza.

Elaborar reportes técnicos, indicadores y análisis que permitan monitorear balances metalúrgicos, recuperaciones, inventarios y pérdidas metalúrgicas.

Desarrollar análisis estadísticos y herramientas de visualización para soportar la toma de decisiones y la mejora continua.

Implementar controles y mecanismos de aseguramiento de calidad que garanticen la integridad y auditabilidad de la información.

Participar en auditorías internas y externas asociadas a balances metalúrgicos, reconciliación y controles SOx.

Generar recomendaciones técnicas orientadas a mejorar la confiabilidad de los resultados, la gestión de inventarios y la eficiencia de los procesos de reconciliación.

Asegurar que las actividades se desarrollen en estricto cumplimiento de los estándares de Seguridad, Salud, Medio Ambiente y Comunidad (HSEC).

Participar activamente en iniciativas de excelencia operacional y mejora continua de acuerdo con el sistema operativo de BHP.

Buscamos personas que cuenten con:

Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Metalúrgica, Química o carrera afín.

Al menos 3 años de experiencia laboral en balances y reconciliación metalúrgica.

Experiencia laboral en análisis de pérdidas metalúrgicas, inventarios y contabilidad metalúrgica.

Conocimiento y experiencia laboral en sistemas de medición y muestreo.

Experiencia en análisis estadístico y gestión de datos.

Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel.

Deseable experiencia en Power BI.

Deseable experiencia en software especializado de reconciliación metalúrgica.

Experiencia trabajando con equipos multidisciplinarios.

Inglés nivel intermedio.

Disponibilidad para trabajar en faena.

Licencia de conducir clase B vigente.

jobs.description:

Work Location:
  Fortescue’s Perth office, located on the traditional lands of the Whadjuk people.

Roster:

Fortescue’s Global Sustainability and External Affairs team works across the business and externally to develop and implement government advocacy, approvals and stakeholder engagement strategies that support operational efficiency and growth.

The team’s work includes decarbonisation, energy policy, renewable energy, electricity markets, transmission, green iron, technology and mine development.

The External Relations Adviser will support Fortescue’s government relations and policy priorities, with a particular focus on energy policy and the transition to a lower-emissions industrial base. The role will monitor policy and regulatory developments, prepare advice and support engagement with government, industry associations and other stakeholders.

Work with internal teams to assess the implications of energy and climate policy developments for Fortescue’s operations, projects and investment priorities.

Support engagement with Australian Government, State Government, industry associations and other external stakeholders.

Represent Fortescue at selected meetings, forums, conferences and stakeholder events.

Contribute to the broader work of the Global Sustainability and External Affairs team.

The team’s work includes decarbonisation, energy policy, renewable energy, electricity markets, transmission, green iron, technology and mine development.

Experience in government relations, public policy, energy policy, climate policy, stakeholder engagement, government, politics or a related field.

Strong research, analytical and written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear advice.

Ability to build constructive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail and sound judgement.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Adviser
jobs.description:
About Woodside

We know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential and working in a positive work environment. We recognise that enduring, meaningful relationships with communities are fundamental to maintaining our licence to operate.

Technology and innovation are essential to our long-term sustainability. We are growing our carbon and new energy businesses using technology to reduce emissions and the carbon footprint of our products. We are working to improve energy efficiency, offset emissions, reduce emissions intensity and explore options for lower-carbon energy. Woodside led the development of the LNG industry in Australia and is applying this same pioneering spirit to solving future energy challenges globally.

Refer to our corporate website for more information about our different locations and projects: 

https://www.woodside.com/what-we-do

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Tax Adviser to support Woodside’s US direct tax function. This role will join a highly collaborative team, supporting tax leadership and coaching other tax team members while leading the delivery of tax advice and execution of tax processes in assigned areas. The successful candidate will provide technical, quantitative and implementation support for projects, coordinate with internal stakeholders, engage external advisers on technical and procedural matters, and help deliver best practice service and outcomes to internal and external stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities

US Tax Accounting, Provision and Reporting

Review US tax provision computations in accordance with IFRS guidelines, including taxable income calculations, deferred tax roll forwards, effective tax rate analyses and uncertain tax positions.

Review current and deferred tax provision deliverables, tax proofs, reconciliations and related reporting controls.

Maintain audit-ready support for tax positions and ensure alignment with Woodside reporting requirements and internal governance expectations.

Coordinate with accounting, finance and external audit stakeholders to support half-year, year-end and other reporting deliverables.

Federal and State Income Tax Compliance

Oversee preparation and filing of US partnership and corporate income tax returns, including Forms 1065, K-1 and 1120.

Ensure compliance with federal and state income tax laws and maintain complete, well-supported workpapers for return positions and filings.

Coordinate and review the development of tax positions and advice that are accurate, supportable and optimally beneficial to the Company.

Review new US tax legislation and develop plans to implement new rules, requirements and process impacts.

Tax Advisory, Projects and Business Partnering

Provide commercially focused US direct tax advice to commercial, legal, accounting and other group functions.

Maintain strong relationships with relevant business stakeholders to ensure Tax is aware of new business developments and able to provide timely input.

Provide tax support for growth and M&A activities, including business entry analysis, structuring analysis and implementation support.

Coordinate technical, quantitative and implementation support for projects, including engagement with internal stakeholders and external advisers.

Governance, Controversy and Leadership

Assist with US direct tax controversies as they arise, including coordination of responses, documentation and adviser engagement.

Identify US direct tax risks, recommend mitigation actions and escalate significant exposures, judgments or control matters as appropriate.

Support and coach other tax team members, including review of technical work and delivery against agreed priorities.

Contribute to process improvement, control enhancement and effective use of tax systems, including SAP and OneSource.

Skills and Experience

Required Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in accounting or a related field.

15+ years of income tax experience, including significant US direct tax experience.

Demonstrated experience reviewing US tax provisions and income tax compliance deliverables.

Experience with federal and state tax laws, partnership and corporate income tax returns, and tax accounting under IFRS.

Strong technical, quantitative, analytical, research and documentation skills.

Ability to lead complex workstreams, manage competing deadlines and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Experience with SAP, OneSource or comparable ERP and tax reporting systems.

Experience supporting growth projects, M&A activities, business entry analysis or implementation workstreams.

Experience supporting US direct tax controversies, audits or information requests.

Experience coordinating external advisers and reviewing technical advice.

Oil and gas, energy, capital-intensive or multinational corporate tax experience.

Critical Competencies

Strong governance mindset and commitment to complete, audit-ready documentation.

Commercially focused tax judgment with the ability to identify critical issues and practical solutions.

Clear, structured communicator able to translate complex US direct tax matters for non-tax stakeholders.

High ownership and accountability, with strong prioritization across reporting, compliance, advisory and controversy deadlines.

Leadership and coaching capability, including the ability to support tax leadership and develop team members.

Continuous improvement mindset, including the ability to strengthen controls, processes and tax technology use.

Recognition and Reward

What you can expect from us:

Commitment to your ongoing development, including on-the-job opportunities, formal programs and coaching

Industry-leading 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carer, and maintenance of superannuation or retirement benefits at the current rate during any period of unpaid parental leave for up to 24 months (plus secondary carer leave

jobs.title: Maintenance Electrical Supervisor, Underground Operations
jobs.description:
WHAT DOES AGNICO EAGLE VALUE?

At Agnico Eagle, our values never waver. We believe in trust, respect, equity, family and responsibility. Why? Because they express who we are, and they have helped us succeed in business for over 60 years. We value
you
- your unique set of skills and experience. We value your willingness to build those skills and make a meaningful contribution to our company. And, we value your commitment to treat every person on our team with respect, helping us to operate safely, protect the environment and make a positive contribution to our local communities.

ABOUT OUR OPERATION

Canadian-based and led, Agnico Eagle is Canada's largest mining company and the second largest gold producer in the world. It produces precious metals from operations in Canada, Australia, Finland and Mexico and has a pipeline of high-quality exploration and development projects. Agnico Eagle is a partner of choice within the mining industry, recognized globally for its leading sustainability practices. Agnico Eagle was founded in 1957 and has consistently created value for its shareholders, declaring a cash dividend every year since 1983.

Agnico Eagle Mines' Detour Lake Mine is situated on the traditional homelands of the Apitipi Anicinapek Nation, Moose Cree First Nation, and Taykwa Tagamou Nation. In honoring our relationships with and commitments to our Partner Nations, Agnico Eagle prioritizes the hiring of members from these Nations. Additionally, Agnico Eagle has entered into an agreement with the Métis Nation of Ontario, and therefore, we also prioritize citizens of the Métis Nation of Ontario. To support this commitment, members from these Nations seeking employment opportunities at the Detour Lake Mine are encouraged to self-identify during the job application process. This ensures that we can consider your application appropriately in line with our dedication to supporting our Partner Nations.

Want to learn more about Detour Lake Mine?
Click here
!

In compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, Agnico Eagle Mining (AEM) is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities. Accommodation is available, upon request, for candidates participating in the recruitment process.

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE:

Reporting to the Underground Electrical General Supervisor, you will be part of the Underground Maintenance Department. You will be responsible for providing support to the Maintenance team by being accountable for directing the workforce in daily electrical activities for all mining and mobile equipment, while ensuring compliance with all safety and regulatory procedures. You will ensure that the goals and objectives are achieved while promoting and respecting Agnico Eagle’s values, Health & Safety Code of Conduct and the environment.

Oversee and provide expertise for all electrical activities related to mining equipment maintenance and mine advancement;

Lead and coach team members in the achievement of maintenance safety and productivity targets;

Develop and implement standards and procedures that meet all statutory and regulatory requirements;

Assist in the preparation of maintenance operating cost forecasts, budgets, and monthly maintenance reports;

Schedule, plan and oversee electrical maintenance and construction activities to maximize equipment availability and reduce downtime.

Coordinate and oversee the installation of electrical equipment such as: 13.8kv-600v Substations, Distribution equipment, VFDs Motor Starters, PLCs, Leaky Feeder, Fiber Optic, LTE ect.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Ontario provincial or inter-provincial (Red Seal) trade certificate;

10 years of experience in an underground mining capacity;

5 years of supervisory experience with proven interpersonal and management skills to lead and inspire a team;

Sound interpersonal and management skills with the ability to lead and motivate a team of employees;

Experience working in SAP, JDE or similar Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) is a strong asset;

Experience in low and high voltage distribution, SEL Protection Relays as well as troubleshooting/ programming PLC’s will also be considered an asset;

Hands on experience with underground mining equipment, including Jumbo Drills, MacLean Bolters, Diamond Drills, Long Hole Drills, VFDs and motor starters for fans and pumps;

Excellent working knowledge of all Microsoft Office Suite applications especially Outlook, Excel, Word & PowerPoint.

Your Work Schedule:

Schedule: 14 days of work, followed by 14 days for transportation and rest;

Accommodations and meals are provided on site at no cost to the employee. Agnico Eagle provides transportation to and from the mine site and will accommodate to cover other travelling expenses according to your location of residence in Canada.

Compensation Statement

In accordance with applicable legislation, the expected compensation includes base salary and potential bonus opportunity. Your individual pay will reflect your skills and experience while remaining competitive within the local market.

jobs.title: Mine Engineer, Mid-Range Planner
jobs.description:
The Company

Globe 24-7 is partnering with a mining client in Dubreuilville, ON, to hire an experienced Mine Engineer for a Mid-Range Planner opportunity with focus on underground operations. This role will support a precious metals mining operation in northern Ontario, with a FIFO schedule. 

Position Overview 

As the Mine Engineer – Mid-Range Planner, you will be responsible for preparing, maintaining, and continuously improving a rolling 12-month mine plan that supports safe and efficient mining operations. Reporting to the Senior Production Engineer, you will coordinate with technical services, operations, and geology teams to develop practical, achievable schedules that integrate development and production requirements. This role focuses on ensuring operational plans remain aligned with business objectives while adapting to changing geological information, resource updates, and operational priorities. Through effective planning and cross-functional collaboration, you will help optimize production outcomes and support the successful execution of both near-term and longer-range operational goals.

The Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

Develop, maintain, and update a rolling 12-month mine plan, including production schedules and forecasts that support operational requirements and business objectives.

Coordinate mid-range planning activities by incorporating development, infrastructure, maintenance, and construction requirements while ensuring consistency across short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons.

Partner with operations, geology, survey, and technical services personnel to produce practical, executable mine plans and provide engineering support for day-to-day mining activities.

Evaluate alternative mining strategies through scenario modelling, risk assessments, and trade-off analyses to improve operational performance, productivity, and resource utilization.

Prepare planning reports, production reconciliations, and variance analyses, while supporting budgeting processes and contributing to life-of-mine planning, capital project evaluations, and technical studies, including economic assessments.

Provide technical direction and mentorship to junior technical staff, including engineers, survey personnel, and drill and blast planners, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects. 

Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Mining Engineering or a related discipline.

Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation or immediate eligibility to obtain registration.

Approximately 3–5 years of experience in underground mining, including responsibility for mine planning and production scheduling.

Sound understanding of underground mining methods, with experience in narrow vein and longhole stoping operations considered a strong asset.

Advanced proficiency with mine planning and scheduling software such as Deswik or comparable industry applications.

Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple assignments and adapt effectively within a dynamic mining operation.

Strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

Commitment to maintaining high standards of health, safety, environmental stewardship, and operational excellence.

Comfortable working in a combination of office and underground mining environments, with regular site exposure.

Willingness to work a rotational camp-based schedule, including a 14 days on / 14 days off roster.

The Environment

This is an onsite Fly-in/Fly-out position offered with a 14 14 rotating schedule. Team member flights will be provided from Toronto, Sudbury, Thunder Bay, or Rouyn-Noranda. Accommodations are provided while onsite.

The Rewards

The position offers a competitive remuneration package, including a base salary range of $90,000-$172,150/yr, STIP, Travel Allowances, Health Benefits and more.

Contact Us

Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document.

Our client, a flexible energy solutions provider,ere is seeking a EC&I Supervisor who will join their team in West Africa. The EC&I Supervisor is responsible for overseeing all electrical maintenance activities at the Thermal Power Plant, ensuring the seamless operation of low-voltage (LV), medium-voltage (MV), and high-voltage (HV) systems. This role ensures the proper integration of electrical equipment from generators to transformers, including cabling, switchgear, protection systems, and communication networks.

Responsibilities:

Electrical System Maintenance & Operation

Supervise and execute electrical maintenance for LV, MV, and HV systems, ensuring uninterrupted power supply.

Troubleshoot electrical faults, relay coordination issues, and protection system failures.

Inspections, Risk Assessments & Reporting

Conduct daily electrical system inspections to identify risks, faults, or potential failures.

Analyze operating statistics and generate reports on power system performance, failures, and required corrective actions.

Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on system health, maintenance activities, and improvement plans.

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and client requirements.

Power System Integration & Optimization

Oversee the integration of battery storage, solar, and generator systems to maintain grid stability.

Ensure proper synchronization of multiple power sources to maintain continuous and reliable energy supply.

Optimize electrical systems to enhance power efficiency, load balancing, and grid stability.

Switchgear & Protection System Management

Maintain and troubleshoot switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, relays, and motor control centres (MCCs).

Conduct relay protection testing, fault analysis, and coordination studies to prevent electrical failures.

Ensure correct settings and calibration of electrical protection devices to safeguard plant equipment.

Team Leadership & Supervision

Supervise and mentor the Electrician, ensuring compliance with maintenance schedules and best practices.

Assign tasks, provide technical guidance, and oversee the installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems.

Foster a safety-first culture among electrical maintenance personnel, ensuring adherence to PPE and lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.

Safety & Compliance

Ensure full compliance with electrical safety standards, including ISO, NFPA 70E, IEC, and local regulatory requirements.

Implement preventive maintenance programs to reduce risks of electrical failures or fire hazards.

Conduct arc flash analysis, grounding system inspections, and insulation resistance testing.

:

Experience on CAT MAK CM32 or similar is required.

Expatriate FIFO Contract

Job Description:

One of our Global leading clients based in the Northern Province of Sierra Leone is in search for a Chief Mine Geologist to join their team. The role

requires managing all geological functions on a mine, including resource evaluation, geological modeling, and mine planning support. Oversees exploration programs, ensures compliance with reporting standards (SAMREC/JORC), and maintains geological databases and more.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage geologists, technicians, and contractors; oversee daily geological activities aligned with mine plans.

Grade Control:
Ensure accurate sampling, logging, and ore-waste delineation; maintain ore quality for processing.

Resource & Reserve Estimation:
Supervise data collection and interpretation for resource modeling; assist with JORC/NI 43-101 compliant reporting.

Manage geological models using Surpac, Leapfrog, or Vulcan; produce block models and reconciliations.

Reporting:
Generate regular geological reports and provide insights for production and planning.

Design and manage near-mine exploration and infill drilling programs; integrate new data into operational plans.

Compliance & Safety:
Ensure geological operations meet safety, environmental, and statutory requirements; promote a safety-first culture.

Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with mine planning, production, metallurgy, and environmental teams; provide geological input for strategic planning.

Training & Development:
Conduct training programs for junior staff; facilitate skills development and knowledge transfer to build team capacity.

Qualification and Skill

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, or a related field.

A master’s degree in Geology or MBA will be an added advantage

Our client is seeking an accomplished Group Finance Director to lead the Group's strategic finance function during a significant phase of growth and project development. This is a high-profile executive leadership role with a strong focus on capital raising, funding strategy, treasury management and financial governance, supporting the successful delivery of a large-scale mining project.

Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Board and key financial stakeholders, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing the Group's funding strategy, leading debt and equity financing initiatives, managing banking and investor relationships, and optimising the Group's capital structure. Provide financial due diligence and valuation support for investment decisions.

:

Chartered Accountant (CA, ACCA, or equivalent).

Deep understanding of treasury, IFRS, and cross-border tax and compliance frameworks, including international audit and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing multi-currency portfolios and funding operations in emerging markets, with strong currency exposure and liquidity risk management skills.

Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.

Strong commitment to integrity, transparency, professionalism, and high ethical standards.

Adaptive and decisive in dynamic financial environments.

Drive Discovery outcomes through technical geoscientific leadership, disciplined operational execution and continuous improvement.

Bachelor's Degree in Geology, Geosciences or related discipline (essential).

Proven experience planning and executing multidisciplinary exploration programmes.

Strong understanding of sediment-hosted copper mineral systems and economic geology.

Strong geological mapping, interpretation and target generation capability.

Financial Controller (Mining / Finance Leadership / IFRS / Taxation) South Africa

Job Reference:
DGS-021

Southern Africa

Posted 1 month ago

Reference Number: DGS-021

Job Description:

Our client, a leading mining company in South Africa, is seeking an experienced and commercially focused Financial Controller to join their leadership team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the finance function by ensuring accurate financial and management reporting, maintaining robust financial controls, overseeing taxation and regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial support to operational and executive management. The role will also drive budgeting, forecasting, integrated business planning, Life of Mine (LOM) evaluations, financial modelling, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional with strong mining industry experience to contribute to the financial performance and long-term success of a major mining operation in South Africa.

Responsibilities:

Ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial results to corporate management, shareholders, lenders, and regulatory authorities.

Manage month-end and year-end close processes and ensure the integrity of financial reporting.

Lead the preparation and review of annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS and company policies.

Coordinate external audits and support all statutory reporting requirements.

Oversee general ledger integrity, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial controls to safeguard company assets and ensure reporting accuracy.

Provide financial analysis and insights to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Partner with mine management, engineering, geology, processing, and operational teams to support business performance and reporting requirements.

Lead the annual Integrated Business Planning process across mining, processing, maintenance, exploration, and administration functions, including budgeting and forecasting activities.

Monitor budget performance, investigate significant variances, and support cost optimisation initiatives.

Lead the financial component of Life of Mine (LOM) planning and long-term financial modelling activities.

Collaborate with technical services, geology, mine planning, and operations teams to align financial assumptions with production plans.

Evaluate project economics, including NPV, IRR, payback periods, and long-term cash flow projections.

Conduct sensitivity analyses relating to commodity prices, operating costs, grade profiles, recovery rates, and capital investments.

Support strategic planning processes, feasibility studies, expansion projects, acquisitions, and business development opportunities.

Ensure compliance with all direct and indirect tax obligations, including corporate income tax, provisional tax, royalties, transfer pricing, and deferred tax accounting requirements.

Manage relationships with tax authorities, external auditors, and tax advisors.

Monitor changes in tax legislation and assess the impact on the business.

Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and company policies.

Support internal audit engagements and implement audit recommendations.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the finance function.

Lead, mentor, and develop finance team members to achieve departmental objectives.

Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership.

Build strong working relationships with operational, technical, and corporate stakeholders.

Requirements: Qualification and Skills

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Professional accounting qualification such as CA(SA), ACCA, CPA, CIMA, or equivalent will be highly advantageous.

8–10 years of progressive finance experience.

Minimum 3–5 years in a senior finance leadership role within the mining sector.

Strong knowledge of IFRS, taxation, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and mining industry financial practices.

Proven experience in mine costing, financial modelling, and Life of Mine planning.

Experience evaluating capital projects and preparing investment analyses.

Strong understanding of corporate governance, risk management, and internal controls.

Experience managing external audits, tax compliance, and statutory reporting requirements.

Advanced financial modelling, analytical, and reporting capabilities.

Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

High attention to detail with the ability to meet tight deadlines in a dynamic operational environment.

Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and business partnering.

Job Description:

We are partnering with a major international mining group to appoint a Processing Lead to deliver the new processing plant at the heart of a large copper expansion project in Central Africa. Reporting to the Processing Manager and leading a team of five to six, you will own the end-to-end delivery of the plant, from the project execution plan through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and ramp-up to final handover to operations, on time, within budget and to specification. This is a delivery leadership role for someone who has built and commissioned processing plants on major international projects and can hold scope, cost and schedule while managing contractors, risk and stakeholders on the ground. On completion of the plant, the role transitions to operations or to the next phase of the expansion project.

Responsibilities:

Lead delivery of the new processing plant, executing in accordance with the approved scope, budget and schedule.

Develop and implement the Project Execution Plan (PEP) across engineering, procurement and logistics, construction, risk management, document control and QA/QC.

Manage the processing plant budget, strictly controlling expenditure and ensuring cost-effectiveness.

Establish and maintain a detailed project schedule, monitoring key deliverables and milestones to ensure timely completion.

Lead tendering and award of major equipment and construction contracts, and oversee contractor performance and variations.

Own and maintain the processing plant risk register, developing and implementing mitigation strategies.

Coordinate on-site construction resources, ensuring efficient workflow and strict adherence to safety standards.

Secure the necessary permits, licences and statutory approvals, ensuring compliance with all relevant codes and regulations.

Organise and oversee plant commissioning, ramp-up and final handover to operations, coordinating operational readiness.

Build and lead a cohesive team, driving skills transfer and performance against individual and functional targets.

Requirements: Qualification and Skill

A degree in a relevant engineering or technical discipline; a Master’s and a PMP (or equivalent project-management certification) are advantageous.

15+ years across multiple international industrial and processing projects, with strong EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) management.

Experience as Engineering, Study or Project Manager on at least three international copper projects; copper or gold processing experience preferred.

A proven track record delivering processing plants through construction, commissioning, ramp-up and handover to operations.

Strong commercial, contracts and tendering acumen, with disciplined schedule, cost and risk management.

The ability to build and lead high-performing, multicultural teams on a remote site.

Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including with government and regulatory bodies.

Fluent English is essential; Mandarin/Chinese is advantageous given the ownership and project environment.

A valid international driving licence.

Rotational FIFO roster, set by point of hire (typically 6 weeks on / 2–3 weeks off for South African and other international hires)

Attractive USD-denominated salary, plus performance bonus

Full expatriate benefits package

Fixed-term contract of up to 3 years

jobs.description:
class="sjb-detail sjb-v1">

BACK

Chief Geologist (Resource Estimation / Feasibility / OP / Open-Pit / Copper / Mining) Southern Africa

Job Reference:
DSS02 - OC

Southern Africa

Posted 2 weeks ago

Reference:

DSS02 OC

Job Description:

A client of ours is looking for a Chief Geologist to lead the geological function for a copper development project, which is progressing from PEA into the PFS phase and ultimately towards DFS, financing and production. The project has significant resource extension and near-mine exploration potential. The Chief Geologist will provide senior geological leadership across exploration, resource development, feasibility, and production, while overseeing the geological model, resource database, grade control, and production geology to ensure a consistent and well-characterised ore supply throughout the mine’s life.

Responsibilities:

Manage the geological database and ensure the integrity of drillhole, assay, geological, and QA/QC data.

Lead geological interpretation, 3D geological modelling, and mineral resource estimation in line with JORC, NI 43-101, or SAMREC standards.

Plan and manage exploration, infill, extension, geotechnical, and grade control drilling programmes.

Oversee core logging, sampling, QA/QC, and data quality across all drilling activities.

Lead grade control and production geology activities, ensuring accurate ore/waste delineation and consistent ore supply to the processing plant.

Integrate grade control and production data into resource models and conduct regular mine-to-mill reconciliation.

Provide geological input into short-, medium-, and long-term mine planning, PFS, DFS, and pit optimisation.

Manage geotechnical and hydrogeological monitoring programmes and provide geological input into pit stability and dewatering strategies.

Develop and manage near-mine and regional exploration programmes focused on resource replacement and growth.

Prepare and review technical reports, resource statements, regulatory submissions, and investor documentation.

Lead, mentor, and develop the geology team while promoting strong technical, safety, and environmental standards.

Ensure all geological and exploration activities comply with applicable reporting, mining, HSE, and environmental requirements.

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Geology, Geological Sciences, or a related field.

At least 10 years’ mining industry experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior geological position within base metals, preferably copper.

Strong expertise in geological modelling and mineral resource estimation using Leapfrog Geo, Vulcan, Datamine, or similar software.

Hands-on experience with mine fleet management and mine planning systems (e.g., Modular Mining, Wenco, Deswik, MineSight, or equivalent) and integration of geological models into operational mine plans.

Extensive open-pit geology experience, with a strong background in grade control, production geology, drilling programs, ore block definition, and mine-to-mill reconciliation.

Proven ability to manage geological teams and drilling programs across greenfield and brownfield mining projects.

Good knowledge of JORC 2012, NI 43-101, or SAMREC reporting requirements.

Strong understanding of copper deposit geology, including supergene and hypogene mineralisation and structural controls.

Experience supporting a mining project through a PEA-to-PFS or PFS-to-DFS transition.

Working knowledge of geotechnical and slope monitoring technologies, including slope radar, LiDAR, and UAV photogrammetry, with an understanding of geological and hydrogeological influences on pit stability.

Benefits and Contractual information

Competitive Salary

Manage the

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

will be advantageous.

seasoned Payroll Manager

accuracy, confidentiality, compliance and deadlines are non-negotiable
.

About the Opportunity

Our client, a leading provider of mining technology, equipment solutions and specialised services, is seeking an experienced Area Manager to join their team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the sustainability and profitability of Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and training agreements, while leading operational teams and maintaining strong relationships with key mining clients.

Manage and coordinate the operational schedule and implementation of systems and products on clients' mining equipment.

Coordinate and manage operational staff, allocate tasks and resources, and facilitate effective interdepartmental communication.

Manage the performance of direct reports and ensure operational targets are achieved.

Drive employee development, training and continuous improvement.

Manage disciplinary processes in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Monitor SLA performance and implement corrective action where required.

Ensure day-to-day service requirements are effectively managed and completed to client expectations.

Attend client meetings and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.

Provide accurate and meaningful weekly operational reports to Senior Management.

Provide timely management reporting on service performance, challenges and opportunities.

Develop strategies to improve service efficiency, reduce costs and enhance customer satisfaction.

Ensure the effective delivery and profitability of customer SLAs and training agreements.

Sound knowledge of South African mining legislation, including:

Environmental legislation.

Labour Relations Act.

Basic Conditions of Employment Act.

Knowledge of engineering codes of practice and procedures applicable to coal and hard-rock mining operations in South Africa.

Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies relating to electrical and electronic engineering.

Strong knowledge of flameproofing and gas testing.

Understanding of mining equipment and service-related operations will be highly advantageous.

Key Competencies

We are looking for an experienced leader who demonstrates:

Strong leadership and people-management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication.

Strong client relationship management skills.

Commercial and operational awareness.

Excellent organisational and planning abilities.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

jobs.description:
Be part of the team. The team that makes it happen.

We are the world’s leading diamond company, powered by thousands of people around the world who are driven to support thriving local communities, protect the natural environment, and stand with women and girls, focused on Building Forever.

If you like chasing demanding targets, thrive on making decisions in the pursuit of brilliance, and enjoy the support of the world’s finest experts, we have a place for you.

This position is instrumental for the management and maintenance of all site digital and communications systems. The
Operational Technology Specialist (Communications & Systems)
will leverage learnings from across global OT teams, to create and share repeatable concepts and efficient ways of working. The incumbent will be positioned to work proactively with OEMs, mining and technical departments to ensure support is readily available and to ensure maximum equipment utilization. The role is well suited to someone who is forward thinking, has a keen eye for continuous improvement opportunities, is willing to contribute to the development of Digital Transformation Best Practices, can quickly build relationships with key stakeholders, is comfortable with ambiguity and who is committed to safe work practices while striving for zero harm.

Previous experience working in Arctic conditions

jobs.locationRaw: Conceição do Mato Dentro, MINAS GERAIS, Brazil
jobs.description:
A Anglo American é uma empresa global de mineração com sede em Londres, presente em diversos países e com uma história de mais de 100 anos, com o propósito de reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Na América Latina, nossas operações desempenham um papel estratégico no fornecimento responsável de recursos essenciais para o desenvolvimento do mundo – com atuação no Brasil, Chile e Peru, sempre pautadas por inovação, segurança, sustentabilidade e alto desempenho.

No Brasil, operamos o sistema Minas-Rio, que integra mina, usina, mineroduto e porto. As operações do Peru e do Chile se concentram na produção de cobre em larga escala, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma transição energética sustentável.

Acreditamos que nossas pessoas são o maior diferencial competitivo. Investimos no desenvolvimento de talentos, promovendo ambientes inclusivos e colaborativos, onde diferentes perspectivas constroem soluções melhores para os desafios do presente e do futuro.

Na Anglo American, valorizamos quem deseja crescer com propósito e gerar impacto real.

Como
Engenheira de Planejamento Sênior
, você será responsável por liderar o planejamento, monitoramento e controle de projetos e obras de infraestrutura de pequeno, médio e grande porte, garantindo a integração das informações relacionadas a engenharia, suprimentos, contratos, cronogramas e controle de custos. Atuará na elaboração de cronogramas executivos, avaliação de prioridades de demandas, análises de desempenho, gestão de riscos e definição de estratégias para assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos de prazo, custo, qualidade e segurança.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Elaborar, consolidar e controlar cronogramas de implantação de projetos e obras de infraestrutura utilizando, MS Project e demais ferramentas de planejamento.

Desenvolver Estruturas Analíticas de Projeto, planos de execução, curvas de avanço físico e financeiro e cronogramas integrados.

Realizar análises de caminho crítico, produtividade, riscos e restrições, propondo ações de mitigação.

Monitorar e reportar o avanço financeiro do orçamento da gerência, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria no desempenho dos processos.

Conduzir o planejamento de curto, médio e longo prazo, integrando engenharia, suprimentos, contratos e construção.

Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para suporte à tomada de decisão da gerência e diretoria.

Apoiar a definição estratégica de priorização de demandas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização nos processos de serviços, facilities e gestão operacional, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência, produtividade e qualidade das entregas.

Apoiar estratégias de contratação, mobilização de recursos e dimensionamento de equipes e equipamentos.

Coordenar reuniões de acompanhamento e promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de planejamento, controle e governança.

Atuar como referência técnica da área, desenvolvendo profissionais e garantindo o cumprimento das políticas de Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade e Integridade Empresarial.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino superior em Engenharia Civl, Produção e outras Engenharias.

CREA ativo.

CNH – B.

Desejável Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos ou similar.

Desejável experiência em planejamento de grandes projetos e obras de infraestrutura.

Desejável inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

·
Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental:

Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional

·
Especial para você e sua família:

Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!

· Espaço para ser você mesmo:

Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade!

· Para seu futuro:

Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado

· E ainda:

Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança?

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. E foi para escutar todas essas vozes que criamos os Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho.

*Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

Nosso processo seletivo

Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, e anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição.

Nosso processo seletivo, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição, análise dos currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão.

jobs.title: Ausbildung Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik M/W/D in Burghaun | Fulda
jobs.description:
Element Six ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Design, Entwicklung und Produktion von synthetischen Diamant- und Hartmetall-Supermaterialien. Als Teil der De Beers Gruppe befinden sich unsere Produktionseinrichtungen u.a. in Großbritannien, Irland, Deutschland, Südafrika und den USA.

In Burghaun konzentrieren sich rund 360 Mitarbeiter mit der Entwicklung, Produktion und dem Vertrieb von Hartmetallprodukten sowie hochverschleißfesten Werkzeugen. Kontinuierliche Investitionen und Produktentwicklungen in den letzten Jahren haben diesen Standort zu einem der modernsten und produktivsten Hartmetallwerke weltweit gemacht.

Unsere Mission

Unsere Kunden stehen bei uns an erster Stelle. Mit unserem technologischen Know-how und unserer industriellen Führerschaft liefern wir unseren Kunden innovative Lösungen, um Wettbewerbsvorteile zu erzielen.

Unsere Vision

Mit Zugang zu den fortschrittlichsten F&E-Technologien und den besten Köpfen in diesem Bereich ist die Zukunft voller Möglichkeiten...

Unsere Geschichte

Seit 1959 liegt unser Schwerpunkt auf der Entwicklung des Diamantsyntheseprozesses, um innovative synthetische Diamant- und Hartmetalllösungen zu ermöglichen. Diamant ist nicht nur das härteste Material der Welt, sondern besitzt aufgrund seiner extremen und vielfältigen Eigenschaften auch eine hohe Zugfestigkeit, chemische Trägheit, eine breite optische Transmission und eine sehr hohe Wärmeleitfähigkeit.

Auf unserer Website können Sie mehr darüber erfahren, wer wir sind und was wir tun:

https://www.e6.com/de/about/corporate-information

Für unseren Standort Burghaun suchen wir für August 2027 Auszubildende zum Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik (m/w/d)

Die Ausbildungsdauer beträgt 3,5 Jahre und findet im Dualen System sowohl im Unternehmen am Standort Burghaun als auch in der Berufsschule statt. Die Berufsschule findet wöchentlich an ein bis zwei Tagen an der Ferdinand-Braun-Schule in Fulda statt. Die Berufsausbildung endet mit erfolgreichem Bestehen der Abschlussprüfung vor der Industrie- und Handelskammer. Bei guten schulischen und betrieblichen Leistungen kann die Ausbildungszeit verkürzt werden, d.h. die Abschlussprüfung kann vorzeitig abgelegt werden.

Elektroniker installieren, warten und reparieren elektrische Betriebs-, Produktions- und Verfahrensanlagen. Verantwortung haben sie außerdem für Schalt- und Steueranlagen der Energieversorgung und für Einrichtungen der Kommunikations- und Beleuchtungstechnik.

Zu Deinen Hauptaufgaben während Deiner Ausbildungszeit in unserer Instandhaltung gehören:

Reparieren/Instandhalten von Geräten und Maschinen

Montieren von Steckdosen, Lichtbändern, Lampen und Motoren

Überprüfen von elektrischen Geräten

Kennen und Verstehen von Automatisierungssystemen sowie Programmieren von Steuereinheiten

Das solltest Du mitbringen:

Freude im Umgang mit Menschen

handwerkliches Geschick

technisches Verständnis

Computerkenntnisse

Mittlere Reife

Deutsche Sprache in Wort und Schrift

Das bieten wir Dir:

eine spannende, interessante und abwechslungsreiche Ausbildung

hohes Ausbildungsniveau

qualifizierte und erfahrene Ausbilder

überbetriebliche Ausbildungen wie z.B. CAD-, CNC- und Englischkurse

Möglichkeit eines Auslandsaufenthalts in einer unserer weltweiten Niederlassungen

sehr gutes Betriebsklima in einem jungen, dynamischen Team

gute Übernahmechancen

Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten nach der Ausbildung wie z.B. Duales Studium, Meister, Techniker, Fachwirt und Betriebswirt

tarifgebundenes Unternehmen

Arbeitgeberzuschuss AVWL

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

2. Ausbildungsjahr: 1.328€

jobs.title: Contractor Social Management Officer
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for
Contractor Social Management Officer.
The purpose of this role is to support contractor social management programmes to enable effective contractor social performance in accordance with organisational standards and requirements.

We’re the best in the industry.

You’ll make us better.

Guided by our purpose and our values, we enable both high performance and purposeful action as we aim to “re-imagine mining to improve people’s lives", delivering the metals and minerals that make modern life possible – from mobile phones to medicines.

Kumba Iron Ore

We produce high-grade iron ore, the key component in steel widely used in construction and manufacturing across the world. Our activities include all aspects – exploration; mining; processing and blending; shipping; marketing and selling. In South Africa, we have mining operations in the Northern Cape province, as well as a head office in Rosebank, Gauteng, and a port operation in Saldanha Bay, Western Cape.

As
Contractor Social Management Officer
your responsibilities will include but not limited to:

Safety, Health, and Environment:

Adhere to all health and safety practices and requirements.

Maintain good housekeeping to ensure compliance and an environment where team members can deliver their outputs within a controlled risk environment.

Program Coordination and Support:

Support the development, implementation and monitoring of Contractor Social Management Plans (CSMPs) and associated social performance commitments for socially material contracts.

Track and report program progress, including contractor compliance with social impact mitigation measures.

Maintain accurate records of all program activities and outcomes.

Stakeholder Engagement:

Facilitate communication between contractors, the corporate social department, and community stakeholders.

Respond to basic queries from stakeholders regarding social management initiatives.

Provide administrative support for contractor-related grievance processes by capturing information, maintaining records, coordinating meetings and communicating updates to relevant stakeholders.

Support the receipt, tracking and coordination of contractor-related grievances, including investigations, resolution actions and stakeholder communication.

Monitoring and Reporting:

Conduct site visits to verify contractor adherence to agreed-upon social standards and policies.

Collect data related to community feedback and contractor performance for reporting purposes.

Assist in preparing routine compliance and performance reports for internal review.

Compliance and Administration:

Ensure contractor compliance with corporate social responsibility guidelines and legal requirements in alignment with the Social Way Standard and Contractor Performance Management process.

Document issues related to contractor non-compliance and escalate them as necessary.

Coordinate and maintain contractor training schedules on social and environmental policies.

General Administrative Tasks:

Manage the filing and storage of program-related documentation.

Support the department in preparing communication materials related to contractor social management.

Perform other related tasks as delegated by supervisors.

This role is in Corporate Affairs (COR) department on a Band 7 (C-Upper) level reporting to the Specialist Social Risk & Impact.

Grade 12 or equivalent

NQF5 qualification in Business Administration Services or equivalent

SA Drivers Licence

Technical Knowledge

Basic understanding of CSR principles, particularly in contractor and community relations.

Familiarity with community engagement and development practices.

Awareness of organisational social and environmental policies, contractor compliance standards, and relevant regulations.

Knowledge of basic monitoring techniques to assess contractor performance and program outcomes.

Awareness of the local community's social dynamics, cultural norms, and economic environment.

Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and SAP (preferred).

Who we are?

Anglo American is a global diversified mining business. Our portfolio of world-class mining operations provides the metals and minerals that make modern life possible. We use innovative practices and the latest technologies to discover new resources and mine.

We work together with our key partners and stakeholders to unlock the sustainable value that those resources represent for our shareholders, the communities and countries in which we operate and for society at large. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives.

How we are committed to your safety

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

Inclusion and Diversity

Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

How to apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

jobs.title: Legal Specialist
jobs.description:
Anglo American Australia
In Australia, we operate five steelmaking coal mines in Queensland’s Bowen Basin, and have additional joint venture interests in manganese, as well as copper exploration projects under way in North West Queensland. Steelmaking coal is an essential ingredient in blast-furnace steel manufacture, producing steel used for critical building and infrastructure around the world.

Reporting to the relevant Legal Manager, as a Legal Specialist, you will act in a legal counsel capacity, partnering closely with operational, procurement, commercial teams and other business stakeholders to provide practical, high-quality, commercially focused legal advice that facilitates business outcomes while managing risk effectively. You'll play a key role in supporting supply chain and procurement matters, commercial transactions, governance activities, and other strategic initiatives across our Steelmaking Coal business.

Key accountabilities also include:

Providing timely and pragmatic legal advice across procurement, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, governance and strategic projects.

Drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial agreements and transactions.

Partnering with business stakeholders to identify, assess and manage legal risk while supporting commercial objectives.

Supporting governance and regulatory compliance activities, including company secretarial and joint venture matters.

Managing external legal advisors to ensure quality outcomes and value for money.

Developing practical legal solutions and enhancing existing systems and processes to strengthen business capability and risk management.

We're seeking a capable, self-motivated lawyer who combines strong technical legal capability with commercial acumen and a collaborative approach, and who enjoys working as part of a small in-house legal team with access to experienced senior lawyers.

Ideally, you'll bring:

A Bachelor of Laws (LLB) and a current Australian practising certificate.

At least 5 years' post-admission experience gained within a reputable law firm, corporate legal team, or a combination of both, with the capability to operate at legal counsel level in an in-house environment.

Strong experience in commercial contracting, procurement, corporate and commercial law.

Excellent communication, drafting, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with strong attention to detail.

The ability to provide pragmatic, risk-based advice in a complex and fast-paced business environment.

Sound judgement to work autonomously, prioritise competing matters and know when to escalate issues for guidance or approval.

A proactive and solutions-focused mindset, with the confidence to build trusted relationships and contribute to practical business outcomes.

Permanent, full-time position based in our Brisbane Corporate office

Centrally located in our Brisbane CBD Corporate Office, close to train, bus and ferry connections

Flexible work options including WFH and 9 day fortnight

Competitive salary + 12% superannuation and annual bonus

Paid parental leave for both primary and secondary carers

Employee Assistance Program for employees and their family

What we offer

When you join Anglo American, you can expect to enjoy a competitive salary and benefits package and a range of flexible work arrangements that support the balance of work, family and individual circumstances. But more than this, you’ll find yourself in an environment where the opportunities for learning and growth are second to none. From technical training to leadership programmes, we bring out the best in our people. There are plenty of opportunities to move onwards and upwards too.

Who we are

We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. Anglo American is a leading global mining company focused on the responsible production of copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients – future-enabling products that are essential for decarbonising the global economy, improving living standards, and food security. Our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively to unlock enduring value from precious natural resources for our shareholders, for the benefit of the communities and countries in which we operate, and for society as a whole. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives.

Background checks

Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening which may include a criminal check and validation of qualifications.

Inclusion and Diversity

Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential.

How we are committed to your safety

Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer.

How to apply

To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process.

CLOSING DATE

17 September 2026

Please note, screening and interviews may take place prior to closing date – applications may also close before this date.

jobs.title: Operador Mina AB - División Chuquicamata
jobs.description:
Operador/a Mina AB -
División Chuquicamata

¿Quieres ser parte del desarrollo sostenible de Chile y el mundo?

¡Únete a la empresa más importante del país y construyamos juntos(as) la minería del futuro!

Nuestra estrategia de negocio es maximizar de forma competitiva y sustentable el valor económico de Codelco y su aporte al Estado de Chile. Si compartes nuestro propósito, te invitamos a participar del concurso
Operador/a Mina AB
 de la Gerencia de Operaciones, para impulsar juntos(as) la transformación y sostenibilidad de nuestra Corporación.

Buscamos a personas comprometidas(os) con el progreso del país, líderes que desafíen el status quo, que muestren su mejor versión e impulsen el trabajo colaborativo para enfrentar el futuro de la compañía.

Diversidad e Inclusión

En Codelco estamos llamados a ser líderes en diversidad e inclusión por nuestro rol social y productivo para el país. En términos de equidad de género aspiramos alcanzar 35% de representación femenina al 2027 y generar igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas, porque tenemos convicción en el valor de los equipos diversos (esta oferta se enmarca en la ley 21.015 que incentiva la inclusión de personas con discapacidad). 

¡Te invitamos a ser parte del mejor lugar para desarrollar tus talentos!

Propósito del Cargo:  

Ejecutar labores de producción minera subterránea mediante la operación y control de equipos y sistemas de extracción, hundimiento, chancado y manejo de materiales, tanto en terreno como desde el Centro Integrado de Operaciones (CIO), contribuyendo al cumplimiento seguro y eficiente de los programas de producción. Asimismo, coordinarse con personal propio, de mantenimiento y empresas colaboradoras para maximizar la disponibilidad y vida útil de los activos, ocupándose de cumplir y hacer cumplir las políticas, normas y procedimientos establecidos en la División y en la Corporación, relacionados con seguridad, salud ocupacional, medio ambiente y la diversidad e inclusión.

Funciones Principales:

Asegurar la continuidad operacional y seguridad de las áreas asignadas, verificando condiciones de trabajo, identificando riesgos y ejecutando acciones correctivas para mantener la operación segura y continua.

Operar, controlar y monitorear equipos y sistemas productivos, tanto en terreno como desde el Centro Integral de Operaciones (CIO), verificando condiciones operacionales y variables críticas del proceso.

Ejecutar actividades de producción minera, incluyendo procesos de hundimiento, extracción, reducción secundaria, carga de explosivos y entrega de mineral al proceso productivo.

Realizar actividades de apoyo operativo y servicios asociados, tales como traslado de equipos, desatollos, manejo de materiales, manejo de rises y otras labores necesarias para asegurar la continuidad de las operaciones.

Participar en actividades de mantenimiento y reparación minera, gestionando o apoyando intervenciones mecánicas, eléctricas e instrumentales en equipos e instalaciones.

Registrar, controlar y comunicar información operacional, manteniendo actualizados los datos del proceso productivo, novedades de equipos, condiciones operativas y riesgos detectados, asegurando un adecuado traspaso de turno y coordinación con otras áreas.

Coordinar y supervisar actividades en la zona o área asignada, interactuando con personal propio y empresas colaboradoras, controlando el estado de los activos y gestionando la primera respuesta ante contingencias operacionales.

Cumplir y promover estándares de calidad, seguridad, salud ocupacional y medio ambiente, velando por el cumplimiento normativo, la mejora continua y la sustentabilidad de las operaciones.

Contribuir al cumplimiento de los planes de producción y excelencia operacional, optimizando procesos, participando en proyectos y procesos de cambio, promoviendo la innovación tecnológica y el uso eficiente de los activos.

Trabajar colaborativamente y apoyar el desarrollo organizacional, fomentando el trabajo en equipo, el desarrollo de las personas, el respeto de los valores corporativos, la conducción de vehículos de apoyo cuando corresponda y la ejecución de otras funciones afines requeridas por la supervisión.

¡Porque aquí el despliegue de tus talentos se pondrá al servicio De Chile!

Requisitos de Postulación:

Titulado/a en Enseñanza Media Completa, científica, Humanista, Técnico Industrial o carreras afín al cargo.

Al menos 1 año de experiencia laboral en minería.

Licencia de conducir clase B vigente.

Salud compatible con el cargo

Aspectos Deseables:

Al menos 1 año de experiencia en operación de equipos o mantenimiento de equipos mineros.

Licencia de Conducir Clase D vigente 

Condiciones Ofrecidas:

Contrato: Temporal.

Cargo contractual Operador Mina AB  

Lugar de trabajo: División Chuquicamata (Sin campamento)

Turno: 7x7 Turno Continuo

Número de vacantes: 08.

Cierre de Postulaciones: 09 de septiembre de 2026

Hora de cierre de postulaciones: 23:59 hrs.

“Declaro en este acto, estar en conocimiento de las condiciones que, de acuerdo a la normativa de Codelco, podrían configurar una incompatibilidad para el ejercicio del cargo al cual postulo y, en consecuencia, afectar mi continuidad en el proceso. Por este motivo, me obligo a presentar todos los documentos y antecedentes requeridos por Codelco en el marco del proceso de selección e informar oportunamente de cualquier situación que pudiera representar una inhabilidad y/o incompatibilidad. Del mismo modo, declaro que he sido debidamente informado de que cualquier omisión, error o falsedad en la información entregada, puede ser causal de que se desestime mi postulación, que no se adjudique el concurso o del término del contrato de trabajo.”

Para asegurarnos de que no se pierda ninguna de nuestra información y/o actualizaciones relevantes, le recomendamos que revise regularmente su carpeta de Spam (correo no deseado). Si encuentra algunos de nuestros correos allí, asegúrese de marcarlos como "No es spam" o

jobs.title: Internship Opportunity | Integrated Planning (Kuala Lumpur)
jobs.description:
About BHP 

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

Come and be a part of this success.

About the Role:

This internship provides hands-on experience in applying data science techniques to real-world business challenges. The intern will support data sourcing, validation, and testing activities, ensuring data quality and integrity for analysis. They will also work on data mining and analysis, leverage various tools, build and implement predictive models, develop algorithms, and run simulations to generate actionable insights.

The role requires the ability to translate complex data into meaningful recommendations that drive business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about uncovering solutions hidden within large datasets and enjoys collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams to improve performance and decision-making.

As a Data Science Intern, you will perform tasks of varying complexity under guidance, gaining practical experience in data science and analytics while contributing to meaningful business outcomes.

Key accountabilities include:

Support data sourcing and validation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of datasets used for analysis and modeling.

Assist in data preparation and testing by cleaning, transforming, and verifying data for use in predictive models and simulations.

Apply data mining and analysis techniques to identify patterns, trends, and insights that inform decision-making.

Contribute to model development and algorithm testing, supporting implementation and performance evaluation.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions.

Prepare simple reports and visualizations that communicate findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders.

Participate in team workshops and presentations, learning how to tell compelling stories with data.

Gain exposure to real-world projects, on-the-job training, and mentorship from experienced professionals.

About You:

Currently pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Must be available to work full-time (five days a week – Hybrid).

Proficient in English (written and spoken).

Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, or SQL.

Exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).

Strong computer literacy and proficiency in standard applications (e.g., MS Office, Outlook, Teams).

Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for data storage and processing.

Ability to design, refine, and apply effective AI prompts.

Basic knowledge of data analysis and visualization concepts.

Understanding of machine learning concepts and basic algorithms.

Understands the capabilities, limitations, and practical business applications of generative AI technologies.

Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions.

Experience with data cleaning, validation, and testing in academic or project settings.

Strong time management skills to ensure timely delivery of tasks.

Willingness to take initiative and drive personal development during the internship.

About Our Process 

At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks. 

If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal. 

Supporting a Diverse Workforce 

The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance-based bonuses and a best-in-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms.  

At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity employer that is committed to making BHP a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and be at their best every day. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and recognise that true diversity includes gender, age, race, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, education levels, and many more aspects of your identity.

BHP is committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible for all. If you have a disability, we know that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. If you would like to reach out to someone about your situation and our recruitment process, please email us at 

inclusion@bhp.com

.

Apply now »
