jobs.title: Principal PMO | Escondida
jobs.description:
Sobre Escondida | BHP 

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global.

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Somos operados por una compañía global líder en recursos naturales, con operaciones en más de 90 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo. 

Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar. Aquí, tu voz cuenta. Tu crecimiento importa. Y tu trabajo contribuye directamente a transformar el mundo. 

El desafio que te espera

En Escondida | BHP tendrás la oportunidad de desempeñar un rol clave que potencia el impacto de la Head of Transformation mediante la coordinación estratégica, el seguimiento de iniciativas críticas, la gestión de stakeholders y la generación de información accionable que facilite decisiones oportunas y la consecución de los objetivos organizacionales.

Serás una persona fundamental para lograr resultados estratégicos, eliminando barreras de ejecución, coordinando stakeholders clave y garantizando el seguimiento riguroso de las iniciativas prioritarias.

Principales Responsabilidades

Como Principal PMO, serás responsable de:

Seguridad y Salud:

Agregar valor a la compañía y a la gerencia con la conexión de las practicas BOS [8, 9 y 10]; Identificando y analizando desviaciones para luego poder Diseñar, Gestionar y Controlar medidas para la eliminación y/o mitigación de riesgos de salud y/o seguridad a nivel transversal.

Siendo las mayores prioridades de BHP se encuentra el objetivo a nivel compañía de “identificar los riesgos que pueden afectar a las personas”.

Medioambiente, Sustentabilidad y Valor Social:

Agregar valor al medioambiente y nuestra sociedad, manteniendo un trabajo colaborativo con diversos Stakeholder, para la implementación de iniciativas con impactos positivos en, remediación ambiental, relaciones comunitarias, sustentabilidad ambiental. Generando conexión con las practicas BOS [2 y 11], entendiendo como cliente todo nuestro entorno [ambiental, comunitario, legislativo, planes de descarbonización, entre otros].

La salud a largo plazo de nuestro negocio, depende de la salud de nuestra sociedad y de un medioambiente natural y sostenible.

Productividad y Costos:

Mantener el desempeño operativo, seguro y confiable.

Agregar valor al negocio y a nuestros accionistas con una planificación ajustada y desafiante, generando oportunidades de mejoramiento continuo.

Lo que esperamos de ti

Buscamos personas que cuenten con:

Titulo profesional de Ingeniería en cualquiera de sus especialidades.

Al menos 5 años de expeirencia laboral en procesos de gestión relacionados a la minería.

Conocimientos de sistemas de información transversales [Nivel intermedio – visualizar, extraer reportes y cargar informes e información] [ Fiori – 1SAP – EMS – WAVE].

Liderazgo estratégico y visión sistémica.

Orientación a la calidad y excelencia operativa.

Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de estructurar procesos.

Influencia y gestión de stakeholders.

Comunicación efectiva y enfoque colaborativo.

Alta orientación a la mejora continua.

Conocimiento general sobre la gestión de la seguridad y salud en el trabajo en faenas.

Manejo plataformas corporativas como Tempo y Sharepoint.

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí

En Escondida | BHP entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.  

- Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.  

- Remuneración: justa y competitiva que refleje tu rol, habilidades y logros. 

- Cultura inclusiva: Promovemos un entorno laboral donde cada persona se siente valorada, respetada y libre de expresar su identidad auténtica. 

- Reconocimiento: Te recompensamos por tus pequeños y grandes logros a través de nuestro programa global de reconocimiento Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias. 

¡Y mucho más!  

Sobre nuestro proceso

En Escondida | BHP contratamos personas que se alinean con nuestros valores y cumplen con los requisitos del rol. Como parte del proceso, podríamos analizar el cumplimiento de los requisitos para determinar la idoneidad y capacidad personal para ejecutar el trabajo.  

Si ya trabajas en BHP, postula a través del portal interno con tu correo corporativo.   

¿Y por qué no tú?

Nuestra compañía te ofrece oportunidades sin límites. Desde beneficios competitivos hasta la posibilidad de trabajar en distintos países, aquí puedes diseñar tu carrera a tu manera. Si estás buscando un lugar donde tu trabajo tenga propósito y tu crecimiento sea parte del camino, este puede ser tu próximo paso.  

¡Postula hoy y sé parte de la transformación de la minería! 

Apoyamos una fuerza laboral diversa

En Escondida | BHP nos adherimos a la Ley de Inclusión 21.015.  

Sabemos que la diversidad nos fortalece. Es por eso por lo que estamos enfocados en crear una fuerza laboral más diversa que represente las comunidades en las que operamos y vivimos, asegurando un ambiente laboral donde cada persona sea incluida y tratada con respeto.  

En ese sentido, estamos comprometidos a realizar un proceso de selección justo, equitativo y accesible para todos. Si tienes algún tipo de discapacidad, por favor escríbenos a inclusion@bhp.com para poder ajustar nuestro proceso

jobs.title: Supervisor Security & Emergency Management | Kwinana | Monday-Friday
jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

Come and be a part of this success.

About the Role

The Health, Safety, Security & Emergency Management team at WA Nickel is a supportive, inclusive and high-performing team dedicated to protecting the safety, health and wellbeing of our people. We are seeking an experienced
Security and Emergency Management Supervisor
to help lead and enhance emergency response, security and medical readiness capability across our Southern Operations.

Reporting to the HSS Superintendent Southern Operations and West Musgrave, this Perth-based role (Kwinana) includes regular travel to Kalgoorlie, Kambalda and West Musgrave. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact, leading and developing teams that play a critical role in keeping our people safe every day.

As a visible and trusted leader, you will work closely with Emergency Services Officers, Security Officers, HSS leaders and operational teams to strengthen emergency response capability, uplift team performance and drive continuous improvement across the asset. The role combines operational leadership, capability development, governance and stakeholder engagement, making it ideal for someone who enjoys coaching and mentoring others while influencing positive safety outcomes.

You will lead the ongoing development of emergency response, security and medical readiness programs, ensuring teams have the skills, confidence and support required to respond effectively to a range of situations. jobs.description:
Sobre Escondida | BHP 

En Chile, nuestra operación tiene una identidad única que refleja nuestro compromiso de crear un futuro más sostenible. Escondida, ubicada en el desierto de Atacama, es la mayor productora de cobre del mundo y un motor clave para la transición hacia energías limpias. Operamos con energía 100 % renovable y agua desalinizada, liderando la minería responsable e innovadora que conecta Chile con el futuro global.

¿Por qué Escondida | BHP?

Porque en Escondida, operada por BHP, creemos que nuestro propósito va mucho más allá de la minería: trabajamos para mejorar vidas y construir un futuro mejor para todos. Somos operados por una compañía global líder en recursos naturales, con operaciones en más de 90 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo. 

Ser parte de nuestros equipos significa unirte a una empresa que cree en el poder de las ideas valientes, en la fuerza de los equipos diversos y en el impacto positivo que cada persona puede generar. Aquí, tu voz cuenta. Tu crecimiento importa. Y tu trabajo contribuye directamente a transformar el mundo. 

El desafio que te espera

En Escondida | BHP tendrás la oportunidad de desempeñar un rol clave en la identificación, estructura e implementación de iniciativas de transformación que generen valor sostenible para el negocio, actuando como socio estratégico de las Gerencias Operacionales y Funcionales.

Serás una persona fundamental para traducir los desafíos estratégicos definidos por el negocio y la Gerencia de Transformación en oportunidades concretas de mejora, aplicando rigurosamente las prácticas del Business Operating System (BOS), metodologías de resolución estructurada de problemas y gestión del cambio para asegurar la captura sostenida de valor en productividad, costos, inventarios, confiabilidad y desempeño operacional. Tu capacidad para garantizar que las iniciativas bajo tu responsabilidad avancen de manera disciplinada desde la identificación de oportunidades hasta la estabilización de resultados será clave para alcanzar resultados de excelencia en un entorno dinámico y desafiante. 

Principales Responsabilidades

Como Principal Business Optimization, serás responsable de:

Seguridad y Salud:

Ejercer liderazgo visible en terreno, realizando salidas semanales y cruzadas con clientes internos reforzando la cultura de seguridad y la aspiración de cero accidentes.

Brindar soporte de coaching en terreno, promoviendo comportamientos seguros y fortaleciendo competencias en la gestión de riesgos.

Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares y protocolos de salud y seguridad en todas las iniciativas, integrando prácticas preventivas en la estrategia de transformación y protección a las personas junto a la continuidad operacional.

Medioambiente, Sustentabilidad y Valor Social:

Asegurar conexión estratégica entre las iniciativas del portafolio y los compromisos ambientales, sociales y de sustentabilidad, integrando criterios BOS y considerando el entorno como cliente (ambiental, comunitario y legislativo).

Productividad y Costos:

Agregar valor al negocio a través de la excelencia operacional en los procesos de Operación Mina, Desarrollo Mina, Mantenimiento Equipos Moviles y Mantenimiento Equipo Semi - Movil, impulsando la optimización de procesos, la mejora del desempeño operacional y la captura sistemática de oportunidades de transformación, integradas en las prácticas BOS.

Impulsar iniciativas estratégicas que maximicen la productividad y confiabilidad de los procesos de Hauling, Loading y Blasting, optimizando costos operacionales, eliminando restricciones al desempeño y priorizando iniciativas con mayor impacto en la generación de valor y sostenibilidad del negocio.

Lo que esperamos de ti

Buscamos personas que cuenten con:

Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Mina, Metalúrgica, Mecánica, Eléctrica o carrera afín con el proceso.

Al menos 5 años de experiencia laboral en la industria o en gestiones afines con las requeridas

Diplomados y/o cursos en Evaluación de Proyectos.

Diplomados y/o cursos en Comunicación Efectiva.

Dominio en evaluación y priorización de proyectos transformacionales.

Conocimiento integral del proceso Mina a Puerto, así como áreas transversales, para mejorar la visión global y la toma de decisiones estratégicas

Conocimiento de los indicadores del negocio — productividad, costos, LoA y proyecciones financieras.

Conocimiento de benchmarks de otras industrias con potencial de aplicabilidad en minería.

Alta capacidad de análisis de sistemas de costos complejos en toda la línea de valor.

En Escondida | BHP entendemos que para dar lo mejor, necesitas sentirte bien. Por eso, nuestros beneficios están diseñados para acompañarte en cada etapa, cuidando tu salud, impulsando tu desarrollo y promoviendo un equilibrio real entre tu vida personal y laboral.  

- Desarrollo profesional: Formación continua y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.

- Cultura inclusiva: Promovemos un entorno laboral donde cada persona se siente valorada, respetada y libre de expresar su identidad auténtica. 

- Reconocimiento: Te recompensamos por tus pequeños y grandes logros a través de nuestro programa global de reconocimiento Big Thanks | Muchas Gracias. 

¡Y mucho más!

Freeport-McMoRan es una empresa minera internacional líder con sede central en Phoenix, Arizona. Operamos grandes activos, de larga vida, geográficamente diversos con importantes reservas probadas y probables de cobre, oro y molibdeno. La compañía tiene una cartera dinámica de proyectos de operación, expansión y crecimiento en la industria del cobre. Freeport-McMoRan es uno de los mayores productores mundiales de cobre que cotiza en bolsa, el mayor productor mundial de molibdeno y un importante productor de oro.

Lo alentamos a que se tome el tiempo para explorar la oportunidad de tener una carrera en Freeport-McMoRan.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to lead the development and execution of High Voltage (HV) transmission and substation projects supporting our operations in Chile. The successful candidate will oversee technical, engineering, stakeholder, regulatory, and construction activities to ensure safe, efficient, and successful project delivery while meeting schedule, cost, quality, and sustainability objectives.

Lead the engineering, construction, commissioning, and energization activities of HV transmission lines, substations, and MV distribution systems.

Coordinate engineering consultants, contractors, vendors, regulators, and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, quality, and technical standards, as well as applicable Chilean electrical regulations.

Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.

Minimum of 15 years of experience in HV transmission, substations, or large-scale electrical infrastructure projects.

Proven experience leading engineering and construction activities in complex industrial or mining environments.

Knowledge of Chilean electrical regulations and standards applicable to HV/MV systems.

Experience managing contractors, consultants, regulatory agencies, and external stakeholders.

Proficiency in Primavera P6 and/or MS Project, AutoCAD, and MS Office.

Fluent English and Spanish

Previous experience in mining projects and concentrator plant electrical distribution systems.

Knowledge of power system studies, including Power Flow, Harmonics, Motor Starting, Reactive Power Compensation, SCCAF, Energy Quality, and Electromagnetic Transients.

Experience supporting Environmental Impact Studies (EIS) and permitting processes.

Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and team collaboration skills.

Work Location:
Fortescue’s Hedland Operations are located on the traditional lands of the Kariyarra people.

8D/6R

Fortescue is seeking a driven and hands-on Process Engineer to join our high-performing Engineering team in Port Hedland. Working closely with Port Operations, Port Maintenance, Iron Bridge Concentrate Handling and Engineering teams, you will optimise critical materials handling processes and maximise throughput performance.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your technical expertise in a fast-paced operational environment while enjoying a lifestyle-friendly 8/6 roster.

Key Responsibilities

Drive process optimisation initiatives across port operations to improve throughput, sampling accuracy, moisture management and water usage.

Develop and lead test work programs focused on sampling, material characterisation and system performance.

Use process modelling, simulation and data analysis to support decisions relating to shipped moisture, water balance and product grade optimisation.

Collaborate with Port Operations, Port Maintenance, Iron Bridge, Engineering and OEM vendors to identify and deliver process improvements.

Act as the technical liaison across Port Operations, Engineering and the Iron Bridge Concentrate Handling Facility.

Maintain high-quality technical documentation and process design deliverables while ensuring compliance with Fortescue’s Health, Safety, Environment and Quality standards.

Qualifications and Experience

Degree qualification in Chemical, Process or Metallurgical Engineering.

2–5 years’ relevant experience in process engineering, preferably within mining, materials handling or heavy industry.

Sound understanding of bulk materials handling, water usage in processing environments and process optimisation principles.

Experience using process modelling and simulation software.

Proven ability to lead test work programs and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with a strong safety mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Industrial Placement (2027-2028) - Software - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (September 2027 - August 2028) student placement programme within our Formula E Car Development (Software) group. This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates, offering plenty of scope to learn and develop - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience. It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Car Development (Software) group you should be working towards a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related area.

What you will do

During the placement you will take on responsibilities such as: 

Working as an integral part of the Car Development team. 

Developing a new generation of software tools, APIs, and packages using the modern .NET stack (C# - candidates do not need prior experience with the language but should be confident programmers who understand core principles and are eager to learn), cloud technologies (Azure, AWS) and containerization (Docker, WSL containers). This will support the standardisation and automation of our applications including:  

Trackside car ECU monitoring/configuration and sensor calibration 

Trackside data processing 

Cloud-based technical document management 

Cloud-based event management 

Component lifing support 

Tooling to support performance and system engineer workflows 

Supporting the development and maintenance of databases in SQL (T-SQL, Postgres) and NoSQL (MongoDB). 

Writing unit, integration and mutation tests to ensure high code quality. 

Experiment with agentic coding using cutting edge frontier AI models with generous budgets (like everyone, we’re still figuring this one out!). 

Our goal is to reduce the time it takes for engineers to make valuable performance decisions over a race weekend.

Submitting your application

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

• Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

• Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take. 

• Relevant leisure pursuits and activities. 

• Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

Next Steps

Those students that are shortlisted will be invited to attend an assessment.  It is expected that the student takes sole responsibility for making suitable travel and accommodation arrangements.

Our Commitment

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. At Fortescue Zero we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences and skills.  

Fortescue Zero is an equal opportunity employer who values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability, 

We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.

jobs.title: Garage Technician - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

An opportunity has arisen for a Garage Technician to join the Jaguar TCS Racing department in a rapidly expanding and exciting work environment.

About the role

To provide the workshop and trackside garage technician function, in support of the Jaguar Formula E Teams daily operational goals.

What you will do

Operate as a Garage Technician both at the factory and at trackside events.

Manage the team’s wheel and tyre inventory in collaboration with Engineering, including preparation, TPMS unit fitting, and event management (session pressure adjustments, tyre running, supplier/engineering liaison).

Plan and administer team truck operations, including loading, inventory control, supplier liaison, and unit booking for events.

Maintain all team consumable stocks in liaison with Chief Mechanics, ensuring timely re-stock ordering and follow-up.

Oversee the team pit equipment and off-car hardware in liaison with Chief/#1 Mechanics, ensuring readiness, proactive daily maintenance, repairs, and correct storage.

Support the assembly and maintenance of race and test garage infrastructures, including repair and upkeep of garage equipment and packhorses.

Assist with freight operations, including organisation, packing, loading/unloading of shipments, and preparation of documentation (Carnet lists, truck inventories).

Act as the key contact for storage of pit equipment (current and historic), maintaining PDN documents and inventory records.

Ensure all Jaguar Racing workshop, race, and test locations remain organised, clean, and operationally efficient, utilising offsite storage as needed.

Escalate equipment or operational issues to management promptly.

Adhere to Jaguar Formula E and wider business processes and policies.

Comply with safety regulations at all venues.

About you

Motorsport event garage operational experience (both factory and trackside).

Experience in tyre management at race / test events, including pressure adjustments and liaison with engineers and suppliers.

Strong knowledge of race truck preparation / operation and stock keeping.

Familiarity with road and air freight operations.

A confident, self-starting team player, adaptable to the fast-paced, dynamic requirements of race and test environments.

What is in it for you?

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Aviva Pension

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus
public holidays and the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days per year

Childcare Benefits

Free on-site gym access and discounted national memberships

jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (September 2026 - August 2027) student placement programme within our Formula E Design Office. This is an exciting opportunity where you will work with highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates who you can learn and develop with - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience.  It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Design Office us you should be working towards a degree in Mathematics, Mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive or Motor Sport Engineering.  An understanding of vehicle dynamics, CAD design, particularly Siemens NX and programming would be advantageous.

What you will do

During the Formula E Design Office placement, you will take on responsibilities such as:

Design of various components, both mechanical and composite, including car components and prototype and test equipment.

Possible requirement for attendance at various on-site test events such as chassis or component testing.

Possible requirement for attendance at a track test day or two during pre-season testing for the season(s)

Submitting your application

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

• Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

• Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take. 

• Relevant leisure pursuits and activities. 

• Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

jobs.title: Principal - Energy & Power
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Work Location: 
Perth CBD. Fortescue’s Perth office is located on the traditional lands of the Whadjuk people.

Roster: 
Monday to Friday

An opportunity has arisen to join Fortescue’s Energy Operations business unit in a pivotal senior role within commercial energy management. The ideal candidate will be an experienced commercial or technical manager in the energy or resources industry willing to step up to the challenge of being part of an innovative and results driven organisation that is leading the world in decarbonising heavy industry.

As Principal – Energy, you will lead the commercial management of high value, business critical gas and electricity agreements, applying your commercial and technical expertise to support Fortescue’s decarbonisation strategy.

This role is central to shaping and executing commercial strategies that enable the transition of Fortescue’s energy portfolio, ensuring value delivery, regulatory alignment, and risk mitigation. You will engage directly with senior leadership, regulatory bodies, and strategic counterparties, operating at the forefront of Australia’s evolving energy landscape.

We are seeking an experienced commercial or technical leader from the energy or resources sector who is motivated by innovation, decarbonisation, and delivering measurable outcomes in a complex and fast-evolving environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial strategy

Lead end-to-end procurement activities across the Energy portfolio, including supporting Fortescue’s decarbonisation initiatives.

Develop and execute commercial negotiation strategies for complex, high-risk, high-value energy contracts which drive value for Fortescue and our supplier partners.

Provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership on gas and electricity market positioning and contracting structures.

Identify and deliver value optimisation opportunities across Fortescue’s energy agreements.

Regulatory and market engagement

Operate as a key liaison in strategic internal and external meetings including the Clean Energy Regulator, the Pilbara Independent System Operator, the Economic Regulation Authority and other regulatory bodies, managing the relationship and developing expertise.

Develop deep expertise in relevant regulatory frameworks to support Fortescue’s energy transition.

Provide internal advisory support on regulatory compliance, legislative developments, and governance requirements.

Contract and relationship management

Oversee contract lifecycle management to ensure performance, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation.

Manage strategic supplier relationships to deliver value, resilience, and long-term partnership outcomes.

Proactively assess and manage commercial risks through robust governance and compliance practices.

Leadership

Build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure full alignment of procurement effort with business objectives.

Represent Fortescue in strategic internal and external forums.

Provide leadership and mentoring to team members, supporting capability development and talent management initiatives. 

Qualifications and Experience

Significant experience in the energy or resources sector, specialising in commercial negotiation and contract management.

Electricity, gas and regulatory experience is essential.

Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market complexity into actionable commercial outcomes.

Strong influencing and communication skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders and regulators.

Highly organised with strong self-management and prioritisation capabilities.

Agile mindset with the ability to challenge conventional thinking and operate effectively in ambiguity.

Resilient, adaptable, and outcome focused.

Tertiary qualifications in engineering, commerce, law or related fields will be highly desirable.

Ability to effectively operate within the governance and compliance frameworks of a large ASX-listed organisation.

About Us

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

jobs.description:
About Us

Fortescue is both a proud West Australian company and a global green solutions business. We are recognised for our culture, innovation and industry-leading development of infrastructure, mining assets and green energy initiatives.

Our Opportunity

Work Location:

Perth Office – Fortescue’s Perth office is located on the traditional lands of the Whadjuk Noongar people

Roster:

 Monday to Friday

We are seeking a Training Specialist Critical Minerals to lead the development and continuous improvement of training and competency systems across Fortescue Critical Minerals Exploration.

This role will provide practical training leadership across Australian and international projects, ensuring employees and contractors have the capability and competency to work safely and consistently. Working closely with operational leaders, Health and Safety teams, central Training and external providers, you will develop and deliver fit-for-purpose learning solutions across diverse and remote operating environments.

The role will suit an experienced training professional who can work independently, influence stakeholders and translate operational risks and technical requirements into practical and effective learning solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain a risk-based training and competency framework aligned with Fortescue systems, central Training standards and project requirements

Identify capability gaps and establish training plans across Australian and international Critical Minerals Exploration projects

Coordinate the delivery of practical training and competency programs for employees and contractors

Maintain consistent processes for training records, competency verification, trainer and assessor authorisation, refreshers and assurance evidence

Develop or source practical learning solutions for exploration activities and critical risks

Support multilingual, culturally appropriate and accessible learning solutions across diverse operating environments

Coordinate with central Training, Health and Safety, operational leaders, contractors and external training providers

Ensure effective onboarding and induction processes are implemented and reviewed for employees and contractors

Monitor training completion, competency, quality and effectiveness, and provide clear reporting on performance and trends

Drive continuous improvement using feedback, incidents, operational learnings and assurance findings.

Qualifications and Experience

Substantial experience in training, competency or workforce capability within mining, exploration, resources, construction or another high-risk industry

Experience implementing training systems across dispersed or remote operations

Strong knowledge of training needs analysis, competency assurance and verification of competency principles

Knowledge of adult learning, assessment practices and learning management systems

Experience developing risk-based training solutions for high-risk and remote work environments

Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing and facilitation skills, including experience supporting leaders, contractors and culturally diverse workforces

Ability to translate operational risks and technical requirements into practical, accessible learning solutions

Strong program planning, prioritisation, coordination, data analysis and reporting skills

Relevant qualification in training and assessment or a related discipline; Certificate IV in Training and Assessment or equivalent may be desirable

International or multilingual operating experience and relevant high-risk, emergency response, four-wheel-driving or exploration competencies are desirable.

Our Commitment

Fortescue is deeply committed to providing a safe culture that builds respect, fosters inclusiveness, and values diversity. jobs.title: Early Career Pathways - Supply Chain Internships
jobs.description:
About Woodside Energy

We know great results come from our people feeling valued, getting the support they need to reach their full potential and working in a positive work environment. We recognise that enduring, meaningful relationships with communities are fundamental to maintaining our licence to operate.

Technology and innovation are essential to our long-term sustainability. We are growing our carbon and new energy businesses using technology to reduce emissions and the carbon footprint of our products. We are working to improve energy efficiency, offset emissions, reduce emissions intensity and explore options for lower-carbon energy. Woodside led the development of the LNG industry in Australia and is applying this same pioneering spirit to solving future energy challenges globally.

Refer to our corporate website for more information about our different locations and projects: 
https://www.woodside.com/what-we-do

About the Program

The Supply Chain Summer Internship Program is part of Woodside’s USA Early Career Pathways initiative and is designed to build a sustainable pipeline of future supply chain, contracts, procurement, logistics, and commercial talent.

The program provides undergraduate students with hands-on, real-world experience supporting Woodside’s U.S. operations, projects, and business activities. Internship opportunities may be available within Contracts & Procurement teams supporting Woodside’s corporate functions, Louisiana LNG (LALNG), and Gulf of America (GOA) operations.

Depending on business needs and academic background, interns may gain experience across strategic sourcing, procurement, contracting, supplier management, materials management, logistics, inventory planning, supply chain analytics, market research, cost analysis, contract administration, tendering and bid evaluation, purchase order management, performance reporting, and supply chain risk management.

Interns may also support the development and execution of sourcing and contracting strategies, analyze supplier and market data, assist with commercial evaluations, monitor contract and supplier performance, and contribute to initiatives focused on cost efficiency, operational reliability, responsible sourcing, and continuous improvement.

Interns will work alongside experienced supply chain, contracts, procurement, commercial, project, and operations professionals while developing analytical, commercial, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving capabilities. They will also gain exposure to how supply chain activities support major energy projects and day-to-day operations across LNG and deepwater oil assets.

The internship serves as a primary feeder into Woodside’s future graduate and early-career programs and supports Woodside’s broader workforce and capability planning strategy in the United States.

Qualifications

Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field

Rising junior or senior with an expected graduation date of Spring 2028 through Spring 2029 

Enrolled in an accredited college or university for the full duration of the 2027 internship 

Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.30 

Available for a minimum of twelve (12) consecutive weeks during Summer 2027 

Authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., F-1) 

Agree to complete pre-employment screening and understand that correspondence will primarily be conducted via email 

Agree not to utilize AI or AI-assisted tools during any part of the application or interview process

Recognition and Reward

What you can expect from us:

Commitment to your ongoing development, including on-the-job opportunities, formal programs and coaching

Values led culture with a focus on creating a psychologically and physically safe work environment

You will also ensure that the goals and objectives are achieved while promoting and respecting Agnico Eagle’s values, Health & Safety Code of Conduct and the environment.

Department Overview

The Open Pit & Site Services Department is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant management of all contracted open pit mining activities and site infrastructure services at the Upper Beaver Project. The department oversees contractor performance, mine production coordination, earthworks execution, water management infrastructure, and operational readiness activities that support both mining and site-wide operations.

Open Pit Mining

Given the scale of the open pit operation, primary mining activities will be conducted to external mining contractors. The department will provide owner oversight, technical coordination, planning integration, and operational governance to ensure production, cost, safety, and environmental objectives are achieved;

Ensure compliance with mine plans, pit designs, geotechnical requirements, and operational procedures;

Verify contractor equipment availability and productivity;

Support short- and medium-term mine planning activities;

Develop and maintain ore stockpile management strategies;

Manage waste rock storage areas and temporary material stockpiles.

Site Services

Support emergency preparedness and response activities;

Plan, construct, and maintain all operational roads and access routes while ensuring road conditions support safe and efficient equipment operation;

Coordinate snow removal, dust suppression, grading, and drainage control activities;

Execute site-wide earthworks required to support mining, processing, and infrastructure development;

Operate and maintain the Water Treatment Plant through direct management or contracted services;

Ensure all activities comply with environmental permits and site management plans , while minimizing impacts to land, water, and surrounding ecosystems.

jobs.description:
Intern - Mining Engineer

AMAT

Glade Spring, Virginia, United States

Req ID: 528354

Appalachian Aggregates, LLC, a CRH Company, is located in southern West Virginia employing more than 100 employees during the construction months. As a stone producer with multiple locations located in the central and southeastern areas of West Virginia, Appalachian Aggregates, LLC supplies stone for ready-mix concrete, asphalt pavement, roadways, commercial buildings, as well as the private markets. Appalachian Aggregates, LLC prides itself on its ability to provide services to many customers in various geographical locations. In addition, by being a part of the CRH Americas family, we are a proud reflection of the hundreds of family businesses, local and regional companies and mid to large sized enterprises that come together to form CRH Americas. CRH Americas is the number one asphalt producer, the third-largest aggregates producer, and one of the top 5 ready mixed concrete producers in the United States. CRH Americas operates with a decentralized, diversified structure, letting you work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large enterprise.

Pay Range: $20-24.00 per hour

Position Overview

An Aggregate Mine Engineering Intern will be given the opportunity to work with a vertically integrated company and experience multiple aspects of our aggregate mining business as well as other lines of business.

Key Responsibilities (Essential Duties and Functions)

The duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

Working with company staff to determine solutions to common issues.

Work with Operations Manager/accounting on monthly projections.

Learn the administrative requirements of the business through hands-on experience.

Work with multiple departments on special projects as needed.

Assist Plant Foreperson with establishment of field calculations and cost yields communication and accountabilities.

Assist with tracking and recording fuel usage, hour meter readings, and mileage reporting for equipment.

Shadow operations personnel to learn operational planning and aggregate objectives.

Learn standards and procedures of aggregate budgeting, production planning, staffing, and inventory levels.

Learn objectives of aggregate sales by learning about various materials available in quarries and pits.

Learn basic operations and logistics.

Survey and Engineering duties

Complete exploration in mine planning and design

Quality Control/Quality Assurance

Other Requirements:

Display a professional and courteous attitude to co-workers, supervisors, and the general public at all times.

Must be willing to travel and work away from home when required.

Must be willing to work nights and weekends when necessary.

Report to the assigned job site ready to begin work at the designated start time.

Strict adherence to safety requirements and procedures as outlined in the Manual of Safety Practices and Procedures.

Strict adherence to Company policies and procedures as outlined in the Company Book of Policies.

Willingness to work in a team environment and assist co-workers or supervisors with other duties as required.

Timely and regular attendance is an expectation of performance for all Company employees. Employees will be held accountable for adhering to their workplace schedule.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

Education and Experience

Working towards a mine engineering degree from a college or technical school. Must be proficient with Windows, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Language Skills:

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively to customers or employees of organization.

Mathematical Skills:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to climb or balance. The employee is occasionally required to sit and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move more than 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works near moving mechanical parts and in outside weather conditions and is regularly exposed to wet, humid condition airborne particles, and extreme heat or cold. The employee is occasionally exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud and may require protective equipment.

The statements included in this job description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform the job. Other duties may be assigned as required. Requirements for this job are subject to modification by the Company and its designees, and reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Advisor, Business Performance and LOM Planning
jobs.description:
WHAT DOES AGNICO EAGLE VALUE?

At Agnico Eagle, our values never waver. We believe in trust, respect, equity, family and responsibility. Why? Because they express who we are, and they have helped us succeed in business for over 60 years. We value
you
- your unique set of skills and experience. We value your willingness to build those skills and make a meaningful contribution to our company. And, we value your commitment to treat every person on our team with respect, helping us to operate safely, protect the environment and make a positive contribution to our local communities.

ABOUT OUR OPERATION

Canadian-based and led, Agnico Eagle is Canada's largest mining company and the second largest gold producer in the world. It produces precious metals from operations in Canada, Australia, Finland and Mexico and has a pipeline of high-quality exploration and development projects. Agnico Eagle is a partner of choice within the mining industry, recognized globally for its leading sustainability practices. Agnico Eagle was founded in 1957 and has consistently created value for its shareholders, declaring a cash dividend every year since 1983.

Want to learn more about our operations and projects?
Click here
!

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE:

As the Advisor, Business Performance & LOM Planning, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Business Performance team in executing and continuously improving the Company’s global planning cycle, capital cost management, and operational cost performance framework. Reporting to the Senior Advisor, Business Performance and LOM planning, your role ensures consistency and completeness of the corporate planning processes, provides analytical support around both capital and operating costs, and assists with the development and implantation of tools, insights and methodologies that enhance decision-making across the organization.

You will work collaboratively with Operations, Corporate Finance, and the Technical Corporate Team (TCT) to ensure high-quality inputs, alignment with corporate standards, and strong governance across planning and performance activities.

In this role, you will require strong analytical capabilities, an advanced business acumen, and the ability to work cross-functionally while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, structure, and strategic insight. You will ensure that the goals and objectives are achieved while promoting and respecting Agnico Eagle’s values, Health & Safety Code of Conduct, and the environment.

Corporate Planning Cycle

Assist with the execution and governance of the full corporate planning cycle, including the Scenarios, Budget/LOM, and ELOM processes;

Coordinate scenario planning calendars, deliverables, and communications with sites, TCT and Corporate Finance;

Deliver meaningful cost and performance insights by leveraging rigorous analysis and advanced reporting capabilities;

Review and analyze Scenarios, Budget/LOM and ELOM submissions to ensure completeness and accuracy of data provided in the EPM, and provide timely data to key stakeholders as necessary;

Support Corporate Finance in consolidating Budget/LOM outputs as needed;

Assist with Quality Control documentation for all aspects of the planning process, from Scenarios to approved Budgets.

Capital Allocation Process

Assist the Senior Advisor with the pre-screening of site capital business cases, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and overall quality, as well as alignment with financial and operational guidelines;

Develop a strong knowledge of the Planisware capital tool to aid mine site and corporate users as required;

Work closely with mine site/regional capital allocation champions, along with Corporate Finance, to assist with the continued optimization of the capital process;

Maintain tools, templates and governance frameworks around capital planning and business case evaluation;

Prepare summaries and analysis for Business Performance team and the Capital Allocation Committee.

Cost Performance & Business Optimization

Assist in producing detailed cost and performance analyses, identifying drivers, trends, and opportunities for improvement;

Support the continuous improvement of business performance methodologies, tools, and reporting systems;

Assist in the development and maintenance of dashboards, reporting structures and tracking tools for the Business Performance program;

Aid with the preparation of analytical support to Regional VPs and site leadership regarding Continuous Improvement initiatives.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Minimum 7-10 years experience in Finance, Corporate Planning, Mining Operations, Business Performance, or fields;

Bachelor's degree in finance, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline; advanced degree or professional designation is an asset;

Strong understanding of financial modelling, mining processes, cost structures, and operational drivers;

Full professional proficiency in English; proficiency in French and/or Spanish is an advantage;

Ability and willingness to travel occasionally;

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking capabilities;

Ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels and functions;

High degree of attention to detail while being able to manage competing priorities;

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to summarize complex information concisely and efficiently;

Proficiency with corporate financial systems and reporting tools, along with experience with dashboards and reporting frameworks.

Your Work Schedule:

Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday from our Corporate Office in Toronto, ON. Occasional visits to the site may also be required.

Compensation Statement

In accordance with applicable legislation, the expected compensation includes base salary and potential bonus opportunity. Your individual pay will reflect your skills and experience while remaining competitive within the local market.

jobs.description:
A Anglo American é uma empresa global de mineração com sede em Londres, presente em diversos países e com uma história de mais de 100 anos, com o propósito de reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Na América Latina, nossas operações desempenham um papel estratégico no fornecimento responsável de recursos essenciais para o desenvolvimento do mundo – com atuação no Brasil, Chile e Peru, sempre pautadas por inovação, segurança, sustentabilidade e alto desempenho.

No Brasil, operamos o sistema Minas-Rio, que integra mina, usina, mineroduto e porto. As operações do Peru e do Chile se concentram na produção de cobre em larga escala, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma transição energética sustentável.

Acreditamos que nossas pessoas são o maior diferencial competitivo. Investimos no desenvolvimento de talentos, promovendo ambientes inclusivos e colaborativos, onde diferentes perspectivas constroem soluções melhores para os desafios do presente e do futuro.

Na Anglo American, valorizamos quem deseja crescer com propósito e gerar impacto real.

Como
Técnica/Técnico Manutenção, Inspeção e Instrumentação Filtragem III
você será responsável por elaborar o planejamento das atividades de manutenção e inspeção dos equipamentos elétricos na planta de Filtragem de Rejeitos e Rejeitoduto.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Realizar as inspeções sensitivas em equipamentos e instrumentos conforme rota;

Emitir nota de manutenção das anomalias e melhorias encontradas durante a inspeção e relatórios de turno;

Fazer planejamento prévio das necessidades de manutenção para os ativos considerando mão de obra, materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos auxiliares;

Sanear a carteira de serviços;

Fazer interface com os programadores e demais planejadores para nivelamento das prioridades;

Participar das reuniões de programação;

Encaminhar necessidades de revisão e criação de planos de manutenção de sua especialidade visando manter a estratégia de manutenção sempre atualizada;

Atualização do Sistema de MRP com dados de qualidade, acompanhando os indicadores de utilização do sistema;

Cadastrar os materiais necessários a manutenção, junto a equipe de suprimentos com PDM's adequados a gestão de cadastro da Empresa;

Criar ordens de manutenção, notas de avaria, planos de manutenção, listas de tarefa, listas técnicas, com nivelamento de capacidade dentro do MRP;

Manter atualizado o parque de materiais dentro do sistema MRP para consulta das demais áreas de interface;

Buscar a melhoria continua das atividades de planejamento e inspeção sensitiva junto aos clientes internos;

Acompanhar os relatórios de custo visando aderência com as apropriações de sua especialidade;

Desenvolver de fornecedores estratégicos ao negocio em parceria à equipe de Suprimentos;

Fiscalizar os contratos necessários ao planejamento de manutenção da planta;

Executar atividades com autonomia para tomada de decisões, de forma a garantir o andamento do processo, atuando com liderança nos processos.

Repassar conhecimentos para os Técnicos menos experientes como forma de capacitá-los para execução dos processos internos.

Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Médio Completo;

Ensino Técnico em Elétrica, Eletrotécnica, Instrumentação, Automação e/ou áreas afins;

CRT ou CFT Ativo;

Experiência em Instrumentação;

Conhecimento em SAP e MS Project;

Desejável Cursos de aperfeiçoamento técnico aplicados na área de Manutenção;

Desejável Cursando Ensino Superior em áreas afins.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa empenhada em fazer nossas crenças e valores acontecerem de verdade. O objetivo é proporcionar a você um ambiente de qualidade, diverso e seguro para que você desenvolva o seu melhor. Para isso, oferecemos os melhores benefícios:

·
Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental:

Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (extensivo a você e seus dependentes), além de Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional

·
Especial para você e sua família:

Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação!

· Espaço para ser você mesmo:

Fique à vontade para participar de nossos Grupos de Afinidades e dos eventos incríveis da Semana da Diversidade!

· Para seu futuro:

Plano de Previdência Privada diferenciado

· E ainda:

Transporte fretado, refeições no local de trabalho, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, Apoio e orientação: Jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Como estamos comprometidos com a sua segurança?

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa com segurança após um dia de trabalho. Para que isso aconteça, temos os padrões de segurança mais rigorosos do setor. Além disso, também estamos investindo continuamente em novas tecnologias, de drones a análise de dados, que estão ajudando a tornar a mineração mais segura.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, no qual valorizamos e respeitamos cada colega por quem ela/ele é. Acolhemos e celebramos todas as identidades de gênero, etnias, idades, espiritualidades, orientações sexuais, deficiências, classes sociais, estilos de vida e habilidades. Grupos de Afinidades: espaços seguros para discutir, refletir e construir ações de inclusão e diversidade no âmbito da equidade de gênero, LGBTQIAP+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e geracional.

Nós queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e sintam-se abertos para trazer seu “verdadeiro eu” para o trabalho.

*Reforçamos que todas as vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

Para se candidatar a essa vaga, realize seu cadastro on-line, e anexe seu currículo no ato da inscrição.

jobs.title: SOLDADOR MINERODUTO I
jobs.description:
Somos a Anglo American, uma empresa global de mineração diversificada cujo propósito é "reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas".

Acreditamos que valores como
segurança, cuidado e respeito, responsabilidade, integridade, inovação e colaboração
são essenciais para alcançar resultados de excelência e vivemos isso no nosso dia a dia.

Valorizamos a diversidade e reconhecemos que são as diferentes histórias, ideias e experiências que impulsionam nosso crescimento. Aqui, cada pessoa importa.

No Brasil, atuamos com minério de ferro em Conceição do Mato Dentro (MG), de onde parte nosso mineroduto até o Porto do Açu (RJ). Nosso escritório corporativo fica em Belo Horizonte.

Queremos conhecer a sua trajetória. Vem crescer com a gente.

Como
Soldador Mineroduto I
você será responsável por executar serviços de soldagem menos complexos, em peças ou estruturas de máquinas e/ou equipamentos diversos, visando a sua recuperação para restabelecer o funcionamento adequado de acordo com as ordens de serviços recebidas e normas técnicas.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Receber, executar e apropriar as OM - Ordens de Manutenção de soldagem, conferindo peças e recursos necessários (ferramentas, instrumentos, local apropriado, dentre outros), a fim de executar as intervenções necessárias, conforme especificação e prioridade.

Preparar e limpar as peças e/ou partes a serem soldadas, conferir as medidas, soldar as peças e executar acabamento.

Executar serviços inerentes a soldagem e oxicorte, recuperando, ajustando e confeccionando peças e outros componentes para o Mineroduto, conforme a necessidade da área.

Fabricar peças de caldeiraria e equipamentos para o Mineroduto, como tubulações, estruturas, dentre outros, conforme necessidade da área e orientação do superior imediato.

Selecionar o tipo de material a ser empregado, consultando o desenho, especificações e outras instruções, para garantir a segurança da soldagem e/ou fabricação.

Manter a limpeza e organização da oficina de solda, garantir a correta utilização, conservação e armazenamento dos gases, ferramentas manuais e equipamentos de solda.

Executar soldas com eletrodos revestidos.

Manter registro dos serviços realizados, bem como suas especificações, visando apoiar a supervisão na elaboração de relatórios de controle.

Executar atividades de pouca complexidade em atendimento as demandas recebidas, sob a orientação de um profissional mais experiente.

Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Médio Completo com curso profissionalizante em Soldador Industrial;

Desejável formação Técnica em mecânica ou eletromecânica;

Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno 4X4;

jobs.title: Coordenador(a) Compras
jobs.description:
Mais do que uma responsabilidade, Segurança é nosso valor. Junte-se a nós nesse compromisso!

Segura. Inteligente. Sustentável. Provavelmente, estas não são as primeiras palavras que você normalmente associa à mineração. Mas a Anglo American não é uma empresa de mineração comum.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com foco no propósito de "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas". Somos incondicionais diante a segurança, saúde e bem-estar de nossos empregados, seja no trabalho, em casa, e nas comunidades onde trabalhamos.

Nosso objetivo é liderar o setor investindo em inovação para proteger as pessoas, que são o coração de nossos negócios. Nossas equipes assumem a responsabilidade por suas próprias ações e dos demais, trabalham de forma colaborativa e sempre demonstram cuidado e respeito.

Com sede em Londres, Reino Unido, e operações localizadas em todo o mundo, a Anglo American é realmente uma empresa global. Empregamos mais de 60.000 colegas em todo o mundo e gerenciamos operações de mineração na África do Sul, América do Norte e do Sul e Austrália.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado nos estados de Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações nos municípios de Barro Alto e Niquelândia, em Goiás. Além disso, temos estrutura corporativa localizada em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e nossa crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Você será responsável por liderar a estratégia de abastecimento de categorias específicas e CAPEX da organização, assegurando a disponibilidade dos bens e serviços necessários para suportar as operações industriais, corporativas e de infraestrutura, com foco em geração de valor, governança, conformidade, competitividade de custos e gestão de riscos.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de compradores e analistas, garantindo alta performance, engajamento e alinhamento às prioridades da organização.

Liderar a transformação de uma equipe de compras transacional para uma equipe de gestão de categorias estratégicas;

Definir e implementar estratégias de Category Management para categorias indiretas, incluindo serviços operacionais, manutenção, MRO, facilities, tecnologia da informação, logística de apoio, engenharia, projetos CAPEX e serviços corporativos;

Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas operacionais, meio ambiente, manutenção, engenharia, tecnologia, recursos humanos, finanças e demais stakeholders para garantir atendimento eficiente às demandas do negócio.

Conduzir processos estratégicos de sourcing, negociação e contratação visando otimização do custo total de propriedade (TCO), mitigação de riscos e geração de valor sustentável.

Desenvolver e implementar modelos de gestão de fornecedores e contratos, monitorando indicadores de desempenho, segurança, qualidade, compliance e nível de serviço.

Garantir aderência às políticas corporativas, requisitos de governança, controles internos e legislações aplicáveis.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, padronização, consolidação de fornecedores e captura de sinergias entre operações e áreas corporativas.

Liderar iniciativas de produtividade, redução de custos, inovação e transformação da cadeia de suprimentos.

Promover o desenvolvimento do mercado fornecedor local e a geração de valor compartilhado junto às comunidades e regiões onde a empresa atua.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Logística, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerada diferencial.

Experiência sólida em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement e Category Management.

Experiência na gestão de categorias indiretas, contratos de serviços e CAPEX será um diferencial;

Vivência em negociações complexas e de alto valor agregado;

Necessário Inglês avançado;

Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Belo Horizonte.

jobs.title: Lubrificadora I - Exclusiva para mulheres com deficiência
jobs.description:
Na Anglo American, acreditamos no potencial das mulheres para transformar o futuro da mineração.

Somos uma empresa global de mineração diversificada, movida pelo propósito de
reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas
. E sabemos que essa transformação acontece quando diferentes talentos, histórias e perspectivas têm espaço para crescer e prosperar.

Por isso, estamos fortalecendo a presença feminina em nossas operações e convidamos mulheres que queiram construir uma trajetória sólida, desafiadora e cheia de oportunidades a fazer parte do nosso time.

Vivemos diariamente valores que fazem a diferença:
segurança, cuidado e respeito, responsabilidade, integridade, inovação e colaboração
. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente onde sua voz é valorizada, seu desenvolvimento é incentivado e suas conquistas são reconhecidas.

No Brasil, atuamos com minério de ferro em
Conceição do Mato Dentro (MG)
, de onde parte nosso mineroduto até o
Porto do Açu (RJ)
, além de contarmos com nosso escritório corporativo em
Belo Horizonte (MG)
.

Se você busca um lugar onde possa crescer profissionalmente, contribuir com seu talento e fazer parte de uma empresa comprometida com a diversidade e a inclusão, queremos conhecer a sua história.

Venha ocupar o seu espaço, desenvolver sua carreira e construir o futuro com a gente.

Você será responsável por executar serviços de lubrificação preventiva, corretiva ou programada em máquinas, equipamentos, ferramentas e outros dispositivos da Empresa, conforme programação estabelecida ou solicitações de serviços recebidas.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

Lubrificar máquinas, veículos e equipamentos à graxa e à óleo, conforme plano de lubrificação preestabelecido e Ordem de Serviço – OS, visando aumentar a vida útil dos mesmos.

Efetuar troca dos filtros de ar e óleo, conforme diferencial de pressão detectado por meio de equipamento específico (manômetro), indicação da sala de controle e/ou alarme sonoro e luminoso, visando manter o bom funcionamento do equipamento.

Abastecer o reservatórios e componentes com óleos específicos, de acordo com a descrição do equipamento, visando manter o nível ideal para operação.

Abastecer o reservatório de lubrificação centralizada com graxa, de acordo com descrição do equipamento, visando manter o nível ideal para operação.

Abastecer o reservatório de unidade de tratamento de ar comprimido com óleo hidráulico, visando manter lubrificação dos componentes montados na linha de ar comprimido.

Limpar filtros, telas magnéticas e varetas na troca de óleo, evitando contaminar peças com impurezas que prejudiquem o bom funcionamento dos componentes dos veículos, máquinas e equipamentos.

Cumprir as normas de segurança do trabalho, com utilização de ferramentas e participação em programas corporativos como: ATS (Análise de Trabalho Seguro), DDS, FALAAD.

Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança e Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

Ensino Médio completo

Curso de Mecânica, Noções Básicas de Mecânica ou Noções Básicas de Lubrificação é diferencial

CNH - Categoria C é diferencial

Necessário disponibilidade para atuar em turno 4x4

Vaga exclusiva para mulheres com deficiência

Na Anglo American, acreditamos que as mulheres têm um papel fundamental na construção do futuro da mineração. Estamos ampliando a presença feminina em nossas operações e investindo em um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo, seguro e acolhedor para que você possa crescer, se desenvolver e construir uma carreira de sucesso.

Cuidamos de você e de quem importa para você

Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, sua qualidade de vida e sua família:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para você e seus dependentes

Wellhub (Gympass), Assistência Psicológica e aplicativo de saúde emocional

Vale-alimentação, Auxílio-creche, Programa Família e Brinquedo de Natal

Previdência Privada diferenciada para planejar seu futuro

Transporte fretado, refeições no local, Seguro de Vida e remuneração variável

Apoio jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico

Sua segurança vem em primeiro lugar

Nada é mais importante para nós do que garantir que você volte para casa em segurança todos os dias. Por isso, adotamos os mais rigorosos padrões de segurança do setor e investimos continuamente em tecnologia e inovação para tornar nosso ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais seguro.

Um ambiente onde você pode ser você mesma

Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que diferentes histórias, experiências e perspectivas tornam nossa empresa mais forte. Promovemos uma cultura de respeito, pertencimento e inclusão, apoiada por Grupos de Afinidade e iniciativas voltadas à equidade de gênero, diversidade LGBTQIAPN+, etnia, pessoas com deficiência e diversidade geracional.

Queremos que você se sinta valorizada, respeitada e confiante para desenvolver todo o seu potencial.

Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas pelo INSS.

Nosso processo seletivo

Para participar, basta realizar sua inscrição online e anexar seu currículo.

De forma geral, o processo contempla as etapas de inscrição, análise curricular, entrevistas, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão.

Fique atenta aos seus canais de contato — e-mail, telefone e WhatsApp —, pois toda a comunicação sobre o processo será realizada por meio deles.

Venha construir o futuro da mineração com a gente

Se você busca desenvolvimento, protagonismo e a oportunidade de fazer parte de uma empresa que acredita no talento feminino, queremos conhecer a sua história.

Vem crescer com a Anglo American.

jobs.title: Assistant Store Manager
jobs.description:
De Beers London is the ultimate diamond jewellery House, globally recognised for its leadership and expertise in diamonds. jobs.title: Commercial Director
jobs.description:
Commercial Director

About the company:

In the coming decades, our world needs substantially more critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago, because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is a leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to make discoveries faster—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. We made our first discovery—Mingomba, one of the world’s largest undeveloped high-grade copper deposits—after spending materially less than the industry average. This asset is expected to operate for decades, and be a leading global copper supplier. KoBold is actively running exploration programs in 8 countries worldwide, all with the potential for another high-quality discovery.

We are developing Mingomba by applying the same technical rigor to resource development and mine planning as we do to exploration. Mingomba is also a scientific laboratory where we prototype new technology and workflows, combined with the expertise of veteran engineers. Our multidisciplinary team consists of mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. We want to develop world-class mining projects that are safer and have more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the role

This is a senior Engineering leadership role for the development of a significant Copper mining complex in Zambia. The Mingomba deposit contains over 10 million tonnes of copper more than half of which exceeds 6% grade. This role will help turn that world class deposit into a world class mine.

The Commercial Director establishes the commercial strategy, contracting approach, procurement and market engagement plan, and contractor management disciplines required to deliver the Mingomba project safely, competitively, and predictably. The role owns the commercial pathway from PFS and engineering delivery through package strategy, tendering, negotiation, award, contract administration, contractor performance, transition to operations and commercial close out. The Mingomba project is expected to require capital expenditure of more than US$2 billion, so the role requires a commercial leader who has built and run major-project commercial functions before.

What this role is accountable for delivering

This role provides the strategic commercial leadership for a significant greenfield project by setting the commercial direction, developing and implementing the strategies that flow from it and building and directing the team that delivers them. The successful candidate will be measured on:

A commercial strategy — delivery model, contracting approach, market engagement, and packaging — approved through project governance, delivered on schedule, and updated as conditions change.

A capable, high performing contracting, procurement and supply chain team built, developed and directed to deliver the targets with clear accountabilities and growing local capability

Major packages tendered and awarded to the baseline schedule with no critical path slippage attributable to procurement or contract formulation

Final contract outlays within the agreed band of the approved estimate, with commitments, cost exposure and forecasts visible to the project and finance at all times.

Claims and variation exposure quantified, contained and actively managed with no material unresolved disputes at handover to operations

Local content targets met with auditable evidence of local supplier participation and capability development

A procurement and contracting function that passes independent commercial audits and stage gate review without material qualification

A clean integrity record with no sanctions, bribery or conflict of interest findings in the supply chain and contracting workflows.

Responsibilities

Commercial governance and routines: Establish the commercial policies, approval thresholds, procurement gates, contract governance, tender review cadence, award recommendations, change controls, claims controls, and vendor management routines needed to support safe, competitive, and predictable project delivery.

Project delivery model and contracting options: Develop the project delivery model and contracting strategy (EPC, EPCM, design-and-build, owner-managed, or hybrid), assessing each option against risk, cost, schedule, market capacity, local content, and value for money

Commercial leadership and decision support: Lead commercial inputs into the project, executive forums and technical committees ensuring that contracting and procurement status, market intelligence and feedback, contractor risks, cost exposure, and package readiness are visible and early enough for management action.

Interface with engineering: Partner with the Senior Engineering & Integration Manager under a defined split of authority (engineering responsible for design authority and technical bid evaluation). The Commercial Director is responsible for commercial evaluation, contract formation and administration, with a single joint change control process spanning technical and commercial impacts.
