jobs.title: Senior Mine Engineer
jobs.description:
SUDBURY INTEGRATED NICKEL OPERATIONS (INO)

Sudbury, Ontario. Canada

100% site-based

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a
Senior Mine Engineer
to join our
Glencore

Sudbury Integrated Nickel Operations in Greater Sudbury, Ontario.

The position will be based in Onaping, Greater Sudbury, Ontario.

This is a full-time, permanent staff position.

Range of Pay: $143,689 to $160,593 (includes annual variable compensation bonus)

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

Work location is not accessible by public transportation.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. We encourage early applications.

Duties and Accountabilities

Reporting to the Chief Mine Engineer, the Senior Mine Engineer (SME) is accountable for the coordination and delivery of a significant portion of mine engineering services, as delegated by the Chief Mine Engineer. The SME is responsible to ensure that the engineering services provided are of high professional standard, meet all appropriate health, safety and environmental regulations and meet the goals of the organization.

The incumbent will act as designate to the Chief Mine Engineer in their absence and lead a significant portion of the annual site budget process and long-term business planning.

The SME is accountable for ensuring that technical systems, processes and standards at the mine are consistent with Sudbury INO best practices and follow the Mine Design and Engineering Guidelines documents. This will be achieved through a strong working relationship with technical personnel at all Sudbury INO underground operations.

The SME must ensure that processes are in place and followed to engage the operations personnel in the plans and technical issues so that there is joint ownership and shared understanding of the business plan.

About You

Your personal commitment to health, safety, training, and continuous improvement will be the key to your growth in this role.

Education and Skills

The incumbent requires a professional engineer registered in the Province of Ontario who has a minimum of 10 years of experience in mine engineering, mine design and preferably some experience in mine operations and/or management of projects.

Strong leadership and communication skills are a must as are initiative and a progressive change attitude.

May supervise up to seven technical employees and integrates the work of many more.

Has significant influence on a mine budget of $5 million to $25 million and significant impact on the long-term viability of the mine.

The incumbent has the authority to make professional engineering decisions on an independent basis and should feel free to resist pressures to change plans or designs (with appropriate explanations) if it compromises professional requirements.

Why choose Glencore?

Working at Glencore means choosing a safe environment where well-being, respect, fairness and integrity are top priorities. Glencore offers a range of career opportunities leading to a variety of paths within the company.

Additionally, Glencore Canada offers a series of benefits including:

Attractive salary

Comprehensive benefits

Performance Bonus

Wellness and Employee Assistance Programs

Opportunities to build your network

Through our IDEAL framework (Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, Advancement and Local), Glencore is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from underrepresented groups such as Indigenous people, women, the LGBTQ2S+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities and people from different cultural backgrounds. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, accommodation is available throughout our recruitment process for applicants with disabilities.

On this project, you will work a 14-days-on / 14-days-off schedule, with 12-hour shifts, and with the opportunity for overtime on days off. You will be responsible for the safe, efficient and effective repair and maintenance of machinery and components on heavy equipment, in the field, ensuring a high level of service quality and customer satisfaction.

Given the nature of the project and the proposed schedule, we are welcoming Field Technicians from Sparwood, Vancouver, Medicine Hat, Lethbridge, Red Deer, Kamloops, Kelowna, Black Diamond, Turner Valley, Calgary, Edmonton, among other adjacent locations. Accommodations are provided while on shift, and travel allowance is included for this role.

Responsibilities

Troubleshoot, inspect and diagnose Liebherr machinery and components including electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, engines, gearbox/drive train, etc. to resolve moderate to complex problems

Perform new and used machinery preparation, scheduled maintenance, repair or overhaul usually requiring component replacement, commissioning and adjustment of mechanical/hydraulic, electrical and pneumatic equipment, including warranty upgrades

Recondition and repair equipment components and systems as assigned

Perform pre-delivery inspections of equipment and new & used equipment preparation

Occasionally perform servicing on Liebherr machinery as directed, including fluid checks, and sample pulling, oil and filter checks, changing lubricants, replacing filters, greasing machine lube points etc.

Ensure components, material and/or equipment is inspected, is corrected to specifications and ensure timely delivery programs are achieved

Ensure all final verifications specified in work instructions, scope of work, verbal communication and specifications are carried out and complete

Accurate and timely submission of reports and technical document including service reports

Operate and maintain tools, equipment and work areas in accordance with company policy

Support in Shop repairs/work as requested

Other duties as assigned

Competencies

Red Seal Heavy Equipment Technician certification is mandatory

Working knowledge of electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical components

Demonstrated diagnostic and troubleshooting skills, component exchange, repair and warranty related activities

Ability to read and understand schematics and technical drawings

You are able to effectively communicate detailed and complex information in a clear and concise manner

You are self-motivated with the ability to work alone, unsupervised for extended periods of time

Fully proficient with computers and Microsoft Office suite

Our Offer

Competitive wages with overtime opportunities available, and $9.10/h in premiums additional to the base pay.

$1200 Travel Allowance per rotation, accommodations provided by Liebherr during the shift, at no cost to the employee.

Extensive benefits with employer paid premiums starting day 1

$5000 annual License Bonus*

Paid vacation starting at 3 weeks PLUS 6 dedicated family, health and wellness days

6% employer RRSP matching

$3000 annual allowance for continued education

$600 Annual Boot allowance for Liebherr Technicians

$400 Prescription Safety Glasses allowance

International training & development work opportunities for select roles*

Top of the line equipment

And much more!

jobs.title: Site Services Coordinator, Springer
jobs.description:
Site Services Coordinator

Location:
Springer Tungsten Mine & Mill, Imlay, Nevada

Department:
Site Services / Operations

Reports To:
Site Services Administrator

Position Summary

The Site Services Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to ensure the efficient delivery of site services at the Springer Mine. This role coordinates day-to-day activities that support employees, contractors, and visitors, including travel and accommodations, facilities, transportation, vendors, procurement, and general site logistics. Working closely with internal departments and service providers, the Site Services Coordinator helps maintain a safe, organized, and productive work environment.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate daily site support activities to ensure the effective delivery of site services.

Arrange employee and contractor travel, accommodations, transportation, and visitor logistics.

Support site access, onboarding, and coordination of contractors, vendors, and visitors.

Coordinate meetings, training sessions, employee events, and other site activities.

Assist with procurement by creating purchase requisitions, tracking orders, maintaining inventory, and verifying invoices.

Coordinate office, camp, and facility support, including housekeeping, catering, maintenance requests, office supplies, and workspace setup.

Maintain accurate records, service schedules, contractor documentation, and administrative files.

Monitor contractor and vendor performance and communicate service issues or improvement opportunities.

Support budget tracking, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives within Site Services.

Promote and support compliance with company health, safety, and environmental policies while participating in safety initiatives.

Qualifications

Education

High school diploma or GED required.

Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Logistics, Facilities Management, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.

Experience

2–5 years of experience in administration, logistics, facilities coordination, site services, or a similar support role.

Experience in mining, construction, industrial, or remote operations is considered an asset.

Skills & Qualifications

Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

Ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Experience with ERP or procurement systems is an asset.

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.

Ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple departments.

Working Conditions

Work is based at a surface mining operation in Imlay, Nevada.

Requires regular interaction with employees, contractors, vendors, and visitors.

Combination of office and field work with occasional travel throughout the site.

May require rotational or extended work schedules based on operational needs.

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in an active mining environment.

Ability to walk throughout the site and work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.

Ability to occasionally lift up to 30 pounds.

Pay range and compensation package

Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

The Jansen project in Saskatchewan, Canada is set to become one of the largest potash mines in the world and is located approximately 140 kilometers east of Saskatoon. As the largest investment in Saskatchewan’s history, Jansen is expected to generate approximately 5,500 workforce opportunities during construction and 900 long-term roles.

Once fully ramped up, Jansen is expected to have an initial production capacity of approximately 8.5 million tonnes per annum (Mtpa), with the potential to produce 16 to 17 Mtpa in future stages. To find out more about Potash and the Jansen project,

click here

BHP has recently been named one of Canada's top 100 employers again for 2026.  This formal recognition is a testament to our dedication to fostering a positive, diverse and rewarding work environment.

Work Location

This role will be based at the Jansen Mine Site located in Leroy, SK. The work schedule for this role will be seven days on, seven days off.  

For those not living locally, BHP provides relocation assistance to the local Jansen area. Alternatively, you can enjoy the convenience and comfort of our onsite camp accommodation at Discovery Lodge during your shifts.

BHP offers domestic relocation assistance to support the successful incumbent in transitioning, if required. Benefits offered as part of the relocation program include (but are not limited to) new home purchase assistance, temporary accommodations, home finding trip and a resettlement allowance. 

Purpose

We are excited to share that we are recruiting for permanent positions for mining Trade and Operations Supervisors.

Supervise operational activities to enable the delivery of continuous safe operations. 

Ensure safe, quality work execution of trades and contractors.

Promotes compliance of work instruction and operational procedures.

Drive business improvement through the measurement of BHP's performance.

Translate corporate objectives into actionable plans, communicating, managing and analyzing the implementation of those plans, and reporting back on their progress to facilitate the delivery of our strategy.

Identify and assess risks, makes risk informed decisions, uses BHP's risk management framework and builds a risk aware culture to support safe and productive performance outcomes. 

Conduct routine operational and safety meetings to effectively prepare for and manage operational workload.

Evaluate safety and operational performance and drives changes to maximise safety, cost and volume performance through processes, equipment and technology initiatives.

Embed practices/tools that enable teams to proactively identify improvement opportunities and detect deviations within daily mining and production activities across a site.

5+ Years mining Supervisor experience.

Prior experience leading a team or training experience is recommended.

Red Seal Certification (Trade roles).

Mine Supervisor Certification.

Demonstrated experience in managing teams and overseeing projects.

Strong communication skills.

Aptitude for building and maintaining strong relationships.

jobs.description:
About BHP

At BHP, we believe our purpose goes beyond mining: we work to improve lives and create a more sustainable future. We are a global resources company with operations in more than 90 locations worldwide. 

In Canada, our presence is growing with the development of 
one of the most significant potash projects in the world — Jansen
. This project reflects our long‑term commitment to sustainability, community engagement, and economic growth. 

About BHP - Jansen

Imagine being part of something truly world‑class — something shaping the future of sustainable agriculture and responsible resource development. That’s what the Jansen Potash Project offers. 

Located about 140 kilometres east of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Jansen is set to become one of the largest and most sustainable potash mines on the planet. With a CAD$14 billion (US$10.5 billion) investment, it represents the largest private investment in Saskatchewan’s history, and a bold step forward for BHP in Canada. 

But Jansen is more than a mine; it’s a long‑term opportunity to build something meaningful. During construction, it will create ~5,500 jobs, and once operating, ~900 permanent roles. Whether you're looking to grow your career, contribute to a sustainable future, or be part of a legacy project, Jansen could be the place where it all begins. 

Why BHP?

At BHP, we are transforming the way mining is done. We embrace innovation, sustainability, and inclusion to build a smarter, safer, and more human future. 

We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2025, a testament to our dedication to fostering a positive, diverse, and rewarding work environment. Here, you’ll be part of a team that values safety, integrity, performance, and collaboration. 

Work Location

This role will be based at the Jansen Mine Site located in Leroy, SK.  The work schedule for this role is 8/80.

For those not living locally, BHP provides relocation assistance to the local Jansen area. Alternatively, you can enjoy the convenience and comfort of our onsite camp accommodation at Discovery Lodge during your shifts. 

BHP offers domestic relocation assistance to support the successful incumbent in transitioning, if required. Benefits offered as part of the relocation program include (but are not limited to) new home purchase assistance, temporary accommodations, home finding trip and a resettlement allowance. 

The Challenge Ahead

Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the Superintendent Maintenance (underground) will effectively help support the assembly and ongoing routine maintenance of continuous boring machines, extensible belts and auxiliary systems related to production mining.  Ownership of additional assets will grow as the mine expands.

In this role, you will:

Oversee assembly and overall mechanical maintenance of all underground assets including continuous mining machines, mobile equipment, conveyor belts and structural assets such as bins and feeders.

Ensure direct reports have the necessary tools, training and skillsets required to perform work safely.

Utilize the enterprise Maintenance system (SAP) to execute proper preventative maintenance plans and ensure key performance indicators related to in-field execution.

Manage department spending and drive future facing projects related to the department.

Be able to learn and adhere to applicable BHP company policies and procedures.

Engage in field safety activities (FLEX), risk assessments and toolbox meetings.

Support/maintain BHP Operating System practices which drive continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Self-motivated with an aptitude for learning and understanding equipment operation and maintenance.

Holds certification as a mechanical engineer, mechanical technologist, project manager or a journeyperson in a suitable trade.

Applicable experience in underground mining, preferably potash and able to obtain/retain a Saskatchewan underground Supervisor ticket.  (Minimum 3 Years)

Experience using an asset management system such as SAP

A strong safety conscious mindset.

Strong communication skills

An individual looking to be part of a positive team environment.

Professional Development: Continuous learning and meaningful growth opportunities.

Compensation: Fair, competitive, and aligned with your skills and contributions.

At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are several checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants' suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks.  The outcome of these checks is not determinative or whether or not BHP decides to make an offer of employment.

jobs.title: Technical Specialist - Embedded Application Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Location: Kidlington, Oxford, Unit 5 Technology Dr,

Roster: Monday to Friday 

Role Purpose:

The Technical Specialist in Application Engineering team will lead the integration and validation of the Elysia Embedded product.

Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver high performance battery state estimation and control, and diagnostics and prognostics algorithms aimed at maximizing the performance, safety and life of battery systems.

Key Responsibilities

•    Leads customer requirements gathering and elicitation into software requirements. 
•    Lead collaboration with cross-functional teams, including software developers, product and project managers, to ensure seamless integration of Elysia Embedded algorithms into customer’s BMS application software.
•    Lead the evaluation of Elysia Embedded algorithms in customer’s controlled and live operating environments (e.g., Virtual, Cell-In-The-Loop, HIL, EOL, vehicle testing).
•    Support hardware benchmarking of Elysia Embedded algorithms.
•    Lead pilot projects, proof of concepts, technical workshops and presentations to demonstrate the capabilities and benefits of Elysia Embedded to potential and existing customers.
•    Fulfil the role of a Lead Application Engineer in Delivery Squads, being responsible for the technical leading of projects delivered to customers.
•    Write and maintain customer facing documentation, maintain fluency of Elysia Embedded Products for communicating capabilities to customers.
•    Defines software quality and compliance with relevant certifications (e.g., MAAB, ASPICE).
•    Owns technical specialist delivery in multiple domains, such as requirements elicitation, system architecting, customer calibration & validation, and/or software delivery.

Qualifications and Experience

Details of the experience needed to be successful in the role, the qualifications essential/desirable to be able to fulfil the role and any specific behavioral traits.

Essential:

•    Experience in customer-facing roles, providing technical support and translating customer requirements into technical solutions.

•    Bachelor’s or master’s degree with a minimum 2:1 (or equivalent) in a relevant STEM subject (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computing, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, etc.).

•    Expertise in code generation using MATLAB/Simulink.

•    Experience with version control and CI/CD frameworks (e.g., Github, Gitlab, Azure DevOps).

•    Excellent communication skills and the ability to prioritize tasks and maintain a high-level view of project goals.

•    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and analytically.

•    To have a ‘can do’ proactive attitude day in day out and proactively support and collaborate with others.

•    They will be able to take on innovative ideas, concepts, and ways of working to meet strict project deadlines.

•    Willingness to proactively build new relationships & connections across the business in support of team & company goals.

Beneficial:

•    Experience with Requirements Elicitation methods.

•    Experience in embedded state estimation algorithm development.

•    Experience in electro-thermal modelling of battery systems. 

•    Experience in ASPICE processes.

•    Experience in electrical testing of battery cells, including development of test plans.

•    Experience with embedded systems and hardware

This job description is not exhaustive, and the job holder will be required to carry out from time-to-time tasks in addition to the above that will be both reasonable and within their capabilities.

About Us

At Elysia, we are at the forefront of revolutionizing the life, safety, and performance of battery systems, across markets and industries. 

As a pioneering technology company, we specialize in the development of cutting-edge software solutions that supports, optimises and de-risks the deployment of batteries, from cradle to grave, starting with design and manufacture, through to first-life monitoring and the transition to second-life or recycling.

Our team of brilliant minds and passionate experts are dedicated to pushing the boundaries in software-derived performance, both within embedded BMS and cloud-based domains. We believe in the combination of expertise in electrochemistry, battery systems and data science to build products that empower our customers to unlock the full potential of their battery assets.

Elysia is wholly owned business of Fortescue, a top 10 ASX listed company. Fortescue is a world leading mining and energy company, who has committed to reach net zero by 2030. As one of its flagship customers, Elysia is working closely with Fortescue to assist with the decarbonisation of their operations.

Our Commitment

Fortescue celebrates individual strengths and team members are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics. 
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

https://fortescue.com/careers

Internal Candidates / Current Contractors please apply via Success Factors Careers Portal. For further information on how to apply please visit the Fortescue Hub. 

Fortescue reserves the right to close applications early should a suitable pool of candidates be identified. Fortescue will never contact you to ask for payment of any kind, whether directly or through a third party.

jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Work Location: 
Iron Bridge - located on the traditional lands of the Nyamal people.

Roster: 
8D/6R - FIFO ex Perth

Employment Type:
6-month Secondment

Fortescue is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer for a
6-month secondment
at Iron Bridge, providing technical leadership and specialist electrical engineering support across the Ore Processing Facility (OPF) and Concentrate Handling Facility (CHF).

Reporting to the Engineering & Reliability Superintendent, this role will lead and support a small team of Electrical Engineers, while working closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering & Reliability and Energy Operations to support the safe, reliable and efficient operation of Iron Bridge electrical assets.

The position provides an opportunity to combine hands-on electrical engineering, technical leadership and team development in a complex fixed-plant operating environment, with a strong focus on reliability, asset performance and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership and day-to-day support to a team of Electrical Engineers, setting priorities, reviewing engineering work and supporting capability development.

Provide specialist electrical engineering support across the Iron Bridge OPF and CHF to maintain safe, reliable and efficient plant operation.

Support Operations and Maintenance teams with fault finding, troubleshooting and resolution of electrical breakdowns and recurring equipment issues across HV/LV systems, switchgear, motors, VSDs, protection, controls and instrumentation.

Lead and facilitate root cause analysis and reliability improvement initiatives, using plant performance, reliability data and asset-management KPIs to identify risks and prevent repeat failures.

Develop and implement electrical maintenance and reliability improvements, including maintenance strategies, technical documentation and change-management requirements.

Scope and support small to medium electrical improvement and sustaining-capital projects, including engineering input through construction, commissioning and performance verification.

Qualifications and Experience

Tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering.

5–10 years’ electrical engineering experience, ideally in mining, mineral processing, fixed plant or heavy industry.

Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring or supervision to engineers or technical personnel.

Strong knowledge of HV/LV power systems, switchgear, motors, VSDs, protection systems, PLCs, controls and instrumentation.

Proven capability in fault finding, root cause analysis, reliability improvement and maintenance strategy optimisation.

Strong understanding of electrical safety, relevant legislation, standards and engineering governance.

Experience using SAP or a similar CMMS.

jobs.title: Reservoir Engineer
jobs.description:
About Woodside Energy and Sangomar

Woodside Energy is the operator of the Sangomar field, Senegal’s first offshore oil development, which achieved first production in 2024. The initial phase of development includes 12 production wells, 10 water injectors, and 2 gas injectors, tied back via subsea infrastructure to a Floating Production Storage and Offloading facility with ~100,000 barrels of oil per day capacity.

Sangomar represents a strategic, high-impact asset in an emerging hydrocarbon basin, offering direct exposure to reservoir management, production optimisation, and future development phases. The asset provides an opportunity to work within a multicultural, high-performing team across Dakar and Houston, while contributing to Senegal’s energy future and long-term resource development.

About the Opportunity

An exciting opportunity exists to join the Sangomar Subsurface team based in Dakar, Senegal.

The Subsurface team is responsible for the delivery of all subsurface production and development activities, including:

Reservoir management and surveillance

Production forecasting and optimisation

Field development planning

Reserves and resources evaluation

Engagement with joint venture partners and the Ministry of Energy and Petroleum

The team operates across Dakar and Houston, Texas, requiring strong collaboration across locations and disciplines.

Role Overview

The Reservoir Engineer will support short- to medium-term production forecasting, reservoir management, and production optimisation, while contributing to subsurface deliverables and external stakeholder engagements.

Key responsibilities include:

Develop and maintain integrated reservoir models to support optimisation and development decisions

 Deliver short- and medium-term production forecasts across the uncertainty range

Support history matching using field performance and surveillance data

Prepare subsurface inputs to the annual budget, aligned with operational assumptions

Contribute to reservoir management plans, surveillance strategies, and subsurface work programmes

Support production optimisation in close collaboration with Production Engineering

Provide input to well prioritisation and performance targets

Participate in joint venture and government technical engagements, presenting reservoir insights and forecasts

Support collaboration with Petrosen and Ministry stakeholders

Contribute to future development studies and optimisation of future development phase opportunities

Perform technical evaluations of wellwork and intervention opportunities

Support well integrity monitoring and performance tracking

About You

Legal right to work in Senegal

Degree in Petroleum, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering or related discipline

7+ years’ experience in the oil and gas industry with strong reservoir engineering exposure

Demonstrated experience in reservoir modelling and integrated system analysis

Experience in production forecasting and reservoir management  

Exposure to cross-functional collaboration (subsurface, operations, wells)

Strong communication skills, with ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Mentoring or coaching experience is advantageous

Fluent in English

Key Capabilities

Strong collaboration and integration skills across subsurface, wells, and operations

Ability to manage uncertainty and deliver pragmatic solutions

Effective communication and stakeholder engagement, including JV and government interfaces

Proven problem-solving and analytical capability

Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and sense of urgency

Strong focus on risk management and value delivery

jobs.title: Specialist - Corporate Affairs (Government & Stakeholder Relations)
jobs.description:
You’re talented and adaptable. That’s why you’ll fit in.

The strategic objective of the Marketing business is to sustainably maximise cash flows from the marketing of Anglo American’s and third parties’ mined products, and related services. As we prioritise the most value accretive activities of Marketing, we have set ourselves a target to deliver a considerable uplift in value contribution to Anglo American.

The Corporate Affairs discipline ensures that Anglo American stands out as a trusted leader in responsible mining that unlocks long-term value for society by: engaging proactively and meaningfully with relevant stakeholders to support strategic opportunities and shape public policy outcomes; effectively mitigating political risk; rallying employees around the company’s ambitions to help build a high performance culture; and protecting and strengthening our global reputation and brand.

China is Anglo American’s largest market and an increasingly critical jurisdiction, accounting for 50% of revenue in 2025 (USD 9.6 billion). This reflects not only strong demand but also deeper commercial exposure following recent portfolio changes. More broadly, Asia, within China’s sphere of influence, accounts for 76% of revenue. Historically viewed primarily as a sales destination, China’s role is expanding across supply chains, equity investment, and innovation, alongside growing institutional and commercial engagement. In response, Anglo American is adopting a more proactive and nuanced approach to strengthen relationships, navigate geopolitical sensitivities, and capture emerging opportunities in this evolving landscape.

What you'll do

This role supports the Manager – Corporate Affairs, China & Northeast Asia by executing government relations, stakeholder engagement, and corporate activities across China. It assists in strengthening Anglo American’s strategic positioning by building and expanding relationships with key stakeholders, managing executive visits, and coordinating high-level conferences and events. The role ensures that activities align with Anglo American’s
Purpose
, strategy, values, and business priorities in China and Asia more broadly.

The role collaborates with internal teams such as Group Legal & Corporate Affairs, Marketing Corporate Affairs and CMTs, and AARTC, as well as external partners, to implement initiatives that advance Anglo American’s corporate reputation, foster key relationships, and support the company's long-term growth in China.

KEY TASKS

Government Relations (China & Ex-China)

Support the drafting and implementation of the China Corporate Affairs strategy and engagement plan through research, analysis, and coordination activities in alignment with the Manager’s direction.

Maintain and update stakeholder mapping and analysis to identify, prioritise, and track relevant government, regulatory, and non-government stakeholders, supporting engagement planning and execution.

Monitor and analyse the policy, regulatory, geopolitical, and macroeconomic environment of China and the relevant countries

Track and analyse peer company activities, industry positioning, and engagement approaches, providing insights and supporting recommendations to inform Corporate Affairs strategies and priorities.

Prepare high-quality briefing materials, policy summaries, and analytical reports that translate regulatory and political developments into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.

Maintain structured records of stakeholder engagements, policy developments, and regulatory interactions to support reporting and follow-up activities.

Support the assessment of stakeholder engagement activities by compiling outcomes, insights, and supporting analysis for senior review.

Executive Visits, Conferences and Events

Support the planning, coordination, and execution of senior executive visits, conference participation, and high-level stakeholder engagements under the guidance of the Manager.

Assist in the preparation of tailoured briefing materials, talking points, background notes, and stakeholder profiles for meetings with government officials, regulators, and key external partners.

Coordinate meeting logistics and engagement preparation with government and external stakeholders, ensuring all materials and arrangements are completed to a high standard.

Support the planning and coordination of corporate participation in key conferences (e.g., China Development Forum), forums, and industry platforms, ensuring alignment with strategic messaging and engagement priorities.

Provide operational and on-the-ground support during executive visits and events, ensuring smooth execution and timely resolution of issues.

Support post-event follow-up, including tracking action items, engagement outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to ensure continuity of engagements.

BU & CMT Corporate Affairs Support

Support BU and CMT teams by providing Corporate Affairs input to help advance their business objectives in China.

Contribute to ensuring alignment between BU and CMT activities and broader Corporate Affairs priorities.

Support coordination between Corporate Affairs and BU/CMT teams to enable effective collaboration.

Teamwork and Collaboration

Work closely with the Manager to support delivery of Corporate Affairs objectives in China.

Collaborate effectively across Legal & Corporate Affairs, Marketing Corporate Affairs and CMTs, AARTC, as well as other internal and external stakeholders to implement initiatives.

Contribute to a collaborative team environment and continuous improvement of processes and outputs.

Provide back-up support to the other Specialist to ensure continuity of activities.

Health, Safety & Environment

Demonstrate behaviour in line with health, safety and environmental standards and with the Group’s values.

Set the health, safety and environmental expectations for your team and monitor behaviour so that it meets the required standards.

jobs.title: Chief Mining Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company:

KoBold Metals Zambia Limited is a Zambian-led company exploring for the ore deposits that will become the next generation of new mines in Zambia.

KoBold Metals Zambia is the Zambian affiliate of KoBold Metals, a U.S.-based company exploring around the world for battery metals using proprietary AI to guide exploration decisions. Our business is discovering, defining, expanding, and developing mineral resources, and our objective is to achieve a step-change improvement in exploration success, resulting in more tier 1 resources discovered faster, with fewer failures, and with far less exploration capital.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

KoBold Metals Zambia is building a rapidly growing team of Zambian geologists, operators, and executives to identify, acquire, explore, and develop exploration opportunities and mineral resources drawing upon KoBold’s technology and the expertise of colleagues worldwide.

About the job:

This role reports into the Vice President of Projects and leads the full mine design, planning, and production scheduling efforts for KoBold’s Mingomba project, including pre-feasibility and feasibility engineering studies. The role is responsible for the strategy, implementation and execution of the mine design program consistent with the project's development plans and in coordination with engineering, construction and operations teams. The role owns all component modelling work around the mine and also builds a collaborative relationship to support synergies with surrounding mine operators. Candidates who have worked as Mine Technical Services Managers are also suitable for this role.

You will join an outstanding team of geoscientists, engineers, data scientists, and software engineers. You will be a core part of the project team, supporting the advancement of the science and practice of exploration. You will support the development of novel data collection and monitoring programs. Lead and manage service providers providing specialist technical inputs

Build and maintain robust WBS/OBS/RBS structures and activity coding to enable multi-level reporting (program; project; area; system; subsystem).

Integrate with cost control to support Earned Value Management (EVM); reconcile schedule and cost performance (SPI/CPI) and explain variances.

Define progress measurement rules of credit and automate performance tracking at work‑package and system levels.

Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is an asset.

jobs.title: Operador(a) de Chancado en Planta Arequipa / Muestreo y Perforación / 14x7 (Ref: 106234)
jobs.description:
Por encargo de nuestro cliente, importante empresa de minería, nos encontramos en la búsqueda del mejor talento para cubrir el puesto de Operador(a) Chancado para Arequipa ¡La oportunidad de tener un futuro mejor, está aquí!
FUNCIONES: 
Recepcionar ticket de lote, registrar número de tolva, número de sacos, procedencia, tipo de análisis. Anotar la información en el cuaderno de registro.  
Operar los equipos del circuito de chancado como: reciprocantes, chancadoras, grislly, zaranda, fajas, divisor rotatorio. 
Efectuar el muestreo y cuarteo correspondiente del lote de mineral obteniendo una muestra representativa. 
Realizar el embolsado, sellado y codificado de la muestra según el ticket entregado por el artesano minero en tolva. 
Anotar en el cuaderno de registro de preparación de muestra. 
Liberar mineral retenido en tolva utilizando la barretilla (chucear). 
Preparar referenciales de mineral dejados por artesanos mineros. 
Realizar orden y limpieza de todo el circuito y el área de trabajo. 
Reportar fallas y necesidades al jefe de guardia en el circuito de chancado. 
Recepcionar lotes de arenilla con su respectivo ticket para luego identificarlo con un letrero. 
Realizar muestreo de mineral y arenilla en cancha siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos. 
Rotular los sacos con el respectivo número de lote. 
Identificar los lotes a levantar y juntarlos para armar la pila de mineral/arenilla según sea el caso. 
Realizar el muestreo de la pila de mineral/arenilla y depositarlo en un saco (blending). 
Coordinar con la supervisión para el envío volquetes con mineral/arenilla de la pila armada con dirección a planta. 
El operador operara el equipo minicargador para extender los lotes a muestrear/remuestrear. 
El operador operara el equipo minicargador para levantar lotes en cancha lagarto. 
Entre otras funciones inherentes al puesto solicitados por el jefe(a) inmediato(a).
REQUISITOS: 
Secundaria Completa. 
Experiencia mínima de 1 año en técnicas de muestreo y/o trabajos de perforación. 
Conocimiento en el muestreo y manipulación de equipos de muestreo. 
Disponibilidad inmediata para laborar en San Juan de Chorunga, Rio Grande, Condesuyo, Arequipa bajo sistema 14x7 desde las 7:00 a.m. a 7:00 p.m. 
Residir en Arequipa (INDISPENSABLE)
BENEFICIOS: 
Ingreso a planilla de Manpower, con todos los beneficios de ley. 
Salario acorde al mercado. 
Integrar el equipo de trabajo de una empresa sólida y reconocida. 
En Manpower Perú, promovemos la inclusión e inserción laboral sin distinción por razón de discapacidad, género, orientación, identidad y expresión de género, lugar de origen o generación. Por ello ¡Todos los talentos son bienvenidos!.

jobs.title: Superintendente de Geología (Mina Brownfield y Reservas)
jobs.description: Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Superintendente de Geología para liderar la gestión geológica de una compañía minera líder en el sector, en un contexto de transformación y fortalecimiento del área. La posición tendrá como principal desafío tomar el control y ordenar la gestión de Geología Mina, fortaleciendo el equipo y asegurando una mayor integración con la operación.Se busca un líder cercano al negocio y con fuerte presencia en campo, capaz de generar confianza en los equipos y entregar información técnica oportuna para la toma de decisiones de la Gerencia. Será además un actor clave en la evolución de la estructura del área y en los desafíos asociados al crecimiento y continuidad de la operaciónFunciones: - Liderar la gestión de Geología Mina, asegurando el adecuado soporte geológico a las operaciones subterráneas.- Tomar el control y fortalecer la estructura del área, optimizando la organización, roles y desempeño del equipo.- Supervisar el control geológico de la operación, incluyendo mapeo, muestreo, interpretación, modelamiento y seguimiento de la información geológica.- Liderar las actividades de exploración brownfield asociadas a la operación, identificando oportunidades para incrementar el conocimiento y potencial del yacimiento.- Asegurar la calidad y confiabilidad de la información geológica utilizada para la planificación y toma de decisiones operativas.- Supervisar el cumplimiento de estándares y buenas prácticas de QA/QC, JORC y NI 43-101.- Coordinar permanentemente con Gerencia de Operaciones, Planeamiento, Mina y otras áreas técnicas, entregando información geológica oportuna para la operación.- Preparar y presentar informes y resultados técnicos a la Gerencia de Operaciones y Gerencia General.- Desarrollar y gestionar un equipo de aproximadamente 40 personas entre profesionales y personal operativo, promoviendo disciplina, desarrollo técnico y trabajo colaborativo.- Mantener una alta presencia en campo, identificando problemas geológicos y operativos y proponiendo soluciones técnicas.- Gestionar los recursos, presupuesto y programas de trabajo del área, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos y prioridades de la operación.- Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad, medio ambiente y normativa minera aplicables a las actividades geológicas. Requisitos: Profesional titulado y colegiado en Geología o Ingeniería Geológica, con 15+ años de experiencia en minería y al menos 5 años en posiciones como Jefe de Geología, Superintendente o equivalentes, proveniente idealmente de operaciones de mediana minería hacia arriba. Experiencia comprobada en minería subterránea convencional y mecanizada, Geología Mina y exploración brownfield, así como liderazgo de equipos numerosos. Sólidos conocimientos en JORC, NI 43-101, QA/QC, modelamiento geológico y Recursos y Reservas, siendo deseable experiencia en procesos de certificación. Se requiere un perfil con alta competencia técnica, orientación operativa y fuerte presencia en campo, capacidad de liderazgo y comunicación con niveles gerenciales. Inglés intermedio deseable.
